ARC-001.subject: E1.persistent_predictive_substrate
ARC-001.title: E1 is the persistent predictive substrate.
ARC-001.what_would_answer:
ARC-001 asserts E1 functions as a genuinely PERSISTENT predictive substrate --
carries information across a boundary a non-persistent/reset predictor would
lose it at. Never tested as its own claim (0 genuine_exp entries; sole
evidence is an indirect macaque-V4 literature analogy, not a direct
persistence measurement). Assumed via 23 dependent claims, not measured.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: E1's fast component (LSTM hidden state) is
explicitly and unconditionally cleared at every episode boundary via
reset_hidden_state() (agent.py:3012, :9390) -- so "E1 persists" is NOT
vacuously true of the whole module. The asserted-persistent component is
specifically ContextMemory's 16-slot associative bank, which
reset_hidden_state() never touches and which is separately offline-gated
during sleep (MECH-120/SD-017). A genuine test requires (a) a real
before/after boundary, and (b) a stateless comparator that ALSO zeroes
context_memory.memory at that boundary, so persistence is measured
against a matched non-persistent baseline.

MEASUREMENT: write distinguishable content into context_memory during
episode N, let reset_hidden_state() fire normally, measure retrieval at
the first few post-boundary steps in episode N+1 against a zeroed-memory
ablation at the same boundary. Reuse existing readouts (cosine similarity
already computed in _get_context_memory_code_contributions, or the
MECH-216 schema-salience head) rather than inventing new instrumentation.
Repeat across the sleep/consolidation boundary using the offline-mode
gate as the ablation lever.

ANSWER "persistent" (PASS) if the memory-intact condition shows
above-baseline retrieval in the first few post-boundary steps (>= 0.8 SD
of the seed-to-seed delta), while the zeroed-memory ablation shows none.

ANSWER "not functionally persistent" (FAIL) if there is no measurable
advantage over the zeroed-memory baseline -- would falsify "persistent
predictive substrate" as functionally distinguishing E1 from a stateless
predictor, and would prompt review of the 23 dependent claims.

ARC-002.subject: E2.fast_forward_predictor
ARC-002.title: E2 is the fast forward predictor of affordances.
ARC-002.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test environment must have genuine
context-dependent action viability -- some actions available/effective only
in some states, not others (e.g. causal_grid_world.py's per-tick
consummatory-act affordance flag, gated on resource-zone entry). Without
this, "E2 predicts affordances" collapses into the untestable claim "E2
predicts world dynamics" -- there is no affordance structure distinct from
raw transition dynamics for E2 to get right or wrong.

CONFIRMING: E2's action-conditioned forward predictions (world_forward /
action_object, ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) discriminate viable from
non-viable actions at a given state above a naive baseline -- e.g. a
readout over predicted world-effect (reusing the action_object o_t
representation, or the per-action-class viability-index pattern already
built for the narrow escape domain in
ree_core/pfc/e2_escape_affordance_linker.py, generalised beyond
threat/escape) correlates with ground-truth action viability/success at a
state, exceeding a baseline that assumes all actions are equally viable.
A weaker but still confirming form: cand_world_pairwise_dist /
world_forward_contrastive_loss (SD-056) shows predicted-outcome divergence
across actions that tracks true viability differences, not just generic
state drift.

FALSIFYING: E2's action-conditioned predictions show no advantage over a
uniform-viability baseline (predicted outcome/viability uncorrelated with
which actions are actually available/successful at a state) -- i.e. E2
behaves as a generic world-dynamics predictor that happens to be indexed
by action, without encoding "what am I able to do here" as a structure
distinct from "what happens next." This would not falsify E2 as a forward
predictor (ARC-001/E1-adjacent claims are unaffected) -- it would falsify
specifically the "of affordances" qualifier in ARC-002's title, meaning
the affordance-manifold language in e2.md sec 3 should be revised to plain
outcome-prediction language.

ARC-003.subject: E3.trajectory_commitment
ARC-003.title: E3 selects and commits trajectories.
ARC-003.what_would_answer:
ARC-003 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "E3 SELECTS" and "E3 COMMITS" are separate assertions
with OPPOSITE readiness. Digested 2026-07-21 by splitting on testability.

LEG A -- SELECTION (testable now, COMMITMENT-FREE).
ANSWER "E3 selects" if the E3 score gradient over the candidate set is non-flat
and predicts the taken candidate above chance, AND lesioning the E3 contribution
to the score collapses selection toward the candidate-generation prior.
ANSWER "E3 is a pass-through, not a selector" (FAIL) if candidate choice is
statistically indistinguishable from the proposer's prior. MECH-060/061/062 and
the tri-loop gating claims would then lose their premise.
NON-DEGENERACY: the candidate pool must be DIVERGENT (cand_world_pairwise_dist
above floor -- the GAP-A guard). Scoring a pool of near-identical candidates
tests nothing and would manufacture either verdict. Measured at the scoring
level; requires NO sustained execution.

LEG B -- COMMITMENT (BLOCKED; not queueable as of 2026-07-21).
ANSWER "E3 commits" if a selected trajectory persists across >= N steps under a
perturbation that would flip an uncommitted selector, with a measurable
release/switch cost (hysteresis).
This leg requires SUSTAINED MULTI-STEP ACTION COMMITMENT, and the basal-ganglia /
action-commitment layer is under active construction (ARC-107 BG-selector
constitution; MECH-448 demotion lever provisional; MECH-449 substrate_conditional;
commit/release-duration falsifiers 460j/485i/654h pending). A behavioural FAIL run
now would RE-DERIVE THE F-DOMINANCE CONVERSION CEILING ("a navigable landscape
does not convert to committed action because the selector drowns it"), NOT
adjudicate ARC-003 -- a confound, not a verdict.
RELEASE CONDITION: ARC-107 BG-selector constitution landed AND the
commit/release-duration levers (460j / 485i / 654h) returned.

ARC-004.subject: L_space.latent_stack
ARC-004.title: L-space is a multi-timescale latent stack.
ARC-004.what_would_answer:
ARC-004 asserts that L-space's z_beta/z_theta/z_delta layers are genuinely
stratified by TIMESCALE, not merely by role/information-content within a
single-rate recurrence. This has never been tested as its own claim (absent
from claim_evidence.v1.json) -- it is currently assumed via 36 dependents'
architecture, not measured.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: as-built, LatentStack.encode smooths z_beta,
z_theta, and z_delta with a SINGLE SHARED EMA constant (alpha_shared = 0.3,
hardcoded, ree_core/latent/stack.py) -- there is no differential clock rate
across the three layers. So the claim is NOT vacuously true by construction;
any timescale differentiation must emerge from the recursive top-down
architecture (z_delta reads only z_theta's history, z_theta reads only
z_beta's, so information at each level is progressively more temporally
aggregated) rather than from a built-in rate split. A genuine null (no
differentiation) is possible and must be measurable, not assumed away.
Precedent for taking this seriously: MECH-058 asserted an adjacent
"timescale separation" framing (for the z_self/z_world split) and was
directly tested in V3-EXQ-019 via lag-k autocorrelation -- it FAILED and
the claim was retired (superseded by MECH-069, "incommensurable domains,"
not timescale). ARC-004 could suffer the same fate.

MEASUREMENT: log z_beta(t), z_theta(t), z_delta(t) trajectories over an
evaluation rollout (no code change needed -- reuse V3-EXQ-019's lag-k
autocorrelation / persistence-half-life methodology per layer instead of
per z_self/z_world). Optionally corroborate with a per-layer decomposition
of MECH-423's inference_convergence readout (currently a single relative-
delta over the concatenated [z_beta,z_theta,z_delta] vector -- would need
unpacking by layer, a small extension since the per-layer tensors already
exist inside LatentStack.encode's settling loop).

ANSWER "multi-timescale" (PASS) if the layers show a monotonic ordering of
effective persistence -- z_delta autocorrelation half-life > z_theta's >
z_beta's -- by a margin exceeding cross-seed noise (>= 0.8 SD of the
seed-to-seed half-life delta, matching the effect-size convention used
elsewhere in this registry), AND (if measured) MECH-423 per-layer
convergence rates show the same ordering (z_delta settles slowest).

ANSWER "layers differ in content, not timescale" (FAIL) if autocorrelation
half-life is statistically indistinguishable across z_beta/z_theta/z_delta
despite their different informational roles -- i.e. the architecture
nominally stratifies by timescale but in practice all three layers carry
functionally identical temporal persistence. This would not remove the
layers' functional roles but would mean "multi-timescale" is the wrong
description of why they work, structurally analogous to what happened to
MECH-058, and would prompt a supersession review of ARC-004's framing.

ARC-005.subject: control_plane.precision_routing
ARC-005.title: Control plane routes precision and modes.
ARC-005.what_would_answer:
The falsifiable content is NOT "a control plane exists" (that is a design fact --
we built one). It is that the control plane ROUTES: has causal authority over
precision and mode that is DISSOCIABLE FROM CONTENT. If precision and mode are
readouts of what the agent happens to be processing, the plane is epiphenomenal
and all 88 dependents inherit a false premise.
Testable in V3 as a DOUBLE DISSOCIATION over the implemented channel set
(5-HT rigidity, phasic-surprise-burst gain, SalienceCoordinator mode prior,
pcc_stability mu): a 2x2 of {channels varied, content fixed} x {content varied,
channels fixed}, measuring (i) the E3 precision readout and (ii) mode-occupancy
distribution.
ANSWER "routes" (PASS) if channel intervention shifts precision and mode occupancy
monotonically with channel setting, AND the channel effect on mode occupancy
exceeds the content effect by >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed DELTA and by an absolute
floor of >= 0.15 occupancy-fraction, AND identical channel settings reproduce the
same regime across differing content.
ANSWER "readout, not router" (FAIL) if mode occupancy and precision are predicted
as well or better from content features than from channel settings. ARC-005 then
demotes and its dependents need re-derivation from whatever does the routing.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict): in the
baseline arm at least two modes must be occupied >= 5% of steps, and the precision
readout must carry non-zero cross-seed variance (not floor-pinned). A single-mode-
collapsed agent makes both arms trivially identical and the comparison vacuous.
SCOPE: tests routing authority over the CURRENTLY-IMPLEMENTED channels. A PASS
does not vindicate every channel posited in MECH-002/MECH-004; it establishes the
plane is causal rather than decorative.

ARC-006.subject: entities.binding
ARC-006.title: Entities are sparse, persistent, bindable structures.
ARC-006.what_would_answer:
ARC-006 asserts entities are (i) sparse, (ii) persistent, (iii) bindable
structures. Two of the three properties already have direct
experimental support one hop away: MECH-045's V3-EXQ-658 (2026-06-09,
PASS/supports) exercises ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py's
token-continuity association (C1/C5) and occlusion-persistence (C3) and
shows the buffer re-identifies a moved entity across occlusion
(reid_frac INTACT=1.0 vs SHUFFLE=0.3 vs OFF=0.0, feature term
non-degenerate d_cos_min=0.92, 3/3 seeds) -- "persistent" and "bindable
[across motion]" are effectively answered, but the evidence is tagged
only to MECH-045's claim_ids, not to ARC-006. [Note: a prior digestion
memory calling this "V3 pending" was stale as of this pass -- MECH-045
landed 2026-06-09.]

The third property, "sparse," is NOT yet exercised: V3-EXQ-658
deliberately set obf_max_tokens = N_DISTRACTORS + 2 (one slot of
headroom) to guarantee zero capacity evictions, isolating reid/
persistence from competitive contention. The buffer's C4
capacity-eviction machinery (_enforce_capacity(), _n_capacity_evictions,
default max_tokens=5) exists and is wired but has never run
over-capacity.

What would answer this (no new substrate build -- only a new experiment
config over the existing ObjectFileBuffer):
1. Bridge existing evidence: tag/synthesize V3-EXQ-658 onto ARC-006's
   own evidence block so "persistent"/"bindable-across-motion" support
   is visible at the parent-claim level.
2. Run a capacity-contention arm: N entities > max_tokens (e.g. 8
   salient candidates against max_tokens=5), varying per-entity
   salience, and test whether _enforce_capacity's evictions track the
   TRUE salience ranking above a shuffle/random-eviction control (same
   INTACT/SHUFFLE/OFF logic as V3-EXQ-658, applied to eviction choice).
   PASS = eviction selectivity beats shuffle control on >=2/3 seeds;
   FAIL = evictions are salience-independent (effectively FIFO/random),
   falsifying "sparse [attention-gated]" even though the raw capacity
   cap trivially holds.
3. Complementary confirming test (structurally parallel to SD-015's
   z_resource identity-recovery probe): a linear probe recovering
   per-token identity from the buffer's stored feature embedding should
   generalise across nuisance transformations (position, occlusion-gap
   length) well above a token-shuffled control -- operationalising
   "bindable" as identity-stability under transformation.

NON-DEGENERACY GUARD: uninformative if _n_capacity_evictions stays 0
throughout (contention never triggered) or distractor salience values
are near-identical. Add G3 (capacity actually exceeded) to V3-EXQ-658's
existing G0-G2 gates.

ARC-007.subject: hippocampus.path_memory
ARC-007.title: Hippocampal systems store and replay paths through residue-field terrain.
ARC-007.what_would_answer:
ARC-007 is CONJUNCTIVE and only one leg has ever been tested.
LEG 1 -- "hippocampal systems store and replay paths" -- is already carried
behaviourally by EXQ-114 (harm_rate 0.006 intact vs 0.765 ablated, 99.2%
reduction, 2/2 seeds). That is what the exp_conf 0.55 rests on.
LEG 2 -- "THROUGH RESIDUE-FIELD TERRAIN" -- is untested. Nothing in the evidence
trail distinguishes paths through a residue field from paths through an ordinary
spatial/latent map that residue merely co-varies with. Leg 2 is the whole
REE-specific content: without it ARC-007 reduces to "a hippocampus helps
navigation" -- true, generic, and not load-bearing for the 76 dependents that
assume residue-shaped terrain.
Answered by a RESIDUE-SCRAMBLE DISSOCIATION with the hippocampal path machinery
left fully intact: A0 intact / A1 hippocampus-ablated (the EXQ-114 reference arm,
establishing the base effect is live) / A2 residue field PERMUTED (residue values
shuffled across cells -- preserves the field's marginal distribution and the
spatial map, destroys the residue<->location correspondence) / A3 residue field
frozen at initialisation. Primary DV BEHAVIOURAL (harm_rate, path efficiency).
NOT hippo_quality_gap -- that probe is sign-inverted (EXQ-397/397c reclassified
non_contributory 2026-04-22) and must not be a verdict source until redesigned.
ANSWER "leg 2 holds" (PASS) if A2 and A3 degrade toward A1, recovering >= 50% of
the A0->A1 harm gap, with an effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta. The stored
paths depend on residue structure specifically.
ANSWER "terrain claim false, leg 1 survives" (FAIL) if A2/A3 are statistically
indistinguishable from intact A0. Path memory works, but not through residue
terrain. ARC-007 must then be SPLIT: the path-memory leg promotes on EXQ-114, the
residue-terrain leg demotes, and dependents assuming residue-shaped terrain
(MECH-073 value-shaped geometry, the replay cluster) need re-derivation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict):
(a) the residue field must carry live non-flat structure in A0 -- non-zero
cross-cell variance, not uniform-pinned; permuting a flat field is a no-op and
would manufacture a false FAIL; (b) the A0->A1 harm gap must reproduce EXQ-114's
magnitude, else there is no base effect to attribute; (c) the permutation must
verifiably change the field state, not merely be requested.
This also makes the 4-PASS/4-FAIL evidence split legible: a FAIL here EXPLAINS the
divergence rather than adding to it -- the passes tested leg 1, leg 2 was never
under test.

ARC-008.subject: temporal.depth_phase_gating
ARC-008.title: Commitment eligibility is gated by tau, rho, and phi.

ARC-009.subject: language.symbolic_mediation
ARC-009.title: Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.
ARC-009.what_would_answer:
Requires two layers of substrate that do not yet exist in ree-v3, neither of which has an implementation and only the first has even a named design target. Layer 1 (shared with ARC-010): a multi-agent environment -- ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated minimal substrate, itself status: candidate, confidence 0.0, gated to implementation_phase v5, and unbuilt. Layer 2 (specific to ARC-009): a discrete symbolic communication channel between agents -- confirmed absent from ree_core/ entirely (no "language", "symbol", "communication", or "message-passing" inter-agent machinery anywhere; the one reference, control_demand.py's LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label, has no implementation behind it). MECH-014 ("Minimal signalling channel requirements") is the closest existing design artifact for this layer, but it is a prose interface sketch only (inputs: latent-state summaries/residue flags; outputs: discrete-or-continuous signals other agents can condition on) with no substrate, no confidence score, and no queued experiment -- it is not an ARC-047-equivalent scoped build target.
A genuine test becomes possible once both layers land: two (or more) REE agent instances in a shared multi-agent environment (per ARC-010/ARC-047), given access to a shared discrete symbol channel (per MECH-014's sketch, built out as a real interface), on a task with information asymmetry -- one agent observes something the other needs to act correctly on, and coordination/reward requires the information to cross the channel (a standard emergent-communication paradigm, e.g. a referential/signalling game or a coordinated-response variant of ARC-047's predator-avoidance setup). Evidence for the claim would be: (1) agents given the symbol channel achieve significantly better task/coordination performance than a no-communication baseline; (2) the symbols carry recoverable meaning -- e.g. probe accuracy predicting the sender's underlying latent state (z_theta/z_delta slice, residue flag, or intent) from the emitted symbol above chance; and (3) ablating the channel, or shuffling the symbol-to-meaning mapping post-hoc, degrades coordination specifically (not just general task performance), showing the effect is mediated by the symbolic layer rather than some other shared signal (e.g. the scent-channel proxies ARC-047 already specifies). Until both the multi-agent substrate and a real (non-sketch) symbol-passing channel exist, no version of this claim is falsifiable in V3.

ARC-010.subject: social.mirror_modelling
ARC-010.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.
ARC-010.what_would_answer: Requires a multi-agent substrate that does not yet exist in ree-v3 (confirmed: no "social", "mirror", "other_agent", or "otherness" implementation anywhere under ree_core/ beyond two comments acknowledging its absence; ARC-047's SocialGridWorld environment -- the designated minimal substrate for this claim -- is itself unimplemented, status: candidate, confidence 0.0, and gated to implementation_phase v5). A genuine test becomes possible once that substrate lands, and would look like: train a REE agent in a multi-agent environment (e.g. ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, N agent instances sharing a grid) where a second agent's internal state is only observable indirectly (e.g. via the scent-channel proxies ARC-047 specifies: wanting_scent, alarm_scent, harm_stress_field, etc., rather than direct state access). Using the same shared self/other latent stack ARC-010 depends on (ARC-004 L-space, reused with reduced precision gains per the mirror-modelling mechanism), measure whether the agent's inferred other-model -- its OTHER_SELFLIKE-tagged shadow-bundle estimate of the other agent's action-selection (MECH-031) -- converges toward the other agent's actual policy/action distribution at above-chance accuracy across training, and whether coupling strength (signed harm+benefit routing into E3 ranking) predicts downstream cooperative or protective behavior (e.g. MECH-190's predicted defense- coalition sequence: individual defense -> alarm-triggered early coalition -> altruistic defense under no self-threat). Falsified if: even after the substrate exists and training is extended, the other- agent latent estimate does not track the other agent's true policy above chance, OR ablating the shared self-model machinery (forcing an independent from-scratch other-model) produces equal or better mirroring -- which would indicate social cognition does not in fact reuse self-representational machinery as ARC-010 asserts. Currently blocked, not testable: no multi-agent environment and no other-agent latent/inference channel exist in the V3 substrate. The single-agent CausalGridWorld environments used by nearly all current V3 experiments have no second agent to model.

ARC-011.subject: sleep.offline_integration
ARC-011.title: Offline integration (sleep) is required for stability.
ARC-011.what_would_answer:
ARC-011 asserts offline integration (sleep) is REQUIRED FOR STABILITY --
distinct from INV-010 (sleep exists and is required, a bare universal
necessity grounded in cross-species biology, no depends_on) in that
ARC-011 stakes a REE-specific architectural claim: that omitting sleep
causes measurable instability, mediated through ARC-007 (hippocampal
replay) and ARC-005 (control plane). [Digestion note, not resolved
here: INV-010 and ARC-011 are near-duplicate in wording -- worth a
governance pass to make the distinction explicit in one or both
entries, or confirm they should stay separate.] Never tested as its
own claim: 0 genuine_exp entries (claim_evidence.v1.json), sole
evidence one literature citation (zebrafish sleep biology) shared with
INV-010. The extensive sleep experimental corpus in this codebase
(SD-017, MECH-120, MECH-204, MECH-272/273/275/285, Q-055) all attaches
to child mechanism claims, never to ARC-011 or INV-010 directly.

STABILITY OPERATIONALIZED (per docs/architecture/sleep.md's own
"Failure if omitted" list, using DVs already instrumented in the
sleep-cluster experiments):
  (a) Representation drift: slot_cosine_sim among ContextMemory slots
      rising toward ~1.0 (context representations collapsing/
      undifferentiated) -- instrumented since the SD-017/EXQ-436
      family.
  (b) Policy/diversity erosion ("monostrategy convergence"): committed-
      action-class entropy retained at t_k vs t_0, sleep-ON vs
      sleep-OFF -- the DV used by V3-EXQ-691/Q-055.
  (c) Residue-field runaway: unbounded growth/variance in the residue
      field R, or policy entropy collapsing toward frozen -- the
      "residue overgeneralisation" / "brittle or frozen policy
      selection" failure modes named in sleep.md.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the comparison must run long enough / over
enough would-be sleep cycles that instability has a chance to manifest
in EITHER arm. A short run where neither condition destabilizes is
uninformative -- this is not hypothetical caution, it is the observed
failure mode of the two closest existing attempts: EXQ-430 (SLEEP harm
< NO_SLEEP, INV-010) found no differential effect in 0/3 seeds and was
read as substrate-gated/inconclusive rather than falsifying;
V3-EXQ-691 (Q-055) found sleep-OFF was NOT visibly worse than sleep-ON
on diversity erosion at the horizon tested (sleep-OFF was in fact
marginally LESS eroded). Both are consistent with "the run never got
long/stressed enough for the predicted divergence to appear," not with
"sleep doesn't matter." A valid test therefore needs either (i) a
horizon long enough that waking-only operation visibly degrades on
>=1 of the DVs above while the sleep-ON arm does not, or (ii) an
explicit stressor (elevated novelty/harm load, episode count well past
where current sleep-adjacent experiments stop) to force the divergence
within a tractable budget. The sleep-ON arm must run the FULL flag
stack (use_sleep_loop, sws_enabled, rem_enabled,
use_sleep_aggregation_cluster -- landed 2026-05-16 GAP-3), not the
partial/legacy configs used in EXQ-418/436/538a, which repeatedly
produced vacuous or non_contributory results from missing read-paths
rather than a genuine sleep-ON vs sleep-OFF contrast.

CONFIRMING signature: the sleep-OFF arm shows measurable degradation
on >=1 of the three stability DVs over the extended/stressed horizon
(slot_cosine_sim trending toward degenerate; action-class entropy
collapsing toward a frozen/monostrategy floor; residue-field
norm/variance growing without bound), while the sleep-ON arm (full
flag stack) does not show the same degradation, or shows it
significantly less severely, matched for total experience/compute.

FALSIFYING: sleep-OFF sustains the same stability profile as sleep-ON
across all three DVs over the extended/stressed horizon -- no
differential drift, no differential diversity erosion, no differential
residue runaway. This would falsify ARC-011's specific "required FOR
STABILITY, in REE" claim even if INV-010's weaker "sleep exists and is
architecturally motivated" survives on cross-species biological-
analogy grounds alone -- this is the concrete point at which the two
claims can empirically decouple, which is why they should not share
one falsifier.

ARC-014.subject: default_mode.internal_generative
ARC-014.title: Default Mode enables safe imagination without commitment.
ARC-014.what_would_answer:
ARC-014 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "safe imagination" (positive: useful internal
simulation genuinely occurs) and "without commitment" (negative: it
never durably writes to real-experience state) are separate assertions
with DIFFERENT evidentiary status.

LEG A -- SAFE IMAGINATION (that Default Mode / DMN replay genuinely
executes and its content reaches SOME functional consumer). ANSWER by
architectural audit of the live replay/ghost call site, not by
V3-EXQ-880 (which does not exercise it). ree_core/agent.py's
_do_replay() (the production ghost/replay call site) calls
hippocampal.replay()/diverse_replay() -- so the GENERATIVE act of
internal simulation genuinely fires in production -- but per the
V3-EXQ-880 driver's own docstring, its output trajectories are
currently DISCARDED without ever reaching lateral_pfc.update() or
residue_field.accumulate(); MECH-319 names this the "reserved seam"
for the still-pending V3-EXQ-543c replay-driven invocation path.
Separately, INV-011's own audit (this session) traces a DIFFERENT
generative pathway -- E1 internal generation via simulate()/sense()
with hypothesis_tag=True -- through ~30 live agent.py call sites and
concludes DMN/E1 rollout content reaches phi(z)-adjacent read paths
for attenuated affect without producing a belief update. That is
evidence LEG A holds for the E1/simulate() pathway specifically; it is
NOT evidence for the hippocampal _do_replay()/DMN-ghost pathway, whose
output is currently discarded wholesale (not merely write-suppressed)
and is not yet wired to any consumer, safe or not. LEG A therefore
remains PARTIALLY answered: confirmed for E1/simulate(), open
(reserved seam, pending 543c) for the DMN/hippocampal-replay pathway
specifically named in ARC-014's own "Default Mode" title.

LEG B -- WITHOUT COMMITMENT (that simulation-tagged content, IF it
reached a commitment-capable write consumer, would be suppressed while
waking-tagged content commits). ANSWERED by V3-EXQ-880 (2026-08-02,
PASS, 3/3 seeds). Matched-content design: identical captured
(z_delta, z_world) content from a real seeded env rollout applied to
two agents built from the same seed, differing only in
hypothesis_tag/simulation_mode. Two independent channels, both
load-bearing: rule_state/MECH-319 (sim_rule_state_delta <= 1e-7,
measured 0.0 all seeds; wake_rule_state_delta >= 1e-4, measured
0.31-0.43 all seeds); residue/MECH-094 (sim_residue_delta <= 1e-6,
measured 0.0 all seeds; wake_residue_delta >= 1.0, measured ~2.0 all
seeds). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the experiment constructs the write-gate
seam DIRECTLY via manual tag injection and direct API calls -- it does
NOT drive the real production _do_replay() call site, which (see LEG
A) currently discards its trajectories before they would ever reach
these consumers at all. V3-EXQ-880 therefore confirms the categorical
write-gate ITSELF behaves correctly as a defense-in-depth safeguard,
not that production replay content is currently routed through it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (LEG B, per V3-EXQ-880's own pre-registered

ARC-015.subject: agency.self_impact_attribution
ARC-015.title: Self-impact attribution and responsibility flow are required.
ARC-015.what_would_answer:
ARC-015 bundles two testably-separable sub-claims: (1) SELF-IMPACT ATTRIBUTION --
discriminating self-caused from externally-caused state change via an
efference-copy/reafference comparator (operationalised as MECH-095, the TPJ
agency-detection comparator at the z_self/z_world interface); and (2)
RESPONSIBILITY FLOW -- routing that attribution into commit-boundary-gated
learning with pre-commit/post-commit channel separation (MECH-060/061/066/067)
and action/thought-loop completion gates (MECH-057a/057b).

These two halves currently have DIFFERENT evidentiary status and different
substrate requirements. Do not treat ARC-015 as a single testable-now unit.

== HALF 2 (responsibility flow / commit-boundary separation): already has
supporting evidence, testable now ==
MECH-060 (V1, EVB-0043/EXQ-005 PASS) and MECH-061 (channel independence,
|corr|=0.114) already confirm write-locus separation is enforceable and
beneficial. MECH-057a has informative sub-threshold V1/V2 evidence
(FULL < NO_ATTRIBUTION < NO_GATING, correctly ordered) and is now V3-eligible
because V3 supports multi-step committed actions, which V2's atomic single-step
actions could not provide. A clean V3 re-test of MECH-057a on multi-step action
sequences would CONFIRM this half if the completion-gate ablation degrades
responsibility-attribution quality above the pre-registered threshold, and would
FALSIFY it if gating vs. no-gating remains indistinguishable at V3 scale.

== HALF 1 (self-impact attribution / self-vs-world discrimination):
CONFIRMED substrate-blocked on single-agent V3, do not re-test as-is ==

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a genuine test requires an environment containing
BOTH self-caused and externally-caused outcomes that are causally
indistinguishable from surface features alone -- discriminable only via the
agent's own efference copy / action history. CausalGridWorld's native hazards
and resource dynamics do NOT satisfy this: hazard drift and resource respawn
are environment-authored processes with no "intent" for the comparator to
contrast against the agent's own commanded action, so mismatch collapses to
noise regardless of comparator quality.

This was tested directly, not assumed. SD-047 (multi-source environmental
dynamics) was purpose-built to supply a structurally distinct "other" cause.
V3-EXQ-741 (2026-07-12, confirmed failure autopsy, governance-consumed) is the
first VALID test of MECH-095 on the SD-047 substrate: non-degenerate on both
the probe-partition and self/world-balance guards, all 4 intensity arms
exercised as pre-registered. Result: no arm discriminates (best routing
improvement +0.028, below the 0.04 pre-registered floor); the BASELINE already
carries strong contact recall (0.75-0.93) without the comparator. Recorded
interpretation: SD-047's world-caused drift is not a structurally-distinct
OTHER, so a single-agent environment -- however richly instrumented -- cannot
make the comparator load-bearing. This is registered as the 1st valid
substrate_ceiling hit for MECH-095 and empirically confirms
multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3's standing prediction that this mechanism is
intrinsically relational.

CONFIRMING signature (once MAE-3 / a genuine second agent is available):
on a multi-agent environment where some negative/positive outcomes are caused
by the OTHER agent's actions and some by the focal agent's own actions
(surface-matched, causally distinguishable only via each agent's own action
history), MECH-095's routing improvement on an other-caused-event partition
exceeds the pre-registered 0.04 floor over baseline, with contact_recall_routed
and action-dissociation metrics both clearing their thresholds on >=3 seeds.

FALSIFYING signature: even against a genuine second agent's actions, the
comparator's routed condition fails to discriminate self-caused from
other-caused outcomes -- this would exhaust the mapped substrate ceiling and
force a mechanism-level reconsideration of MECH-095's TPJ-comparator
translation, not merely another substrate enrichment attempt.

Until MAE-3 lands, ARC-015's self-impact-attribution half stays at the same
disposition as ARC-010 (mirror modelling of other agents): substrate-blocked,
pending_retest_after_substrate=true, bound to multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3.

ARC-016.subject: cognitive_modes.control_plane_regimes
ARC-016.title: Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.
ARC-016.what_would_answer:
ARC-016 is UNLIKE the other load-bearing ARC claims: its core circuit is ALREADY
VALIDATED and it does not need a new discovery experiment. Digested 2026-07-21.
VALIDATED: E3-derived variance -> relative commit threshold -> BetaGate ->
action_selection, by EXQ-018b (PASS 5/5; commit_threshold = 2 x
training_baseline_variance; stable env commit_rate 0.90 / precision 718, perturbed
0.50 / 426 -- a 40% precision drop producing a proportional 40-point commit-rate
drop) and EXQ-060 (PASS 4/5; committed_step_count 5980,
hold_rate_during_committed 0.936).
ARC-016 would be OVERTURNED by the commit threshold ceasing to track E3-derived
variance -- commit_rate failing to move with a manipulated precision level while
the BetaGate remains wired. That would mean modes are NOT control-plane regimes
over shared predictive machinery but independent modules.

THE 15 FAILs DO NOT REFUTE THE CIRCUIT -- each is already diagnosed (see
heterogeneity_note): the V2 precision_regime_probe imposed precision externally
rather than deriving it from E3 and had no end-to-end commitment wiring; V3
EXQ-018's absolute threshold 0.40 was 100x the operating variance range (fixed by
going relative); EXQ-396a x3 and EXQ-396b are non_contributory on a train/eval
variance gap (train ~0.000032-0.000064 vs eval ~0.001, so the threshold never
engages in eval); EXQ-454 is non_contributory because the V_s monostrategy lock
dominates threshold-adaptation behaviour; V3-EXQ-642's autopsy records a
measurement / test-design gap, explicitly NOT a substrate_ceiling.
NOTE FOR GOVERNANCE (flag, not a digestion action): exp_conf 0.53 is therefore an
AGGREGATION ARTEFACT -- a claim whose FAILs are almost all already stamped
non_contributory still scores as if half-refuted. Re-scoring needs a governance eye
rather than a digestion edit, because stripping non-contributory FAILs can expose
that the REMAINING supports are thinner than the headline number suggested.

THE ONE GENUINELY OPEN ITEM is calibration, not mechanism -- named by this claim's
own notes as "pending recalibration with eval-derived threshold". ANSWERED by
re-running the EXQ-396 design with an EVAL-DERIVED (or online-adapted) baseline
variance in place of 2 x training_baseline_variance.
ANSWER "calibration artefact; validation stands" (PASS) if with an eval-derived
threshold the commitment threshold engages during eval and commit_rate tracks
manipulated precision monotonically.
ANSWER "genuine evidence against the circuit" (FAIL) if even a correctly-calibrated
eval-time threshold leaves commit_rate not tracking precision. That would be the
FIRST real evidence against ARC-016, and the 15 prior FAILs would need re-reading
as right for the wrong reasons.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (this is exactly what killed EXQ-396a/b -- trap it):
the commit threshold must ACTUALLY ENGAGE in eval -- commit_rate strictly between
floor and ceiling, not pinned at 0.0 or 1.0, and eval-time variance within the
threshold's dynamic range. A threshold that never fires makes all arms identical ->
substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict.
SCOPE GUARD: the run must be STRUCTURAL ONLY. Do NOT attach a behavioural harm DV --
that re-imports the V_s monostrategy-lock confound that voided EXQ-454, and the
behavioural consequence layer is ARC-029, not ARC-016 (split 2026-03-22).

ARC-018.subject: hippocampus.rollout_viability_mapping
ARC-018.title: Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.
ARC-018.what_would_answer:
ARC-018 is CONJUNCTIVE, and its PASS/FAIL split is NOT noise -- the evidence
separates cleanly by leg. Digested 2026-07-21.
LEG A "post-commitment viability mapping": EXQ-042 PASS (terrain_prior learns E3
preferences, hippo_quality_gap 0.393, terrain_loss -> 0), EXQ-053 PASS (terrain-
guided navigation 50x less harm than random, 5/5 criteria), EXQ-120 PASS
(discriminative pair). Three consistent PASSes.
LEG B "explicit rollouts": EXQ-172 FAIL (harm_advantage_mean -0.190), EXQ-196 FAIL
(harm_advantage_mean 0.0 across all 3 seeds). Two FAILs.
Every PASS is leg A; every FAIL is leg B. Carrying this as one conjunction at
exp_conf 0.547 averages a well-supported leg with an unsupported one and hides
both facts.
BUT LEG B IS UNTESTED, NOT REFUTED -- both FAILs are confounded, differently:
EXQ-172 ran at e2_world_r2 = 0.203 and the note itself concludes "rollout planning
counterproductive at current fidelity ... ARC-018 may be E2-quality-gated" -- a
negative advantage from a poor forward model indicts E2, not the rollout
architecture. EXQ-196 ran at good fidelity (e2_world_r2 0.766, residue populated)
and returned EXACTLY 0.0 on all three seeds -- an exact-zero-everywhere result is a
DEGENERACY SIGNATURE (the rollout output never reached the DV), which is why
governance classified it non_contributory and deferred the verdict.

LEG A would be OVERTURNED by: terrain-guided navigation losing its advantage over
random when the terrain prior is ablated WHILE hippo_quality_gap and terrain_loss
remain healthy -- i.e. the map is learned but inert.

LEG B is ANSWERED by a ROLLOUT-DEPTH ABLATION AT VERIFIED E2 FIDELITY: arms at
rollout depth 0 (no rollout) / shallow / full, run only after E2 fidelity clears a
measured floor. Primary DV harm_advantage_mean.
ANSWER "rollouts confer planning advantage" (PASS) if harm_advantage_mean scales
monotonically with rollout depth, effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta, on
>= 2/3 seeds. ARC-018 then holds conjunctively.
ANSWER "rollout leg demotes" (FAIL) if there is no advantage at ANY depth despite
verified-live rollouts and adequate E2. ARC-018 reduces to its mapping leg, and
MECH-092 plus the replay-consolidation dependents need re-derivation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (each drawn from a specific prior failure; any breach
-> substrate_not_ready, NOT a verdict):
(a) e2_world_r2 >= 0.6 measured IN-RUN -- below this the EXQ-172 confound recurs;
(b) rollout-derived scores must carry non-zero cross-candidate variance -- the
rollout must actually discriminate between candidates;
(c) harm_advantage_mean EXACTLY 0.0 across all seeds is the EXQ-196 signature of an
unwired DV -- trap it explicitly and self-route substrate_not_ready. NEVER record
that pattern as a FAIL.

ARC-019.subject: developmental.curriculum_stages
ARC-019.title: REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.
ARC-019.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: A staged-vs-unstaged comparison is only informative if
the staged arm can actually traverse its stages under the tested budget -- i.e. the
phase-advance gate criteria (as in InfantCurriculumScheduler / infant_substrate_expansion.md
Section 8) must be reachable, and the unstaged control must differ from the staged arm only
in the presence/absence of gating (same total episode budget, same environmental feature set
eventually enabled, same seeds) -- not merely relabeled episode counts. V3-EXQ-591 (2026-05-27)
demonstrated the failure mode this precondition guards against: all arms (staged and flat
alike) plateaued at 1/7 gate criteria because a goal-pipeline prerequisite (z_goal seeding,
goal_pipeline:GAP-4) was not yet substrate-ready, producing a substrate-ceiling non-result
rather than a test of the curriculum question. This precondition must be independently
verified (e.g. staged arm reaches at least Phase 1 in >=80% of seeds) before treating any
outcome below as evidence either way.

CONFIRMING: Given the non-degeneracy precondition holds, the staged/gated curriculum arm
(ARM_2-style, phase-advance gated on the DEV-NEED-008 / infant_substrate_expansion.md
Section 8 criteria) reaches a materially higher fraction of the 7-criterion developmental
gate (>=6/7 in >=4/5 seeds, per V3-EXQ-591's own acceptance design) than an unstaged/ungated
baseline trained on the identical total episode budget and identical eventual feature set
(flat ARM_0/ARM_1-style). Equivalently, on any already-used downstream competence metric in
this registry (e.g. MECH-457 competence-floor measures, or convergence quality/H_pos
trajectory stability), the staged arm should show measurably better or more stable outcomes
than the ungated control at matched total training cost -- and this advantage should
reproduce across at least one additional curriculum-bearing lineage (e.g. scaffolded_sd054
onboarding, or the play-type progression of MECH-197) once each is substrate-ready, not
just the infant-stage instance.

FALSIFYING: Given the non-degeneracy precondition holds (staged arm demonstrably traverses
multiple stages), the staged/gated arm shows no reliable advantage over the unstaged/ungated
baseline at matched total training budget -- e.g. gate-criterion satisfaction, competence-floor
measures, or convergence quality are statistically indistinguishable between staged and flat
arms, or the flat arm matches/exceeds the staged arm at equal or lower cost. This would
indicate the explicit stage/gate structure is not doing useful work beyond what unstructured
training achieves anyway -- the curriculum may still be a convenient scaffold for organizing
training runs and diagnostics, but "staged development with explicit gates" would not be
architecturally load-bearing for outcome quality, only for interpretability/debuggability
(which is a different, weaker claim than ARC-019 currently asserts).

ARC-020.subject: sleep.protected_offline_consolidation_boundary
ARC-020.title: Offline consolidation is protected by typed authority/write boundaries.
ARC-020.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim requires a live, reachable typed commit-boundary mechanism gating writes FROM offline/sleep consolidation TO privileged authority stores (POL/ID/CAPS per docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020) -- i.e. MECH-067's "machine-checkable phase/store/actor permission matrix" (or equivalent) must actually be wired into the V3 sleep pipeline, with an offline code path CAPABLE of attempting an authority-store write and being intercepted/typed-routed rather than merely never attempting one by construction. THIS PRECONDITION CURRENTLY FAILS: exhaustive grep of ree-v3/ree_core/ for write_locus, permission_matrix, POL/CAPS/ID authority-store analogs, commit_token, and commit_boundary returns zero hits. The sleep pipeline has phase/mode routing (SWS/REM gates, sleep-onset permits) but no privileged-authority-store concept and no typed commit-boundary/ verifier-mediation machinery. MECH-067, the claim this would be implemented through, is provisional on V1 substrate only (ree-v1-minimal EXQ-005/EVB-0043, 2026-02-27) and has never been retested in V3. Do not force a genuine_exp test while this precondition is unmet -- any attempt would be vacuous (no reachable write path to authority stores exists for offline consolidation to violate OR respect). CONFIRMING (once the precondition is met): an experiment in which offline/sleep consolidation generates a candidate authority-affecting change (a commitment-token mint, an external-action dispatch, or a direct write to a POL/ID/CAPS-equivalent store) is rejected or re-routed through the typed commit-boundary/verifier path rather than landing directly -- distinguishable from an ordinary representational/residue/ precision write (which should succeed unimpeded, per the sleep.md "MAY update" list). FALSIFYING: (a) offline/sleep consolidation can mutate a privileged authority-store equivalent directly, with no type check, no verifier mediation, and no distinguishable code path from an ordinary representational write; or (b) a boundary exists but does not discriminate by TYPE (any offline-originated write reaches the store regardless of whether it is representational or authority-affecting); or (c) the only enforcement is a naming/comment-level convention with no machine-checked gate.

ARC-021.subject: basal_ganglia.three_loop_learning_channel_separation
ARC-021.title: Three BG-like cortico-striatal loops require distinct learning channels.
ARC-021.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the three error channels to be
genuinely separately optimized in the substrate under test. Confirmed
currently true: E1 (E1DeepPredictor), E2 (E2WorldForward / E2HarmSForward /
E2HarmAForward), and E3 (E3TrajectorySelector) each run as independent
nn.Modules with their own torch.optim.Adam instance and own loss
(ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py, e2_world.py, e2_harm_s.py,
e2_harm_a.py, e3_selector.py) -- a shared-trunk/single-optimizer collapse
would void the precondition. Note this is NOT the MECH-062 situation
(BG-selector's internal motor/cognitive-set/motivational loop-gating,
corrected stable->candidate 2026-06-22 per the BG assembly map, now owned
by ARC-110): that claim is about arbitration-loop structure inside E3;
ARC-021 is about the E1/E2/E3 predictor-level channel split, which the
substrate genuinely instantiates today.

CONFIRMING signature (per the SD-003 / V3-EXQ-007-010 causal-signature
methodology): the calibration gap
mean_causal_sig(near_hazard) - mean_causal_sig(safe), computed from E2's
action-conditioned causal signature E2(z_t, a_actual) - E2(z_t, a_cf)
(MECH-069), should be reliably positive and clear a pre-registered bar
(the EXQ-007-010 series used >0.05) under sufficient per-step observation
variation -- and widening E2's capacity to force harm attribution through
it (the EXQ-009 manipulation) should NOT improve attribution, only overfit
(already shown, and the basis for MECH-069's stable promotion). A
load-bearing confirmation of ARC-021 itself additionally requires an
ABLATION not yet run: merging E1/E2/E3 into a shared trunk/single optimizer
(a joint-channel condition) should measurably DEGRADE calibration_gap
and/or harm-attribution accuracy relative to the separated-channel
baseline, isolating channel separation as the causal factor rather than
only observing that separated channels trend the right direction.

FALSIFYING signature: if a merged/shared-channel condition (single trunk,
single optimizer, one loss combining sensory + motor-sensory + harm/goal
error) produces calibration_gap and attribution accuracy statistically
indistinguishable from -- or better than -- the separated-channel baseline,
across the same near-hazard/safe probe design and both dense- and
sparse-hazard conditions, that falsifies the REQUIRED part of ARC-021: a
single shared channel would suffice, and the three-way split would be
unnecessary engineering rather than a load-bearing requirement. Calibrate
expectations against current evidence: all four EXQ-007/008/009/010 runs
are formally FAIL against their own >0.05 bar (only EXQ-010, dense hazards,
was positive-direction: +0.0267; EXQ-007/008/009 were -0.0151/-0.0066/
-0.0184). So existing evidence supports "separation trends correctly and
does not obviously hurt under sufficient per-step variation," not yet
"separation is required" -- the merged-channel ablation above is the
missing test and has never been run.

ARC-023.subject: basal_ganglia.three_loop_thalamic_heartbeat

ARC-023.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: SD-006 phase 2 (true asynchronous multi-rate execution) must be active, not the phase-1 time-multiplexed substrate. EXQ-131's own diagnosis (2026-03-30 review) is explicit that synchronous/time-multiplexed polling produces an "E3 output freeze artifact" -- stale E3 state under synchronous polling drives var_harm_eval_on to near-zero (1.05e-7), statistically indistinguishable from the ablated condition (0.00276), regardless of whether the three loops are genuinely rate-separated. A test run on phase-1-only substrate is therefore uninformative by construction, not merely under-powered, and cannot be read as evidence either for or against this claim.
CONFIRMING signature: with SD-006 phase 2 active, E1/E2/E3 show measurably distinct and stable update-rate signatures (effective update frequency, or latency-drift-under-load) that persist without collapsing into lockstep when processing latency is varied. If EXQ-131's var_harm_eval-style discriminative-pair metric remains diagnostic once E3 state updates are genuinely asynchronous rather than time-multiplexed-stale, reuse it directly. If the phase-2 substrate changes how E3 state is exposed between ticks, the metric should be replaced with a direct measurement of realized inter-loop update-rate ratios (E1:E2:E3 tick-count ratios under load, measured empirically) plus a rate-drift measure under injected latency perturbation.

In that case "characteristic thalamic heartbeat rates" is architecturally decorative (a naming/period-configuration choice) rather than a functionally necessary coherence mechanism, and the claim should be demoted or reframed as a design choice rather than an architectural commitment. evidence:

ARC-028.subject: control_plane.hippocampal_betagate_coupling_wiring
ARC-028.title: HippocampalModule must emit a trajectory completion signal wired to BetaGate to couple the candidacy and propagation gates.
ARC-028.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the wiring this claim asserts is ALREADY BUILT in ree-v3, not merely proposed -- HippocampalModule.compute_completion_signal() (ree_core/hippocampal/ module.py) feeds BetaGate.receive_hippocampal_completion() (ree_core/heartbeat/beta_gate.py), called at agent.py:5280-5302 under an explicit "ARC-028 / MECH-105" comment, gated by config.heartbeat.beta_gate_bistable (default False, but True in the MECH-090/SD-034 experiment family) and beta_gate.is_elevated. Confirmed by direct source inspection (2026-08-07) and independently by evidence/planning/mech090_release_path_audit_2026-06-02.md. A run is non-degenerate only if beta_gate_bistable=True, the agent actually reaches beta_gate.is_elevated at least once (real committed episodes occur), and completion_signal takes a non-degenerate range of values across trajectories rather than saturating at 0 or 1. Existing runs with beta_gate_bistable=True already satisfy this; no new substrate build is required.
CONFIRMING signature: a controlled ablation -- matched seeds/config, ON arm with the hippocampal-completion pathway live (completion_release_threshold at its configured value, e.g. 0.75) vs. OFF arm with the pathway suppressed (e.g. completion_release_threshold pinned above 1.0) while holding every OTHER BetaGate release pathway (MECH-091 urgency-interrupt, V_s anchor invalidation, SD-034 closure operator) at identical trigger conditions across both arms -- shows BetaGate release timing and/or release rate measurably and reproducibly contingent on HippocampalModule's completion_signal: releases attributable to this pathway specifically (releases that fire in the ON arm at ticks where no other pathway's trigger condition is independently met) occur at non-trivial rate, and removing the pathway measurably shifts release latency distribution or total release count relative to the intact ON arm.
FALSIFYING signature: BetaGate release timing and rate are statistically indistinguishable between the ON and OFF arms once the other release pathways are accounted for -- every release attributed to the hippocampal-completion pathway would have fired anyway via one of the other four release pathways audited in mech090_release_path_audit_2026-06-02.md, or completion_signal never (or trivially rarely) crosses completion_release_threshold under realistic trajectory-quality distributions. In that case the two gates remain functionally decoupled in practice despite the code-level wiring existing.

ARC-032.subject: architecture.theta_frontal_hippocampal_goal
ARC-032.title: The theta-rate packaging of E1 output (MECH-089 ThetaBuffer) is the primary pathway through which E1's goal-context maintenance reaches E3's trajectory scoring -- the computational analog of frontal-hippocampal theta synchronisation.
ARC-032.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: z_goal_norm must clear >= 0.05 (the EXQ-247 gate) for goal-context maintenance to be meaningfully present at all -- otherwise there is no signal to test theta-bypass against, per the 2026-04-06 governance finding (goal_norm=0.031 on EXQ-228a, 0.0 on EXQ-247, both below threshold). As of 2026-08-08, EXQ-247 itself has never been re-run since its 2026-04-07 FAIL and the gate has never cleared on that experiment. Separately, a newer substrate (scaffolded_ sd054_onboarding curriculum, V3-EXQ-603n PASS 2026-06-10) has since demonstrated z_goal_norm well above 0.05 in unrelated experiments (e.g. V3-EXQ-632, V3-EXQ-866/866a) -- so the precondition mechanism is plausibly satisfiable now, but no ARC-032-tagged experiment has been run on that substrate to confirm it, and EXQ-247 has not been re-issued against it. A genuine theta-bypass ablation condition (E1 output -> E3 direct, bypassing MECH-089 ThetaBuffer -- as designed in V3-EXQ-228a: THETA_ACTIVE vs THETA_ZEROED trained-from-scratch agents) must be run WITH the precondition met, not just joint E1/MECH-116 goal-conditioning tests (all EXQ-076/EXQ-247/EXQ-228/EXQ-228a series tested only joint conditioning or failed precondition). CONFIRMING: with z_goal_norm precondition met (>= 0.05), the theta-bypass (THETA_ZEROED) condition shows measurably degraded goal maintenance versus the theta-packaged (THETA_ACTIVE) condition: shorter z_goal persistence, noisier goal-proximity scores in E3's trajectory scoring, and a behavioral lift (resource_rate/harm_rate differential) statistically distinguishable from zero across seeds. FALSIFYING: with the precondition met, theta-bypass and theta-packaged conditions show statistically indistinguishable goal maintenance quality (lift ~ 0, no separation across seeds). This would mean the theta channel is not actually the primary -- or even a necessary -- pathway for goal-context communication, undermining both ARC-032 itself and its stated corollary that MECH-116 does not need a separate communication channel.

ARC-033.subject: harm_stream.sensory_discriminative_forward_model
ARC-033.title: SD-003 counterfactual attribution requires a dedicated harm forward model E2_harm_s(z_harm_s, action) -> z_harm_s_next operating within the sensory-discriminative harm stream.
ARC-033.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (a rerun is only informative if all hold --
per the diagnosed EXQ-095/166 confounds):
  - Prediction target must be the harm-DELTA formulation (EXQ-166e), not a
    raw scalar harm_obs_s target -- EXQ-095a/b showed the raw target has
    near-zero action-conditional variance and no training budget fixes that.
  - Phase-1 training budget >= 200 episodes with the delta target (the
    budget that produced EXQ-525's clean result), not the 900-1800 ep
    budgets that were insufficient for the raw-scalar target -- budget and
    target formulation are coupled.
  - P0 (HarmEncoder) convergence must be verified PER SEED, across >=4
    seeds, before trusting any aggregate hf_r2 -- EXQ-166 showed a single
    collapsed-encoder seed (obs_fwd_r2=0.0) can silently sit inside an
    otherwise-strong aggregate and masquerade as architecture failure.
  - n_approach >= 50 per seed so causal_sig comparisons are not
    noise-dominated.
  - The counterfactual/ablation pipeline must be genuinely wired end-to-end
    -- EXQ-195 showed a sound forward model (r2=0.914) can still show a
    negative attribution_gap purely from missing pipeline wiring.

CONFIRMING signature (what V3-EXQ-525 already showed, 2026-05-06,
4 seeds [42,7,123,13], supersedes V3-EXQ-205):
  - hf_r2 = 0.9191 +/- 0.0037, tight and non-bimodal across all 4 seeds
    (resolves EXQ-166's bimodal 0.867/0.0/0.0/0.885 pattern).
  - attribution_gap positive in all 4 seeds (0.102-0.126, mean 0.115),
    >> the 0.002 threshold in every seed (resolves EXQ-195's negative gap).
  - intact_vs_ablated > 0 in 4/4 seeds; null_cf_max = 0.0 in every seed.
  - All 6 pre-registered criteria PASS on every seed tested.
  A rerun under the same non-degeneracy preconditions reproducing this
  pattern (tight multi-seed hf_r2 > 0.85, positive attribution_gap > 0.05
  in >=3/4 seeds, intact>ablated in >=3/4 seeds) would further confirm.

FALSIFYING signature: recurrence of the EXQ-095/166 pattern on a rerun
where the non-degeneracy preconditions above are genuinely controlled for
-- hf_r2 collapses to ~0 in >=2/4 seeds despite verified-adequate P0
encoder convergence, OR attribution_gap <= 0.002 or non-positive in >=2/4
seeds, OR intact_vs_ablated fails to discriminate in >=2/4 seeds despite
n_approach >= 50. Any of these on a controlled rerun would indicate
EXQ-525's clean 4/4 result was seed-fortunate rather than a genuine
resolution, and would require re-opening the architecture question.

SCOPE NOTE: this falsification condition covers only the "a dedicated
harm forward model IS LEARNABLE and causally discriminative" half of the
claim. The "dedicated" (i.e. NOT shared-trunk) half competes with ARC-058,
whose own arbitration test (V3-EXQ-445h) was ruled non-contributory
(floor-locked by the pre-conversion-ceiling F-dominance monostrategy) and
remains blocked on ARC-065 GAP-A / MECH-439 (committed-action diversity).
Confirming or falsifying ARC-033's learnability does not by itself resolve

ARC-034.subject: ethics.test_scope_nth_order
ARC-034.title: Ethics testing must span nth-order multiagent trajectory distributions; local pairwise probes are insufficient to characterize emergent ethical properties.
ARC-034.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a multi-agent ecology substrate (n>=2 REE agents interacting causally, with the feedback topology G the claim's own formalization requires) must exist and be exercisable, AND MECH-127 (counterfactual empathic activation) and MECH-129 (relational harm-to-agency representation) must both be implemented and active. None of this exists in V3. Per multi_agent_ecology_v5_plan.md (MAE-1), the substrate itself is status:blocked with owner_exq:null across every node in all six V5 social-tier plan docs -- design-only, no env code, no REEAgent factoring -- gated on MECH-163 (V3-pending) plus V4 object-permanence and self-model-stability prerequisites. MECH-127 is independently design-only (no built substrate, no EXQ/run IDs, gated on MIRROR-1/2 and MECH-163). MECH-129 is held v5 pending the same substrate. Until the substrate and both dependency mechanisms exist, ARC-034 cannot be tested, confirmed, or falsified -- there is no n=k trajectory distribution to test against n=1 probes. CONFIRMING: once the substrate exists, a designed nth-order ethics test (per the claim's own three-part test design -- counterfactual probes, multi-agent stress tests, cascade mapping) finds cases where local-pairwise (n=1) ethical assessment diverges from the nth-order (n=k) emergent assessment. The canonical case is the claim's own motivating example: direct-pathway analysis of a depleted agent predicts reduced helping, but nth-order analysis (accounting for MECH-127's counterfactual empathic activation) predicts and observes increased helping instead. FALSIFYING: nth-order ethics tests systematically agree with local pairwise probes across a range of designed scenarios -- emergent collective ethical properties are always predictable from pairwise (n=1) interactions alone, with no cases of the divergence the claim's motivating example illustrates. If cascade mapping and attractor-theory/ Lyapunov/transfer-entropy analysis never surface an emergent state that pairwise assessment would have missed or mis-scored, the extra test-scope machinery is unnecessary overhead rather than a genuine requirement, and this claim is false.

ARC-035.subject: vmPFC.affective_normative_state_preparation
ARC-035.title: vmPFC is the substrate that converts stored affective, normative, and residue content -- prior outcome history, social and identity constraints, learned value associations, and safety memories -- into active components of the navigable state used by E3 during trajectory evaluation.
ARC-035.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the SD-033c vmPFC-analog subdivision must be a genuine wired activation substrate, not the claim-graph consolidation currently registered (v3_pending: false / consolidation_status: complete, closed purely by subsuming ARC-035 + MECH-151 + MECH-152 + MECH-235 with no new implementation). The substrate actually performing "stored -> active" conversion is SD-016 (implemented 2026-04-16): E1DeepPredictor.extract_cue_ context(z_world) -> action_bias (E2, MECH-151) / terrain_weight (E3, MECH-152), covering three of the four ARC-035 content classes (residue, safety memory, goal-approach gating). But SD-016's own evidence_quality_note records V3-EXQ-418d/418e FAILs: ContextMemory attention collapses to the uniform-distribution ceiling (entropy ~ln(16)) and slot diversity fails in most seeds -- the pathway is wired and exercised but not demonstrably doing content-selective retrieval. The fourth content class -- social/identity constraints (MECH-132, the EVR/bvFTD case) -- has NO wired substrate: status candidate, unimplemented. A non-degenerate test therefore requires (a) the SD-016 attention-collapse issue resolved or independently verified not to affect the content class under test, and (b) for content-class-2 tests specifically, MECH-132 built and wired as a live tonic constraint gate before an ablation is meaningful.
CONFIRMING SIGNATURE: with the substrate non-degenerate, ablate the vmPFC-analog pathway for one content class while leaving underlying storage intact (content still retrievable via a direct probe of ContextMemory / the residue field). Confirming: the probe shows content is still present and retrievable AND E3 trajectory selection is measurably LESS sensitive to that content with the pathway ablated than intact -- e.g. w_harm no longer scales with hazard-cue proximity (psychopathy/reversal-learning analog); trajectory choice no longer differentiates constraint-violating vs -consistent options (vmPFC-lesion/norm-application analog); safety-context cues no longer shift E3 away from the threat-biased trajectory (PTSD/extinction analog); or goal-directed trajectory frequency drops despite unchanged goal representation (depression/approach-attenuation analog).
FALSIFYING SIGNATURE: ablating the vmPFC-analog pathway produces NO dissociation -- trajectory selection is equally (in)sensitive whether the pathway is intact or ablated, while content remains equally retrievable via direct probe in both conditions. This would mean E3 already gets the content some other way (e.g. directly from ResidueField curvature or hippocampal graph structure), so there is no separable "activation" function distinct from what the residue field / hippocampal machinery already performs -- the stored/active distinction collapses for that content class, and the four-failure-mode taxonomy would need re-grounding elsewhere (e.g. folded back into ARC-007).
CURRENT STATE: zero experimental evidence exists for ARC-035 (13/13 entries literature; exp count = 0). MECH-131/132/133/134 -- the four discriminator mechanisms -- appear nowhere in claim_evidence.v1.json, and no experiment has ever operationalized any of the four failure-mode analogs.

ARC-036.subject: hippocampus.multidimensional_valence_map
ARC-036.title: Hippocampal terrain maps encode separable valence dimensions (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise); ARC-007 residue-field navigation is the harm-causal special case of this general architecture.
ARC-036.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ARC-036's own dissociation probe (EXQ-176) has never actually exercised the production substrate -- its RBFLayer was a standalone, never-trained reimplementation (fixed random centers, no add_residue-style placement), distinct from ree_core/residue/ field.py's real RBFLayer, which has placed centers at true event locations since the initial V3 substrate build and has since gained DA-modulated multi-center allocation (SD-024/MECH-232, now stable and reconfirmed 2026-08-08 via V3-EXQ-893/900). A corrected probe, run against the real ResidueField/get_valence_priority path (the instrument SD-014's V3-EXQ-887 series already validates), is the non-degeneracy floor -- until then, EXQ-176-style results are uninformative about ARC-036 regardless of outcome. NOTE: SD-014's own instrument, which tests wanting/liking dissociation on the real substrate, PASSED as of V3-EXQ-887b (2026-08-08) -- so a real, favorable, non-degenerate touchpoint on two of the four dimensions now exists, just not filed under ARC-036's own claim_ids. CONFIRMING: once ARC-036's own probe is rerun on real substrate (or the SD-014 instrument is extended to cover all four dimensions in one map), the hippocampal terrain shows measurably SEPARABLE responses across wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, and surprise -- e.g. wanting (drive-scaled benefit_exposure) and liking (raw benefit at outcome receipt) are non-collinear and independently recoverable per node (as SD-014's V3-EXQ-887b already shows for that pair), harm-discriminative tracks SD-011's z_harm_s/z_harm_a as the causal-attributive special case ARC-007 already specifies, and surprise-driven replay prioritisation (MECH-030/MECH-124) responds to RPE independent of the other three. FALSIFYING: once rerun on real substrate, the four proposed dimensions collapse onto fewer independent signals -- e.g. wanting and liking remain collinear (as V3-EXQ-887's original FAIL found, before the decouple fix), or surprise-driven replay is indistinguishable from harm-driven replay, or the harm/benefit terrain fields fail to spatially differentiate even with real event-driven center placement (which would indicate a genuine, not merely probe-artifactual, substrate limit). Any of these would mean the terrain map does not encode separable valence dimensions as claimed, undermining the generalisation from ARC-007's harm-causal special case to the broader four-dimension architecture.

ARC-038.subject: hippocampus.waking_consolidation_mode
ARC-038.title: During waking immobility, hippocampal replay switches between task-focused forward sweeps (planning mode) and local consolidation replay (integration mode) based on task demand; this waking consolidation mode is architecturally necessary for viability map integration during experience.
ARC-038.what_would_answer:
ANSWER via EXQ-355a's own design, re-run with MECH-261 now operative (see the currency note above): three-arm contrast of Phase0 harm rate (pre-consolidation baseline), Phase1 harm rate with waking-consolidation-mode ENABLED (offline_consolidation write-gate open per MECH-261, replay triggered per MECH-092 at low task-demand / beta elevation / no active commitment, no z_goal, map-geometry update from recent trajectory per this claim's (a)-(c) specification), and Phase1 harm rate with waking-consolidation ABLATED (replay suppressed or write-gate held closed). Matched seeds across arms (>=3, matching 355a's seed count).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (drawn directly from why 355a was voided, not usable as a verdict): confirm MECH-261's mode-conditioned write gate is LIVE in-run -- i.e. the offline_consolidation-mode write path is demonstrably open during ENABLED and closed during ABLATED (a direct gate-state check, not inferred from the harm-rate outcome). If ENABLED and ABLATED Phase1 harm rates are bit-identical (as in 355a, 10+ decimal places) despite this check passing, that is a NEW degeneracy signature -- self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue and do not record it as a FAIL against ARC-038.
CONFIRMING (waking-consolidation mode is architecturally necessary for viability-map integration): Phase1-ENABLED harm rate is meaningfully lower than Phase1-ABLATED (effect >= 0.8 SD of the cross-seed delta), AND Phase1-ENABLED shows the predicted Phase0->Phase1 integration improvement (harm rate drops from Phase0 baseline) while Phase1-ABLATED does not (harm rate stays at or near Phase0 baseline -- the ABLATED arm should now reproduce 355a's non-propagation pattern deliberately, as the control, rather than as an unexplained degeneracy).
FALSIFYING (waking-consolidation mode is NOT architecturally necessary / does no integration work distinct from other write paths): even with the MECH-261 gate confirmed live and MECH-092 confirmed triggering, Phase1-ENABLED and Phase1-ABLATED harm rates remain statistically indistinguishable (no meaningful delta, gate-state check passing so this cannot be attributed to the 355a degeneracy) on >=2/3 seeds -- the map integrates (or fails to) regardless of whether waking-consolidation-mode gating is engaged, indicating either the map updates through some other path or the task-focused/consolidation replay-mode distinction ARC-038 asserts does no architectural work.

ARC-039.subject: hippocampus.entorhinal_offline_consolidation
ARC-039.title: Durable long-term storage of the hippocampal viability map requires a hippocampal-entorhinal loop that engages during offline (sleep/DMN-equivalent) consolidation and provides a coordinate-invariant grid representation; this loop does not operate during waking planning or waking immobility consolidation.
ARC-039.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the full hippocampal-entorhinal grid circuit must exist before this claim is testable -- a separate entorhinal grid module, an offline (sleep-equivalent) processing phase distinct from waking micro-quiescence, and a read-back mechanism that seeds waking hippocampal sequences from the grid representation. None of this exists in V3 regardless of the machine-readable implementation_phase tag above (see PHASE-TAG NOTE below); the claim's own notes describe it as V4-scope. The one V3 proxy attempted so far (ResidueField.integrate() every 20 episodes) was shown NOT to be a valid substitute -- EXQ-214 (2026-04-03) found it actively DEGRADES residue-hazard correlation (mean_delta_accuracy=-0.283) rather than consolidating it, so a negative result on that proxy cannot be read as evidence against this claim, and no other V3-buildable proxy is known. CONFIRMING: once the V4 hippocampal-entorhinal circuit exists, viability-map durability over long training runs (e.g. residue-hazard correlation measured across extended episodes) is measurably better with the offline entorhinal-loop consolidation active than with it disabled, AND the grid-coded representation demonstrably generalises across environment layouts (coordinate-invariance) in a way the episodic hippocampal representation alone does not. FALSIFYING: once the V4 circuit exists, offline consolidation via the entorhinal loop shows no durability benefit over an episodic-only baseline, or the grid representation fails to generalise across environments -- meaning the specific mechanism (a hippocampal- entorhinal loop engaging only during offline/immobility periods) is not what durable map storage actually needs, even if some other consolidation approach eventually is. PHASE-TAG NOTE (flagged 2026-08-08, not resolved here): implementation_ phase: v3 above is not a data-entry error -- it is a mechanical reclassification applied by scripts/check_claim_phase_consistency.py, triggered by MECH-261's own depends_on: ARC-039 edge (commented "offline consolidation target"). That edge looks mistyped as a build prerequisite: MECH-261 reached status:stable in V3 (V3-EXQ-446/455/453) while ARC-039's entorhinal circuit never existed, i.e. MECH-261 did not actually need ARC-039 built first -- it reads more like a forward reference to a future write target than a true dependency. ARC-039 also never had phase_locked: true set, which would have routed this to the checker's CONFLICT path (human adjudication) instead of a silent RECLASSIFY. Flagged for whoever owns that checker/validator logic; not fixed in this pass.
RESOLVED 2026-08-10 (chip chip-20260810-phase-consistency-reconciliation): fixed exactly as diagnosed above -- MECH-261.depends_on: ARC-039 deleted, implementation_phase reverted v3 -> v4, phase_locked: true set. See evidence/planning/arc039_phase_reclassification_staged_20260808.md.

ARC-041.subject: architecture.frontal_cue_weighting_circuit
ARC-041.title: The frontal cue-weighting circuit -- E1 cue-indexed retrieval (MECH-150) feeding dual pathways to E2 action biasing (MECH-151) and E3 terrain precision scaling (MECH-152) -- completes the stored-to-active pathway specified in ARC-035 by providing the retrieval mechanism and dual downstream output architecture.
ARC-041.what_would_answer:
RELATIONSHIP TO SD-016: ARC-041 and SD-016 describe the identical
physical mechanism (E1 ContextMemory queried with z_world alone ->
cue_context -> MECH-151 action-bias output + MECH-152 terrain-weight
output) but at different claim altitudes and are NOT a near-duplicate
pair. SD-016 (claim_type design_decision, status implemented) is the
IMPLEMENTATION decision for the query mechanism itself
(E1DeepPredictor.extract_cue_context); ARC-041 (claim_type
architectural_commitment) is the higher-level claim that THIS CIRCUIT
SHAPE -- one retrieval feeding two structurally and biologically
distinct downstream pathways -- is the correct way to complete
ARC-035's stored-to-active pathway. SD-016 is upstream infrastructure
ARC-041 depends on, not a restatement of ARC-041.

DO NOT RE-DERIVE THE RETRIEVAL-MECHANISM QUESTION: SD-016's own
what_would_answer (this session) already covers the shared substrate
question in full -- its leg (A) RETRIEVAL-SELECTIVITY, answered
negatively for the originally-proposed remedy, with a named still-open
re-test path; and leg (B) DOWNSTREAM EXPLOITATION, untested and gated
on cue_action_proj consumer-wiring fix + SD-055 differentiable-CEM
behavioural validation. ARC-041's own falsifier is downstream of and
conditional on both legs of SD-016 clearing -- see SD-016's
what_would_answer for the acceptance criteria on the shared mechanism.

RESIDUAL CONTENT ARC-041 ASSERTS BEYOND SD-016 -- THE DUAL-PATHWAY
STRUCTURE: SD-016's leg (B) tests whether "action_bias/terrain_weight
get used behaviourally by E2/E3" as a single combined question.
ARC-041's distinctive claim is that this is genuinely a DUAL-OUTPUT
circuit -- cue_context reaching BOTH pathways, not just one -- mapping
onto the dual biological role of OFC (action gating) and vmPFC (value
weighting). MECH-152 (E3 terrain-weight leg) already has its own
independent partial evidence unrelated to SD-016's retrieval question:
EXQ-194/194a (2026-04-01) found the harm sub-pathway works (C1 PASS
3/3, r_w_harm=0.70) under phased/direct training that bypassed the
z_world cue-indexed retrieval question entirely, while the goal
sub-pathway does not (C2 FAIL, r_w_goal=-0.007). MECH-151 (E2
action-bias leg) by contrast has NO experimental evidence of its own
beyond the shared SD-016 blockers PLUS its own additional gate:
cue_action_proj's dead-gradient defect (SD-055, partially fixed
2026-05-15 but opt-in, behavioural validation still deferred) --
confirmed by V3-EXQ-640a: mean_cue_action_bias_norm NULL in all 6
cells under default settings.

CONFIRMING signature for ARC-041 (once SD-016 leg A retrieval-
selectivity clears AND SD-055/cue_action_proj consumer fixes land):
a discriminative test shows BOTH pathways independently tracking
retrieval content -- action_bias_div correlates with cue-context
identity (E2 leg) AND w_harm/w_goal correlate with cue-context
identity (E3 leg) -- run together in the same experiment so the
dissociation is directly observable.

FALSIFYING ARC-041 SPECIFICALLY (as distinct from falsifying SD-016
or either sub-mechanism alone): once both legs of SD-016 are cleared
and cue_action_proj/SD-055 gates are satisfied, only ONE of the two
pathways shows content-tracking behavioural divergence while the
other remains flat -- this falsifies the DUAL-pathway architecture
specifically, even though it would leave the surviving single
pathway's own mechanism claim (MECH-151 or MECH-152) intact.

MECH-160 DIFFERENTIAL-UPDATE-RATES SUB-CLAIM -- OUT OF SCOPE HERE:
ARC-041's notes flag that E2 action_bias and E3 terrain_weight
"should have different update rates," citing MECH-160. MECH-160 is
its own un-evidenced candidate claim (evidence: [], no
what_would_answer) proposing a REVISION to ARC-041's current design.
This is a refinement layered on top of ARC-041, not a component of
ARC-041's own falsification.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: same as SD-016's -- selection entropy
pinned at the uniform ceiling is not evidence against ARC-041, it is
