ARC-043.title: The REE ethical architecture is organised as a conceptual stack: Layers 0-4 are the five axioms (epistemic ground, existence, other minds, shared world, love/shared valence); Layer 5 is ethics derived from the axioms; Layer 6 is REE as the decision system implementing ethics under uncertainty; Layers 7-9 close the action-consequence-learning loop.

ARC-044.subject: architecture.neuromodulatory_gain_unifier
ARC-044.title: Context-dependent neuromodulatory gain is a single unifying mechanism expressed at multiple levels: ARC-016 (temporal precision from prediction error variance), MECH-152 (contextual terrain weight from cue-indexed retrieval), MECH-026 (arousal-mediated vigilance sensitivity), and MECH-093 (z_beta heartbeat frequency modulation) are all facets of a global arousal/precision signal (LC-NE) modulated by a context-specific gain signal (vmPFC/OFC).
ARC-044.what_would_answer:
CURRENT EVIDENCE STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): ARC-044 has never been tested, in whole or in part. No experiment has varied context and temporal state jointly against either MECH-152 or ARC-016, and no ARC-044-tagged queue entry or proposal exists (checked evidence/experiments/, manual_proposals.v1.json, experiment_proposals.v1.json, governance_agenda.v1.json, substrate_queue.json, ree-v3/experiment_queue.json). The claim's own notes already specify the falsifying design in full: vary context (hazard-gradient vs resource-proximate, i.e. MECH-152's cue_context axis) and temporal state (stable vs volatile, i.e. ARC-016's running_variance regime) simultaneously, and read off whether the two gains combine MULTIPLICATIVELY or merely ADDITIVELY/independently.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two mechanisms under test must each be independently confirmed live in the substrate before a null interaction can be read as evidence of independence, rather than as one arm being a wiring gap. ARC-016 (temporal gain): CONFIRMED live -- status stable, gate_green, mean_rho_rv_vs_commit=-0.955 (V3-EXQ-818, 2026-07-25); the substrate already computes volatility_estimate = var(running_variance) over a sliding window (Q-007, ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py), so the stable-vs-volatile axis is directly instrumented. MECH-152 (contextual gain), harm pathway only: CONFIRMED live -- V3-EXQ-194/194a C1 PASS 3/3, r_w_harm=0.70 (hazard-gradient context drives w_harm as specified). The GOAL pathway (w_goal) is FAIL (r=-0.007, flat) and is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this test -- the design must manipulate context along the harm axis, not attempt to recruit the unconfirmed goal pathway. A run in which either running_variance or w_harm shows negligible variance across its manipulated conditions must self-route substrate_not_ready / non_contributory, not be read as a test of ARC-044.
SCOPE NOTE: the claim's title also names MECH-026 (arousal-mediated vigilance sensitivity) and MECH-093 (z_beta heartbeat-rate modulation) as additional facets of the same unifying mechanism. MECH-093's rate-channel is independently confirmed (V3-EXQ-097b/396b/505), but MECH-026 has zero experimental evidence of its own and explicitly defers its mechanism to MECH-161, whose specific optimal-arousal-regulator controller is described only as something that "could be implemented as" a z_beta-gated controller -- i.e. it reads as UNBUILT, not merely untested (MECH-161: evidence: [], status: candidate). A full 4-facet unification test is therefore NOT testable now; this what_would_answer scopes to the 2-facet (MECH-152 x ARC-016) test the claim's own notes fully specify and that both required substrates already support.
CONFIRMING: a statistically significant multiplicative interaction term on the combined precision/gain readout (e.g. a 2x2 hazard-gradient/resource-proximate x stable/volatile design; interaction effect on effective_harm_precision, or equivalently on E3 harm-evaluation variability/commit-rate, exceeding what either main effect alone predicts) -- consistent with MECH-152 and ARC-016 being the same gain-control mechanism at different levels of description. Per the gain-control literature already cited in MECH-152's notes (Kanashiro et al. 2017), the confirming signature should also show that high w_harm x low running_variance jointly REDUCES harm-evaluation variability (signal-to-noise gain), not merely scales its magnitude -- distinguishing genuine shared precision-gain machinery from two independent magnitude-scaling knobs that happen to both multiply into the same downstream score.
FALSIFYING: the context x temporal-state interaction term is additive or null -- effects of w_harm and 1/running_variance combine linearly (or not at all) on the harm-evaluation readout, with no interaction term exceeding the main-effects prediction. This would falsify ARC-044's single-mechanism claim for the MECH-152/ARC-016 pair specifically: they would stand as REE currently implements them -- two independent gain knobs that happen to both scale harm evaluation, not facets of one underlying neuromodulatory gain architecture. A null result obtained despite both non-degeneracy preconditions holding (running_variance and w_harm both show healthy variance across their manipulated conditions) is a clean falsifier, not an instrument failure.

ARC-045.subject: hippocampus.bidirectional_information_flow
ARC-045.title: Bidirectional hippocampus-neocortex information flow is architecturally necessary for attribution mapping convergence: the SWS-direction (hippocampus to cortex) installs context schema structure; waking and REM-direction reactivations fill those structures with causal attribution estimates. Without bidirectional flow, context representations remain globally undifferentiated despite locally coherent online encoding.

ARC-046.subject: development.infant_hazard_protection
ARC-046.title: The infant stage requires a hazard protection mechanism that permits sensorially salient harm exposure without catastrophic residue saturation.
ARC-046.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED as of 2026-08-07. This is a testable-now falsifier design (reusing the V3-EXQ-591 curriculum-vs-flat structure: residue_scale_factor ~0.1 + reduced hazard_magnitude vs full-rate baseline), but it cannot be run validly today because the InfantCurriculumScheduler still fails its own Phase 0 advancement gate under the agent's current action-selection substrate (the precise 591-family failure mode). Two of the three original substrate prerequisites are now CLEARED: (a) MECH-307 default-value recalibration (V3-EXQ-540e/540g), and (b) non-trivial z_goal formation+consumption in default V3 config (V3-EXQ-603n PASS, 2026-06-10). Prerequisite (c), Phase 0->1 advancement, split in two: (c-2) the gate-criterion defect is RESOLVED end-to-end (crossing-count criterion identified V3-EXQ-591f PASS 2026-06-15, wired into InfantCurriculumScheduler 2026-06-19, commit b4dc264, opt-in no-op-default flag phase_0to1_use_crossing_count). (c-1), seed-46 exploration-strength collapse, remains OPEN and is the sole outstanding precondition -- see the corrected ceiling_routing_note above: its gate is now the MECH-457 competence-floor wall, NOT GAP-A (which is resolved and must not be re-cited).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before this falsifier is non-vacuous): the InfantCurriculumScheduler must actually advance past Phase 0 in BOTH the protected and full-rate arms (the 2026-05-27 V3-EXQ-591 failure mode -- scheduler stuck in Phase 0 across all 5 seeds, H_pos 0.03-1.08 vs the advancement gate -- must not recur), AND z_goal must develop non-trivially in both arms (must not collapse to ~1e-7 as in 591). Both require (c-1)'s clearance (the MECH-457 competence-floor wall) plus a successful, redesigned V3-EXQ-667a-class exploration-strength retest, ahead of the full curriculum-vs-flat comparison (EXQ-ISEF-005 / GAP-14).
CONFIRMING: once non-degenerate, infant-stage protected agents (residue_scale_factor ~0.1, reduced hazard_magnitude) show normal harm-signal learning -- z_harm_s and z_harm_a fire and train at a rate statistically indistinguishable from full-rate agents -- while residue accumulation over the curriculum stays measurably below full-rate agents, such that protected agents avoid the catastrophic-saturation failure mode (residue field saturating before a behavioral repertoire exists to avoid harm) that would otherwise block childhood-stage training (INV-041).
FALSIFYING: EITHER (i) protected agents show no meaningful reduction in residue accumulation relative to full-rate agents -- the residue_scale_factor / hazard_magnitude scaling does not actually protect the residue field; OR (ii) harm-signal learning is measurably degraded in protected agents relative to full-rate agents -- residue_scale_factor dampens the z_harm_s/z_harm_a LEARNING signal itself, not just downstream accumulation -- so the mechanism cannot decouple educative harm-learning from catastrophic-saturation protection as claimed. A design that needs two independently-tuned levers (one for learning-preservation, one for accumulation-suppression) is itself informative and should be recorded as a qualified falsification rather than folded into either branch.

ARC-047.subject: testing.social_scent_harness
ARC-047.title: Multi-agent gridworld with affective state leakage as gradient scent fields is the minimal substrate for empirically testing ARC-010 mirror modelling, MECH-041 affective expression, and cooperative behavior claims.
ARC-047.what_would_answer:
This is a MINIMALITY claim about test infrastructure, not a behavioral hypothesis -- it asserts that the specific 7-channel gradient-scent SocialGridWorld design (N agents + predator + wanting/seeking/alarm/harm_stress/direction/celebration/defense as diffusing Gaussian fields) is the MINIMAL environment sufficient to generate empirical evidence for ARC-010 (mirror modelling), MECH-041 (affective expression), and cooperative-behavior claims -- not merely A sufficient environment, but the SMALLEST one that works. A minimality claim cannot be answered by building the full design and having it work; that only shows sufficiency. It requires comparing the full design against deliberately simpler alternatives.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- three things must hold before any result here is informative, none currently true (checked 2026-08-08): (1) IMPL-019's self_stability_gate (DEV-NEED-021/026) is confirmed passing -- Stage 1 self-viability, Stage 2 control-plane stabilisation, Stage 3 rollout feasibility, all demonstrated in single-agent CausalGridWorld across seeds; as of this writing this gate is OPEN, no evidence artifact records it passing, and the queue-validation enforcement developmental_metrics.md calls for does not exist in ree-v3/validate_queue.py. (2) SocialGridWorld is actually built -- zero implementation exists anywhere in ree-v3 (no SocialGridWorld class, no scent-channel machinery). (3) A genuine ARC-010/MECH-041 mechanism is live and engaged during the run.
CONFIRMING (minimality is supported): a battery of deliberately SIMPLER substrate variants is run against the same claim set and each demonstrably FAILS to elicit measurable ARC-010/MECH-041/cooperative-behavior signal, while the full 7-channel SocialGridWorld succeeds on the same seeds/budget. Candidate simplifications, in order of removal: no predator, fewer scent channels (e.g. alarm+harm_stress only), discrete presence/absence signaling instead of continuous Gaussian gradient fields, no diffusion (point-source scent instead of a spatial gradient). If each simplified arm fails and only the full design succeeds, minimality is empirically supported -- not asserted, but shown load-bearing.
FALSIFYING (minimality is NOT supported -- ARC-047 as specified is over-built): any materially simpler substrate variant is SUFFICIENT to elicit the same target signal at comparable strength (e.g. binary presence/absence scent suffices for ARC-010 mirror modelling; 2-3 channels suffice for MECH-041; cooperative defense emerges without an autonomous predator). Any of these means ARC-047's specific design commits more implementation cost than the science requires and needs revision to the simpler sufficient design, not confirmation as stated.
A genuinely INDETERMINATE outcome is also possible and should be reported as such rather than forced either way: if simplified arms fail for reasons orthogonal to minimality (insufficient budget, seed variance, an unrelated control-plane instability inherited from an unresolved IMPL-019 gate), the comparison is confounded and does not bear on whether the full design's specific complexity is necessary.

ARC-048.subject: language.externalization_channel

ARC-049.subject: play.context_tag_architecture
ARC-049.title: Play mode boundary requires a co-maintained context tag held by both agent and environment; agent-internal tagging alone is insufficient and unilateral play assertion without mutual signal is manipulation.
ARC-049.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: the play_frame_tag mechanism named in this claim's
own notes (persistent L2 flag in LatentState, L1 frame_open/frame_close
events, L3 ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair signals) is UNIMPLEMENTED
in V3 -- confirmed by direct search of ree_core (2026-08): zero occurrences
of play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold anywhere
in the substrate. No experiment has exercised this mechanism. Everything
below is gated on building it first.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- WHAT IS AND IS NOT TESTABLE IN THE V3
DEGENERATE CASE: per this claim's own notes, V3's environment is
experimenter-complicit by design (the experimenter scripts play-mode
signals rather than a partner agent generating them autonomously). This
means:
  - TESTABLE IN V3 (single-agent, experimenter-scripted signal): whether
    the agent's OWN behavior differentially responds to L1 (frame open/
    close) and L3 (repair) events that the experimenter injects on a
    schedule. This tests whether play_frame_tag is load-bearing for the
    agent's own policy, not whether it is legible to or co-maintained
    with a partner.
  - NOT TESTABLE IN V3, REQUIRES V4/MULTI-AGENT: whether the tag is
    genuinely BILATERAL -- externally legible to and monitored by a
    partner that can independently initiate a frame violation or a
    repair, rather than following an experimenter's script. This is
    specifically the clause "unilateral play assertion without mutual
    signal is manipulation" (INV-059). A scripted experimenter can only
    ever cooperate with the frame; it cannot play the role of a partner
    who is deceived by a unilateral assertion, so the manipulation
    signature cannot be produced or falsified in V3. Sibling questions
    Q-050 and Q-051 already establish this precondition explicitly for
    games-with-rules and cooperative play, and the same reasoning
    applies to ARC-049's own bilateral clause.

CONFIRMING signature (V3-testable slice, once play_frame_tag is built):
following the Q-048/Q-049 pattern, inject an aggression-adjacent action
(bite-shake or equivalent) at an ambiguity juncture, with two arms --
(1) L3 repair signal present immediately after the action, (2) L3 repair
signal withheld. Measure post-juncture behavior (continuation of
play-typical action selection vs escalation/withdrawal consistent with a
real-harm read). ANSWER "genuine frame-tracking" if behavior differs
measurably between arms in the direction predicted by Bekoff 1995's
non-random repair-signal placement, at or above an effect-size floor
across >=2/3 seeds. This also requires L1 (frame open/close) to produce a
detectable behavioral state change on its own, as a baseline check that
the tag is read at all before testing L3's selective effect.

FALSIFYING signature: behavior at ambiguity junctures is statistically
indistinguishable between L3-present and L3-absent arms (and/or L1
open/close events produce no detectable behavioral change) -- the
play_frame_tag is tracked internally but not load-bearing for action
selection, i.e. decorative rather than functional. This would falsify the
V3-testable slice without touching the bilateral/manipulation clause,
which remains open regardless (see below).

SCOPE OF WHAT A PASSING V3 RESULT WOULD AND WOULD NOT ESTABLISH: a PASS
on the confirming signature above would show a co-maintained-style tag CAN
be functionally load-bearing for an agent's own behavior. It would NOT
confirm the full claim as titled -- the bilateral co-maintenance
requirement and the "unilateral assertion is manipulation" clause are
untestable without a partner agent capable of independently violating or
repairing the frame (V4 multi-agent, per INV-059 and Q-050/Q-051). The
full claim stays substrate_conditional/open even if the V3 slice passes.

ARC-051.subject: goal.emergent_hierarchy
ARC-051.title: multi_level_wanting_goal_hierarchy
ARC-051.what_would_answer:
Three-arm ablation (full hierarchy / MECH-217-removed / MECH-216-removed), predicting scale-specific degradation: removing MECH-217 hurts paths longer than the E1 schema radius; removing MECH-216 hurts environments with reliable approach cues but no clear CEM-horizon gradient.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all three write paths (SerotoninModule.update_benefit_salience, REEAgent.update_schema_wanting, HippocampalModule.backward_credit_sweep) verified firing via logged write counts (not just flag state) in the full-hierarchy arm; hippocampal.wanting_weight > 0; task suite has genuine independent variation in path-length-vs-schema-radius AND cue-reliability-vs-gradient-clarity so the two conditions do not collapse onto each other.
CONFIRMING: degradation is concentrated at each level's claimed operating scale (near-parity to full-hierarchy outside that scale), not uniform across scales.
FALSIFYING: (1) removing a level produces no measurable degradation anywhere (not load-bearing under the tested distribution); or (2) degradation is uniform across scales (undifferentiated pooled wanting signal, not an emergent scale-differentiated hierarchy); or (3) the level-to-scale mapping is inverted (removing MECH-216 hurts long paths more than removing MECH-217, or vice versa).
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: substrate confirmed BUILT and wired -- all three write paths exist in ree-v3/ree_core, gated by independent default-off flags (serotonin.tonic_5ht_enabled, e1.schema_wanting_enabled, hippocampal.use_backward_credit_sweep), composable into the ablation with zero new implementation. Zero experimental evidence exists (claim_evidence.v1.json: 4 literature entries only); no experiment queued. Note for the eventual queue entry: SD-014's wanting-write was found entangled with VALENCE_LIKING (V3-EXQ-887, |Spearman|=0.93-0.97); a decoupling fix (incentive_sensitization_enabled) landed 2026-08-07 but stays default-off -- state explicitly which state this ablation runs under.

ARC-053.subject: architecture.temporal_coherence_loop
ARC-053.title: Temporal Coherence Loop (TCL): architecture must include a distributed loop responsible for maintaining phase alignment and temporal synchrony necessary for V(t) to be computable.
ARC-053.what_would_answer:
This is an arch_commitment sitting on THREE dependencies, all already
audited this session and all reporting the same result: the
mechanism this claim requires does not exist, and one candidate
implementation explicitly declines to be it.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (this is the blocker, check nothing else
first): a claim about a "loop that maintains phase alignment for
V(t)" is not statable in falsifiable form while V(t) itself has no
phase-alignment term to maintain. Per this session's INV-067 audit,
V(t) is UNBUILT as a literal combined quantity -- content agreement
C_i has a Stage-1 proxy only (MECH-269), phase alignment P_i has NO
implementation and NO functional analog anywhere in the substrate.
Per this session's INV-068 audit, D_V (temporal depth/persistence of
coupling) is equally unbuilt -- no D_V computation exists, and there
is no consumer wiring into E3 even if one did.

Independent spot-check this session (grep of ree_core/ and
experiments/ for phase_align, temporal_coherence, TCL,
phase_reference, phase coupling, synchrony, oscillat): confirms no
TCL-shaped mechanism exists. The only related implementation is
cross_stream_binder.py, whose own module docstring states binding-
by-synchrony is LEARNED, not a fixed phase-coupling field -- the
opposite design choice from what TCL specifies. BreathOscillator
(MECH-108) is a periodic threshold sweep, not phase/timing-window
coupling.

MECH-089 is the sharpest finding, because it is not merely
"unbuilt" -- it is a DELIBERATE ARCHITECTURAL DISCLAIMER. MECH-089
(cross-frequency temporal packaging, the one dependency of ARC-053
that could plausibly implement phase/timing coupling) states
explicitly: "implemented as a rolling aggregation over E1 outputs
before E3 sampling, NOT as oscillatory coupling... the biological
mechanism (theta-gamma CFC) is one implementation of this functional
requirement; it is not required in the ANN substrate." So this is
not one un-built dependency plus two others -- it is three
compounding blockers, one of which is a standing design decision
against the mechanism class ARC-053's title names.

What would need to change before this becomes testable:
  (a) V(t) needs at least a computed phase-alignment term P_i(t) to
      exist (ARC-055 Stage 2, itself status: candidate and unbuilt).
  (b) An actual timing/synchrony-adjustment mechanism, distinct from
      MECH-089's disclaimed rolling-aggregation approach, would need
      to be built -- OR MECH-089's existing scope would need to be
      re-examined as already discharging what ARC-053 requires,
      under a non-anatomical name.

LIVE ARCHITECTURAL QUESTION (flagged, not resolved here): does the
ANN substrate genuinely need literal phase/oscillatory coupling to
make V(t) computable, or does MECH-089's functional-analog rolling
aggregation already satisfy ARC-053's functional requirement --
"ensure ascending and descending signals meet in a comparable
temporal frame before comparison" -- just not implemented as a
distributed phase-alignment loop and not named TCL? If the latter,
ARC-053 as currently titled may be asking for a specific biological
IMPLEMENTATION where only the functional REQUIREMENT is
architecturally necessary -- in which case the claim needs
re-scoping to the requirement level before it can be evaluated at
all. This mirrors MECH-089's own stated position and should be
resolved by whoever next touches ARC-053/MECH-225/MECH-226, not
assumed either way here. This propagates forward: ARC-053 is itself
a load-bearing dependency for ARC-054, ARC-055, MECH-226, MECH-227,
MECH-228.

Re-audit only after (a) above lands, i.e. once V(t) has a real,
non-collapsed phase-alignment term computed and reachable by E3/E1.

ARC-056.subject: architecture.ethics_as_coherence_optimisation
ARC-056.title: Ethics-as-coherence architecture: ethical trajectory selection is implemented as optimisation of shared temporal-depth coherence across self and represented others.
ARC-056.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: J_ethical's terms are all unbuilt/unexercised -- D_V_self (ARC-054) flag defaults off; D_V_j needs the same multi-agent substrate INV-028/029 are independently blocked on; beta_j and the threat/similarity classifier (INV-070) confirmed absent from ree_core/. Can only be evaluated for internal consistency, not audited live.
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL, testable now by argument): does the axiom -> D_V mapping hold together? Does beta_j -> 0 recover ARC-054's J(pi) exactly (no discontinuity)? Does the violence condition (beta_j collapse OR self-preservation forcing a D_{V,j} sacrifice) exhaustively partition the case space? CONFIRMING: strict generalisation, beta_j -> 0 recovers ARC-054 exactly, violence condition jointly exhaustive. FALSIFYING: a coherent counterexample where the limit doesn't recover ARC-054, or a case the two-branch violence condition can't classify.

CONFIRMING: trajectory ranking shifts in the axiom-consistent direction, shift size scales with beta_j (not all-or-nothing) -- formula does real work. FALSIFYING: no measurable difference beyond a beta_j-blind baseline (formula present but decorative), or an agent whose beta_j has collapsed shows no differential willingness to sacrifice that target's D_{V,j}.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion, not resolved here): ARC-096 and ARC-097 (registered 2026-06-10, same day as this claim's v4 -> v5 push) each already carry possible_overlap_with: ARC-056 -- review for merge -- pre-existing and unresolved; a claims.yaml disposition call for governance, not digestion.

ARC-059.subject: developmental.three_stage_ordering
ARC-059.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate SD-003 requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.
ARC-059.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this ordering claim is not yet
constructible as a clean ablation on V3 as built, and two distinct
gates must clear before either test below is informative. (1) V3
currently hand-wires the action space (MECH-277's own note: "V3
hand-wires action knowledge into the agent... MECH-277 is not
actively tested in V3"), so a literal "withhold stage 1" manipulation
must specifically degrade or ablate the counterfactual-backed self/
world attribution mechanism the agent would otherwise use -- not
merely truncate an arbitrary phase's episode count while the action
space stays fully specified underneath. (2) The MECH-276 scientist-
agent counterfactual-backed attribution feedstock that MECH-278's
stage-2 object-schema signal depends on is not itself substrate-
ready: V3-EXQ-703 (2026-06-23, confirmed failure-autopsy) found both
of its readiness preconditions unmet -- the P0 world-forward
comparator did not converge (world_forward_r2 mean -0.0547, 1/3 seeds
cleared the 0.20 threshold) and cf_margin was calibrated above the
achievable contrast band (0/3 seeds straddled backed/correlational).
This is the same untrained-P0-world-forward confound as
V3-EXQ-701/642, not a missing MECH-276 mechanism. The recommended
re-queue (converged P0 + recalibrated cf_margin, tentatively
V3-EXQ-703a) has not been run as of this draft. This is a different,
narrower substrate lineage than the SD-049 / scaffolded_sd054
foraging-competence family -- confirmed not the same substrate; do
not conflate the two. Until (1) and (2) both clear, a "stage-2-
without-stage-1" run that fails to form stable object-schemas is not
distinguishable from ordinary undertrained-base-representation noise,
and should self-route substrate_not_ready rather than count as a
verdict either way.

PRIMARY (skip-ordering ablation, per the claim's own falsifier): given
the precondition holds, an agent given stage-2 training (MECH-278
experimental-action object-schema formation) before stage-1 (MECH-277
action-space discovery / self-world attribution) is meaningfully
complete.

Confirming signature: the stage-2-before-stage-1 arm shows measurably
degraded, noisier, or less stable object-schema formation than a
matched stage-1-then-stage-2 arm (same total budget, same eventual
environment/feature set) -- because self-produced and world-produced
sensory change cannot yet be reliably distinguished. This would
confirm the ordering is load-bearing, not merely a convenient
scaffold.

Falsifying signature: the stage-2-before-stage-1 arm forms object-
schemas statistically indistinguishable in stability/noise from the
properly-ordered arm -- object-schema formation does not measurably
depend on prior self/world disambiguation. This would undercut the
claimed dependency between MECH-277 and MECH-278 even if the
individual stage mechanisms each hold in isolation.

SECONDARY (SD-005 shortcut-validity check, per the claim's own
falsifier -- V4-scoped, and a validity check on OTHER V3 claims that
depend on SD-005's engineered z_world, not only on ARC-059 itself):
given the precondition holds AND MECH-277's self/world distinction is
genuinely live (not hand-wired), ablate the engineered z_world
(SD-005) and require the agent to reconstruct an object-schema
decomposition via experimental (interventional) action alone.

Confirming signature: the reconstructed decomposition matches the
engineered SD-005 split -- features the engineered version groups as
one object are recovered as causally coherent bundles under
intervention, and vice versa. This shows the V3 engineered-z_world
shortcut was benign for every other V3 claim resting on SD-005's
z_world as a stand-in for developmentally-formed object
representation.

Falsifying signature: the reconstructed decomposition diverges
materially from the engineered split -- meaning the engineered
z_world smuggled assumptions the agent would not independently form,
and any OTHER V3 claim resting on SD-005's split needs re-examination
once V4's genuine experimental-action construction is available.

Evidence status (2026-08-07): no V3 experiment has queued or run

ARC-062.subject: policy.rule_apprehension_layer.weak_reading

ARC-062.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (both required before any C1/C2 result on this
claim can be read as decisive):

(1) ARC-062 READINESS/NON-VACUITY GATES (C1a-f, GAP-B behavioural falsifier
design). ANY gate failing self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a
falsification: (a) committed-class axis exercisable (frac_pre_ge2 > 0.30);
(b) GAP-A consumed-summary divergence real (pairwise dist mean > 0.05,
bounded); (c) ARM_ON rule field matured (crf_frac_active >= 0.30 of P2 ticks,
minted-rule floor cleared); (d) propagation non-vacuity (paired |bias_ON -
bias_OFF| > 1e-3); (e) MECH-448 demotion lever live and actually excluding
(not all-admit); (f) MECH-449 active No-Go live and actually suppressing (not
inert). These gates have been repeatedly, non-degenerately CLEARED across the
GAP-B lineage (654i/654j/485h/485m/714/719a and others) -- the minted
rule-apprehension bias demonstrably reaches the E3 accumulator with genuine
modulatory authority. A run that fails any (a)-(f) says nothing about
ARC-062/MECH-309 and must not be read as a weakens.

(2) SHARED DOWNSTREAM CONVERSION CEILING. Every ARC-062 GAP-B behavioural
falsifier run (V3-EXQ-654g/654j/485h/485m/714/719a, 21 autopsies) shows
the identical C1-holds/C2-fails signature: rule-biased signal reaches E3
with genuine authority but fails to convert to committed-class diversity
(MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling, shared by both readings,
in-flight via ARC-108/MECH-450). Until this lifts, any committed-action
strong-vs-weak test is confounded.

CONFIRMING SIGNATURE (supports MECH-309 + ARC-062):
Both (1) C1(a)-(f) ALL clear non-degenerately, AND (2) C2 -- the PRIMARY
falsifier -- clears: paired-by-seed lift in committed_class_entropy_nats,
ARM_ON over ARM_OFF, of at least 0.05 nats (C2_LIFT_MARGIN_NATS,
strict-above-by-margin), on a majority (>=2/3) of seeds. This has never yet
occurred across 21 runs.

FALSIFYING / PRESENT-STATE SIGNATURE (the observed condition, 21 times):

crf_frac_active 0.94, GAP-A divergence 0.080, MECH-448 excluded_count

CURRENT REGISTERED STATE (as of the most recent governance note,

ARC-064.subject: rule_discovery.bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway
ARC-064.title: bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).
ARC-064.what_would_answer:
A two-arm learning-curve comparison on a no-external-cue substrate where
the rule must be discovered from the observed-behaviour stream, matched
by a second run on a cued-control substrate where the rule is
externally signalled. This operationalises the design the claim's own
functional_restatement already specifies.

DESIGN: ARM_0 = ARC-062-alone (top-down gated-policy + learned context
discriminator, the existing V3 rule-apprehension instantiation). ARM_1
= ARC-062 + ARC-064 children (at minimum the load-bearing subset of
MECH-316 cross-episode regularity extraction, MECH-317 behavioural-
pattern compression, MECH-318 rule-state abstraction). Substrate
candidates named in the claim's own evidence_quality_note: SD-054
extended with hidden cross-episode structure (a transition/reward
contingency that varies between two regimes with NO externally
observable cue distinguishing them), or a serial-reaction-time-task
analog with hidden sequence structure. Run BOTH arms on BOTH the
no-cue substrate and a matched cued-control variant (same substrate,
rule signalled by an explicit external cue).

CONFIRMED if, on the no-cue substrate, ARM_1 produces a measurably
better learning curve than ARM_0 (lower episodes-to-criterion, higher
terminal reward, or earlier behavioural divergence between the hidden
regimes) AND, on the cued-control substrate, ARM_1 gives no material
benefit over ARM_0 (consistent with "ARC-062 alone suffices when the
cue is external"). This dissociation -- large ARC-064 contribution
only where the rule must be discovered -- is what would establish
bottom-up rule discovery as architecturally distinct, load-bearing
functionality rather than a redundant restatement of the top-down
pathway.

FALSIFIED if, on the no-cue substrate, ARM_1 does not outperform ARM_0
beyond noise (adding MECH-316/317/318 gives no measurable
learning-curve advantage even when the rule genuinely must be
discovered from behaviour alone), OR if ARM_0 alone already solves the
no-cue task at a rate matching ARM_1 (existing top-down/updater
machinery already suffices for what looks like "discovery," so the
claimed bottom-up/top-down architectural distinction is not
load-bearing). Either result argues ARC-064 does not name a separate
architectural function from ARC-062.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (all required before either verdict is
interpretable):
(1) The no-cue substrate must not be trivially solvable by chance or
rote memorisation independent of any rule-discovery machinery -- ARM_0
(or a null/random-policy control) must not already saturate
near-ceiling performance on the no-cue task for reasons unrelated to
rule discovery (e.g. an episode horizon too short for the hidden
regime to matter, or a reward structure solvable by a fixed policy
regardless of regime).
(2) The comparison must clear the SAME structural conversion-ceiling
bottleneck already identified on the sibling ARC-062/MECH-309
falsifier line (MECH-439 F-dominance / E3 commit-selection-authority
coupling -- V3-EXQ-654-series through 700b, most recently reconfirmed
unresolved by V3-EXQ-851, 2026-08-01): whatever bottom-up-derived rule
signal MECH-316/317/318 mint must be shown to actually reach committed
action (readiness gates analogous to the ARC-062 GAP-B C1 gates), not
merely exist in representation. Absent that check, a null ARM_1 result
is confounded with the known selection-authority washout rather than
informative about the top-down/bottom-up architectural question -- the
same failure mode V3-EXQ-606 (below) ran into for MECH-318 alone.
(3) MECH-316/317/318 must exist as at least minimally functional
substrate before the comparison can run at all.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): none of the three
preconditions are met. MECH-316, MECH-317, and MECH-318 all remain
candidate/v3_pending with zero built substrate; their most recent
live_status.as_of is 2026-07-11 with no evidence beyond the original
2026-05-10 literature registration, except MECH-318, which has one
directly-relevant but inconclusive prior attempt: V3-EXQ-606
(2026-05-21, "ARC-064 GAP-I MECH-318 multi-rule empirical gate") ran
C3 rule_state_active PASS (wiring live) but C1/C2 behavioural
cross-regime tests failed on 2/3 seeds, self-routed as premature --
fired before its resume_condition (V3-EXQ-543k contributory PASS) was
met. That condition still is not met (543k itself is FAIL/mixed).
MECH-309 (ARC-064's other direct dependency) remains
candidate/v3_pending/substrate_ceiling as of its most recent entry
(2026-08-01, V3-EXQ-851 autopsy); the decisive V3-EXQ-700b test
(2026-06-24) itself returned FAIL/non_contributory
(precondition-unmet, self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue) rather
than resolving the conversion-ceiling question either way. ARC-064's
OTHER dependency, ARC-065, HAS converted (substrate_ceiling lifted

ARC-065.subject: rule_apprehension.behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway
ARC-065.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

ARC-066.subject: action.tonic_vigor_coupling
ARC-066.title: tonic_vigor_coupling (capacity-to-action-bias, average-reward-rate / LC-NE tonic / DA effort-vigor analog). Architectural commitment: behaviour-bias toward action scales with capacity (high energy AND low recent prediction error AND low drive -- 'things are going well, deploy'), independent of any specific target. Distinct from existing behavioural-source slots (z_harm threats, z_goal deficit-seeded wants, novelty curiosity) which all fall to zero when the agent is well-fed, safe, and the world is familiar. Without ARC-066 a healthy REE agent has no gradient to act; biology has a positive gradient (felt phenomenology: drive to deploy energy when one has it). First of three slots in the non_deficit_action_drives family; companion ARC-067 (idle aversion / boredom) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) cover the aversive-of-rest and cost-of-passivity halves of the same architectural commitment. Family principle: behaviour comes from surplus capacity AND from deficits, not deficits alone.

ARC-067.subject: action.idle_aversion_boredom
ARC-067.title: idle_aversion_boredom (sustained-low-engagement aversive valence accumulator). Architectural commitment: prolonged low-engagement is itself negatively valenced; the agent acts to escape boredom, even in the absence of specific targets, threats, or novelty pressure. Distinct from the policy-side ARC-066 vigor coupling: ARC-067 instantiates an aversive-side accumulator that recruits the same downstream as actual harm (z_harm-like channel), so engagement-poverty competes for action-selection priority on the same axis as discomfort. Companion to ARC-066 (vigor / capacity-deploy) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) in the non_deficit_action_drives family.

ARC-068.subject: action.opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty
ARC-068.title: opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty (waiting accumulates forgone-reward cost; passive trajectories pay for time consumed). Architectural commitment: trajectories that consume time without progress are not free in E3 scoring; the score function carries an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary candidates that scales with the agent's average expected reward rate. Companion to ARC-066 (capacity-to-vigor) and ARC-067 (idle aversion). Existing dACC switch_value (SD-032b / Kolling 2015 foraging) is the closest current substrate but covers a different framing (when to switch FROM the current option to alternatives), not the always-on cost of choosing the null action.

ARC-069.subject: policy.hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation
ARC-069.title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.
ARC-069.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS: (a) ARC-071 LEG 2 cleared -- chunks survive E3 re-evaluation (use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit, landed 2026-08-01, not yet measured); (b) ARC-070 mid-execution reachability already confirmed (V3-EXQ-839); (c) a long-horizon repeating task run with both mechanisms live vs. an ARC-069-OFF control. None queued to date.
CONFIRMING: OFF control still flat-grain at episode 1000; ON arm shows BOTH rollout-cost drop on repeatedly-successful sub-sequences (partially corroborated: V3-EXQ-810a/810b) AND re-decomposition + cost recovery under induced prediction failure (partially corroborated: V3-EXQ-844 C2 PASS).
FALSIFYING: preconditions met, but ON arm shows no measurable compression despite the accumulator gate firing, and/or no re-decomposition despite a verified trigger -- the triggers fire individually but don't compose into the claimed cluster-level cost benefit.
EXPLICITLY NOT FALSIFYING: MECH-321's downstream selection-quality failures (V3-EXQ-844 C1, 867 family) -- that's a claim about candidate quality, not about grain-rescaling itself.
CROSS-REFERENCE: this is the cluster-level joint prediction, distinct from either child's own narrower claim -- see ARC-070/ARC-071 for their own what_would_answer.

ARC-070.subject: policy.decomposition_on_prediction_failure
ARC-070.title: policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'
ARC-070.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS: use_policy_decomposition + hippocampal.use_event_segmenter both live; the persistent commit handle (SD-084) present so the R4 mid-execution hook is genuinely reachable (confirmed per V3-EXQ-839: decomp_n_evaluated_midexec > 0 in ARM_HANDLE_ON, structural zero in ARM_HANDLE_OFF); a genuine mid-sequence high-MECH-269-V_s-drop region actually induced, not merely configured; each arm (WITH/WITHOUT ARC-070) independently commits at least one multi-action program.
CONFIRMING: with preconditions met, the WITH-ARC-070 agent's mid-execution decomposition hook actually fires (decomp_n_evaluated_midexec/decomp_n_decomposed_midexec >0, distinguishable from the WITHOUT arm's structural zero), AND either (a) yields a finer-grain re-plan that grounds -- operationalised as measurable forward-PE reduction following the re-decomposition/abort (already measured and PASSED by V3-EXQ-844's C2_FORWARD_PE_CORROBORATES) -- or (b) fails to find a grounding re-plan and aborts the trajectory. Per the claim's own registered prediction, EITHER (a) OR (b) confirms -- the architectural commitment is that decomposition FIRES under a genuine trigger, not that the alternative succeeds.
FALSIFYING: with the same preconditions satisfied, the WITH-ARC-070 agent nonetheless commits blind and executes the ungrounded remainder at a rate statistically indistinguishable from the WITHOUT-ARC-070 arm, even though its own trigger condition (V_s drop / MECH-288 boundary pulse) is genuinely met -- the mechanism does not engage when it architecturally should.
EXPLICITLY NOT FALSIFYING: a failure of the DOWNSTREAM task-level benefit (decomposition fires but does not reduce harm/improve reward, as V3-EXQ-844's C1 and the V3-EXQ-867/867a/867b family found) does not by itself falsify ARC-070 -- that is MECH-321's separate, narrower functional claim about the QUALITY of harm-aware selection among re-tiled candidates, not about whether re-segmentation occurs at all.

ARC-071.subject: policy.composition_via_repeated_grounding
ARC-071.title: policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.
ARC-071.what_would_answer:
Two distinct legs -- do not conflate "the accumulator exists and fires"
with "chunking buys anything." Both must independently clear before
ARC-071's functional_restatement can be scored supports/weakens.

LEG 1 (ANSWERED, PASS): does the chunk-formation/maintenance substrate
itself fire under non-degenerate conditions? YES -- V3-EXQ-810a
(2026-07-30, supports/standard, 7/8 seeds vs 0.75 pre-registered bar)
and V3-EXQ-810b (seed-202 narrow-repertoire follow-up, supports/
standard) confirm MECH-323/MECH-324 accumulate and maintain chunks with
non-vacuous margins (2.4x-7.0x floors). This leg is closed; do not
re-derive it.

LEG 2 (OPEN, gated on a substrate wiring fix, itself unvalidated): does
a formed chunk, once committed, actually SURVIVE across E3's internal
re-evaluation cycles long enough to be selected/executed as one atomic
move rather than silently re-deliberated at primitive grain? This is a
PRECONDITION for the claim's own falsifiable prediction and has gone
through two rounds of measurement defect:
  - V3-EXQ-841 (2026-07-31) found the between-tick readout
    mis-reporting persistence; fixed (ree-v3 278599a, flag
    use_persistent_committed_program_handle).
  - V3-EXQ-871 (2026-08-02) mis-scoped that flag across the WHOLE cell
    instead of the probe phase only, contaminating formation via
    RNG-coupled environment dynamics -- adjudicated
    measurement_test_design_defect, no evidence change
    (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-871_2026-08-02).
  - V3-EXQ-871a (2026-08-03), correctly scoped, confirmed fix (a)
    works, but exposed a SECOND, universal, deterministic gap (b): E3
    unconditionally recreates a fresh committed-trajectory object at
    every internal tick, 100% of ticks, both seeds
    (n_genuine_commits_identity_based == n_e3_ticks + n_episodes_probe,
    exact). Read non_contributory/competence_implementation_gap for
    MECH-090 (narrow to this wiring site; core gate-propagation
    mechanism unaffected). ARC-071 evidence UNCHANGED (exercised only
    as chunk-injection vehicle, same precedent as V3-EXQ-841 excluding
    MECH-323) -- still candidate/v3_pending.
  - Gap (b)'s fix landed (ree-v3 31ed78e, 2026-08-01, flag
    REEConfig.use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit, default False,
    bit-identical) and is tracked in substrate_queue.json (sd_id
    mech090-arc071-attick-persistent-handle-fix) as
    implemented_pending_validation -- as of this drafting (2026-08-07),
    NO experiment has run to confirm the fix restores cross-tick
    persistence (the redesigned DV n_genuine_commits/n_e3_ticks, per
    871a's own recommendation, has not been measured anywhere).

LEG 3 (NEVER ATTEMPTED, not merely blocked): the claim's own
falsifiable prediction -- rollout deliberation cost and behavioural
latency measurably drop on chunked sub-sequences relative to an
ARC-071-OFF control, once chunking reliably persists -- has NOT been
queued or run under any experiment to date. V3-EXQ-834
(budget-coupled-ceilings, FAIL, 2026-07-29) is the closest adjacent
work and explicitly disclaims this: "classified diagnostic... excluded
from confidence scoring on purpose," and its own driver docstring

expensive design" that was not built. No other queued or completed
experiment measures rollout_cost, deliberation_cost, or

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory guard, learned from the 871
incident): any future retest of LEG 2 or design of LEG 3 MUST (a)
confirm a chunk-commitment count clears a non-trivial floor (per
871a's own precondition, n_persistent_present_ticks >= 10, worst seed)
before trusting any downstream statistic, and (b) scope any
persistence-related flag (use_persistent_committed_program_handle, and
by direct analogy use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit) to the PROBE PHASE
ONLY -- never across formation -- since 871 showed that flipping such
a flag for the whole cell perturbs formation itself via RNG-coupled
environment dynamics, producing a measurement artefact
indistinguishable from a real substrate finding. LEG 2's verdict
statistic must additionally be tick-rate-normalised
(n_genuine_commits / n_e3_ticks, per 871a Section 6 recommendation #5)
rather than raw mean segment length, which was shown confounded by
e3_tick_rate (~4.4x variation between seeds, unrelated to whether the
latch holds).

CONFIRMED if, once (i) the AT-tick fix
(use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit) is validated to restore persistence
under the tick-rate-normalised DV, and (ii) a genuine ARC-071-ON vs
ARC-071-OFF contrast experiment is run on a repeating sub-task under

FALSIFIED if, with persistence confirmed working post-fix and the

Benefit clause.

ARC-072.subject: architecture.developmental_bootstrapping_and_cue_indexed_retrieval_gaps
ARC-072.title: developmental_bootstrapping_and_cue_indexed_retrieval_gaps -- REE lacks (1) a dedicated diversity-bootstrapping epoch that populates the hippocampal trajectory store before reinforcement narrowing; and (2) a differentiable cue-indexed retrieval path from PFC context representation to trajectory generation. EXQ-561 cluster / MECH-269 is diagnostic of gap (1); EXP-0155 zero-gradient cue_action_proj is diagnostic of gap (2). The two gaps are inter-dependent: the severed cue gradient (gap 2) is the mechanism that prevents diverse option population (gap 1).
ARC-072.what_would_answer:
CURRENT SUBSTRATE STATE (checked 2026-08-08): Gap 2 wiring closed (SD-055, V3-EXQ-568 PASS, grad_max=372) but use_differentiable_cem defaults False -- never behaviourally exercised. Gap 1 unambiguously absent (no cross-tick accumulation code). EXQ-563c/567 (Gap-1 diagnostics) measure only within-tick entropy, tagged ARC-065 not ARC-072 -- confirms rather than closes the claim's own caveat that they treat within-tick symptom only.
GAP 1 FALSIFYING: no diversity gap opens between epoch-given and no-epoch agents, or a gap opens but fully closes under later equivalent exploration. GAP 1 CONFIRMING: epoch-given agent retains a larger, cross-tick diverse library that persists.
GAP 2 FALSIFYING: with the flag on and gradient confirmed live, PFC context variation produces no retrieval difference (gradient flows but carries no cue-discriminative signal). GAP 2 CONFIRMING: distinguishable context states retrieve distinguishable trajectory subsets, absent with the flag off.
JOINT FALSIFYING: either gap closes independently of the other -- contradicts the claimed interdependence. JOINT CONFIRMING: Gap 1 does not close while Gap 2 stays severed (Warlaumont & Finnegan severed-feedback topology).
CROSS-REFERENCE: INV-073 names the same underlying gap from the general/ biological-principle angle and already carries an independent 2026-08-08 what_would_answer + a queue flag proposing flipping use_differentiable_cem=True to measure option diversity -- that flag serves both claims; do not duplicate it here.

ARC-073.subject: play.transition_criterion
ARC-073.title: Play-to-real transition is triggered by competence saturation (d(PE)/dt < threshold) or competitive drive pressure, not by scheduled duration; premature transition leaves policy structure undertrained.

ARC-074.subject: development.phase_0_reward_free_exploration_epoch
ARC-074.title: The infant stage requires a reward-free Phase 0 motor babbling epoch, prior to any E3 scoring or reward-weighted learning, in which Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, basic z_self structure, and non-trivial residue gradients are established.
ARC-074.what_would_answer:
CROSS-REFERENCE (mandatory reading before any retest is queued): this claim's mechanism is NOT an independent discovery. It is a candidate fifth locus in the registry's existing conversion-ceiling / monostrategy investigation (MECH-439 F-dominance, INV-088 representation-ceiling, MECH-457 competence-floor/actor-critic). That campaign has run 20+ confirmed experiments against a substrate where E3 is ALREADY ACTIVE and found the diversity-mechanism failure structural and downstream of selection (F-dominance) or attributable to representation under-differentiation in an already-training z_world (INV-088) or to action-learning-machinery failure independent of representation (MECH-457) -- NONE of which manipulate the pre-E3, pre-training period ARC-074 targets. INV-088's own memory record already proposes an untested "differentiate-first" ordering prediction structurally identical in shape to ARC-074's Phase 0, for z_world rather than the residue field specifically. ARC-074 should be read as sharpening/extending that untested ordering prediction to the residue field and to the very start of training, NOT as a rediscovery of the F-dominance or competence-floor findings, and NOT as something those findings already settle.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before any A/B result is treated as informative): (i) Phase0Config is actually implemented and wired ahead of E3 activation (epoch_steps, hebbian_lr, residue_entropy_min, z_self_loss_max gate criteria; Phase 0 skipped only on warm-start checkpoint load; gate failure within epoch_steps raises a training error) -- not a stub or no-op default. (ii) The gate criteria genuinely discriminate a trained vs. untrained state -- residue_entropy and z_self encoder loss must show real separation between fresh-init and Phase-0-completed agents. (iii) ARC-065's diversity mechanisms (MECH-313/314/320) are genuinely exercised downstream in both arms -- confirm non-zero diversity-channel activation in both arms so a null result cannot be attributed to the diversity stack being silently inert for an unrelated reason. (iv) The environment/task used is confirmed solvable (an oracle/greedy baseline clears the floor).
CONFIRMING (2-arm A/B, WITH-Phase-0 vs WITHOUT, diversity params at existing validated settings): E3 scores measurably differentiate once Phase 0 completes (residue_entropy and per-candidate E3-score variance both rise from step-0 baseline) AND the WITH-Phase-0 arm shows a measurable, non-degenerate diversity-mechanism effect the WITHOUT arm does not, under matched seeds/config.
FALSIFYING: monostrategy/V_s collapse persists in the WITH-Phase-0 arm at statistically indistinguishable levels from WITHOUT, despite the non-degeneracy preconditions holding. This would mean the root cause is NOT cold-start residue-field flatness but lies where the existing MECH-439/INV-088/MECH-457 cluster already localizes it -- in which case ARC-074 should be folded into that cluster's disposition rather than treated as a separate open front, and EXQ-ISEF-006's warm-start gate calibration should not be attempted on this substrate.
A partial result -- Phase 0's own gate met but E3 scores still fail to differentiate once Phase 1 begins -- is itself diagnostic: the ordering fix would be necessary but not sufficient, and should route to the F-dominance/representation-ceiling cluster rather than to a Phase0Config parameter retune.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: Phase0Config confirmed UNBUILT (zero hits across ree-v3/ree_core for Phase0Config/hebbian/phase_0/residue_entropy_min/z_self_loss_max outside an unrelated MECH-094/ARC-108 Hebbian eligibility-trace mechanism). EXQ-ISEF-006 has never been queued or run (absent from experiment_queue.json, evidence/, and git log -S on ree-v3).

ARC-075.subject: development.infant_curriculum_plasticity_magnitude_gating
ARC-075.title: The infant curriculum architecture must implement plasticity magnitude asymmetry across developmental phases, not only temporal phase scheduling: F's effective update weight must be suppressed during the MECH-333 plasticity-open window to allow diversity circuits to reach competitive weight; temporal scheduling alone (as in current GAP-9/GAP-14 implementation) is insufficient.

ARC-076.subject: development.commitment_loop_calibration_window_personality
ARC-076.title: Developmental commitment-loop calibration window with critical-period lock (two-layer): the three BG-like cortico-striatal commitment loops (ARC-021 / MECH-069 / ARC-023) are calibrated during a bounded juvenile/adolescent developmental window and then crystallized (an INV-075 LOCK-arm instance), and this locked calibration IS personality. The architecture is two-layer: (L1) the basic drive-prior set-points of the loops (temperament; the limbic-loop value prior) lock on a largely ENDOGENOUS maturational timer, while (L2) a downstream commitment-policy / characteristic- adaptation layer is calibrated by the juvenile play/peer environment and consolidated at window close. Personality is neither a pure environmental readout nor purely endogenous: the environment writes L2; the timer locks L1.

ARC-077.subject: rule_apprehension.socially_scaffolded_rule_population_pathway
ARC-077.title: Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). Architectural commitment: in biology the candidate-rule hypothesis space is not invented by the agent alone -- caregivers populate it from outside via scaffolded exposure (Vygotsky ZPD; Wood/Bruner/Ross scaffolding; Csibra & Gergely ostensive cueing / natural pedagogy; Tomasello shared intentionality; joint attention / social referencing). This is the most direct architectural answer to MECH-309: a non-Bayesian rule-creator that does not invent its own hypotheses receives candidate regularities, context-bound to the scaffolding episode, from a caregiver. The pathway fills the ARC-063 CandidateRule field (the 'in' face); MECH-337 is the population mechanism; MECH-338 is the cue-driven context-bound retrieval mechanism (the 'select' face). Registered 2026-05-18 as a structural slot only -- hard-gated on the GAP-L biology lit-pull and on a caregiver/teacher-agent substrate that does not yet exist in V3.
ARC-077.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED PRECONDITION: this claim is not yet testable, and the blocker is unchanged since registration (2026-05-18). Re-verified 2026-08-07: (a) the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate implementation_prerequisite (3) remains fully unmet -- grep of ree-v3/ree_core, experiments/, and coordinator/ for "caregiver" and "teacher_agent"/"teacher-agent" returns zero hits; every "scaffold" hit is a false positive (protective avoidance_scaffold_floor, SleepLoopManager Phase-A code scaffolding, InfantCurriculumScheduler -- a single-agent curriculum, not a second agent). V3 remains single-agent: no substrate exists that can deliver scaffolded exposure or ostensive cues from outside the learner. (b) Prerequisite (2), the ARC-063 CandidateRule field, is prototyped and v1-substrate-implemented (candidate_rule_field.py, 2026-06-04) for its CREATE/REPRESENT/GATE/CREDIT faces, but ARC-063's own record is explicit that "only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3)" -- the specific write-path this claim needs remains unbuilt. Prerequisite (1), the GAP-L lit-pull, is discharged (2026-05-18, lit_conf 0.74) and does not on its own promote the claim. Sibling routes ARC-062 (substrate_ceiling, v3_pending) and ARC-064 (hold_pending_v3_substrate) also remain unpromoted, consistent with the cluster as a whole staying pre-V3-tractable for this pathway.
Once the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate exists (a second agent, or an environment mechanism that can deliver ostensive/scaffolded cues independent of the learner's own action stream) and MECH-337 (population) + MECH-338 (cue-driven retrieval) are built on top of it, the discriminating test is the claim's own functional_restatement, made explicit:
DESIGN: hold ARC-065 (behavioural diversity) and the ARC-063 CandidateRule field substrate constant across two arms. ARM_0 = field + diversity, NO socially-scaffolded population channel (MECH-337/338 absent or disabled). ARM_1 = ARM_0 + MECH-337 (caregiver-scaffolded population) + MECH-338 (cue-driven, context-bound retrieval). Measure acquisition of context-bound rules whose discriminative cut is a function of agent/episode history rather than current observation -- i.e. rules that cannot be recovered from ARC-062's top-down context-discriminator route or ARC-064's bottom-up behaviour-clustering route alone, per this claim's peer-pathway framing.
CONFIRMING: ARM_1 acquires and reliably retrieves this class of context-bound, history-dependent rule (rollout-eligibility and behavioural expression track the scaffolding-episode context tag) where ARM_0 fails or acquires it at markedly lower rate/fidelity -- adding the socially-scaffolded channel rescues exactly the acquisition class ARM_0 cannot reach, sharpening ARC-063's falsifiable prediction (a) and validating ARC-077 as a genuinely distinct third rule-source rather than a redundant restatement of ARC-062/ARC-064.
FALSIFYING: ARM_1 shows no measurable acquisition or retrieval advantage over ARM_0 for this rule class -- the agent acquires the same context-bound rules at the same rate/fidelity with or without socially-scaffolded population, or ARM_0 (top-down/bottom-up routes alone) already reaches this class once the substrate exists. Either result means the "third source" framing is not doing independent work: the pathway is redundant with ARC-062/ARC-064's existing routes rather than a peer, and the claim should be reframed as a special case of one of them (or demoted) rather than carried forward as an independent architectural commitment.
This test cannot run, and this claim cannot be promoted or demoted on experimental grounds, until the caregiver/teacher-agent substrate is built. Until then this claim remains a structural slot backed by literature only (lit_conf 0.74), not evidence.

ARC-078.subject: goal.cue_addressed_unresolved_goal_retrieval
ARC-078.title: The unresolved-goal bank is a content-addressed cue-addressed retrieval system: the current goal/context is the retrieval cue, the SD-039 payload is the stored trace, and rank_ghost_goals() is cued recall. A correct bank must satisfy three structural constraints -- outshining-gated composite cue, dissociable-additive channels, and a non-closeable recoverability term with an explicit-divergence abandon path.
ARC-078.what_would_answer:
Adjudicated by an EXQ that flips MECH-339 (use_composite_cue_outshining), MECH-292 (use_mech292_ghost_bank, additive form), and MECH-340 (use_persistence_efficacy_gate) ON SIMULTANEOUSLY on one bank configuration, and contrasts flexible recovery of blocked/deferred goals across three arms: (i) the C1-C3-satisfying bank, (ii) a field-only agent (ARC-060 continuous-field prediction, no discrete bank), and (iii) a bank that violates C1 (no outshining gate / flat additive context term) or substitutes a closeable recoverability cutoff for C3's non-closeable term.
CONFIRMING: (i) recovers blocked/deferred goals more flexibly than both (ii) and (iii) on a shared task battery requiring goal deferral + later recovery under changed context, AND all three of C2's dissociated failure states are separately inducible: wanting-channel-only failure (goal_match suppressed/zeroed, entry still surfaces on drive alone), goal_match-channel-only failure (wanting suppressed/zeroed, entry still surfaces on cue match alone), and independent joint failure (neither channel alone reproduces the other's failure mode).
FALSIFYING: (i) does not outperform (ii) and/or (iii) on flexible recovery, OR fewer than all three of C2's failure states are inducible (e.g. the wanting and goal_match channels covary such that only one dissociated failure mode is reachable), OR the outshining/closeable-cutoff variant (iii) performs indistinguishably from (i).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all three flags must be genuinely wired ON together, not tested pairwise or with one held at its no-op default -- a single flag left OFF collapses the arm back toward a form already covered by an existing MECH-level confirmer (e.g. v3_exq_868, C2-only; v3_exq_823/807, C1-on-but-unmanipulated, C3-off) and would falsely read as support for or against the PARENT claim when it only tests a child. The task battery must require goal deferral-then-recovery that a field-only agent is STRUCTURALLY unable to solve (no discrete retrieval target to re-probe), not merely worse at solving.
HARD PRECONDITION shared with Q-053: MECH-340's three control/efficacy failure signatures must be inducible and separable on the substrate before C3 can be meaningfully included in this test; if Q-053's gate signal is still unresolved when this EXQ is designed, use its front-runner (control/efficacy unattainability appraisal) as C3's operationalisation and flag the result as conditional on that choice, not as an independent confirmation of it.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: currently BLOCKED at substrate-assembly, not at design -- C1/C2/C3 are each individually implemented (MECH-339, MECH-292, MECH-340 substrate landed) but all three master switches remain default OFF (use_composite_cue_outshining, use_mech292_ghost_bank, use_persistence_efficacy_gate) as of this check, no experiment has run them together, and no run has been tagged to the ARC-060-vs-ARC-078 comparison this claim requires. Q-053 confirmed still open, no experiment queued. One child substrate landing is not evidence for the parent architectural claim (per the claim's own notes) -- this EXQ is the missing joint test.

ARC-079.subject: goal.gated_persistence_disengagement_default
ARC-079.title: Persistence of an unresolved goal as an active re-probe target is a GATED control/efficacy-detection operation; disengagement is the ungated default. The trace is preserved (no erase -- this matches biology); 'abandonment' is the persistence gate failing to fire, after which the un-gated trace decays in rank and ceases to be re-probed. This RESOLVES ARC-078's C3 by inverting its 'add an explicit abandon path (deliberate divergence)' framing.
ARC-079.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (partially met): a built, separable gate between MECH-292/293 -- MET (MECH-340, PersistenceAppraisal struct, reads only control/unattainability, not recoverability/staleness/failure tallies). NOT MET: config-gated off, never run in a real experiment (exp_conf=0, no V3-EXQ queued).
CONFIRMING: an agent with (gate ON + default disengagement + preserved SD-039 trace) avoids BOTH rumination/intrusion (gate-stuck-on) AND apathy/learned- helplessness (gate keyed on failure generalising across goals).
FALSIFYING: either failure mode appears. Specific contrast: a bolted-on abandon-trigger control (the original, non-inverted ARC-078 C3 framing) is predicted to reproduce learned helplessness; if it doesn't (behaviourally indistinguishable from the gated design), the inversion's differential causal claim fails.

ARC-080.subject: representation.object_identity_primitive
ARC-080.title: Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.
ARC-080.what_would_answer:
NOT a standard empirical CONFIRMING/FALSIFYING pair -- ARC-080 is a THIN UMBRELLA / COHERENCE MAP (architectural_commitment / substrate_coherence), not a testable mechanism, so this specifies the REASSESSMENT TRIGGER for the COORDINATION-PRIMITIVE FRAMING ITSELF (the 2026-06-14 OBJ-1 resolution: an object is a binding of three non-reducing coordinate facets -- TYPE, ANCHOR, TOKEN), not a result that could confirm/refute the four pillars' own mechanisms.
TRIGGER: a real OBJ-2 build that actually COREGISTERS the three facets (not just builds one in isolation). CURRENCY CHECK (2026-08-08): the TOKEN facet alone (ARC-006/MECH-045) was implemented 2026-06-09 as ree-v3/ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py, wired into REEAgent behind a still default-off flag (use_object_file_buffer=False), with one supporting validation run (V3-EXQ-658, MECH-045 still provisional, not promoted). That predates the 2026-06-14 OBJ-1 decision and does NOT coregister with the TYPE store (SD-057) or ANCHOR store (SD-039) -- so the trigger is armed (one facet exists) but has not fired.
EVIDENCE RELEVANT AT THAT REASSESSMENT: does a coregistration build find two facets collapse cleanly into one (contradicting "none reduces to another")? Does keeping the facets coregistered-but-distinct produce a measurable advantage over a flat/collapsed representation on the diagnostics that motivated OBJ-1 (V3-EXQ-641a coherence-non-reducibility; z_world dim=32 discriminative ceiling)? Does the deferred token-vs-type individuation-strength sub-fork resolve compatibly? As ARC-081/082/083 (and the future Pillar-1 child) get built, do they cleanly instantiate as coordinate facets, or does any one need a mechanism outside the object-file/binding frame?
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE THE COORDINATION-PRIMITIVE FRAMING: (a) an OBJ-2 build showing two-or-more facets are not independently necessary; (b) a build showing coregistration yields no advantage over a flat/collapsed representation; or (c) a pillar build needing a mechanism outside the object-file/binding frame entirely. Any of these would revise the OBJ-1 decision and this umbrella's framing -- not any single pillar's own pass/fail result in isolation.
READER NOTE: do not tag ordinary pillar experiments (V3-EXQ-449, V3-EXQ-658, SD-055 differentiable-CEM runs, future ARC-081/082/083 runs) as confirming/falsifying ARC-080 directly -- they speak to the pillar-specific child claims. Only evidence about whether the three-facet coregistration STRUCTURE ITSELF holds up under a real coregistering OBJ-2 build is relevant here. No EXP-#### should be minted against ARC-080 directly.

ARC-081.subject: representation.self_as_object_file_slot
ARC-081.title: Self-as-object (PILLAR 2 of ARC-080): z_self becomes a privileged token-keyed object-file SLOT in the generalised object-file layer. The SELF BEGINS IN V3 -- z_self self/world split (SD-005), self-attribution (SD-003), action-space discovery / self-as-object stage 1 (MECH-277, ARC-059 stage 1), reward-free babbling Phase 0 (ARC-074). The object-file CUTOVER IS V4 -- z_self promoted from a body-state latent to a privileged self-OBJECT slot, gated by the DR-10..DR-14 self-model integration audit, MECH-214 (goal E1-representability), MECH-215 (self-model prerequisite for agentive prediction), INV-064 (maturational-sequence necessity), and SD-030 (E2 self-forward-model, V4-deferred). The beginning of self is V3; the object-file-slot cutover is V4.

ARC-082.subject: representation.tools_object_action_binding
ARC-082.title: Tools/affordances as object->action binding (PILLAR 3 of ARC-080): an object's afforded actions are bound to its object-file. The V3 SUBSTRATE EXISTS BUT IS UNGROUNDED -- SD-016 cue_action_proj is inert (V3-EXQ-449 found 0.0 gradient; the non-differentiable CEM blocks the path before E3.select; EXP-0155 queued to instrument). GROUNDING STRADDLES V3 on its own existing track (EXP-0155 instrumentation + the SD-055 differentiable-CEM dependency). FULL object->action binding via the object-file -- afforded actions keyed to a token-instance object-file slot -- IS V4, once the generalised object-file exists.

ARC-083.subject: representation.others_as_object_file_slot
ARC-083.title: Others-as-object (PILLAR 4 of ARC-080): each other agent j gets its own token-keyed object-file SLOT (z_self_j, z_harm_a_j, drive, commitment chain) -- a special case of the ARC-080 object-file. This pillar is V4 (ARC-010 mirror modelling, ARC-047 SocialGridWorld), gated on MECH-163 multi-step hippocampal planning. Per developmental_needs_register DEV-NEED-021 its prerequisites are object-permanence (PILLAR 1, partial via SD-039 ghost bank) + self-stability (PILLAR 2 self, ARC-081): otherness inference REQUIRES object persistence + a stable self.

ARC-084.subject: cognifold.signed_coupling_edge
ARC-084.title: Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).
ARC-084.what_would_answer:
Restated: once a V4 cognifold signed-edge layer exists, is competition (sign<0) genuinely a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode -- carrying its own gain, precision, gate, timescale, and write_authority that can be independently manipulated and that does causal work no other mechanism reproduces -- or is it fully reducible to (a redescription of) emergent competition already present in local selection softmaxes (MECH-090 BG winner-take-all, ARC-030 Go/NoGo, MECH-254 top-k)?
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the V4 cognifold_edge layer must exist and be wired with genuinely independent sign/gain/precision/gate/timescale parameters at the FIELD level -- not merely a relabeling or thin wrapper around MECH-090/ARC-030/MECH-254's existing local competition. A test is vacuous unless it can construct a scenario where the "softmax-emergent-competition" hypothesis and the "first-class-edge" hypothesis make DIFFERING predictions -- e.g. by holding local selection softmax temperature/top-k fixed while varying only the cognifold-edge sign/gain between two distant fields with no direct local-selection relationship. This is the same non-degeneracy floor Q-058 sets for the adjacent subsystem-scope question and MECH-363 sets for the stability-outcome question; do not re-derive a weaker substitute here.
CONFIRMING: manipulating the sign/gain of a specific cognifold_edge produces a change in competitive dynamics between the two coupled fields (boundary preservation, suppression of an incompatible trajectory, prevention of runaway resonance) that CANNOT be reproduced by adjusting local selection softmax temperature or top-k alone -- a dissociation between edge-level and softmax-level manipulation, holding the other constant. Q-058's per-subsystem ablation and MECH-363's cooperative-only vs. cooperative+long-range-competitive comparison are the two evidence instruments; either producing a dissociation counts toward CONFIRMING ARC-084's representational claim specifically.
FALSIFYING: across the tested subsystems, all observed inter-field competitive effects are fully accounted for by the existing local mechanisms (MECH-090, ARC-030, MECH-254) with no residual effect attributable to an independent signed-edge property -- Q-058's ablation returns "emergent competition suffices" everywhere it is tried, and MECH-363's stability comparison shows no dissociation between an edge-bearing and an edge-stripped (softmax-only) substrate. If so, the "unifying map" adds no causal power beyond what local softmaxes already provide, and ARC-084 reduces to a redescription rather than a first-class generative mechanism -- it should be demoted, not merely left candidate.
CAUTIONS (carried from this claim's own notes, restated because a test design can easily conflate them): competition != synaptic inhibition; a competitive edge firing is not intrinsically harmful, pathological, or ethically negative; competition != reward subtraction. A test operationalising "competitive effect" as inhibition strength, harm/penalty magnitude, or a reward-subtraction term is testing the wrong thing.
DO NOT design a V3 proxy for this -- per this claim's own instruction, do not build any part of the signed-edge layer in V3 until routed by an explicit version decision.

ARC-085.subject: memory.autobiographical_temporal_event_substrate
ARC-085.title: Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries.
