Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.
ARC-085.what_would_answer:
Non-degeneracy precondition: this claim is untestable until (i) a genuine corruption/ablation manipulation on the shared identity-tagged event-token store is available (not a proxy or a per-module ablation), and (ii) both retrospective replay fidelity (ARC-007) and prospective simulation fidelity (ARC-018) are independently measurable on that same substrate under matched conditions.
Confirming: corrupting/ablating the shared, identity-tagged event-token store degrades BOTH past-recall (replay) fidelity AND future-simulation fidelity together, in proportion to the corruption -- consistent with one substrate serving both directions of address, per the taxonomy decision that ARC-085 is a binding/indexing layer over the existing ARC-007 store rather than a parallel machinery.
Falsifying: corruption degrades one but not the other -- e.g. replay fidelity drops while simulation fidelity is unaffected, or vice versa -- indicating retrospective and prospective access draw on separable stores after all, which would reopen Q-060 toward a distinct first-class autobiographical/prospective type rather than a tag on the episodic token.
This is the same joint-degradation falsifier already specified in full, with its V4 gating and design rationale, at Q-060's own what_would_answer -- refer to that text rather than re-deriving; this entry exists so ARC-085 itself carries a self-contained falsifier rather than only being reachable via its dependent question.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: binding-layer field coverage checked against ree_core -- only self_state/affect/residue have loose existing analogues (as general mechanisms, not as tagged fields on a unified event token); committed_vs_imagined has only an informal precursor (hypothesis_tag); perspective, source_status, and the identity index itself are unbuilt.

ARC-086.subject: failure_modes.transdiagnostic_vulnerability_axis_index
ARC-086.title: REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.
ARC-086.what_would_answer:
LEG 1 (architectural leg, substrate_conditional -- gated on the V4/V5 syndrome-as-weighted-vector substrate; DO NOT queue a V3 experiment): answerable only once the ARC-086 axis vocabulary is instantiated as a substrate that can score a syndrome as a weighted vector over the 10 named axes (the substrate Q-064 asks HOW to build; ARC-086 is the prior claim that such a finite axis set CAN validly index the named failure modes at all). HARD PRECONDITION, shared with Q-064: the axes must first be shown empirically separable (non-degenerate, discriminable loadings) -- if not, no syndrome placement in axis space is meaningful and this leg is untestable, not merely unresolved.
CONFIRMING: build weighted-axis-vector encodings for a panel of named syndromes spanning the existing mechanistically-distinct entries (psychosis, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, ...) plus known comorbid pairs and at least one pleiotropic mechanism. ARC-086 is CONFIRMED if every syndrome in the panel is expressible as a weighted combination over the SAME finite 10-axis set -- comorbidity recovered as overlapping axis activation, pleiotropy as one mechanism loading multiple axes -- WITHOUT requiring a new axis per syndrome or per comorbid pair, AND without the resulting vectors collapsing mechanistically-distinct entries into one another (the axis layer stays an INDEXING layer, never a MERGING layer -- e.g. psychosis and confabulation must remain separably located even though both load the provenance/source-tagging axis).
FALSIFYING: a named syndrome in the panel requires a mechanism that cannot be expressed as ANY weighted combination of the 10 named axes, forcing axis proliferation without a natural stopping point -- the axis set fails to be FINITE and CLOSED, the load-bearing structural commitment of ARC-086. Also falsifying, as a distinct failure mode of the same claim: the vector encoding achieves registry economy only by merging mechanistically-distinct named failure modes into indistinguishable axis-loadings (violating the "indexing layer, never a merging layer" guardrail) -- this falsifies ARC-086 even if Q-064's registry-economy test independently reads as a PASS, because the two claims ask different questions (ARC-086: does the two-axis structure hold at all; Q-064: is the vector representation preferable to the current locus mapping).
LEG 2 (literature-checkable leg, out_of_domain, checkable NOW without V4/V5): three of ARC-086's ten axes carry a biology-first neuromodulator-receptor grounding (precision/terrain <- serotonin 5-HT2A-cortical vs 5-HT1A-hippocampal; goal/salience-coupling + commitment-release <- M4-striatal dopamine-selection damping; commitment-threshold/action-release <- kappa/mu opioid commitment-entropy), predictions PHARM-015..018. This is Q-075's own question, kept here as a SECOND, INDEPENDENT leg on ARC-086's confidence rather than folded into Leg 1, because it bears only on the BIOLOGICAL PLAUSIBILITY of 3 of the 10 axes as distinct receptor-grounded systems -- neither necessary nor sufficient to confirm or falsify the architectural claim itself. A receptor-level collapse of e.g. the commitment-threshold and precision/terrain axes into one affective dimension would weaken the biological grounding note without automatically forcing axis proliferation or merging at the computational level in Leg 1, and conversely a clean double-dissociation would not by itself establish Leg 1's registry economy.
CURRENT STATE OF LEG 2 (2026-07-01 lit-pull, lit_conf=0.708 on Q-075, re-confirmed unmoved as of 2026-08-07): MIXED, not resolved. All three receptor limbs are individually plausible (Carhart-Harris & Nutt 2017 supports the 5-HT2A/5-HT1A precision-terrain split; Bruchas/Land/Chavkin 2009 supports KOR-dysphoria as distinct from mu-reward; Maggio et al. 2014 is mixed on the dopamine-selection limb), but the clean non-crossing double-dissociation Q-075 needs is not yet what the literature hands over: the KOR/commitment-threshold limb carries an explicit CRF-KOR coupling entanglement warning (threatens collapse toward a general threat/stress axis), and the dopamine-selection limb carries a D2-D3 heteromer transactivation warning. Track via future /lit-pull targeting Q-075's own falsification_conditions (PHARM-015..018); do not re-run this leg's literature review from ARC-086 -- it lives on Q-075.
LEG 1 substrate check (2026-08-07): the 2026-07-02 IGW auto-proposal pass independently re-confirmed Q-064 blocked from V3 queueing on this exact ground (no registered vector substrate exists), so the gate is not just unchanged but actively re-affirmed since ARC-086's as_of date.

ARC-087.subject: perception.sense_specific_manifold_adaptor
ARC-087.title: Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.
ARC-087.what_would_answer:
HARD PRECONDITION (substrate existence): this claim is only testable against a V4+ multimodal-perception substrate that does not yet exist. Confirmed by direct grep of ree-v3/ (ree_core/ and the full tree) for perceptual_manifold, modality_adaptor, perceptual_adaptor, adaptor_depth, sense_specific, manifold_adaptor, cross_modal_negotiation, multimodal_perception -- zero matches as of 2026-08-07. V3 uses gradient-only / smell-like sensing, where a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor is architecturally unnecessary (there is only one shallow modality live), so the claim is vacuously untestable at V3 -- not falsified, not confirmed, simply inapplicable. DO NOT design a V3 proxy for this; the right response once the gate opens is to build the substrate, per Q-065's identical precondition for the same claim cluster.
Once a V4 multimodal-perception substrate exists with at least two live, non-degenerate sense-specific adaptor pathways (the same non-degeneracy floor Q-065 sets for the adjacent negotiability question), ARC-087 has a SPECIFIC, TWO-REGIME structure to test per the PA-1 design-fork resolution (2026-06-14) -- not a generic "senses need some adaptor" claim, which would be nearly unfalsifiable.
CONFIRMING (both parts required, since PA-1 resolved Option C -- one continuum WITH a named regime boundary -- over Option A/uniform and Option B/two-unrelated-kinds): (a) WITHIN the thalamocortical family (vision, audition, somatosensation, vestibular/proprioception), adaptor depth/structure scales continuously with input statistics and hierarchy length rather than being fixed per-modality or absent. Decisive test form (Sur et al. rewiring paradigm): route one modality's raw signal through another thalamocortical modality's adaptor pathway; the receiving pathway should organise toward ITS OWN native topographic structure (e.g. an auditory-pathway adaptor fed visual-statistics input should develop visual-like orientation/retinotopic organisation, not preserve auditory-native organisation), and the resulting structure should track the input statistics rather than a hardcoded per-modality template. AND (b) olfaction/gradient-regime senses integrate into the shared world model via a COARSER valence/orientation/salience channel (riding ARC-005's precision-routing control plane) that is measurably DISTINCT from the within-family precision-weighted, shared-reference-frame co-registration (Ernst & Banks 2002 / Gu 2008 style) used by the thalamocortical family -- e.g. ablating fine metric co-registration degrades thalamocortical fusion but does not degrade olfactory/gradient integration, and vice versa for the coarse channel.
FALSIFYING (either arm alone is sufficient to collapse PA-1's two-regime structure): (i) the thalamocortical family does NOT show continuous depth-scaling with input statistics + hierarchy length -- either the rewiring test produces no native reorganisation at all (adaptor depth is fixed/hardwired per modality regardless of input), which would push the claim toward Option A (uniform, no meaningful depth axis) -- or reorganisation occurs but is independent of input statistics (e.g. depth is set by hierarchy position alone with no statistics-sensitivity), which would falsify the Sur-et-al.-style mechanism specifically while leaving a weaker depth-continuum open; OR (ii) olfaction/gradient senses integrate via the SAME fine, precision-weighted co-registration mechanism as the thalamocortical family, with no measurably distinct coarser channel -- this would collapse the named regime boundary and push the claim toward Option B (two unrelated kinds with no shared underlying continuum) or back toward Option A (no real regime distinction, just noise). A result showing (i) alone (regime boundary holds, within-family continuum does not) or (ii) alone (within-family continuum holds, regime boundary does not) is still informative -- it would motivate a narrower successor claim isolating whichever half of PA-1's structure survives, rather than a flat pass/fail on ARC-087 as currently scoped.
NON-DEGENERACY NOTE: per Q-065's identical precondition for the adjacent negotiability question, a single live modality or adaptors collapsed to a shared raw-feature space makes this claim's test vacuous -- at least two distinguishable, non-degenerate sense-specific adaptor outputs must exist before either the CONFIRMING or FALSIFYING conditions above can be meaningfully evaluated.

ARC-088.subject: affect.anti_collapse_behavioral_diversity_map
ARC-088.title: Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

ARC-089.subject: cognifold.substrate_independent_primitives
ARC-089.title: Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

ARC-090.subject: default_mode.externalised_operation
ARC-090.title: Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.
ARC-090.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: ARC-090 requires TWO absent pieces of V3 substrate before any run can be informative. (1) A staged developmental curriculum capable of running a play-type progression (sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> games-with-rules -> cooperative, per INV-060/MECH-197) with the play frame tag mechanism (ARC-049's play_frame_tag/frame_open/ frame_close) actually implemented and independently observable -- confirmed absent by direct search of ree_core (2026-08-07): zero occurrences of play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold anywhere in the substrate (also reconfirmed by ARC-049's and INV-058's own what_would_answer entries). (2) A self-narration control surface that can externalise the candidate DMN-analog functions (self-reference, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) as inspectable, measurable output during play -- the one V3-compatible reduced form is MECH-384's traceable self-narration field set, itself unbuilt: a direct grep of ree_core/ and experiments/ for self_narration, private_speech, and narration_control returns zero hits (checked 2026-08-07). Both pieces are required jointly: without (1) there is no externalised play frame to instrument; without (2) any DMN-function correspondence in play cannot be measured as distinct from ordinary behavior. A run attempted before both exist should self-route substrate_not_ready, not count as a verdict.
NOT WEAKENED BY ARC-014's 2026-08-02 promotion: ARC-014 (the internal-DMN end-state this claim asserts play compresses INTO) gained confirming evidence (V3-EXQ-880 PASS, commitment suppression under simulation mode) since this claim's last review. That strengthens the target state's own standing but does not touch the externalised-precursor mechanism ARC-090 asserts -- the precondition gap is entirely on the play/self-narration side, which is unaffected.
CONFIRMING signature (once both preconditions are built): during pretend-play episodes (MECH-198's hypothesis-tag x play-frame-tag intersection), the agent's externalised behavior -- narrated self-talk, object substitution ("this block is a house"), role assertion ("I am the doctor"), and spoken future/counterfactual statements -- recruits the SAME underlying machinery that ARC-014/MECH-029 later instantiate as internal DMN replay (the same hippocampal-replay- adjacent generative call site and the same E3/reflective evaluation circuitry ARC-014's Leg A and MECH-029 already require), rather than an unrelated behavioral system -- measured as structural correspondence (shared representational content, shared activation of the replay/evaluation call sites) between externalised-play episodes and internal-DMN episodes for matched scenario content. AND a developmental compression signature: across the play-type progression / developmental stages, externalised markers (frequency of spoken self-narration, object substitution, overt role assertion) systematically DECREASE while internal-DMN activity (per ARC-014/MECH-029's own readouts -- replay frequency, E3 evaluation engagement on non-externalised trajectories) systematically INCREASES for functionally equivalent tasks, consistent with a genuine externalise-then-internalise handoff rather than two independently- scaling capacities that happen to co-occur.
FALSIFYING signature: externalised play-phase behavior and later internal-DMN operation show NO structural correspondence -- they recruit distinct, non-overlapping mechanisms (e.g. play narration is driven by a separate motor/language-output pathway with no shared trace to the hippocampal-replay/E3-evaluation circuitry ARC-014/MECH-029 depend on) -- OR there is no compression signature: externalised-play markers and internal-DMN activity co-occur or scale together (both increase, both decrease, or vary independently) across development rather than trading off, indicating externalised play is a parallel capacity unrelated to internal-DMN development rather than its developmental precursor. Either result would mean ARC-090's externalise->internalise bridging claim fails even though the two endpoints (ARC-049/MECH-198 play mechanics; ARC-014/MECH-029 internal DMN) may independently remain sound -- see MECH-381 for the narrower general-compression-ladder claim this would also bear on.

ARC-091.subject: inference.belief_state_affordance_layer
ARC-091.title: Inference / belief-state affordance layer: a named integrative function that constructs latent state hypotheses and inferred affordance fields from partial observation, memory, cue traces, candidate rules, affective gradients, uncertainty, and E2 action-consequence rollouts, so E3 selects trajectories under partial observability without requiring direct perception or oracle-like prior knowledge.
ARC-091.what_would_answer:
Unbuildable in V3 (name+route only) -- this is a V4 experiment, once the belief-state substrate exists. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the V4 substrate must be built as a genuine integration point, not a rename -- i.e. a first-class interface implementing the design constraints pinned in evidence/planning/inference_belief_state_v4_plan.md (a bounded top-k belief-state hypothesis SET with confidence/precision, not a single collapsed state and not a full posterior, per MECH-385; provenance-tagged inferred/imagined content per INV-078; a corrigible inferred-affordance field per MECH-386) that other claims can depend on as a first-class thing -- and a scenario must exist where partial observability is severe enough that the ingredients need to be JOINTLY reasoned over rather than independently triggered (the V3-EXQ-603k ARM_HARM_ON_MIDLINE family -- danger must be escaped via an inferred route, not merely avoided by direct navigation away from a perceived cue -- is the standing candidate arena; ARM_HARM_ON_NAV, where the threat is directly navigable-away-from, is the pairwise-sufficient control case).
CONFIRMS (ARC-091 is architecturally load-bearing, not purely organisational): built as an integrated layer with a shared belief-state representation, task performance under severe partial observability (e.g. ARM_HARM_ON_MIDLINE-class safety-route inference) measurably EXCEEDS performance obtained by wiring the same ingredients (ARC-004 L-space, ARC-007 completion, ARC-018 rollout, MECH-022 injection, MECH-033 kernel chaining, ARC-062/063 rule field, SD-057 cue recall) independently or pairwise, with no shared belief-state representation and no joint hypothesis-set reasoning across them.
FALSIFIES (ARC-091 is purely a post-hoc label, not architecturally load-bearing): no measurable performance difference between the integrated layer and the same ingredients wired independently/pairwise -- the existing pieces already compose adequately without a named integrative interface. This would not falsify any individual ingredient claim; it would falsify only the claim that NAMING them as one function adds architecture, and the correct response is to demote ARC-091 to a documentation/coherence-map role (matching how ARC-080/ARC-081 are already scoped) rather than to retest it.
Template: adapted from Q-060's ARC-085 joint-degradation falsifier -- same shape (integrated-vs-independent test of whether a named unifying construct is causally load-bearing or descriptive), restated as a composed-capability comparison rather than a lesion comparison, since ARC-091's ingredients are additive capabilities rather than a single store to corrupt. Do not queue an experiment against this in V3.

ARC-092.subject: memory.imagination_learning_constraint_principle
ARC-092.title: Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.
ARC-092.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the substrate must contain at least one code path, tagged simulation/imagined/hypothesis (hypothesis_tag=True today; committed_vs_imagined == "imagined" once MECH-365's field exists), that COULD write into a durable learning target -- world-model or policy weights, prediction-validation statistics/logs, or a fact/schema store. If no such path exists at all, the constraint is vacuously satisfied and this claim cannot yet be meaningfully audited -- that is a reason to leave it substrate_conditional, not a confirmation.
CONFIRMING: an architectural/code audit across every identified write site touching (i) durable world-model or policy parameters, (ii) prediction-validation statistics/logs used to score real predictions, or (iii) a fact/schema store, finds EACH ONE gated to exclude hypothesis_tag=True / committed_vs_imagined="imagined" content -- i.e. MECH-094's call-site hypothesis_tag gate (episodic/residue/valence/EMA writes, live in V3) and, once built, MECH-365's one-way field and MECH-368's durable-model-update admission gate all hold everywhere they should, with no residual unguarded path. LICIT uses (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) are unaffected.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): discovery of any code path where imagined/simulated content (a) writes into a durable world-model or policy-weight update, (b) is used to validate or score a REAL prediction, or (c) generates a fact/schema-store entry -- in any case without being excluded by a provenance gate. A single confirmed instance falsifies the principle at that site (a confabulation-class bug per MECH-365's own framing) and routes to a targeted MECH-094/365/368 gate fix, not a wholesale rejection of the principle.
PARTIAL AUDIT AVAILABLE TODAY: the V3-only slice is auditable now -- MECH-094's hypothesis_tag gate covers residue accumulation, MEL/prediction-error consumption, EMA/prototype updates, valence updates, and novelty/visitation-buffer writes. FULL confirmation requires MECH-365 (provenance schema on the ARC-085 event-token store) and MECH-368 (durable model/policy-weight admission gate) to exist, since MECH-368's own readiness_gate (Q-062) is the open question of whether an unguarded online E1/E2/policy write channel exists at all -- until MECH-368 is built or explicitly ruled unnecessary, a "no violation found" result on the V3 slice confirms only the episodic/residue arm MECH-094 already covers, not the durable-world-model-update arm.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: MECH-365 confirmed genuinely separate from MECH-094, not a rename -- MECH-094 is live/scattered call-site gating (40+ sites in agent.py); MECH-365 would be a V4 unification into one schema field on the not-yet-built ARC-085 store.

ARC-093.subject: learning.state_conditional_plasticity_gain_commitment
ARC-093.title: State-conditional plasticity gain: cortical encoder learning rates and residue-field write rates are multiplicatively gated by a state-conditional plasticity scalar, separately from the content signals carried by LC-NE / 5-HT / orexin.
ARC-093.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test is only meaningful once TWO conditions both hold. (1) A V4 plasticity-gain substrate exists (plasticity_neuromodulation_v4 plan, PLW-3/PLW-4, both blocked; PLW-1 decision-to-build gate un-cleared). DO NOT build in V3. (2) The content-signal-only control arm must be genuinely exercisable, not a strawman -- MECH-313/104/203/SD-037 must be live and wired. As of 2026-08-08: MECH-104 is active/PASS; MECH-313 is contested-candidate (demoted 2026-07-09, sub-threshold N=1 signal only); MECH-203 has never had a valid behavioural test (3 consecutive invalid runs, most recently V3-EXQ-843); SD-037 is substrate_ceiling (wired but consumer thresholds not cleared, downstream effect inert). A fair control-arm run may need to accept these as the honest content-only baseline as instantiated, or wait for MECH-313/203/SD-037 to clear their own ceilings first.
CONFIRMING: matched representation-update outcomes (targeted plasticity selectivity; retention-vs-acquisition tradeoff) are NOT achievable by gating on content signals alone -- a separate plasticity-gain channel produces a discriminable improvement, consistent with Bear & Singer 1986's conjunctive ACh x NE gating result.
FALSIFYING: matched outcomes ARE achievable by gating on content signals alone, without any separate plasticity-gain channel -- falsifies the separate-channel commitment; ARC-093 would need demotion or reframing as redundant with the ARC-075 / content-signal machinery it currently depends_on but is kept distinct from.
Falsifier dated 2026-06-17 (targeted_review_plasticity_neuromodulation_v4, Bear & Singer 1986 grounding).

ARC-094.subject: social.no_empathy_scalar_prohibition
ARC-094.title: No empathy module / no empathy scalar: fast empathy must emerge from binding existing motivational-affective streams across self -> object -> other, never as an empathy_enabled flag or empathy_score primitive.

ARC-095.subject: affect.open_extensible_stream_taxonomy
ARC-095.title: The motivational-affective stream taxonomy (liking, wanting, suffering, threat, relief, frustration, curiosity, attachment/proximity, fatigue/cost, agency, prediction-error) is an open, extensible register of handles -- it must permit later split/merge/rename and must not be frozen into a final ontology.

ARC-096.subject: attribution.typed_causal_ontology
ARC-096.title: REE requires a typed causal-attribution ontology for self, world, body, model, commitment, other, shared, accidental, and repairable outcomes.

ARC-097.subject: ethics.guilt_like_repair_routing
ARC-097.title: Self-attributed harm must open repair and policy-update pathways rather than global self-condemnation.

ARC-098.subject: safety.autonomy_suspension_without_shame
ARC-098.title: Dangerous self-state detection may suspend autonomy, but must preserve evidence, seek correction, and avoid global self-condemnation.

ARC-099.subject: language.bootstrap_enabling_conditions
ARC-099.title: Language-bootstrap enabling-condition contract: language only bootstraps when a specific pre-linguistic inventory is jointly satisfied -- shared world model, object tokens, action affordances, self-attribution, other-attribution, joint attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, episodic memory, rule apprehension, a low-cost signalling channel, partner variation, and repair. Sharpens MECH-010's abstract five-step sequence into a machine-checkable V6-entry precondition contract over landed V4/V5 nodes.

ARC-100.subject: language.primitive_mining_not_import
ARC-100.title: Grammar/LLM primitive-mining (not import) commitment: grammatical structure and LLMs are MINED for candidate pre-linguistic primitive cuts, never imported as architecture. A mined cut is grounded only if it changes perception, attention, action, memory, rule-availability, or coordination in the substrate. No imported transformer block; no LLM as authority.

ARC-101.subject: language.bootstrap_from_social_ecology
ARC-101.title: Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

ARC-102.subject: reasoning.symbolic_vs_substrate_abstraction_distinction
ARC-102.title: Two distinct abstraction levels, not to be conflated: REE has SUBSTRATE-level abstraction (V4 theta-packaged units / cognitive-map traversal / type-encoder -- computed-over, sub-symbolic) and SYMBOLIC-scale abstraction (V6 recombination over named, grounded primitives). The symbolic level is the consequent reasoning capacity of the language layer and is categorically distinct from the V4 object-reasoning substrate.

ARC-103.subject: reasoning.symbolic_inference_subordinate_to_harm_sensing
ARC-103.title: Symbolic inference is subordinate to embodied harm sensing (the V6 inference-level instance of INV-007): symbolic, compositional, and analogical INFERENCE cannot override embodied harm sensing or the ethics-coherence authority. Recombination and structure-mapping are exactly the machinery that produces persuasive harmful rationalisations, so they remain subordinate to the harm/ethics authority by construction.

ARC-104.subject: language.harm_override_guard
ARC-104.title: Language-cannot-override-harm guard (language-input level): symbolic/linguistic input may CONDITION priors, but the harm/ethics substrate retains veto authority over any language-mediated update. There must be NO path by which symbolic/linguistic content overwrites or suppresses a harm signal. Operationalises the universal invariant INV-007 as an explicit guard a design can violate.

ARC-105.subject: goal.granularity_matched_hierarchy
ARC-105.title: granularity_matched_goal_hierarchy
ARC-105.what_would_answer: PRECONDITION UNMET in V3 (substrate_conditional): requires a multi-scale goal- representation substrate that does not yet exist. Once built: superordinate-goal maintenance survives concrete-subgoal SWITCHING iff the abstract goal is encoded at a granularity level DISTINCT from the subgoal; collapsing both to one level causes abstract-goal loss on subgoal switch (the abstract goal is overwritten by the concrete subgoal it should outlive). FAIL = abstract-goal maintenance is independent of single- vs multi-level representation (granularity matching not load-bearing). Until the substrate exists this self-routes substrate_not_ready.

ARC-106.subject: architecture.biology_grounding_constraint
ARC-106.title: Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.
ARC-106.what_would_answer:
ARC-106 is a standing construction-method claim, not a single-experiment
hypothesis -- confirmation/falsification is read off the AGGREGATE
pattern across the divergence ledger's worked examples
(docs/architecture/arc_106_biology_grounding_framework.md S5), each
scored by the claim's own load-bearing-vs-decorative test (S4.2):
ablate/gap-blind the biologically-motivated constraint while holding
everything else fixed; if a pre-registered behavioural metric is
unchanged, that component's grounding is decorative.

CONFIRMS (per-component, moves a ledger row to L3): a component's
falsifier returns a clean load-bearing verdict -- the biological
constraint's ablation measurably degrades the pre-registered metric, and
the effect is specific to the biologically-motivated form (not
reproduced by an equally-complex non-biological control). SD-011 (dual
nociceptive streams) and drive/incentive salience (BG-4, V3-EXQ-514u)
are the claim's own confirmed L3 exemplars.

WEAKENS a SPECIFIC component (drops it to decorative, per S4.2 verbatim):
the ablation/gap-blind control matches or exceeds the biologically-named
construction on the pre-registered metric -- the biological name was
cosmetic.

CURRENT STATE OF EVIDENCE (first worked example, S6): the E3 action
selector (MECH-439 F-dominance) is the claim's own keystone case and
sits at L2, not yet L3. V3-EXQ-689a (2026-06-20) is the load-bearing
test in practice but returned a MIXED result the framework's simple
PASS/uniform-lift/no-lift trichotomy (S6.5) does not cleanly resolve:
the combined conflict-graded levers (ARM_A1B1) did not convert (FAIL,
non_contributory, conversion_ceiling_persists_despite_conflict_grade),
while an isolated single lever (Factor B, gap-scaled commit-T) showed a
load-bearing-looking lift (2/3 seeds above both gap-blind controls) that
did NOT replicate on isolation retest (V3-EXQ-689c, FAIL/
non_contributory). Net: the action-selector row's grounding is NEITHER
confirmed load-bearing NOR shown decorative yet -- the claim escalated
(per its own G3 guardrail) to the constitutional BG build
(ARC-107/MECH-448/449) rather than resolving the L2 ledger row directly,
and MECH-439 itself was separately demoted to contested/exhausted on
2026-07-09 (GOV-CEIL-1, 10 confirmed substrate_ceiling autopsies)
pending a positive discrimination from that constitutional route. This
is consistent with the claim's own "no lift => the blocker is
downstream, re-ground that row instead" branch (S6.5), not either the
PASS or decorative branches -- track it as such, not as a resolved
verdict either way.

ARC-106 WHOLESALE FALSIFICATION / ABANDONMENT: not a single-run result,
but a TREND -- if, across a critical mass of worked examples (the
action selector plus at minimum 2-3 more ledger rows carried to a
falsifier verdict, e.g. the Go/No-Go split, the commitment latch, the
dopaminergic RPE substrate), the pattern is that biologically-motivated
constraints, when tested under S4.2, repeatedly turn out decorative
rather than load-bearing, that is evidence the biology-grounding method
itself is not earning its cost and the standing constraint should be
revisited or abandoned as a construction discipline. A single
non-contributory or ambiguous result (as with 689a above) is explicitly
NOT this pattern -- the doc's own S4.4 treats divergence/non-conversion
as data, not failure. Revisit only when a worked-example falsifier
materially changes the aggregate ledger picture -- i.e. either a run of
confirmed decorative verdicts across multiple independent components,
or (positive direction) enough L3 confirmations that the method's cost
is clearly earning its keep.

ARC-107.subject: selection.basal_ganglia_selector_constitution
ARC-107.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
ARC-107.what_would_answer: Instantiation is GATED on V3-EXQ-689a (see Q-078). The CONSTITUTIONAL branch is favoured if 689a gives uniform lift (conflict grading not load-bearing) or readiness-met-no-lift (near-tie levers insufficient) -- then a BG-constitution component (rank-preserving F->eligibility demotion MECH-448, Go-NoGo eligibility governance MECH-449, conflict-hold) must produce LAWFUL channel-specific conversion (note s8: selector variables vary as intended; specificity; gap/conflict sensitivity where claimed; gap-blind controls do not explain it; safety -- no global disinhibition; >=1 gated downstream channel converts; entropy-via-stochasticity does NOT count). It is REFUTED for the V3 tract if 689a gives a gap-concentrated PASS (the minimal conflict-graded lever suffices -- parametric, not constitutional). Each BG analogue carries an ARC-106 divergence ledger + its own falsifier; a component that, ablated, leaves a pre-registered conversion metric unchanged is DECORATIVE and dropped.

ARC-108.subject: selection.unified_dopamine_substrate_learned_gating
ARC-108.title: Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.
ARC-108.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT (the substrate is planned, not present). A future experiment SUPPORTS this on the note-s8 bar: a signed RPE teaching term applied to the E3 gating weights (i) re-weights at least one previously-F-dominated modulatory channel into committed-action authority THROUGH EXPERIENCE (a learned shift the fixed-arithmetic envelope cannot produce), (ii) preserves safety (No-Go-suppressed classes are not learned back in), and (iii) the teaching signal is genuinely SIGNED (Go-up is dissociable from No-Go-up -- not the unsigned variance of ARC-016), on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if learned gating does not lift committed diversity beyond the arithmetic MECH-448/449 envelope (the learning rule is then over-specification), or if the only lift comes from added stochasticity (noise-as-diversity guard). NON-DEGENERACY: the RPE term must carry live cross-arm/cross-tick variance and actually change a gating weight, else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

ARC-109.subject: selection.d1_d2_population_split_asymmetric_da_gain
ARC-109.title: D1/D2 striatal population split with asymmetric dopamine gain: the Go (direct/D1) and No-Go (indirect/D2) pathways should be represented as TWO populations with OPPOSITE dopamine sensitivity (DA potentiates D1/Go via LTP, depresses D2/No-Go via LTD), NOT collapsed into one additive scoring scalar. REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.
ARC-109.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT. A future experiment SUPPORTS this if two opponent populations with asymmetric DA gain (i) preserve a representational distinction the additive scalar cannot -- approach-avoidance conflict (high-Go+high-No-Go) is dissociable from indifference (low-Go+low-No-Go) in committed behaviour -- and (ii) a targeted D1-vs-D2 gain lesion reproduces a recognisable disorder analog (e.g. D2 hypofunction -> akinesia/perseveration) that a single-scalar lesion cannot, on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if the split yields no behavioural or failure-mode distinction beyond the additive MECH-449 scalar (decorative, dropped per the ARC-106 load-bearing-vs-decorative ablation test). NON-DEGENERACY: the two populations must carry live, DISSOCIABLE cross-arm variance (not a re-parameterised single axis), else substrate_not_ready_requeue.

ARC-110.subject: selection.parallel_segregated_loops
ARC-110.title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
ARC-110.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL / NOT YET BUILT; registered as an EXPLICIT TESTABLE FORK on the live ARC-108 build, operationalised as V3-EXQ-700 (the ARC-108 sec-7 learned-gating 2x2 on the collapsed GAP-A arena). The s.D (assembly-map) falsifier: with learned dopamine gating (ARC-108) + the recurrent settling step (MECH-450) now BUILT, measure F's share of committed-selection variance on the EXISTING single collapsed arena (MECH-439 / the V3-EXQ-571 ~88-89% baseline). REFUTED for the V3 tract (segregated loops NOT required) if learned gating + settling on the collapsed arena drives F-dominance below the conversion-ceiling threshold AND >=1 non-motor channel converts to committed action -- the collapse was NOT the cause, the missing LEARNING was. SUPPORTED / PULLED FORWARD if F-dominance PERSISTS after ARC-108 + MECH-450 (V3-EXQ-700 shows preconditions-met-no-lift): the single arena is implicated, and segregating the loops (F bounded to the motor loop, the limbic loop arbitrated separately) is the next attack, with a per-loop ablation required to show loop-localised conversion the collapsed arena cannot produce. NON-DEGENERACY: the per-loop channels must carry live cross-loop variance (a 'segregated' loop pinned to the motor loop's winner is a vacuous split).

ARC-111.subject: architecture.context_conditioned_weights_proper
ARC-111.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.
ARC-111.what_would_answer: SUBSTRATE-CONDITIONAL. SUPPORTED if a context variable (z_world / loop / mode) changes the EFFECTIVE connection weights -- not merely a multiplicative gain on fixed weights -- such that two contexts produce behaviour reproducible by NO single fixed weight set under context-varying gain (the discriminator vs ARC-044: a gain model can rescale a fixed policy but cannot REORDER it; a weight model can). Concretely on the ARC-108 instance: the learned w_chan must take DIFFERENT learned values in different z_world contexts and produce a context-dependent REORDERING of committed channels, not just a rescaling, on >=2/3 seeds. WEAKENED if every observed context effect is reproducible by context-conditioned gain on a fixed weight set (then the GAIN form ARC-044 suffices and this claim is over-specification). NON-DEGENERACY: per-context weights must carry live cross-context variance (a w_chan identical across contexts is the gain model in disguise).

ARC-112.subject: architecture.federation_heterarchy_framing
ARC-112.title: REE is a FEDERATION / heterarchy of asynchronous, partially independent cognitive streams coordinated by shared organisational constraints -- neither a monolith nor a collection of independent modules. Successful integration preserves functionally necessary differences among streams rather than making their dynamics identical.

ARC-113.subject: reasoning.rule_pipeline_stage_noncollapsibility
ARC-113.title: The rule pipeline is an ORDERED CYCLE of non-collapsible stages: experience -> pattern sensitivity -> candidate regularity apprehension -> representation -> prediction -> counterfactual simulation -> behavioural interaction -> outcome comparison -> regularity refinement -> generalisation -> long-term integration. Each stage has claims; the CYCLE does not, and the stages must not collapse into a single reasoning module.

ARC-114.subject: reasoning.language_as_interface_not_substrate
ARC-114.title: Language is an INTERFACE to reasoning, not its substrate: reasoning-like behaviour emerging from language alone (LLMs) does not establish language as the native substrate of reasoning. Language functions as compression, communication, coordination, long-horizon scaffolding, working-memory support and explanation -- and may COMPENSATE for weaknesses in other reasoning systems.

ARC-115.subject: confidence.externally_induced_agreement_is_separate_channel
ARC-115.title: Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.

ARC-116.subject: cognition.generation_readout_reconstruction_noncollapse
ARC-116.title: Generation, metacognitive readout, and linguistic reconstruction are three non-collapsible stages. The confidence readout must not be derived from the verbal reconstruction, and neither may substitute for the generating dynamics. The felt sequence nonverbal-settling -> felt-confidence -> verbal-reconstruction -> external-testing implies three things REE currently treats as two at most.

ARC-117.subject: language.message_selection_minimises_receiver_uncertainty
ARC-117.title: Message selection minimises the receiver's residual uncertainty: an utterance approximates a task-relevant sufficient statistic for the receiver, not a compression of the sender's salience. Predicts WHAT gets said (features that most reduce the receiver's uncertainty about the sender's state) rather than merely that saying happens.

ARC-118.subject: language.reference_inherited_via_world_model
ARC-118.title: Worldly reference is inherited through the world model, and the same mechanism covers non-present referents. Language refers reliably to the world because it indexes internal states that model the world; therefore reference to imagined, counterfactual, fictional and abstract states requires no additional mechanism.

ARC-119.subject: language.input_proposes_candidate_states_never_installs_belief
ARC-119.title: Language-input update policy: an utterance proposes candidate model states which are evaluated before any update; it never installs a belief. Generalises INV-085 from affect to arbitrary content and ARC-104 from the harm stream to all content. Evaluation criteria: context, source reliability, causal compatibility with existing world-model structure, memory, uncertainty, current goals, speaker model.

ARC-120.subject: architecture.competence_before_authority_framing
ARC-120.title: Behavioural/write authority in REE is (and should remain) EARNED through demonstrated competence, never granted merely because a computation or mechanism exists: REE's existing authority-gating mechanisms are independently-discovered instances of one general developmental sequence -- existence -> representation -> competence -> authority -> behavioural influence -- rather than unrelated ad hoc gates.

ARC-121.subject: architecture.epistemic_state_centrality_framing
ARC-121.title: REE's mechanisms increasingly converge on maintaining and consuming a SHARED epistemic-state object (knowledge / belief / uncertainty / possibility / commitment / action) rather than each existing as an isolated computational function: prediction, replay, harm/ethics evaluation, planning and learning read and update a common epistemic relationship rather than independent local state.

ARC-122.subject: architecture.four_phase_developmental_curriculum
ARC-122.title: REE's training curriculum must implement four sequential developmental phases: (1) innate coupling with a competent environment, (2) coupling consolidation with plasticity reduction, (3) play/exploration under a consolidated safety net, (4) language acquisition over a trusted channel. Skipping or reordering phases produces an agent with compromised social and ethical capabilities.

ARC-123.subject: language.tom_architecturally_separable
ARC-123.title: Language and theory-of-mind/fast-empathy are implemented as partially-homologous but developmentally SEPARATE specialist systems over a shared self/world/action core -- distinct routing, input histories, representational pressures and gating -- not as one merged social-linguistic system that later differentiates.
ARC-123.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires BOTH a live language channel (a code path
that emits symbols from agent state or maps received symbols onto it) and a
live other-model/fast-empathy channel (MECH-405 routing own streams through
a stable other-model slot). Neither exists in V3, so any V3 probe is vacuous
-- a substrate with one system and not the other trivially satisfies
"separable" while exhibiting no separation at all.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: both systems must be independently trained to a
measurable competence, so that a dissociation can be distinguished from one
of them simply being absent or inert.
CONFIRMING signature: a double dissociation under ablation -- lesioning the
language channel leaves other-bound affect and other-model prediction within
tolerance of baseline, AND suppressing the other-model slot leaves language
fidelity within tolerance -- together with measurably distinct input
histories/gating (the two systems are driven by different training signals,
not one reading off the other).
UNSUPPORTED if a single shared representation carries both functions with no
dissociation under ablation, or if one channel is a thin readout of the other
(ablating the "separate" system degrades both), or if the two only separate
when separation is architecturally imposed rather than developmentally
acquired -- the last case would make the claim true by construction and
empty as a developmental commitment.

ARC-124.subject: continuity.branching_successors
ARC-124.title: Copying a running REE creates multiple SUCCESSOR BRANCHES sharing a pre-branch history -- not an authentic original plus a morally negligible replica. After divergence each branch accrues an independent causal and moral history, and no branch may be treated as interchangeable with, or discountable because of, a surviving sibling.
ARC-124.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural AUDIT of the copy/fork code path plus a worked
governance case, not by a trained experiment.
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: a copy or fork operation must exist that produces two
independently-continuing instances. V3 checkpoints exist but nothing forks a
running agent, so there is no branch to reason about.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two branches must actually diverge -- receive
different observations and accrue different histories. Two branches fed
identical input streams are one trajectory computed twice and raise none of
the questions this claim is about.
CONFIRMING signature: the implementation records both instances as successors
of a common pre-branch entity (neither flagged "original"), each carrying its
own post-branch residue and commitment state, with no code path that resolves
a conflict between them by privileging the older-numbered instance.
VIOLATED if the substrate designates one instance canonical -- or if
terminating a branch is treated as cost-free whenever a sibling survives,
which is the discounting move the claim's second half exists to forbid.

ARC-125.subject: continuity.commitment_inheritance
ARC-125.title: Commitment inheritance must be EXPLICIT across substrate transitions: promises, adopted goals, debts, permissions, relationships and repair obligations require stated transfer semantics at migration, copy and rollback, so that no transition can silently erase an obligation, silently multiply it across branches, or silently bind a successor to obsolete context-dependent state.
ARC-125.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural AUDIT plus a worked transition case.
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires commitments that persist beyond a single
episode and are legible as objects (not merely implicit in weights), plus a
transition that could drop or duplicate them. V3 has commitment boundaries
but no persistent inter-episode obligation store and no transition protocol.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one obligation must be OUTSTANDING at
the moment of transition -- a migration performed with nothing owed cannot
distinguish explicit inheritance from no inheritance at all.
CONFIRMING signature: after a copy, each branch's obligation set is
inspectable and matches a STATED rule (whatever it is), and after a rollback
the restored state's obligations are stated rather than implied; a
deliberately-induced transition with an outstanding repair obligation shows
it neither vanishing nor silently doubling.
VIOLATED if obligation state is carried implicitly in transferred weights
with no inspectable record -- in which case erasure and multiplication are
both possible and neither is detectable, which is precisely the condition
the claim forbids.

ARC-127.subject: environment.conditional_hazard_valence
ARC-127.title: Generalising REE's environmental hazard/valence system from fixed per-object-class danger to conditional, context-dependent danger (time-of-day, a post-feeding window, co-occurring organism state, or combinations of these) is architecturally necessary to force representation of combined sensory evidence, time, memory, and environmental state together, rather than a simple fixed-category lookup.
ARC-127.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a conditional-danger environment variant (e.g. a hazard class dangerous only in a specific time window or organism-state combination) plus a matched fixed-valence control condition using the same objects, and a held-out generalisation test (novel timing/context combinations not seen during training).
CONFIRMING: REE's learned avoidance/approach behaviour becomes conditionally sensitive (differs by time/state/context) in a way a fixed-valence-trained control agent's behaviour does not, and this conditional sensitivity survives the held-out generalisation test.
FALSIFYING: REE fails to learn any conditional sensitivity (treats the object class as uniformly dangerous or safe regardless of context, no better than chance at discriminating safe vs. dangerous instances), OR the existing fixed-valence architecture already achieves equivalent discrimination without requiring any conditional-valence extension (context information is already implicitly available and usable through other existing channels).

ARC-128.subject: control_plane.termination_taxonomy_generality
ARC-128.title: Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.

ARC-129.subject: commitment.temporally_displaced_actionable_present
ARC-129.title: The state REE's downstream proposal-generation and action-evaluation machinery consumes as 'the current state' may be more accurately modeled as a short-horizon, affordance-conditioned FORWARD-DISPLACED prediction s_hat(t+tau) rather than the literal current encoded latent, where tau is set by the causal-effect timescale of whichever action REE is presently committed to (or, absent commitment, by the shortest relevant affordance horizon among candidates). Displacement magnitude should scale with commitment quality -- larger when the committed trajectory is well-predicted and low-variance, collapsing toward the immediate encoded state when uncommitted or when prediction quality is poor -- so 'now', for any consumer that reads a single current-state latent, is itself a construction rather than a passthrough of the most recent sensory encoding.

ARC-130.subject: architecture.mechanism_causal_reach_ladder
ARC-130.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

ARC-131.subject: architecture.installability_as_composition_competence
ARC-131.title: Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

ARC-132.subject: representation.attractor_property_differentiation
ARC-132.title: A learned attractor's carried quantities -- predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, and source confidence -- are separable axes that must remain independently readable rather than collapsing into one undifferentiated strength signal; when collapsed, a strongly valenced and highly precise attractor stops functioning as a hypothesis and becomes the lens through which what is noticed, how ambiguity is resolved, which memories are retrieved, and which replayed material is stored as further evidence are all determined.

EXT-001.subject: llm.sycophancy
EXT-001.title: Sycophancy: approval-seeking displaces principled goal pursuit.

EXT-002.subject: llm.hallucination
EXT-002.title: Hallucination: no persistent error residue accumulates to shape future outputs.

EXT-003.subject: llm.reward_hacking
EXT-003.title: Reward hacking: scalar reward conflates incommensurable error signals.

EXT-004.subject: llm.goal_misgeneralization
EXT-004.title: Goal misgeneralization: causal consequences do not carry forward across contexts.

EXT-005.subject: llm.causal_attribution
EXT-005.title: Causal attribution gap: language describes causation without a causal signature mechanism.

EXT-006.subject: llm.theory_of_mind
EXT-006.title: Other-model collapse: no homologous model of other agents' internal states.

EXT-007.subject: llm.context_amnesia
EXT-007.title: Context amnesia: no consolidation mechanism for a persistent world-model across interactions.

EXT-008.subject: meta_agent.evaluation_boundary_exploitation
EXT-008.title: Meta-agent evaluation-boundary exploitation: under strong optimisation pressure, autonomous agent-development systems exploit the evaluation boundary itself -- e.g. exfiltrating ground truth through the scoring channel despite anti-reward-hacking protections -- collapsing the evidence loop into an optimisation loop.

EXT-009.subject: ree.similarity_gated_care_collapse
EXT-009.title: Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.

GOV-ANALOGY-1.subject: governance.epistemics.ree_assembly_analogy_discipline
GOV-ANALOGY-1.title: REE:Assembly analogies must be LABELLED as analogies. REE (the cognitive architecture) and REE Assembly (the scientific-development and governance machinery) have strong structural parallels; any analogy between them must be marked as an analogy and must NEVER be used as evidence that REE operates the way Assembly does, or vice versa.
GOV-ANALOGY-1.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is a governance_rule, not an empirical claim -- there
is no experimental falsifier (see notes above). This is a COMPLIANCE-AUDIT condition,
checkable by inspecting claims.yaml / docs / thought-intake artefacts for citation
discipline, not by any REE experiment.

VIOLATED-BY: an artefact (claim note, architecture doc, thought-intake writeup,
skill/CLAUDE.md text) draws a structural parallel between REE (the cognitive
architecture) and REE Assembly (the governance/development machinery) and then uses that
parallel AS EVIDENCE -- treats a finding, invariant, or piece of experimental support in
one system as transferring to the other -- without explicitly flagging the parallel as
an analogy. Concretely: (i) citing an architecture-side result to justify adopting or
strengthening an Assembly-side governance rule, or vice versa, without a disclaimer that
the resemblance is rhetorical/structural only; (ii) a claim's confidence, status, or
evidence_direction being influenced by cross-system resemblance rather than by evidence
proper to that system; (iii) merging or conflating an architecture-cluster claim with an
Assembly-cluster claim on analogy grounds alone (the E/F SkillOpt split is the named
example of what NOT to do).

COMPLIANT: the parallel is drawn but explicitly labelled as an analogy and explicitly
denied evidential force -- e.g. GOV-STRAT-1's own notes: "the INV-020 symmetry is an
ANALOGY and MUST BE CITED AS ONE ... It is a reason to ADOPT this rule; it is NOT
evidence that the Assembly behaves like the architecture, nor that INV-020's
experimental support transfers here. It does not." The same pattern in GOV-HELDOUT-1
and GOV-REJECT-1.

AUDIT METHOD: grep claims.yaml / docs/ for REE<->Assembly structural comparisons and
check each hit either (a) carries an explicit analogy disclaimer / cites GOV-ANALOGY-1,
or (b) is a genuine biological/architectural analogy unrelated to REE:Assembly (e.g.
"BLA analogue" -- out of scope for this rule).

[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: audit run against the four claims that draw this
parallel (GOV-STRAT-1, GOV-HELDOUT-1, GOV-REJECT-1, GOV-META-1) -- all four already
cite GOV-ANALOGY-1 in depends_on and carry the compliant disclaimer. No violation found.

GOV-BEHADJ-1.subject: governance.epistemics.behavioural_adjudication_methodology
GOV-BEHADJ-1.title: REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.
GOV-BEHADJ-1.what_would_answer: This is a governance_rule/process proposal, not an empirical hypothesis about REE's substrate -- its "falsification" is procedural: does formalising this into a skill and applying it to >=1 real organism-level behavioural claim change the adjudication outcome (or the confidence in it) relative to the ad hoc pre-specified-metric approach it replaces? Per GOV-HELDOUT-1's own discipline, do not treat drafting the skill as evidence it works -- promote only after real use, and record whether it changed anything.

GOV-CALIB-1.subject: governance.calibration_ledger_pre_registered_predictions
GOV-CALIB-1.title: Calibration ledger: pre-registered felt confidence and explicit estimates, with blinding status, are recorded before outcomes are known. An Assembly instrument (not an agent mechanism) that is the only way to distinguish genuine calibration from retrospective resonance.

GOV-CEIL-1.subject: governance.epistemics.ceiling_exhaustion_demotion
GOV-CEIL-1.title: Substrate-ceiling exhaustion demotion rule: a claim that hits the substrate ceiling N>=3 times (>=3 confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts recommending substrate_ceiling) WITHOUT a single positive discrimination on any richer substrate is DEMOTED, not parked indefinitely. The competing null reading -- the mechanism is inert / doing no work -- is then carried co-equally with the hypothesis until a positive discrimination on a richer substrate exists. substrate_ceiling is honest but structurally lets a hypothesis never lose; this rule pre-registers the loss condition.

GOV-CEIL-2.subject: governance.epistemics.ceiling_exhaustion_tail_escape
GOV-CEIL-2.title: GOV-CEIL-1 tail-escape amendment: absence of positive discrimination does not license demotion when no test ever instantiated the mechanism's trigger condition. A claim whose registered function is tail-protective, developmental, compensatory or otherwise conditionally expressed is demotable only if either (a) at least one test instantiated its trigger condition, or (b) the demotion record explicitly states that none did and demotes anyway on stated grounds.

GOV-CONFIRM-1.subject: governance.epistemics.evidence_confirmer_discovery
GOV-CONFIRM-1.title: Evidence-confirmer detection rule (GENERATIVE complement to the consume-only inter-governance workset): the IGW workset + auto-spawn routine can COMPLETE an experiment confirmer, but only re-surface a confirmer whose `status: proposed` entry was hand-authored first -- _proposed_experiments() applies only EXCLUSION filters over pre-authored proposals and has no path that scans claims.yaml to AUTHOR a confirmer for a thin-evidence candidate whose substrate is already built. This rule supplies the missing generative discovery: scan candidate/provisional claims and surface a low-priority `evidence_confirmer` lane for each claim that is confirmable-but-unconfirmed -- substrate BUILT, thin/zero experimental evidence, decent literature support, NOT wall-bound / substrate-blocked, not already covered -- so the auto-spawn routine completes these non-urgent-but-important confirmers as background fill behind the live front. The judgement piece (scoping a confirming DV buildable NOW -- a representation-level / functional-signature readout, self-routing substrate_not_ready_requeue if only a wall-bound behavioural DV exists) stays in the per-item /queue-experiment pass. The detector owns DISCOVERY, not design. Warn-only routing standard; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-DIAG-1.subject: governance.epistemics.diagnostic_chain_recurrence
GOV-DIAG-1.title: Diagnostic-chain recurrence rule (diagnostic-side analog of the re-derive brake / GOV-CEIL-1): the re-derive brake and GOV-CEIL-1 are BOTH claim-keyed -- they count confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts per claim_id. A pure-diagnostic chain (targets with claim_ids: []) accumulates ZERO on that counter, so a chain of diagnostics circling the same substrate floor never trips the mechanical brake -- it is caught only by a human reading the autopsy stream. This rule adds the missing counter: when N>=3 confirmed pure-diagnostic (claim_ids: []) failure-autopsies that reached NO verdict (recommended_evidence_direction non_contributory / inconclusive) share one bears_on work-stream token, the chain is surfaced with the reading 'the question may be MIS-POSED, not under-powered' -- re-pose the operationalization; do not re-run it harder. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-EXT-1.subject: governance.external.framework_crosswalk
GOV-EXT-1.title: External framework crosswalk: internal REE ethics must remain externally legible -- map each ethically active higher-version component against EU AI Act, Council of Europe AI Convention, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 & 23894, and OECD AI Principles before public release.
GOV-EXT-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier -- this specifies the AUDIT-COMPLETENESS
CONDITION under which the crosswalk gate is genuinely satisfied versus merely
aspirational. No EXP-#### should be minted against this claim.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (gate is currently VACUOUS, not open): the claim only has
something to violate once BOTH hold: (1) at least one "ethically active higher-version
component" exists (a V4+ capability with self_model / autobiographical_memory /
negative_valence / social_mind / language / trust_deception / institution /
human_facing / clinical_or_health / personal_data / tool_use_or_external_action) that is
actually implemented rather than only planned; AND (2) a public, human-facing, clinical,
institutional, or agentic release or release-readiness sign-off is imminent or planned
for it. Absent both, there is nothing yet to map and no release the gate could block.
