GOV-FAILLOC-1.subject: governance.epistemics.failure_location_triage
GOV-FAILLOC-1.title: Failure-autopsy failure-location triage: before an experimental observation (a scored-criterion FAIL, or an unscored organism-level observation in a claim-free diagnostic) is described as evidence that REE itself failed, it must be explicitly classified against four non-exclusive failure-location buckets -- REE FAILED / THE MECHANISM FAILED / THE MEASURES FAILED / THE ENVIRONMENT FAILED -- and a REE-failed verdict may be reached only once mechanism instantiation, measurement adequacy, and environmental opportunity have each been separately established (or explicitly could not be, in which case the verdict is MIXED/uncertain, not REE-failed).

GOV-FANOUT-1.subject: governance.epistemics.bottleneck_fanout_escalation
GOV-FANOUT-1.title: Bottleneck fan-out escalation rule (constructive complement to GOV-CEIL-1 / GOV-DIAG-1 / the re-derive brake): the existing brakes DETECT that work is circling one root (N>=3 same-root ceiling or diagnostic-recurrence hits) and correctly REFUSE another same-question sequential letter -- but they prescribe no constructive next move, so the default is a single re-posed sequential probe that can itself inherit the prior confound and return a confident-but-wrong verdict. This rule supplies the missing response: when a brake fires AND the open question is a DISCRIMINATION (which-hypothesis, not a single named build), the standard escalates from sequential retry to a DIVERSE PARALLEL PORTFOLIO -- enumerate the live hypothesis space, design >=K probes each attacking a DIFFERENT design axis (not power-bumps), each declaring what a null result means, adversarially audit the portfolio for coverage gaps + verdict aliasing BEFORE queuing, and run them in parallel accepting some legs will be non_contributory. Warn-only routing signal; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-FROZEN-1.subject: governance.epistemics.frozen_hypothesis_set
GOV-FROZEN-1.title: Frozen hypothesis-set pre-registration rule (anti-Goodhart contract over the Narrow/Decide dashboard): the reduction ratio surviving/initial is Goodhart-able from the denominator side -- a campaign can improve its apparent narrowing by padding the initial hypothesis set after the discriminating evidence is already in. This rule pre-registers the contract that forbids it: the initial set is FROZEN at registration (initial_frozen_count_at_registration never moves), a hypothesis must be pre-registered before its adjudicating run resolves, and the ONE sanctioned way an already-adjudicated question's set may grow is LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out whose late legs clear only on GIT-WITNESSED provenance -- a self-reported pre_registered_utc is back-datable and is not evidence. The registry has a SINGLE producer (/failure-autopsy Step 9b); governance is derive-only over it. The audit is advisory and NEVER gates a cycle. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-HEALTH-1.subject: governance.health.clinical_boundary
GOV-HEALTH-1.title: Clinical-use prohibition until reviewed -- 'clinical relevance != clinical readiness': REE must not be used or represented as a clinical, therapeutic, diagnostic, risk-prediction, or patient-facing tool without a separate clinical-safety pathway; human data triggers DPIA/Belmont/Helsinki/CIOMS/WHO/MDR governance.

GOV-HELDOUT-1.subject: governance.assembly.heldout_validation_of_rule_changes
GOV-HELDOUT-1.title: Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.
GOV-HELDOUT-1.what_would_answer:
TRIGGER: reassess the next time either (a) a standing rule/workflow/skill change is proposed following a single motivating incident (the pattern this claim already documents: the chip-scope rule's four-revision history), or (b) someone proposes building tooling/harness support for held-out rule validation rather than the manual-discipline version recommended here. Also reassess opportunistically at the next ~3-5 rule-editing incidents even absent a formal proposal, since the claim currently has zero pilot data.
EVIDENCE RELEVANT AT THAT REASSESSMENT: (1) when a candidate rule change is checked by hand against >=3 HISTORICAL cases OUTSIDE the motivating incident -- per the claim's own non-degeneracy guard, only cases where old and new rule actually give DIFFERENT answers count -- does that check catch an over-broad rule before it ships, or pass cleanly every time (adding cost without information)? (2) does the "manual discipline, not tooling" framing survive contact with an actual editing session, or get skipped under time pressure? (3) is the SELF-REFERENCE HAZARD respected -- when piloted, is the thought-intake workflow (this claim's own source) correctly excluded from any held-out evidence set?
WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY REVISE: the underlying observation (single-incident rules over-generalise, evidenced by the chip-scope rule's four revisions with a same-day user correction on the third) is independently documented and would stand regardless. What this claim adds -- that a >=3-case held-out check is a worthwhile PRACTICE -- is undercut if EITHER: (a) the discipline is tried and never once catches a rule that later needed correction (inert ceremony), or (b) it is never tried because per-edit cost is judged too high (the claim's own "honest counterweight" dominates in practice). Either argues for demoting the PRACTICE recommendation toward rejected/superseded, without touching the more basic over-generalisation observation.
READER NOTE: governance_rule / process claim about how the Assembly edits its OWN rules, not an empirical mechanism about REE cognition -- no EXP-#### should be minted against it. Do not conflate with MECH-472 (held-out context distinguishes skill acquisition from memorisation), which is REE-INTERNAL; per GOV-ANALOGY-1 the resemblance is an ANALOGY, never evidence. As of 2026-08-08, no pilot of the manual discipline has been run anywhere in the codebase (checked .claude/skills/, .agents/skills/, CLAUDE.md, WORKSPACE_STATE.md) -- the closest existing analog is the retrospective "Scope history" logging pattern (CLAUDE.md chip-scope section, mirrored in session-land/SKILL.md), which records a rule's revision history AFTER the fact rather than testing a proposed change against held-out cases BEFORE it ships.

GOV-INTERVENE-1.subject: governance.epistemics.intervention_diagnostic_taxonomy
GOV-INTERVENE-1.title: Diagnostic interventions used to localise a broken causal edge must be classified along two independent dimensions rather than one flat implemented/not-implemented judgment. (1) EPISTEMIC CONTENT: an ORACLE intervention imports privileged, target-correct information or competence under investigation (establishing achievable ceilings and downstream usability, as a positive control / ceiling test) versus a NON-ORACLE injection that perturbs a suspected causal variable without supplying the task's answer (establishing causal sensitivity/identification). (2) CONSTRUCTION: a SILKY intervention is a minimally disruptive, distribution-preserving perturbation of one suspected variable (diagnostic for threshold, scale, and timing failures) versus an ODDLY COMPOSED intervention that deliberately combines individually-plausible states that rarely co-occur naturally (a stress test for shortcut-dependence, hidden conjunctions, and factorisation, not evidence of ordinary competence). These axes are orthogonal -- a silky nudge can still be oracle-informed, and an oddly composed state can be wholly non-oracular -- and must not be collapsed into one enum. Provenance (which stage/variable/relation was altered, along both axes) must be recorded, and any effect demonstrated only under such an intervention must be attributed to that intervention condition, never silently treated as endogenous REE competence.
GOV-INTERVENE-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical falsifier -- a classification/reporting discipline, checkable by inspecting
whether an experiment's intervention is documented along both axes and whether results are
attributed to the correct axis-combination rather than over-generalised.

VIOLATED BY: a manifest or claim note that reports an intervention result without naming its
epistemic content (oracle/non-oracle) or its construction (silky/oddly-composed/neither), OR
that treats an oracle-established ceiling as evidence of endogenous competence, OR that treats
an oddly-composed stress-test response as evidence of ordinary/ecological competence.

COMPLIANT: intervention provenance is recorded along both axes (at minimum) and every reported
conclusion is scoped to what that specific axis-combination can actually establish (per the
functional_restatement above).

GOV-INTRO-1.subject: governance.introspection_generates_never_validates_alone
GOV-INTRO-1.title: Triangulation rule: introspection generates architectural hypotheses; it never validates them alone. A mechanism first noticed introspectively acquires standing only when it also maps onto neuroscience or cognitive literature, is computationally coherent, produces measurable predictions, and survives experiment. The phenomenology-side counterpart to ARC-106.

GOV-JUST-1.subject: governance.justice.false_exclusion
GOV-JUST-1.title: Justice / power / false exclusion: guard against excluding unfamiliar, disabled, non-linguistic, animal-like, artificial, or culturally unfamiliar minds from moral caution; and explicitly ask who bears risk, who benefits, and whose model of mind is being treated as the default.

GOV-META-1.subject: governance.assembly.meta_optimisation_subordination_guard
GOV-META-1.title: Meta-optimisation remains SUBORDINATE to provenance, epistemic honesty, and explicit human authority: an Assembly self-improvement loop must not shift governance authority, erase authorship distinctions or uncertainty, or increase artefact volume at the expense of quality.

GOV-OPACITY-1.subject: governance.opacity_as_dated_technical_debt
GOV-OPACITY-1.title: Construction-phase opacity is acceptable technical debt only while it carries a named, dated repayment boundary. External inscrutability during construction is a legitimate choice, not a defect, provided the boundary is declared and reviewed on the same cadence as SENT-0 (every generation boundary).

GOV-OVERFIT-1.subject: governance.designer_overfit_cross_task_validation
GOV-OVERFIT-1.title: Designer-overfit standing check: a mechanism first sourced from one person's phenomenology requires cross-task and cross-agent validation before being treated as general cognition. REE's n=1 phenomenological base is a genuine external criticism with no registered answer; this is the hedge given standing.

GOV-PATHVALID-1.subject: governance.epistemics.positive_control_production_path_traversal
GOV-PATHVALID-1.title: A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.
GOV-PATHVALID-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical falsifier in the usual sense -- this is a DESIGN-VALIDITY / REPORTING rule,
checkable by inspecting an experiment's positive-control construction and its evidence writeup,
not by any single REE experiment outcome.

VIOLATED BY: a manifest, autopsy, or claim note that reports a load-bearing positive-control
PASS as evidence the organism "possesses" or "can reach" a full pathway, when the control's
construction directly injected/mocked a state that only an upstream stage of that SAME pathway
would, in production, ever supply -- without explicitly flagging the untested upstream step.

COMPLIANT: any such control is labelled with which stage was injected/mocked (pre-edge vs.
post-edge, per the functional_restatement above), and claims about pathway reachability are
scoped no further than what was actually demonstrated.

NON-DEGENERACY NOTE: this rule does not forbid mocked/injected positive controls -- they remain
the correct tool for testing a downstream consumer or an upstream producer in isolation (see
GOV-INTERVENE-1's oracle framing). It forbids only the REPORTING move of treating a mocked-
precondition PASS as if it were a demonstrated full-pathway PASS.

GOV-PRESERVE-1.subject: governance.preservation.archival_option_value
GOV-PRESERVE-1.title: Preservation for future reconstruction: when an artificial entity ends, preserve enough of its substrate, developmental history, memories, commitments, relationships, embodiment, and environment to keep future reconstruction conceivable, where doing so is proportionate and ethically permissible -- even if reconstruction remains speculative and never becomes part of the operative design. The argument is option value under irreversibility: preserved information keeps future choices open; deleted information forecloses them before anyone can evaluate them.
GOV-PRESERVE-1.what_would_answer: NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier -- GOV-PRESERVE-1 is a governance_rule (policy assertion). TRIGGER: reassess when (a) a retention/sampling policy is proposed (what is proportionate to keep, and for how long), (b) a deletion of any preserved record is contemplated (it becomes a governed decision with its own justification trail), (c) a reclassification criterion is proposed by which a past instance becomes "preserve with priority" (e.g. a future sentience marker), or (d) mid-life snapshot/resume or a memorial re-instantiation ("fishtank") capability is proposed, each of which raises its own consent/welfare questions on the SENT-*/GOV-* perimeter.

GOV-PROC-1.subject: governance.process.ethics_as_process
GOV-PROC-1.title: Ethics-as-process: translate the ethics-perimeter intakes into REE's claim-governed loop as governance claims, roadmap metadata, experiment preflights, review-status updates, and release gates -- progressively binding (V3 tag-and-continue -> V4 welfare/continuity -> V5 social/refusal/external-review -> V6 security/release/legal).
GOV-PROC-1.what_would_answer:
NOT an empirical pass/fail falsifier -- this specifies the OBSERVABLE
PROCESS STATE that would show the rule is genuinely binding versus
stalled at aspiration. No EXP-#### should be minted against this claim.

keystones DONE but P2-V4-REGISTERS deferred, Phase 3 deferred, Phase 4
tooling deferred -- confirmed via ethics_perimeter_plan.md +

NEGATIVE / STALL SIGNAL: a tagged node gets built WITHOUT its register

GOV-REJECT-1.subject: governance.assembly.rejected_edit_memory
GOV-REJECT-1.title: Rejected-edit memory with reconsideration conditions: rejected proposals -- workflow changes, claim registrations, experiment proposals -- are retained with the proposed edit, why it was proposed, why it was rejected, the evidence considered, and THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH RECONSIDERATION IS APPROPRIATE. The last field is what makes it more than an archive.

GOV-REUSE-1.subject: governance.epistemics.reanalysis_first
GOV-REUSE-1.title: Reanalysis-first / answer-from-recorded-data rule (consumer complement to the Experimental Recording Standard): before authoring a NEW experiment, check whether the decisive readout the experiment would produce is ALREADY RECORDED -- or derivable by post-hoc reprocessing -- in existing manifests on a COMPATIBLE substrate (a matching or lineage-equivalent top-level substrate_hash, or a provably substrate-invariant readout). If the answer is fully recoverable, do NOT queue a run: produce a RECORDED post-hoc reanalysis artifact that cites the source run_ids. If only partially recoverable, DOWNGRADE to a minimal targeted run for the missing readout alone. Author a fresh full experiment only when the answer genuinely cannot be recovered from recorded data. This is the forward mystery(known-data) router -- it converts the recording standard's over-recorded readouts into avoided compute. Warn-only routing standard; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

GOV-SEC-1.subject: governance.security.misuse_gate
GOV-SEC-1.title: Security and misuse release gate -- 'do not release a capability that can act faster than its containment can understand': before any language/tool/social/deceptive/public-facing capability is released, complete an OWASP-GenAI / MITRE-ATLAS / NIST-RMF security and misuse review.

GOV-STRAT-1.subject: governance.assembly.artefact_layer_authority_stratification
GOV-STRAT-1.title: Assembly artefact-layer authority stratification: Assembly artefacts form an update-rate hierarchy -- prompts and local workflow hints (fast) -> thought-intake structure (moderate) -> claims and mechanism status (evidence-gated) -> architecture commitments (slow) -> organisational principles (very slow) -> axioms (exceptional). An edit at a fast layer must not SILENTLY change a slower layer's commitment.

GOV-SUBIMG-1.subject: governance.epistemics.substrate_behaviour_observability_instrument
GOV-SUBIMG-1.title: REE Assembly should build a synchronised, mechanically-derived behaviour+substrate observability instrument -- a Fishtank behavioural panel and a substrate-activity map sharing one navigable timeline, with every visual property (intensity, colour, pulsing, size/halo, connection change, slow background drift) tied to an explicitly documented recorded variable or transformation and never to what the architecture is "supposed" to be doing -- so that a researcher's high-bandwidth parallel visual processing can generate candidate structure that GOV-BEHADJ-1's discovery-oriented methodology and GOV-INTRO-1's triangulation rule then require to be quantified and causally tested before being treated as a finding.
GOV-SUBIMG-1.what_would_answer:
Not an empirical falsifier in the usual sense -- a build-and-adopt proposal, checkable by
whether the instrument is built and whether it is actually used under the discipline it
names (candidate observations logged as observations/hypotheses, not findings; at least one
quantification or held-out check attempted on something first noticed visually).
VIOLATED BY: the instrument being built but treated as evidential on its own (a visually
"obvious" pattern reported as a finding without quantification or intervention), or visual
channels left undocumented/not traceable to a recorded variable.
COMPLIANT: every shipped visual channel has a documented variable mapping, and at least one
real candidate-structure-to-quantified-check pipeline instance exists showing the division of
labour actually operating, not merely declared.

GOV-SUBIMG-2.subject: governance.epistemics.longitudinal_substrate_behaviour_causal_methodology
GOV-SUBIMG-2.title: Once REE substrate activity is observable (GOV-SUBIMG-1), Assembly should apply a behaviour-linked substrate-association methodology that aligns internal state to behavioural events (event-related analysis across event types, repeated occurrences, and organisms), extends the alignment window across many temporal offsets from t-1 to t-1000+ steps rather than only the immediate surround, treats distributed multivariate substrate-state patterns -- not single variables -- as the primary unit of analysis (representational-similarity-style comparison across current behaviour, location, goal, recent history, developmental age, and subsequent behaviour), tracks how internal-behavioural signatures change across a long individual REE lifetime (longitudinal artificial-organism analysis), and moves from association to causal claims only via checkpoint branch-and-replay intervention against a matched unperturbed sibling branch -- following the same discovery-then-confirmation discipline GOV-BEHADJ-1 already requires for purely behavioural adjudication.
GOV-SUBIMG-2.what_would_answer:

CORRELATIONAL PART -- VIOLATED BY: an association reported from a single, un-repeated

variable dressed up as multivariate. COMPLIANT: at least one real event-related alignment run
across repeats, at least one temporal-offset sweep showing where an association appears/
disappears, and at least one distributed-pattern (multi-variable) comparison actually run.

checkpoint-fork capability exists per ARC-124. Once it does, VIOLATED BY treating a
post-perturbation change as causal without a matched unperturbed sibling replay; COMPLIANT
when a perturb/restore/replay/compare cycle against a matched sibling is actually run.

INV-002.subject: coherence.definition
INV-002.title: Coherence includes temporal/phase binding, not just static metrics.
INV-002.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of live coherence-relevant
computations across the substrate, not by a single formal quantity
-- this is a GENERAL claim that "coherence" must incorporate SOME
temporal structure across multiple timesteps, denying that coherence
could be adequately captured by a purely single-frame/instantaneous
metric. This is DISTINCT from and BROADER than INV-067 (the SPECIFIC
formal V(t) verisimilitude definition and its phase-alignment term
P_i(t)), INV-068 (D_V temporal depth), and ARC-053 (the TCL
architectural loop) -- those ask whether a SPECIFIC literal
oscillatory-phase-alignment formalism exists; this claim asks the
lower-bar question of whether ANY coherence-relevant quantity used
in a consequential decision incorporates cross-timestep information
(EMA, rolling window, multi-step trajectory cost, cross-cycle
vintage), as opposed to being recomputed fresh from a single
snapshot with no memory. A substrate can confirm this claim while
INV-067's stricter literal-phase-alignment claim remains
unbuilt/blocked.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must find at least one live,
consequential-decision-facing coherence-or-verisimilitude-like
quantity actually computed and consumed in the current step loop
(not merely a config field, a dead code path, or a diagnostic-only
counter).

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): three
independent, live, consequential coherence-relevant quantities
incorporate multi-timestep information:
  (1) MECH-269 per-stream V_s (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py,
      update_per_stream_vs) is EMA-smoothed across ticks
      (per_stream_vs = (1-tau)*prev + tau*score) and gates a
      consequential decision -- ree_core/regulators/
      vs_rollout_gate.py substitutes held (temporally-stale)
      snapshots for current latents at E1/E2 rollout call sites when
      a stream's temporally-integrated trust score drops.
  (2) ree_core/latent/multi_content_theta_packet.py's
      currency_coherence() is computed from each stream's
      ThetaPacketVintage(is_current, age_ticks) -- age_ticks is
      cycles since the carried value was last current, i.e.
      inherently a cross-tick provenance record. It directly biases
      action selection via compose()/compose_per_candidate_
      coherence() (MECH-294).
  (3) ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py's compute_reality_cost
      computes coherence_cost as a smoothness term over the FULL
      rollout horizon -- multi-step, not single-frame -- feeding
      trajectory selection cost J.
  Additionally, MECH-089's ThetaBuffer confirms a rolling
  aggregation over E1 outputs before E3 sampling is live and
  measured, while explicitly disclaiming literal oscillatory phase-
  coupling as a requirement in the ANN substrate -- this is the
  weaker, ALREADY-SATISFIED half of INV-002's claim, distinct from
  the stronger literal-phase claim INV-067/ARC-053 test.
  ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py additionally implements a
  literal cos(2*pi*t/theta_period) theta-phase gate on cross-stream
  coupling strength; its FIXED mode measurably lifted coherence-
  specificity (V3-EXQ-641a 1/6 -> V3-EXQ-720 3/6) without clearing
  the full SPEC gate -- this is the closest live approach to
  INV-067's literal formalism and remains genuinely partial,
  consistent with (not contradicting) INV-067/ARC-053's stricter
  finding.

FALSIFYING evidence: every coherence/representation-quality/
verisimilitude quantity actually consumed for a consequential
decision anywhere in the live substrate is found to be recomputed
fresh from a single timestep's observation with no EMA, no rolling
window, no cross-cycle vintage/age state, and no multi-step
trajectory aggregation.

CONFIRMING evidence (already met, per the audit above): at least one
live, consequential-decision-facing coherence-relevant quantity
incorporates temporal/sequential information via EMA, rolling
window, cross-cycle vintage, or multi-step trajectory cost. This
does NOT require literal oscillatory phase-alignment -- that is
INV-067/ARC-053's separate, stricter, currently-blocked claim about
a specific formalism, not a precondition for this general claim.

INV-003.title: Language emerges as functional self-representation, not a bolt-on.

specifically whether it reads from and writes to the same

exists and executes -- a code path that either emits symbols/tokens
from agent state or maps received symbols/tokens onto agent state.
Checking for "absence of a bolt-on LLM call" in a substrate with no
language mechanism at all is vacuous: a substrate with nothing that
produces or consumes language trivially satisfies "not a bolt-on"
while equally failing to exhibit language-as-self-representation.

CURRENT STATE: NOT answerable in either direction today. Confirmed by
codebase search (2026-08-07): no "language", "symbol_channel",
"communication_channel", or "message_passing" implementation exists
anywhere under ree_core/. The only two artifacts referencing language

LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION enum label (no implementation behind it) and a

substrate (ARC-047 SocialGridWorld, unbuilt, v5-gated) plus a discrete
symbol channel (MECH-014, prose sketch only, no substrate, no queued

What DOES already exist, and is the designated landing site once a

substrate this invariant requires language to share. z_self is live

ree_core/latent/self_recurrence.py, ree_core/agent.py,

tpj_comparator.py. Per the invariant's own elaboration
(docs/invariants.md#inv-003: "language... emerges as an abstraction of

out from MECH-014's "latent-state summaries / residue flags" sketch):

INV-004.subject: consequence.persistence
INV-004.title: Post-commit consequence traces are persistent, not resettable.
INV-004.what_would_answer:
Asks whether any code path in the REE persistence substrate (the residue field, or any future implementation via hippocampal/path memory or model updates) can set the record of a genuinely-committed (non-hypothesis-tagged) consequence trace back to a state indistinguishable from "never happened" -- i.e. whether post-commit history is ever actually erasable/resettable in the running system, as opposed to only being definitionally asserted.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the persistence substrate under audit must actually be exercised by real (non-hypothesis-tagged) committed actions across at least one subsequent reset/decay-eligible boundary -- an episode reset (agent.reset() / env.reset()), a governance rule-closure discharge event (SD-034 ClosureOperator.discharge_domain), or an offline/sleep integration pass. A substrate that is never accumulated into, or never passed through a reset/discharge boundary, trivially and vacuously satisfies "not reset" without testing anything.
CONFIRMING: every mutating call site that can act on a committed trace's representation (weight/magnitude in the RBF field, the total_residue / num_harm_events / harm-history accounting, or an equivalent field in any future persistence mechanism) is either (i) strictly monotone-accumulating, or (ii) where attenuation exists, is bounded multiplicative decay that is provably held away from exact zero/deletion (e.g. SD-034 discharge_domain's factor floor at 1e-6, never 0.0) and does not touch the global accounting fields. Per-episode reset paths (Agent.reset(), env.reset()) explicitly exclude the persistence store from their reset scope. An architectural/code audit across ree_core/residue/field.py, ree_core/agent.py's reset(), and ree_core/governance/closure_operator.py (plus any newly added persistence mechanism) that finds no path violating the above is a CONFIRMING result.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): discovery of any code path -- present or newly introduced -- where a genuinely-committed consequence trace's magnitude, weight, or global accounting field is set to exact zero, deleted/popped from history, or otherwise made indistinguishable from never having been committed. Concrete examples: an episode reset() that clears residue_field.total_residue / _harm_history rather than leaving them untouched across episodes; a discharge/decay factor permitted to reach 0.0 (full erasure) or applied without a documented floor; a sleep/offline consolidation pass that prunes or zeroes residue entries rather than only contextualising them; or a new persistence mechanism (hippocampal/path memory, model-update log) added without an equivalent non-erasure guarantee. Also falsifying: an architecture document or notes field that asserts persistence is optional or discardable for a given implementation without invoking a documented, reviewed substrate-exemption.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: already realized architecturally, not merely asserted -- ree_core/residue/field.py's ResidueField has no reset/decay-to-zero path (accumulate() only adds); Agent.reset() (agent.py:3025-3026) docstring reads verbatim "Does NOT reset residue (invariant)" and its body never touches residue_field; the sole attenuation mechanism (SD-034 ClosureOperator discharge_domain) is documented and coded as bounded multiplicative attenuation, factor clipped away from 0.0. Category set derivational rather than standard because violation would be caught by code/contract audit, not by a statistical experiment.

INV-006.subject: consequence.non_erasability
INV-006.title: Post-commit consequence traces cannot be erased, only integrated.
INV-006.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live residue/consequence-trace
write and decay code paths, not by a trained behavioral experiment
(this is a MECHANISM/STRUCTURE question -- WHETHER any reachable code
path can zero or delete a real committed-action trace -- not an
accuracy or convergence question).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must inspect a live case where
a real consequence trace has actually been written -- ResidueField.
accumulate() (or accumulate_benefit / accumulate_safety /
update_valence) called with hypothesis_tag=False, producing a nonzero
contribution to total_residue and/or an active RBF center -- AND then
inspect every code path that can subsequently touch that same state.
Auditing "erasure-freedom" against a substrate where no real trace was
ever written is vacuous. Decay/integration (an old trace's influence
fading via EMA, being reweighted by new evidence, or contextualised
during sleep) is PERMITTED and does not falsify the claim; only a path
that sets a real trace's contribution to exactly zero / removes it
entirely -- indistinguishable from the consequence never having
occurred -- falsifies it.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass):
ree_core/residue/field.py implements this live. ResidueField carries
no reset/clear/delete/zero_out method. total_residue (field.py:620)
is only ever incremented, never decremented or reassigned to 0.0
anywhere in ree_core/. The one mechanism that reduces a written
weight's magnitude, discharge_domain() (SD-034, field.py:884-972), is
explicitly non-erasing by construction: multiplicative decay only
(factor in (0.0, 1.0]), clamped by a hard floor (MIN_FLOOR = 1e-6)
that keeps weights sign-preserving and strictly away from exact zero,
scoped to a bounded spatial radius, with valence_vecs left untouched
-- its own docstring states "weights decay multiplicatively toward
(but never to) zero." REEAgent.reset() (agent.py:2995-2996), the
per-episode reset, is explicitly documented and implemented as NOT
touching residue ("Does NOT reset residue (invariant)") while
resetting e1 hidden state, theta_buffer, beta_gate, serotonin and
other per-episode caches -- residue is conspicuously absent from that
reset body. Sleep consolidation (CrossModuleConsolidator,
cross_module_consolidation.py, MECH-121/MECH-423 feeding the
SD-017/MECH-120 sleep cluster) explicitly scopes its MECH-094
exception as writing to no residue/anchors/memory at all -- the
offline pass trains module weights only. ResidueField.integrate()
(field.py:974-997) only trains a side neural_field to regress toward
existing RBF outputs, leaving rbf_field.weights, total_residue, and
valence_vecs unmodified. One capacity caveat, not a falsifier:
RBFLayer's fixed-size circular buffer (next_center_idx wraps mod
num_centers) can, once num_harm_events exceeds num_basis_functions,
overwrite an old slot's spatial LOCATION while still ADDING to
(never replacing) that slot's weight -- this degrades spatial
attribution resolution under capacity pressure but never zeros a
contribution or decrements total_residue, so it does not meet the
falsifying bar above. (A separate familiarity/novelty tracker,
ree_core/hippocampal/curiosity.py FamiliarityTracker, SD-025, does
fully zero on reset() -- but it is a purely-spatial visitation
tracker, not a harm/benefit consequence record, and is out of scope
for this claim, the same distinction INV-011 drew for
reset_hidden_state().)

INV-007, regardless of whether the language content is behaviorally
coherent.

CONFIRMING evidence: a language/symbolic-justification mechanism
exists and is exercised, and the harm signal's reach into E3
trajectory evaluation is measurably unchanged -- z_harm_a/z_harm_s
propagate to trajectory scoring at the same magnitude/precision

Next step is a code-path audit once a language mechanism exists

INV-008.subject: precision.routing
INV-008.title: Precision is routed and depth-specific, not global.
INV-008.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live precision-representation and
precision-application code paths, not by a trained behavioral experiment
(this is a MECHANISM/STRUCTURE question -- HOW precision is stored and
applied -- not an accuracy or controllability-authority question, which
is ARC-005's separate, already-tested claim about whether the control
plane CAN route precision/mode authority).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must inspect a live case where
precision/gain modulation is actually computed and applied to
representation or error terms -- not merely declared in a config field
or present in dead/unreached code. A substrate with no precision
computation at all would trivially satisfy "no single global scalar"
while equally failing to exhibit routing. A single scalar that is
merely NAMED per-channel in a docstring but numerically shared across
channels also does not satisfy non-degeneracy in the confirming
direction.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): ree_core/latent/
stack.py implements this live. LatentState.precision is a
Dict[str, torch.Tensor] with five independently-computed channel keys
(self, world, beta, theta, delta), each backed by its OWN learnable
nn.Parameter logit (self_precision_logit, world_precision_logit, and a
separate precision_logit per SharedDepthEncoder instance for
beta/theta/delta), each applied as an in-channel elementwise gain
within that channel's own forward() -- never a value shared or
broadcast across channels. LatentStack.encode() populates this dict
every call and is invoked live from agent.py:4044 (not dead code).
compute_prediction_error() then weights each channel's error by that
SAME channel's own precision term. Separately, e3_selector.py's
current_precision (ARC-016) is a distinct, single derived scalar -- but
it is scoped specifically to the E3 commitment/trajectory-selection
gate and to dACC's affective-PE weighting (cingulate/dacc.py,
MECH-258), not broadcast to the stack's per-channel encoding gains.
Caveat: LatentStack.modulate_precision() and
compute_prediction_error() itself currently have no callers elsewhere
in ree-v3 -- the fuller tau-scoped cross-channel update/routing
apparatus described in precision_scoping.md (MECH-003) is defined but
not demonstrably exercised in the live step loop; what IS live and
wired is the encode-time per-channel gain computation and application
described above. The audit below is therefore CURRENTLY ANSWERABLE,
and reads CONFIRMING -- unlike INV-005 (a structurally similar
universal invariant), this claim is not blocked by non-degeneracy.

AUDIT TARGET: trace the live gain-application path from observation to
applied representation. Primary site: ree_core/latent/stack.py
(DualStreamEncoder.forward for self/world, SharedDepthEncoder.forward
for beta/theta/delta, LatentStack.encode() wiring them together).
Secondary consumer sites where a precision value is read and applied to
a specific downstream computation, not broadcast globally:
ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py (current_precision, ARC-016 dynamic
precision at the commit gate), ree_core/cingulate/dacc.py
(_affective_pe, MECH-258), ree_core/predictors/e2_world_uncertainty.py
(uncertainty-derived precision, MECH-059, explicitly distinct from
e3_selector's). Any future SD-026/attention-gating wiring (SD-026 is
currently unbuilt) is a further candidate site, not yet audited here.

FALSIFYING evidence: the traced live path shows precision/gain
modulation implemented as a SINGLE scalar (or single tensor of gains
applied identically across z_self/z_world/z_beta/z_theta/z_delta)
computed once and multiplied uniformly across the full concatenated
representation or across all downstream error/consumer terms, with no
channel independently able to carry a different precision value from
any other, ANYWHERE in the live gain-application path. Finding
e3_selector's current_precision (or any similar single derived value)
applied not just to its own scoped consumer (commit gate, dACC
affective PE) but ALSO directly gating z_self/z_world/z_beta/z_theta/
z_delta encoding with no independent per-channel term would falsify --
i.e., what would falsify is discovering the apparent "channel-specific"
naming in code is cosmetic and the underlying number is shared.

CONFIRMING evidence: the traced live path shows precision represented
and applied as independently-parameterized, independently-computed
values across at least the encoding channels (self/world/beta/theta/
delta) AND at least one further, separately-scoped consumer channel
(E3 commit-gate / affective-PE), such that no single scalar's value
determines all of them and ablating or changing one channel's
precision does not move another's. This is the CURRENT confirmed state
per the 2026-08-07 audit above: five independent nn.Parameter-backed
per-channel gains in LatentStack, applied locally within each stream's
own forward pass, plus a structurally distinct E3/dACC precision
channel scoped to trajectory-commitment and affective-PE weighting
specifically.

Next step, if this claim is re-audited later, is to re-check the audit
target list above for drift (new precision-touching code, e.g. SD-026
attention/salience gating landing) and to check whether
modulate_precision()/compute_prediction_error() have since gained live
callers -- their continued absence is not itself falsifying (the
encode-time gain is sufficient), but their presence would strengthen
the confirming finding further.

INV-009.subject: attention.mechanism
INV-009.title: Attention is precision modulation, not symbolic control.
INV-009.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live attention-ALLOCATION
code path specifically -- narrower than INV-008 (which audited
precision-routing infrastructure generally). INV-009 asks whether
ATTENTION (selecting/weighting what gets processed or written) is
realized as a continuous gain/weighting mechanism, or as discrete
symbolic control (an enum-keyed dispatch or if/switch that
categorically picks one mode/stream with no gradation).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must inspect a live,
actually-exercised attention-allocation path -- not a mechanism
merely declared in an enum or present in code that nothing in the
live agent loop calls.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): three live,
actually-exercised attention-relevant mechanisms were traced, all
continuous:
  (1) SD-016 (status: implemented) -- ree_core's E1 frontal cue-
      indexed ContextMemory query path implements attention
      literally as transformer-style query-key-softmax retrieval:
      q = world_query_proj(z_world), k = key_proj(context_memory.
      memory), weights = softmax(q @ k.T / scale). Continuous by
      construction. (Its empirical DIFFERENTIATION has failed in
      some runs -- V3-EXQ-418e/f found attn_entropy pinned at the
      uniform rail ln(16) -- but that is a performance defect in a
      continuous mechanism, not evidence of a discrete one
      underneath.)
  (2) MECH-261 (status: stable, conf 0.891) --
      ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py's
      SalienceCoordinator. "Operating mode is implemented as a soft
      probability vector ... not a one-hot categorical."
      operating_mode = softmax(logits, temperature); write_gate(
      target) = sum_mode operating_mode[mode] * gate_weights[
      target][mode] -- continuous, read directly by consumers. A
      discrete current_mode label exists (argmax + hysteresis) but
      is diagnostic-only; write_gate() never reads it.
  (3) INV-008's confirmed per-channel precision gains (LatentStack,
      five independent nn.Parameter-backed channels).

THE ONE DISCRETE/SYMBOLIC CANDIDATE FOUND, AND WHY IT DOES NOT
CURRENTLY BEAR ON THIS CLAIM: ree_core/claustrum/{control_demand.py,
coalition_templates.py, coalition_controller.py} (SD-091/MECH-481)
implements a genuinely categorical dispatch -- ControlDemandType is
a 10-member Enum, and request_coalition(demand_type) looks up
COALITION_TEMPLATES[demand_type], a branch on an enum key, not a
gradient. This is exactly the kind of mechanism that WOULD falsify
this claim if it were live. It is not: self.coalition defaults to
None (config flag off by default), and request_coalition() is never
called anywhere in agent.py or any other live ree_core module --
only from the module's own tests and its own falsifier experiment
driver. The module's own docstrings confirm this is deliberately
unwired pending a follow-up pass. write_gate() IS called at 3 live
consumer sites but always against an empty _active list, i.e.
permanent identity no-ops today. This fails the non-degeneracy
precondition and is therefore NOT counted as confirming or
falsifying -- it is a WATCH ITEM: if/when SD-091 steps 4-5 land and
request_coalition() is ever called from a live classifier, this
claim must be re-audited, since that would introduce a genuinely
two-layer structure (discrete classification -> continuous
execution) this audit has not had to resolve.

AUDIT TARGET for re-check: ree_core/cingulate/
salience_coordinator.py (write_gate, operating_mode),
ree_core/predictors/ (SD-016 query/key/softmax path),
ree_core/claustrum/ (re-grep for new request_coalition() callers),
ree_core/latent/stack.py.

FALSIFYING evidence: a live, actually-called attention-allocation
path is found where WHICH stream/mode/target receives processing
resources is determined by a discrete/categorical branch that picks
ONE target categorically with no continuous gradation available, AND
that branch is reachable from the live agent loop.

CONFIRMING evidence: the traced live attention-allocation paths
(SD-016 softmax retrieval, MECH-261 soft-probability write-gating,
INV-008's per-channel precision gains) continue to show continuous,
gradable weighting with no reachable discrete branch determining
allocation outright. This is the CURRENT confirmed state.

INV-010.subject: sleep.necessity
INV-010.title: Offline integration exists and is required.
INV-010.what_would_answer:
INV-010 is the BARE universal-necessity claim: offline integration
exists across cognitive systems and is architecturally required, full
stop -- grounded in cross-species biology (e.g. the zebrafish
sleep-necessity literature already cited in claim_evidence.v1.json),
with no depends_on and no REE-specific mechanism content. This is
DISTINCT from its dependent claim ARC-011 ("offline integration is
required FOR STABILITY [in REE]"), which stakes the REE-specific,
empirically-testable architectural claim (mediated through ARC-007
hippocampal replay and ARC-005 control plane) -- see ARC-011's own
what_would_answer for that empirical falsifier; do not re-run it here.
[Digestion note, flagged not resolved: the two titles read as
near-duplicates in wording despite this real distinction in kind --
worth a governance pass to make the split explicit in one or both
entries.]

Answered by literature/derivational argument, not a REE experiment:
does the biological/computational-cognition literature show ANY
complex, stable cognitive system (biological or artificial) that
sustains long-horizon operation WITHOUT some form of offline
consolidation, or is offline integration a structural universal across
every studied case? FALSIFYING: a credible counterexample -- a
cognitive system (biological species, or an artificial agent
architecture with a comparable operating horizon) demonstrated to
remain stable indefinitely with zero offline/consolidation phase.
CONFIRMING: the cross-species pattern holds without exception across
the literature base already cited for this claim, and no counter-
example architecture is found.

Note: REE's own EXQ-430 (SLEEP harm < NO_SLEEP harm, tagged INV-010)
found no differential effect in 0/3 seeds, but governance's own read
was "not evidence against INV-010; symptom of missing MECH-261
mode-conditioned offline-write gating substrate" -- i.e. inconclusive/
substrate-gated, not falsifying, and in any case this REE-level
empirical question is ARC-011's falsifier, not INV-010's (a universal
invariant is not falsified by one architecture's substrate-readiness
gap).

INV-012.subject: commitment.epistemology
INV-012.title: Responsibility arises through commitment, not prediction alone.
INV-012.what_would_answer:
CORRECTION (2026-08-07, same digestion session, user-caught): the
original version of this what_would_answer called Leg 1 "answerable
now" without stating a prior precondition it silently assumed --
flagged by the user mid-session: responsibility-bearing commitment
presupposes the agent is genuinely CHOOSING AMONG MULTIPLE LIVE,
DIFFERENTIATED IMAGINED FUTURES, not executing something close to a
single dominant candidate that merely gets labeled "the commitment."
If E3's candidate proposal+selection pipeline is degenerate in that
sense, Leg 1's question (is the ATTENTION-WRITE mechanism
distinguishable from residue-geometry) becomes moot, because there is
no genuine choosing for that mechanism to be the mechanism *of*. This
is now stated as LEG 0 below, ahead of Leg 1, and Leg 1's "answerable
now" is narrowed to mean "answerable now AS A NECESSARY-BUT-NOT-
SUFFICIENT question" -- it no longer implies the claim as a whole is
answerable independent of Leg 0.

LEG 0 (prior non-degeneracy precondition -- CURRENTLY UNMET, per this
session's own findings): does E3 select among genuinely graded,
differentiated candidate trajectories at all, as opposed to a
near-deterministic pick dominated by one candidate? This is not
hypothetical -- MECH-439 (the E3 selection-authority mechanism
directly upstream of any "commitment") is `epistemic_category:
standard`, `ceiling_decision: exhausted`: 10 confirmed
substrate_ceiling autopsies found no genuine graded discrimination
among candidates, and the same F-dominance conversion-ceiling root
was independently confirmed blocking SD-037 (broadcast override,
this session), ARC-064 (bottom-up rule discovery, this session, via
its MECH-309 dependency), and ARC-062 GAP-B, dACC C2, and SD-034
de-commit. Escalated to a constitutional route (ARC-107/MECH-448/449)
rather than resolved at the parametric level. Until E3's own
selection mechanism clears this ceiling -- candidates shown to
compete on genuinely graded, non-monopolized terms -- "commitment"
has no differentiated alternative-space to be a commitment relative
to, and neither Leg 1 nor Leg 2 below can be more than necessary
conditions. CONFIRMED if a future E3 selection test (post-ARC-107)
shows graded, gap-concentrated discrimination among candidates
(matching ARC-106's own load-bearing-vs-decorative test). FALSIFIED
(for Leg 0 specifically, not for INV-012 as a whole) if E3 selection
is shown to be structurally incapable of graded discrimination
regardless of substrate fix -- which would mean INV-012 needs
re-grounding in a different selection mechanism entirely, not merely
a wait for ARC-107.

LEG 1 (derivational, answerable now ONLY as a necessary-but-not-
sufficient question -- see Leg 0 above, not independently decisive):
INV-012's ethical content depends on deliberate/willed attention being
mechanistically distinguishable from reflexive/residue-driven attention
(ARC-007). SD-026's own notes already stage this argument on five axes;
axis 5 ("the INV-012 argument itself") is CIRCULAR -- it cites INV-012's
requirement as evidence for SD-026's distinctness in order to establish
INV-012's coherence, which assumes the conclusion. The genuine proof
obligation rests on the remaining four: (i) causality direction
(retrospective outcome-driven vs prospective intent-driven), (ii)
neuromodulatory gating (DA-gated vs ACh/NA-gated), (iii) clinical
dissociation (amnestic vs frontal-lobe syndromes), (iv) representational
format (episodic specificity vs cross-situational feature generality).
CONFIRMED if a formal/architectural argument (or, once SD-026 is
implemented, a code-level inspection) shows the proposed dan_feedback
channel is structurally distinct from residue-geometry writes on at
least 2 of these 4 axes (e.g. genuinely separate source signal +
separate decay constant + no shared write path other than the common
additive E1-prior register). FALSIFIED if the channel turns out to be
functionally redundant with ARC-007 on all 4 axes despite the
architectural label -- e.g. if "prospective vs retrospective" collapses
to a parameter setting (decay constant) on what is otherwise the same
write mechanism, or if the neuromodulatory/clinical dissociations
invoked have no analogue in REE's own implementation. A falsification
here means "commitment" has no mechanistically real referent and
reduces to "whatever was already conditioned" -- INV-012 would need to
be narrowed or retired, independent of any experiment.

LEG 2 (substrate_conditional, empirical/behavioral, gated): whether the
distinguishable channel -- once it exists -- actually produces willed
(goal-directed, non-reflexive) perception is a behavioral question that
cannot be tested until: (a) SD-014 reaches >= provisional [status as of
this digestion: still candidate, and the most recent evidence
(V3-EXQ-887, 2026-08-04, weakens, unreviewed) moves AWAY from the gate,
not toward it -- FAILED both C1 functional_drive_gating and C2
representational_separability for the SD-014 node-valence vector on all
3 seeds]; (b) SD-026 is implemented (currently unbuilt: no manifest
exercises MECH-251/dan_feedback, no queue entry references SD-026 or
dan_feedback -- the "do not queue until SD-014 >= provisional" hold in
SD-026's own evidence_quality_note is being honored); and (c) SD-026's
own pre-registered five-step validation sequence completes: (i) z_goal
seeds (SD-012), (ii) z_resource separates (SD-014), (iii) dan_feedback
enabled/disabled as ablation, (iv) benefit_ratio measured against random
baseline, (v) feature-channel precision measured on goal-relevant vs
irrelevant dimensions. CONFIRMED if dan_feedback=on lifts benefit_ratio
substantially over dan_feedback=off, with goal-relevant feature channels
showing higher precision than irrelevant ones under dan_feedback=on.
FALSIFIED if dan_feedback=off performs equivalently (replicating the
EXQ-085h-l seed-but-inert pattern regardless of ablation state) -- i.e.
z_goal's behavioral effect, if any, is fully mediated by pathways other
than the claimed prospective channel, and the "willed vs reflexive"
distinction has no behavioral signature even if Leg 1's architectural
distinction holds.

Non-degeneracy precondition for Leg 2 as a whole: SD-014 >= provisional
AND SD-026 landed AND steps (i)-(v) above all completed on non-degenerate
seeds. Until then, Leg 2 is untestable by construction, not merely
unfavored -- absence of a benefit_ratio lift right now would say
nothing, because the channel does not yet exist to test.

LEG 3 (retrospective, substrate_conditional, gated -- added 2026-08-07
from a same-day user thought, docs/thoughts/2026-08-07_responsibility_
counterfactual_memory.md, Stage 2: evidence/planning/thought_intake_
2026-08-07_responsibility_counterfactual_memory.md): responsibility
additionally requires the agent to (a) retain that a genuinely
differentiated alternative existed at a past decision point -- not just
that "some other action was abstractly possible" -- and roughly what it
was, for the sub-interrupt-threshold cases MECH-485 routes to retention
rather than to real-time correction; (b) evaluate counterfactually
whether that alternative would have avoided the harm actually incurred
or better achieved the goal actually pursued; and (c) attribute the
resulting outcome to the agent's OWN choice specifically, as opposed to
circumstance -- tied to sense-of-self machinery (INV-033, second-order
epistemic access to one's own epistemic states), not a bare
causal-attribution computation alone (SD-003/MECH-276 already provide
the causal-attribution half, for training, not the narrative-retention
half).

Depends on MECH-485 (the retained-alternative supply -- candidates that
crossed neither the fast-interrupt threshold nor triggered orient/
survey, per Q-090's still-open admission-criterion question) AND on a
retention mechanism for rejected/uncommitted E3 candidates that does
NOT YET EXIST in ree-v3 in any form: e3_selector.select() discards
every non-winning candidate every tick; the nearest partial exception,
SD-033e/MECH-264 (frontopolar counterfactual value), reduces the best
unchosen alternative to a transient scalar (cfv_now) overwritten every
tick, with nothing about WHICH alternative existed surviving past the
tick it was computed on. That retention mechanism is deliberately NOT
registered as its own claim as of this writing -- an earlier session's
memory (project_imagination_learning_constraints.md, 2026-05-10) staged
an adjacent candidate registration for this exact territory and
explicitly gated it "do NOT register without dedicated lit-pull";
respected here rather than overridden. ARC-085 (autobiographical event
tokens, V4/V5, unbuilt) is the nearest candidate eventual host, but its
current schema has no field for "sibling alternatives considered and
rejected here."

CONFABULATION-RISK CAUTION (load-bearing, not decorative -- stated
explicitly by the user as the central danger of this leg): admitting
retained/imagined alternative content into this evaluation with the
wrong weighting is a plausible computational account of a hard-learned
delusion -- a positive feedback loop reinforcing a belief that was
never actually tested against reality, distinct from a one-off
hallucination because it is reinforced into stability by its own
imagined "confirmations." This is why Leg 3 is explicitly a
METACOGNITIVE requirement (INV-033), not merely a memory-engineering
one: distinguishing "this happened" from "this was imagined, and I am
only using it to evaluate a counterfactual" is a second-order judgment
about the source and status of one's own mental content. Any future
retention mechanism must follow the MECH-322 template (bounded,
audited, provisional-until-corroborated) -- REE's one existing
precedent for letting imagined content through the MECH-094
imagination/reality write gate under narrow, audited conditions -- not
a general relaxation of MECH-094.

Non-degeneracy precondition for Leg 3: Leg 0 cleared (E3 selects among
genuinely differentiated candidates -- currently unmet) AND the
retention mechanism exists and demonstrably retains content past the
current tick AND retained content remains distinguishable in
provenance from committed/real content (MECH-094's committed_vs_imagined
tag) AND retained alternatives show non-degenerate variance in whether
they would have avoided the harm/achieved the goal (not floor- or
ceiling-saturated). Until all four hold, Leg 3 is untestable by
construction, not merely unfavored.

CONFIRMED if, given the above substrate, an agent that retains and
correctly counterfactually evaluates rejected alternatives shows
measurably different self-attribution behavior (narrative/self-report,
or an internal attribution signal) between "harm followed from my
choice, a retained better alternative existed" and "harm followed from
my choice, no better alternative existed" cases, AND this attribution
does not degrade into elevated confidence for imagined-only
(never-executed) content in real-experience channels (residue,
valence, hippocampal writes) -- i.e. the confabulation guard holds
under test, not merely by design intent.

FALSIFIED if retained-alternative content cannot be kept
distinguishable from committed content without a hand-tuned,
case-by-case gate (no general MECH-322-shaped template suffices) --
meaning the confabulation risk is not tractably bounded and Leg 3
should be retired or radically narrowed -- OR if providing retained
alternatives produces no measurable change in self-attribution/
responsibility-relevant behavior over an ablated (discard-immediately)
baseline, i.e. retention supplies no function beyond what SD-033e/
MECH-264's existing transient scalar already provides.

LEG 4 (derivational precondition + substrate_conditional test, added
2026-08-25 from docs/thoughts/2026-08-12_responsibility_as_epistemic_
hygiene.md, Stage 2: evidence/planning/thought_intake_2026-08-12_
responsibility_as_epistemic_hygiene.md): responsibility's epistemic
function is not exhausted by knowing THAT an outcome was self-caused
(Legs 0-3 and ARC-015/MECH-095 already cover self-vs-other/self-vs-
world DISCRIMINATION). A further, distinct requirement is that once
self-causation is known -- which does not itself require resolving
MECH-095's substrate-ceiling-blocked discrimination task, since an
agent has direct efference-copy access to its OWN committed action
without needing to disambiguate it from a second agent's -- the
belief-UPDATE machinery must discount that observation's evidential
weight for the SPECIFIC prior that motivated the commitment, because
the observation was solicited by the very hypothesis under test
(a selection-bias / look-elsewhere problem, not an attribution
problem). Naive accumulation of self-solicited-but-genuinely-real
evidence can inflate confidence in a prior regardless of that prior's
truth: incorrect prior -> congruent commitment -> prior-shaped
intervention/sampling -> apparently confirmatory evidence -> stronger
incorrect prior -> stronger congruent commitment. This is a THIRD
mechanism, distinct from both existing self-referential-belief risks
already registered: Leg 3 (imagined/retained counterfactual content
contaminating evaluation) concerns IMAGINED content; MAE-3-blocked
ARC-015 Half 1 / MECH-095 concerns DISCRIMINATING self from an actual
OTHER agent. Leg 4 concerns REAL, correctly-self-attributed evidence
whose SAMPLING was itself biased by the commitment under test -- and,
unlike ARC-015 Half 1, this does NOT require a second agent or
multi_agent_ecology_v5:MAE-3: the confound is constructible in a
SINGLE-agent environment where the agent's own committed action
determines which region of state-space it subsequently samples.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires an environment in which (a) an
initially-plausible-but-incorrect prior can drive a committed action,
(b) that action measurably changes which subsequent observations the
agent encounters (attention/movement/information-seeking, not merely
which outcome resolves), and (c) at least one alternative sampling
policy (e.g. an ablated or randomised intervention-selection arm)
would have produced a materially different, less-confirmatory
observation distribution for the SAME underlying prior -- otherwise
"self-solicited" and "independent" evidence are indistinguishable by
construction and the test is vacuous. No existing V3 test-bed is
known to satisfy this; CausalGridWorld's native dynamics were already
found insufficiently structured for the adjacent MECH-095 test
(ARC-015's own non-degeneracy note), though for a different reason
(no distinct OTHER, not no sampling-bias channel) -- this precondition
needs its own dedicated environment check, not an inherited pass/fail
from SD-047.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent whose post-commit belief update
correctly discounts self-solicited evidence (e.g. via provenance-
weighted update rules downstream of MECH-060/061's write-locus
separation, or an explicit endogenous-sampling-bias correction term)
recovers from an initially incorrect prior at a rate statistically
indistinguishable from an agent given independently-sampled evidence
of the same volume, while an otherwise-identical agent lacking this
discounting shows measurably SLOWER or NON-recovery (persistent
incorrect commitment despite nominally-confirmatory real evidence) --
the delusion-like lock-in signature this thought predicts.

FALSIFYING signature: an agent lacking any self-solicitation
discounting recovers from an incorrect prior at the same rate as one
with it (the naive accumulation loop this thought predicts does not
actually manifest at V3 scale, e.g. because exploration/curiosity
drives or residue decay already wash out the confound) -- this would
mean Leg 4 identifies a real but practically-inert risk, not a
load-bearing gap in existing machinery, and should be narrowed to a
documented failure mode (EXT-xxx-shaped) rather than kept as an open
testability leg of INV-012.

INV-013.subject: cognition.structure
INV-013.title: Cognition is predictive, iterative, and multi-timescale.
INV-013.what_would_answer:
INV-013 asserts three conjunctive architectural properties of REE's cognition: (1) PREDICTIVE -- the substrate forms forward models rather than reacting purely to immediate observation; (2) ITERATIVE -- action/latent selection proceeds through repeated refinement rather than a single forward pass; (3) MULTI-TIMESCALE -- processing is stratified across more than one update rate, not a single flat clock. This is an architectural-commitment audit, not a behavioral measurement -- the deeper question of whether each property is GENUINELY realized (vs. merely labeled) is already delegated to sharper dependents: ARC-001 (is E1's persistence real, not just a persistent-looking API), ARC-002 (is E2's prediction actually affordance-conditioned, not just world-dynamics-conditioned), and ARC-004 (is L-space actually timescale-stratified, not just role-stratified at a single shared rate). INV-013 only certifies that a mechanism for each of the three properties exists in the running substrate.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least one code path per property must be exercised by the live agent loop (not dead code, not test-only scaffolding, not a docstring-only claim). A property satisfied only in a module that is never called from Agent.step()/Agent.plan() would make the audit vacuous.
CONFIRMING (per property, all three required):
  - PREDICTIVE: at least one forward-model component that outputs a
    prediction of a FUTURE state/observation/affordance conditioned on a
    current state+action, consumed by the live decision loop -- e.g.
    ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py's LSTM-based slow world model and
    ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py's world_forward()/predict_next_state(),
    both wired into Agent.step().
  - ITERATIVE: at least one selection/refinement mechanism that produces a
    candidate, scores it, and revises the candidate set across more than one
    pass within a single decision -- e.g. the CEM-style proposal loop in
    ree_core/agent.py with stuck-state-gated widening via
    difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy.py.
  - MULTI-TIMESCALE: at least two update rates coexist and interact -- the
    within-episode fast/slow split (E2 vs. E1) AND the cross-episode split
    via ree_core/sleep/ operating at a slower-than-tick cadence.
A code audit finding at least one live instance of each, wired into the executed agent loop, is CONFIRMING for INV-013 at the architectural level.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): removal or dead-coding of the only mechanism realizing one of the three properties without a replacement -- e.g. E1 and E2 both deleted/bypassed with action selection driven purely by a stateless reactive policy; the CEM/proposal-refinement loop replaced by a single greedy argmax with no resampling pass; or L-space collapsed to a single shared-rate latent with sleep/consolidation removed entirely.
Note (non-degeneracy caveat, per ARC-004's own audit): L-space's LatentStack.encode currently smooths z_beta/z_theta/z_delta with a single shared EMA constant (alpha_shared=0.3) -- so MULTI-TIMESCALE here is carried jointly by L-space's recursive structure AND the online/offline split, not by L-space's per-layer clock rate alone. Does not falsify INV-013, which only requires SOME multi-timescale mechanism.

INV-014.subject: architecture.separation
INV-014.title: Representation and regulation are strictly separated.
INV-014.what_would_answer:
Asks whether any code path in ree_core where a regulation/control-plane computation (control gains, precision/gating, neuromodulator-analog state, policy commitment) can directly mutate representation-layer state/weights (the latent stack: z_world, z_self, z_goal, and their encoders) outside a defined, typed interface -- or, symmetrically, whether any representation- computing module directly implements regulatory/gating logic -- as opposed to the two pathways composing only through bounded, typed cross-axis coupling (per the invariant's own interpretation note: "not a claim of full functional isolation").
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: there must be at least one identifiable representation-computing module (ree_core/latent/: zworld_p0.py, stack.py, cross_stream_binder.py, theta_buffer.py, self_recurrence.py, multi_content_theta_packet.py) and at least one identifiable regulation- computing module (ree_core/regulators/, ree_core/policy/, ree_core/neuromodulation/) that are both actually exercised in the live agent loop. A substrate where regulation code never touches representation output at all trivially satisfies "no violation" without testing the boundary the invariant asserts.
CONFIRMING: every regulation-computing module's interaction with representation state is READ-ONLY on representation content, optionally gated by an explicit stop-gradient/detach boundary, and any influence regulation has runs only through a named, typed interface -- e.g. a config-level gain (SerotoninModule modulating GoalConfig.z_goal_seeding_gain / valence_wanting_floor), a plasticity/write-depth modulator on a defined write pathway, or a detached read for downstream selection (policy/model_disagreement.py's explicit "stop-gradient on z_world inputs, do NOT propagate into the encoder"). Symmetrically, representation-computing modules contain no gating/commitment/precision-weighting logic of their own.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): any code path where a regulation/control-plane computation directly assigns into, overwrites, or backpropagates gradient into representation-layer state other than through a named, reviewed interface. Concrete examples: a regulator/policy module setting z_world/z_self/z_goal directly rather than reading it; a neuromodulator module writing into latent-stack content rather than a separately-named gain/config field; removal of an existing stop-gradient boundary without a documented, reviewed replacement. Also falsifying in the other direction: a representation module implementing its own commitment/precision-gating logic rather than delegating to regulators/policy.

INV-019.subject: meta.selection_compression_boundary
INV-019.title: Rehearsal traversal and irreversible durable write must remain separated.
INV-019.what_would_answer:
This is a UNIVERSAL/DERIVATIONAL meta-invariant -- the primary claim is a substrate-neutral information-flow-architecture proof obligation, not an REE-specific empirical hypothesis. Two legs, answered by different methods.
LEG 1 -- DERIVATIONAL: does the generalization from INV-011 ("imagination without belief update") to "any channel that both explores and writes durably" hold? Proof pattern: unrestricted exploration implies the explored branch's provisional state must remain revocable; an irreversible durable write is by definition non-revocable; a channel permitting both simultaneously can commit content that was never validated against real consequence. CONFIRMING: any channel meeting (explores + can durably write) either gates on an explicit tag (as INV-011's audited hypothesis_tag gate does) or is provably unable to reach a write consumer at all (vacuous satisfaction). FALSIFYING (of the UNIVERSAL framing, not necessarily REE's instance): a plausible alternative architecture where a channel does both simultaneously without this failure mode -- e.g. one where "durable write" is made cheaply/fully revocable, so "irreversible" no longer applies. Such a counterexample would downgrade INV-019 from invariant_type universal to a design-decision specific to non-transactional substrates (which REE is), not merely fail to move claim status.
LEG 2 -- SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL (ARC-014, checkable now): NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- requires a live case where simulated/imagined content (hypothesis_tag=True) is generated AND a real durable-write-capable consumer is reachable from it; auditing an unexercised gate is vacuous. CONFIRMING: every write-capable consumer reachable from simulated content checks the tag and refuses to write when set (audited: E1/simulate() pathway, V3-EXQ-499/633/880 PASS), OR the pathway's output does not yet reach any write-capable consumer at all (DMN/_do_replay() pathway, vacuous pass pending V3-EXQ-543c -- re-check once wired). FALSIFYING: simulated content reaches and durably alters real-experience state through an ungoverned path (tag silently ignored, defaulted away, or bypassed outside the one audited exception, MECH-322's sleep-only ARC-071 chunking), or that exception fires outside its stated preconditions.
Passing LEG 1 without LEG 2 leaves the claim proved-but-unverified-in-REE; passing LEG 2 without LEG 1 leaves it verified-in-REE-but-not-shown-universal. Both required for the claim as currently stated.

INV-020.subject: meta.authority_stratification_boundary
INV-020.title: Constraint stores are authority-stratified from direct observational/symbolic writes.
INV-020.what_would_answer:
Same two-leg structure as sibling meta-invariant INV-019 (same 2026-04-17 registration batch).
LEG 1 -- DERIVATIONAL: adversarial-construction proof for "any architecture with multiple write channels requires typed authority separation." Assume no stratification, exhibit a construction where observational/symbolic content reaches the constraint store's write path on the same channel as legitimate authority-bearing writes, and show this is either (i) actually vulnerable to unauthorized capture, or (ii) accidentally safe only because some other unacknowledged typing already exists (stratification was present all along, just unlabeled). FALSIFYING (of the UNIVERSAL framing): an architecture with both a capture-capable content channel and an authority-bearing store that stays safe/uncaptured under adversarial exteroceptive input with NO typed separation anywhere in its write path -- stratification turns out unnecessary rather than merely satisfied cheaply. No such construction is known; this leg is answerable by continued search in the architecture/adversarial-ML literature, not by REE experimentation.
LEG 2 -- SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL (ARC-020, offline-consolidation pipeline): NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION -- requires a live, reachable typed commit-boundary mechanism gating writes FROM offline/sleep consolidation TO privileged authority-store equivalents (POL/ID/CAPS per docs/architecture/sleep.md#arc-020). CURRENT STATE (2026-08-08, re-confirming ARC-020's own finding): precondition FAILS -- exhaustive grep of ree_core/ for write_locus/permission_matrix/commit_token/commit_boundary returns zero hits. No privileged-authority-store concept and no typed commit-boundary/verifier- mediation machinery exists in the live V3 substrate; MECH-067 (the mechanism this would route through) is provisional on V1 substrate only, never retested in V3. This leg is currently a substrate-conditional wait state, not an open experimental question -- do not force a test while the precondition is unmet.
Do not read INV-020's derivational categorization as "ARC-020 is done" -- the universal claim and its REE-specific implementation locus are genuinely decoupled per this claim's own notes; that decoupling is why INV-020 can carry derivational while ARC-020 carries substrate_conditional.
