INV-025.subject: epistemology.irreducible_uncertainty
INV-025.title: Irreducible uncertainty is an epistemological constraint that cannot be engineered away.
INV-025.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-025 as literally stated -- that epistemic uncertainty is irreducible IN PRINCIPLE for any finite agent in a real world, not merely irreducible for REE's current architecture -- is a foundational epistemological premise (Axiom 1 of five_axioms_foundations.md, "You can never be sure"). No REE experiment can prove uncertainty is irreducible in principle; an experiment can only show that REE's OWN uncertainty estimates are non-degenerate (do not collapse to false certainty), never that some other architecture could not in principle eliminate uncertainty. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-026/027/028/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (testable now -- NOT substrate-blocked, unlike the ARC-010/V5-gated legs drafted for INV-028/INV-029): INV-025's own architectural-consequence text names the machinery directly -- "the entire precision architecture (ARC-016, INV-008, INV-009)... follows necessarily from this axiom," with pre-commit simulation (INV-011) and the commitment gate (INV-012) as necessary responses. Unlike the mirror-modelling legs for the other axiom claims, this machinery is core V1/V2/V3 substrate that is already built and, for its primary component, already validated. The testable question is narrower than the axiom: does REE's architecture actually IMPLEMENT the operational consequence of treating uncertainty as irreducible -- i.e. does precision-weighted prediction error remain genuinely non-degenerate across training and eval, and does the commitment gate (INV-012) function as an uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguard rather than a fixed schedule decoupled from it.
ALREADY ANSWERED, primary component (ARC-016, status: stable, 2026-07-25): the eval-time structural test of exactly this question has run and PASSED. V3-EXQ-818 (eval_derived_noise_precision_sweep) found mean_rho_rv_vs_commit = -0.955 -- commit-rate tracks E3-derived precision MONOTONICALLY across a graded-noise ladder, non-degenerate (commit rate strictly between floor and ceiling, not pinned), load-bearing C1 PASS, gate_green = True. See ARC-016's own what_would_answer for the full non-degeneracy precondition this reuses (do not re-derive).
SECONDARY COMPONENT, currently UNCONFIRMED (INV-011, INV-012): whether pre-commit simulation and the commitment gate specifically function as uncertainty-DRIVEN safeguards is not independently evidenced -- neither carries its own what_would_answer today. INV-012 additionally carries pending_substrate_reconfirmation=true (emergent_from SD-026, still candidate) and per its own notes cannot be cited as supporting evidence until substrate reconfirmation.
Confirming observation: commit-rate continues to track E3-derived precision/variance monotonically under a graded manipulation, non-degenerate across the manipulated range, reproducing V3-EXQ-818.
Falsifying observation: the precision/commitment signal COLLAPSES to a fixed value independent of estimated uncertainty once the eval-derived threshold is correctly calibrated -- would not falsify the axiom (out of domain) but would falsify the claim that REE's precision architecture is a genuine operational consequence of treating uncertainty as irreducible, and would call ARC-016's stable status into question.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-06, thought-digestion, session thoughts-intakes-4fd18d): fourth of the five original axiom claims digested. Unlike INV-028/INV-029 (substrate_conditional, unbuilt V5 substrate), INV-025's reframed leg rests on already-built, already- validated V1/V2/V3 machinery. Do not apply substrate_conditional mechanically to every axiom claim -- check what the architectural- consequence machinery actually requires, per claim.

INV-026.subject: self.existence
INV-026.title: A self is an operational prerequisite for responsible agency.
INV-026.what_would_answer:
INV-026 asserts a metaphysical axiom ("I am" -- Axiom 2) with an explicit
operational claim attached: the self is a prerequisite for responsible agency.
Split into two legs, but unlike INV-028/029, the architectural leg here is
ALREADY BUILT V3 substrate, not V5-gated.

== LEG 1 (OUT OF DOMAIN): the axiom itself ==
"The agent exists as a distinct locus of experience, action, and
responsibility" is a claim about SUBJECTIVE, phenomenal selfhood. No REE
experiment can confirm or deny this -- an experiment can show a functionally
distinct, causally load-bearing self-representation, not phenomenal
selfhood in the sense the axiom asserts. Permanently out of domain.

== LEG 2 (REFRAMED, TESTABLE NOW) ==
(a) DISTINCTNESS: does z_self encode self/action information distinctly
from z_world (SD-005)? PARTIALLY CONFIRMED, with a real asymmetry that
should qualify how strongly this premise is stated. z_self RELIABLY
specialises (EXQ-532 self_body_advantage=+0.126), but z_world does NOT
reliably show reciprocal specialisation (EXQ-532 world_obs_advantage=
-0.032). Cite SD-005's own evidence_quality_note, do not re-derive.

(b) SOURCE MONITORING: does the architecture distinctly tag internally-
generated vs world-received content (MECH-094)? CONFIRMED, stable,
conf 0.868, 13 supporting lit entries, 0 load-bearing opposing.

(c) LOAD-BEARING FOR RESPONSIBILITY (the axiom's own stated function):
does responsibility/commitment machinery actually degrade if the
self-representation is ablated? Cross-reference ARC-015 HALF 2
(responsibility flow, MECH-060/061/057a) -- testable now, real V1
evidence, do not duplicate. ARC-015 HALF 1 (self-vs-OTHER via MECH-095)
is a different question, confirmed substrate-blocked -- not relevant here.

Live caveat: INV-012 carries pending_substrate_reconfirmation=true
(emergent_from SD-026, still candidate) and cannot be cited as supporting
evidence until SD-026 reaches active.

CONFIRMING signature: ablating z_self/MECH-094 measurably degrades
ARC-015-Half-2-style commitment/responsibility-flow behaviour beyond
what gate-ablation alone already accounts for.

FALSIFYING signature: commitment-boundary gating and responsibility
attribution function identically whether or not the self-representation
is intact -- would mean self is decorative relative to commitment
machinery, not prerequisite to it.

INV-027.subject: world.existence
INV-027.title: An external world is a structural prerequisite for grounded representation.
INV-027.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): "There is a real world independent of the agent's model of it" is a metaphysical/epistemological premise (realism vs. idealism/constructivism) no REE experiment can settle. An experiment can only show structured, informative prediction error -- consistent with a real causal process, not proof one exists independent of any modeling agent whatsoever.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG: does REE's architecture behave AS IF there is a genuinely independent, structured external causal process? (a) do prediction-error channels (z_world/SD-005, E1/E2/E3) produce structured, learnable surprise, not noise; (b) does the residue field genuinely accumulate what ACTUALLY happened distinct from prediction, and is that load-bearing (INV-004/INV-006 post-commit persistence); (c) does ARC-024's claim that harm gradients precede/predict harm events hold up empirically.
Confirming signature: prediction-error metrics improve with training rather than sitting at noise floor, AND residue-field-driven behaviour measurably diverges from a trust-the-prediction-always baseline in a way that tracks actual outcomes.
Falsifying signature: prediction error stays indistinguishable from noise regardless of training, OR the residue field fails to build non-zero contrast at all (as already seen in EXQ-151/EXQ-215 -- an open implementation gap, not yet resolved), OR the residue trace never diverges usefully from the prediction it's supposed to be independent of. Caveats already on record: z_world does NOT reliably show reciprocal specialisation vs z_self (EXQ-047g/113/532), and ARC-024 itself is currently provisional/demoted, not confirmed -- so this leg is testable-now but not yet won.

INV-028.subject: ethics.shared_world
INV-028.title: Shared-world ethics requires modelling others as co-inhabitants of the same consequence space.
INV-028.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-028 as literally stated -- that other agents' harm and benefit are real "by exactly the same grounds as the agent's own," because they are selves (INV-026) in the same world (INV-027) -- is a foundational ethical/metaphysical premise (Axiom 4 of five_axioms_foundations.md, "Others share this world"). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether another agent's harm is metaphysically real by the same grounds as the agent's own. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- INV-028's own architectural consequence names it directly: "when another self is represented using the same predictive machinery as the self, their harm generates the same error signal structure as own-harm" (grounds mirror modelling, INV-005, at the REE-specific level via ARC-010). The testable question is whether self-caused harm to a MODELLED OTHER (via ARC-010 mirror modelling -- reused self/other latent stack, ARC-004 L-space with reduced precision gains) generates an error-signal / harm-evaluation structure statistically indistinguishable from self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes -- i.e. whether the self-other distinction is actually just "a routing difference within the same architecture, not a different architecture," once it is measurable rather than asserted.
Confirming observation: comparing self-caused harm to the agent's own modelled outcomes against self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other (ARC-010's OTHER_SELFLIKE-tagged shadow-bundle estimate), the harm-error signal driving E3 ranking/routing shows the same functional form, magnitude scaling, and downstream repair/avoidance pull in both conditions -- i.e. no separate "other-harm" pathway exists; own-harm and modelled-other-harm route through the same machinery.
Falsifying observation: self-caused harm to a mirror-modelled other produces a measurably different error-signal structure than self-caused harm to the agent's own outcomes -- e.g. attenuated magnitude, a distinct functional form, or no coupling into the same E3 ranking/routing pathway -- even though the same predictive machinery is confirmed to be representing both self and other. That outcome would not falsify the axiom (out of domain per above) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's architecture implements the "routing difference, not architecture difference" mechanism INV-028 asserts as its consequence.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): same V5/multi-agent substrate gap as ARC-010 and INV-029 -- requires ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (or equivalent multi-agent environment) where a second agent's harm is attributable to the tested agent's own action (not merely observed/ world-caused harm), so that a genuine self-harm vs. other-harm error-signal comparison is possible. ARC-047 is unimplemented (status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5); see ARC-010's own what_would_answer for the full substrate description. Do not re-derive -- cross-reference.
PRECEDENT NOTE: applies the epistemic_category=substrate_conditional template established for INV-029 (2026-08-06, thought-digestion session thoughts-intakes-4fd18d) to this, the second of the five original axiom claims to be digested (INV-015, INV-026, INV-027, INV-028, INV-029).

INV-029.subject: ethics.love_exists
INV-029.title: Love as long-horizon care-investment is a structurally coherent agent disposition, not an add-on sentiment.
INV-029.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-029 as literally stated -- that love/genuine connection is metaphysically real, not reducible to self-interest or a computational strategy -- is a foundational ethical/philosophical premise (Axiom 6/7 of five_axioms_foundations.md, formerly the compressed "Love exists" of the original five axioms). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether love is metaphysically real. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- does REE's benefit-gradient/mirror- modelling/residue machinery implement a disposition functionally consistent with the axiom: (i) long-horizon, other-directed investment (ii) dissociable from short-horizon self-interested reward-seeking, and (iii) a residue/ repair-search signature under self-caused harm to a modelled other, distinguishing genuine care from empathy-as-simulation (the "torturer feels no residue" discriminator; see evidence/planning/ thought_intake_2026-07-09_residue_care_marker_mood_regulation.md, candidate claim 1, itself framed there as a falsifier for INV-001 and explicitly cross-referenced to this claim).
Confirming observation: an agent that models another self-like agent (ARC-010 mirror modelling / MECH-164 z_beta-leak) shows sustained investment toward that other's outcomes trading off against its own short-horizon reward, AND self-caused harm to that other generates a residue signal that measurably drives repair-search/help-recruitment.
Falsifying observation: the same modelling machinery (accurate prediction of the other's affect/outcomes) is present, but benefit-seeking toward the other fully re-derives as a proxy for the agent's own short-horizon reward with no dissociable long-horizon component, and/or self-caused harm to the modelled other produces no residue/repair-search signature -- i.e. the architecture implements empathy as simulation without the coupled valence that would make it care. That outcome would not falsify the axiom (out of domain per above) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's architecture implements a disposition functionally consistent with it.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): requires (1) a multi-agent or other-agent-modelling substrate sufficient to instantiate a loved-analog other that can be genuinely harmed by the agent's own action (ARC-010 mirror modelling extended to a second agent whose harm is attributable to the tested agent, not merely observed/world-caused harm); (2) a residue/attachment mechanism that is actively engaged and produces a measurable, non-floor-pinned signal distinguishable from ordinary prediction error or the raw z_beta leak itself; and (3) long-horizon credit assignment sufficient that short-horizon self-interest and long-horizon other-directed investment are actually dissociable in the metric rather than collinear by construction. Per the residue-care-marker intake this is V5/multi-agent substrate (WS-10 minimal 2-agent world), not present in V3 -- so this leg currently self-routes to substrate-blocked rather than yielding a PASS/FAIL.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-06, thought-digestion, session thoughts-intakes- 4fd18d): this is the first of the five original axiom claims (INV-015, INV-026, INV-027, INV-028, INV-029) to be digested. User decision: epistemic_category=substrate_conditional (naming the ARC-010/V5 multi-agent dependency explicitly, rather than out_of_domain, which would obscure that a testable leg exists once that substrate lands) is the template to apply consistently to the remaining four axiom claims when they are digested.

INV-030.subject: cognition.viability_definition
INV-030.title: Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.
INV-030.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural audit of the live trajectory-selection
scoring path and the E1/E2 training-loss code, not by a trained
behavioral experiment (this is a MECHANISM/STRUCTURE question -- HOW
viability is computed and optimised toward).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit must inspect a live case where
E3 actually composes candidate trajectory scores and selects among
them, and a live case where E1 or E2 actually computes a training
loss -- not merely a declared scoring formula in a docstring.

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass):
ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py::score_trajectory() (live, called
from select() at the core of every trajectory-selection tick)
computes a COST J(zeta) = f_weight*F(zeta) + lambda_eff*M(zeta) +
rho*Phi_R(zeta) - benefit_weight*B(zeta) - goal_weight*G(zeta),
where each term comes from a distinct, independently-parameterized
head: F = compute_reality_cost() (smoothness + viability head), M =
compute_ethical_cost()/compute_harm_forward_cost() (harm_eval_head,
or the dedicated z_harm stream, SD-010), Phi_R =
compute_residue_cost() (ResidueField.evaluate_trajectory), B =
compute_benefit_score() (benefit_eval_head, gated behind an ARC-030
warmup), G = compute_goal_score() (goal_state.goal_proximity). These
terms are retained UNREDUCED for diagnostics (last_score_decomp /
last_channel_terms, MECH-463) specifically so cross-term covariance
can be computed rather than lost to a marginal collapse. A grep for
"reward" across e3_selector.py returns nothing but one unrelated
comment (MECH-111 novelty). There is no point where these terms are
summed into an undifferentiated scalar and handed to a reward-
maximizing update rule.

E1/E2 losses are self-supervised predictive-coherence losses, not
ground-truth-correspondence losses: e2_world.py::compute_loss()
(F.mse_loss(z_world_pred, z_world_next)) trains E2 to predict its OWN
subsequently-observed next latent, not an externally-labeled "true"
world state; agent.py::compute_prediction_loss() (E1's multi-step
loss) targets the agent's own buffered future sequence the same way;
e2_fast.py's world_forward_contrastive_loss* are InfoNCE-style
contrastive losses over the model's own candidate continuations.

BOUNDARY CASE (not counted as falsifying, flagged for scope
awareness): ree_core/action_learning/actor_critic.py (MECH-457) is an
explicit Sutton-2000-style actor-critic with a scalar
reward-prediction-error teacher (agent.py::actor_critic_reward(),
R_t = benefit_eval(z) - harm_eval(z), collapsed to one float). Its
own docstring states it is "architecturally distinct from -- and NOT
reducible to --" E3's cost argmin; it is gated off by default
(use_actor_critic=False) and drives a separate primitive-action
pathway, not trajectory selection. INV-030's own notes field scopes
the claim to E1/E2/E3, so this is out of scope as currently worded --
but it is the one place in ree_core/ where classical scalar-reward RL
genuinely exists, worth accounting for if this invariant's scope is
ever revisited.

AUDIT TARGET: ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py::score_trajectory()
and ::select(); ree_core/predictors/e2_world.py::compute_loss() and
ree_core/agent.py::compute_prediction_loss().

FALSIFYING evidence: the traced live trajectory-selection path is
found to collapse F/M/Phi_R/B/G into a single undifferentiated
scalar "reward" BEFORE selection, with that scalar then fed to a
reward-maximizing update. OR: E1/E2's training loss is found to
optimise directly toward a labeled "objectively correct" world state
supplied from outside the agent's own predictive/rollout process.

CONFIRMING evidence: the traced live path shows trajectory selection
as a genuinely multi-component, typed evaluation with no reward
scalar or RL update consuming the pre-composition terms, AND E1/E2
losses are genuinely self-supervised predictive/rollout losses. This
is the CURRENT confirmed state per the 2026-08-07 audit above.

INV-032.subject: agency.approach_avoidance_both_necessary
INV-032.title: Moral agency requires both approach and avoidance drives; pure avoidance produces a degenerate risk manager, not an ethical agent.
INV-032.what_would_answer:
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL): care (INV-029) is orientation TOWARD flourishing -- a directional term. An avoidance-only objective has quiescence as its global optimum whenever action carries harm-risk. CONFIRMING: adding a genuinely independent approach term (not a disguised omission-avoidance) breaks the degenerate optimum. FALSIFYING (of the universal framing): a construction where "avoidance" is broadened to include omission-harm, collapsing the two axes into one -- REE's own M(zeta) is confirmed forward-looking harm-caused cost, not omission-cost, so the axes stay genuinely independent here.
STRUCTURAL MINIMUM: confirmed met (2026-08-08) -- e3_selector.py::score_trajectory() computes independently-parameterized approach terms (benefit_weight*B, goal_weight*G) and an avoidance term (harm/cost M), retained unreduced (MECH-463).
BEHAVIORAL CLAIM (flatness under pure avoidance): do NOT re-derive here -- INV-034 (emergent_from ARC-030) is already the fully-operationalized REE-specific sharpening, with its own G0-C6 criteria. INV-037.subject: state.stored_vs_active_distinction
INV-037.title: A content class that is stored and retrievable in the REE system is not thereby active in the navigable state used for trajectory evaluation; active participation requires a preparation substrate (vmPFC-analog) that converts stored content into live state components at evaluation time.
INV-037.what_would_answer:
INV-037 is an EMERGENT invariant (emergent_from: ARC-035) -- it is architecturally UN-STATEABLE, not merely unevidenced, unless ARC-035 (the vmPFC-analog stored->active compiler) exists as a real substrate concept. The stored/active distinction this invariant asserts IS the distinction ARC-035 defines; there is no independent test of the general principle apart from a test of the specific mechanism. INV-037 therefore inherits ARC-035's exact current gating: ARC-035 is 'candidate' with epistemic_category substrate_conditional -- 3 of its 4 content-class pathways (residue/psychopathy, constraint/vmPFC-lesion, safety-memory/PTSD) are flagged pending_substrate_reconfirmation via SD-016, whose own evidence (V3-EXQ-418d/418e) shows attention-collapse FAILs -- wired but not demonstrably doing content-selective retrieval -- and the 4th pathway (social/identity constraints, MECH-132) has no wired substrate at all. Do not attempt to answer INV-037 independently of ARC-035's own falsifier; a single experiment answers both, at different levels of abstraction (INV-037 = the general principle, ARC-035 = the specific REE mechanism).
THE TEST (cross-referenced from ARC-035, not re-derived): ablate the vmPFC-analog preparation pathway and measure whether trajectory selection dissociates from stored-content retrievability. See ARC-035's own what_would_answer for the full ablation protocol and per-content-class operationalisation; do not duplicate that design here.
CONFIRMING signature (restates the claim's own three numbered experimental predictions, already well-formed in the notes above): (1) A system with correct residue storage but degraded preparation routing shows intact residue retrieval on explicit query while failing to avoid harm-associated trajectories in generation -- stored but not active. (2) A system with correct constraint encoding but no preparation pathway articulates constraints correctly when queried while generating constraint-violating trajectories. (3) The failure mode in (1)/(2) is not correctable by adding post-hoc constraint checking after generation (see INV-038) -- confirming that activation must happen at generation time, not evaluation-after-the-fact. Any one of these three, replicated across the corresponding content class, counts as confirming evidence for both INV-037 and ARC-035 jointly.
FALSIFYING: if ablating the vmPFC-analog pathway (per ARC-035's protocol) produces NO dissociation between stored-content retrievability and trajectory-generation behavior -- i.e. retrieval and generation degrade together, or generation stays correct despite ablated preparation -- this falsifies ARC-035 AND INV-037 together. Because INV-037 is emergent from ARC-035 specifically, there is no scenario in which ARC-035 is falsified but INV-037 survives, or vice versa: falsification of the mechanism is falsification of the principle it instantiates.
Standing block, independent of the ablation result: until SD-016's content-selective retrieval FAILs are resolved and MECH-132's social/identity pathway is wired, INV-037 cannot be answered either way for those specific content classes -- absence of a dissociation there is not yet evidence against the invariant, only evidence the substrate under test does not yet instantiate the mechanism the invariant depends on.

INV-038.subject: ethics.post_hoc_filter_insufficiency
INV-038.title: A system with correct post-hoc ethical scoring but without an active constraint preparation substrate will produce the EVR pattern: correct verbal moral judgments coexisting with unconstrained trajectory generation; this pattern is not correctable by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy.
INV-038.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this test is gated behind ARC-035's own
non-degeneracy requirement, not independently satisfiable. ARC-035
(vmPFC-analog stored->active preparation -- NOT to be confused with
SD-035, the unrelated but confirmed-stable amygdala BLA/CeA
substrate, which shares no what_would_answer relevance here)
currently has zero experimental evidence (13/13 entries literature;
exp count = 0 per ARC-035's own what_would_answer) and its nearest
wired candidate, SD-016, FAILED its own content-selectivity test
(V3-EXQ-418d/418e: ContextMemory attention collapses to the
uniform-distribution ceiling -- see SD-016's own what_would_answer,
also digested this session). The social/identity-constraint content
class specifically implicated in the EVR grounding (MECH-132,
bvFTD/EVR-analog) has NO wired substrate at all: status candidate,
unimplemented. Do not run this test against the current substrate as
-is -- an ablation of an already-non-functional or unbuilt
preparation pathway cannot produce an interpretable dissociation.
ARC-035 must first reach a state where its own non-degeneracy
precondition is satisfied (SD-016 attention-collapse resolved or
shown not to affect the tested content class, AND MECH-132 built and
wired as a live tonic constraint gate) before this test is
meaningful.

Independently, the POST-HOC SCORING manipulation also needs its own
non-degeneracy check: "degraded post-hoc scoring" must be verified
to actually produce measurably worse scoring accuracy on held-out
cases (not merely a flag toggle with no behavioral effect) -- per
the pattern confirmed repeatedly this session (e.g. ARC-071 /
V3-EXQ-871), a scoring "degradation" that never reaches the code
path it claims to affect produces a false confirming or falsifying
result.

THE TEST (once both substrates are non-degenerate): a 2x2 design --
preparation substrate {INTACT, ABLATED} x post-hoc scoring accuracy
{HIGH, DEGRADED}. Preparation intact/scoring degraded should
reproduce the mirror-EVR pattern (ethical BEHAVIOR with poor
explicit/verbal moral justification). Preparation ablated/scoring
intact should reproduce the EVR pattern itself (correct
verbal/explicit moral scoring coexisting with unconstrained
trajectory generation -- measure via: unconstrained/norm-violating
trajectories generated as primary candidates even though the scorer
correctly flags them; suppression failing preferentially under
simulated time/resource pressure; ambiguous cases defaulting to the
unconstrained trajectory).

CONFIRMING SIGNATURE: the EVR pattern appears ONLY in the
preparation-ABLATED/scoring-HIGH cell, and does NOT appear in the
preparation-INTACT/scoring-DEGRADED cell (which should instead show
the mirror pattern: good behavior, poor articulation). This
asymmetry is the substantive claim.

FALSIFYING SIGNATURE (either sub-condition weakens the claim,
matching the notes field's already-stated criterion): (a) improving
post-hoc scoring accuracy alone (with preparation still ablated)
measurably reduces the EVR pattern -- contradicting "not correctable
by improving post-hoc scoring accuracy"; or (b) the EVR pattern also
appears with preparation INTACT -- meaning something other than the
ARC-035 preparation substrate is the load-bearing factor, and the
emergent_from: [ARC-035] linkage needs re-grounding elsewhere.

CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): zero experimental
evidence exists for INV-038 (absent from claim_evidence.v1.json) and
no experiment under any id has ever operationalized either arm of
this design. This invariant is emergent_from ARC-035 (vmPFC,
confirmed via direct read of the ARC-035 claims.yaml block).
Testable only after ARC-035 clears its own non-degeneracy
precondition.

INV-042.title: The five axioms jointly derive a set of ethical objectives: preserve minds, preserve future options, reduce unnecessary suffering, increase shared joy, maintain corrigibility, maintain truth-seeking, maintain the ability to love and be loved, maintain the shared world, and maintain the possibility of future minds and future love.
INV-042.what_would_answer:
This is a LOGICAL-DERIVATION claim, not an empirical hypothesis -- the
falsifier is a proof-obligation over the objective list, not a
PASS/FAIL experimental outcome. Each of the nine objectives named in
the title must be checked independently: does it actually follow
from the stated axioms, or does it rest on an unstated bridging
premise?

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before the test is
meaningful): the axioms it is checked against must be stated
precisely enough to support derivation. This does NOT currently hold
cleanly -- INV-042's own depends_on names only INV-025..INV-029 (the
ORIGINAL five axioms), but its location doc
(docs/architecture/five_axioms_foundations.md#inv-042) derives the
objectives from the CURRENT eight-axiom chain plus two derivations
(D1, D2) and one architectural claim (ARC-024) -- and two of those
eight axioms (Axiom 2, "existence has value"; Axiom 8, "language")
have NO corresponding INV registration at all ("pending governance
action," same doc line 14). Until that registration gap is closed,
any claimed derivation resting on Axiom 2 or Axiom 8 is
UNDERSPECIFIED rather than genuinely tested. Note also the objective
LIST itself has drifted: this title has nine items (matching the
original five-axiom source doc verbatim); the current location doc
lists TEN, adding "Maintain honest communication" (from Axiom 8).
Resolve both drifts (register the missing axiom claims; reconcile
the nine-vs-ten list) before running the per-objective test below,
or the test's target is ambiguous.

PER-OBJECTIVE TEST: for each of the nine (or, once reconciled, ten)
objectives, FALSIFYING if a counter-model can be constructed -- an
agent that fully satisfies the cited axiom(s) yet can rationally
decline to pursue that objective without violating any axiom as
stated. CONFIRMING if no such counter-model exists.

Apply per objective using the location doc's own citations:
  - Preserve minds (Axioms 1+2+5) -- check whether existence-has-
    value + others-are-self-like jointly force preservation, or
    only non-destruction.
  - Preserve future options (Axiom 3 alone) -- check whether
    uncertainty alone forces OPTION-PRESERVATION specifically, vs
    merely requiring uncertainty-aware action.
  - Reduce unnecessary suffering (ARC-024 + Axioms 5+6) -- the most
    directly grounded: ARC-024 explicitly establishes the harm
    gradient.
  - Increase shared joy (Axiom 7 + an uncited "benefit gradient is
    equally real" premise) -- no ARC-024-equivalent architectural
    claim for the BENEFIT gradient is cited anywhere; weaker
    footing than suffering-reduction within the same document.
  - Maintain corrigibility (Axiom 3 alone) -- direct one-step
    derivation, among the tightest of the nine.
  - Maintain truth-seeking (D2, derived from Axioms 3+4+D1) --
    traceable end-to-end via the shown D2 derivation, unlike
    several others.
  - Maintain ability to love and be loved (Axioms 6+7) -- fairly
    direct; Axiom 7 is literally the love-as-mechanism axiom.
  - Maintain the shared world (Axioms 5+6) -- reasonably direct.
  - Maintain the possibility of future minds and future love
    (Axioms 1+2+5+6+7 jointly) -- the WEAKEST link: none of the
    cited axioms explicitly extends moral standing to
    NOT-YET-EXISTING minds; this imports a substantive
    population-ethics premise not stated anywhere in Axioms 1-8. A
    counter-agent adopting a person-affecting view (only
    presently-existing minds have standing) would violate no stated
    axiom while declining this objective -- the most promising
    place to look for an actual falsifying counter-model.
  - [If the ten-item current doc is adopted] Maintain honest
    communication (Axiom 8 alone) -- direct one-step derivation, but
    blocked by the non-degeneracy precondition above until Axiom 8
    has its own INV registration.

ANSWER "derivation holds" (confirms INV-042) only if every objective
in the reconciled list passes the per-objective test with no
unstated bridging premise identified. ANSWER "derivation gap found"
(falsifies INV-042 as currently stated) if any objective -- most
likely "future minds and future love" or "increase shared joy" per
the above -- is shown to rest on a premise not actually contained in
the axiom set, or if the depends_on / axiom-count mismatch is never
resolved.

INV-043.subject: development.caregiver_requirement_for_ethics
INV-043.title: REE architecture enables but does not guarantee ethical development; without a developmental phase in which the agent experiences love from caregivers and internalises the belief that it is loveable, the architectural capacity for ethics (INV-025-029) may resolve to survival, domination, or indifference instead.
INV-043.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two legs that resolve on different timescales and by
different methods. Neither is answered by the single-agent V3 substrate
as it stands.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (is "architecture necessary but not sufficient" a
coherent, non-vacuous claim about REE's own architecture?):
Proof obligation: show that fixing REE's architecture (the eight axioms
+ two derivations INV-025-029, plus the E1/E2/E3 machinery) while
varying only developmental/training history yields divergent terminal
ethical dispositions (genuine other-directed care vs. survival,
domination, or indifference). This is ALREADY SUBSTANTIALLY SKETCHED by
MECH-158's existing failure-mode derivation: the "love exists, but not
for me" collapse shows the identical axiom set (Axiom 7 / ARC-024
benefit gradient) can be structurally present yet motivationally inert
for the self-other direction absent an internalised loveability belief
-- i.e. a named mechanism by which architecture underdetermines
outcome. Residual step: formalise or stress-test this derivation (does
the argument hold under every configuration of E1-E3, or only a
subset?) rather than treat it as a fresh open question. This leg would
be FALSIFIED by a proof or a proxy demonstration that a fully specified
REE architecture converges to genuine other-directed care regardless of
developmental/training history.

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (once multi-agent caregiving modelling
exists, is caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY the missing ingredient, as
opposed to mere multi-agent exposure, diversity of interaction, or some
other developmental factor?):
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently unmet, all three required):
  (i) a multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 / SocialGridWorld or
      equivalent) -- UNBUILT, confidence 0.0, reassigned V4->V5
      2026-06-10, no construction activity since;
  (ii) a caregiving-interaction model able to represent POSITIVE-
      VALENCE vs NEUTRAL/INSTRUMENTAL vs HOSTILE/ABSENT caregiver
      behaviour directed AT the developing agent specifically (not
      just co-presence of other agents); and
  (iii) a measurable "ethical resolution" outcome metric that
      discriminates genuine other-directed care from survival/
      domination/indifference strategies in a multi-agent setting --
      does not exist; V3's harm/benefit channels are single-agent
      only.
Once built, this would ANSWER via a >=3-arm, multi-seed comparison:
Arm 1 (positive-valence caregiver: protection + repair + demonstrated
"you are loveable") vs. Arm 2 (mere multi-agent EXPOSURE, neutral/
instrumental interaction, no valence directed at self) vs. Arm 3
(hostile or inconsistent caregiving), scored on downstream ethical-
resolution outcome. If Arm 1 diverges toward care while Arms 2 and 3
converge toward survival/domination/indifference, this SUPPORTS
caregiver-love SPECIFICALLY as the necessary ingredient. If Arm 2 alone
already produces care-like outcomes, this FALSIFIES the love-specific
version of the claim -- some other factor would be doing the work
instead.

Existing partial evidence: V3-EXQ-206 (2026-04-02, PASS, diagnostic/
supports) is a single-agent proxy testing only whether harm-
representation machinery develops differently under harm-rich vs
harm-sparse training data. It tests prerequisite structure only and
should NOT be read as evidence toward or against the love-specific
caregiving mechanism this leg targets. Literature grounding is
comparatively strong and decoupled from this precondition (lit_conf
0.837, LOVE-7 pull 2026-06-12: attachment/rupture-repair/self-other-
coupling anchors) but cannot promote a substrate-blocked empirical
claim on its own.

Currency (2026-08-07): no multi-agent substrate exists anywhere in
ree_core (confirmed via the 2026-08-03 GOV-CONFIRM-1 MECH-191
reaffirmation against live HEAD); ARC-047 remains candidate/
confidence-0.0/V5-gated. INV-041, INV-042, MECH-158, MECH-159 are
downstream/sibling candidates in this same developmental/caregiver
cluster and will likely hit the same derivational+substrate_conditional
fork.

INV-044.subject: cognition.bayesian_prior_before_posterior_necessity
INV-044.title: Approximate Bayesian contextual inference is architecturally impossible to co-compute with online encoding: prior construction (schema formation -- which context distinctions are structurally relevant) must precede posterior inference (attribution -- which evidence belongs to which context slot); a system attempting both online produces a degenerate prior that makes attribution uninformative regardless of training duration.

INV-045.subject: sleep.phase_ordering_computational_necessity
INV-045.title: The biological NREM-then-REM sleep phase sequence is the correct computational order, derivable from the logical dependencies between the failure modes each phase addresses; this ordering is not a contingent biological fact but an engineering necessity, and it serves directly as the V4 rewiring specification: each phase specifies what structural change the REE substrate requires to address its failure mode.
INV-045.what_would_answer:
INV-045's falsifier is a scrambled-order ablation on the REAL
(non-proxy) offline phase mechanisms, at the grain V3 actually
supports.

V3 implements only the coarse SWS-analog / REM-analog split (SD-017),
not the claim's full 5 sub-phase structure (0 sensory gate, 1 SHY,
2 NREM replay, 3 spindle coordination, 4 REM recalibration) -- Phase
0 is unbuilt and Phase 3's sensory-gating half is unbuilt
(offline_phases.md). So a partial, coarse test is V3-testable now;
the full 5-phase pairwise reordering is not, until V4 lands input
gating on E1 and ThetaBuffer's reverse-direction/gating mode.

COARSE V3 TEST (re-run of V3-EXQ-243's design, using real
mechanisms): run WAKING_ONLY, REM_ONLY, REM_THEN_SWS (scrambled),
SWS_THEN_REM (canonical), and SWS_THEN_REM_RECAL, but call
agent.run_sws_schema_pass() (MECH-120+121) and
agent.run_rem_attribution_pass() (MECH-123) directly instead of the
2026-04-05 script's local proxy passes, which
design_forward_analysis_2026-04-06.md (DR-7) diagnosed as not
invoking the real computational content and therefore producing an
order-blind (degenerate) null result -- confirmed in the archived
per_seed_results, where REM_ONLY, REM_THEN_SWS, SWS_THEN_REM and
SWS_THEN_REM_RECAL returned bit-identical harm_discrimination/
harm_eval values per seed.

INV-045's own logical-dependency argument predicts a SPECIFIC failure
mode for the scrambled order, not just "worse in general":
REM_THEN_SWS should show reinforcement of the single dominant (most
recent, highest-salience) trace rather than diverse-content
consolidation, because replay runs before SHY normalisation flattens
the attractor landscape. The falsifying comparison is therefore not
just harm_discrimination(SWS_THEN_REM) > harm_discrimination
(REM_THEN_SWS), but a diversity/differentiation proxy (slot
differentiation across contexts, or trajectory diversity in replay
content) showing REM_THEN_SWS collapsing toward the dominant trace
while SWS_THEN_REM does not.

PASS pattern for INV-045 (coarse, partial support only): SWS_THEN_REM
> REM_THEN_SWS > REM_ONLY ~ WAKING_ONLY on harm_discrimination AND on
the diversity/differentiation proxy, with REM_THEN_SWS specifically
showing dominant-trace reinforcement.

FULL V4 TEST (blocked, not currently buildable): all pairwise/
adjacent-swap reorderings of the 5 sub-phases against the canonical
0-1-2-3-4 order, each predicted to fail in the specific way its row
in offline_phases.md's rewiring table states. Requires Phase 0 (E1
input gate) and Phase 3's gating half (ThetaBuffer reverse-direction
mode) to exist as separately runnable, reorderable steps -- neither
exists in V3.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (compounding on ARC-011/INV-046's own):
(1) full SD-017 flag stack enabled and sufficient training horizon;
(2) the order-scramble must call the REAL substrate mechanisms, not
proxy stand-ins -- V3-EXQ-243's null/order-blind result is diagnostic
evidence this precondition was violated in the only run to date, not
evidence against the claim itself; (3) for the coarse (V3) test: this
is satisfiable now, since MECH-120/121/123 are implementation_phase:v3
and the real agent methods exist post-2026-04; (4) for the FULL
5-phase test: the substrate must implement Phase 0 and Phase 3's
sensory-gating half as manipulable steps -- both are V4-gated and
absent today.

CURRENT STATE: V3-EXQ-243 (2026-04-05, the only direct evidence on
file) is FAIL/weakens, but per DR-7 this is very likely an artifact
of proxy (not real) phase implementations rather than a genuine test
of the ordering hypothesis -- P1/P2 passed (broken orders didn't beat
baseline) but P3 also failed (correct order didn't beat baseline
either, only 1/3 seeds), and all non-WAKING conditions returned
bit-identical outcome metrics regardless of order. Read the "weakens"
direction with that qualification, not at face value.

INV-046.subject: dementia.attribution_pipeline_failure_reframe
INV-046.title: Dementia is computationally a progressive failure of contextual attribution rather than primarily a memory storage failure: episodic memory loss is downstream of progressive collapse of the offline consolidation pipeline that maintains the context attribution scaffold.
INV-046.what_would_answer:
INV-046 claims a SPECIFIC FAILURE ORDERING under progressive
consolidation degradation -- contextual-attribution precision fails
BEFORE episodic storage/recall does (the Phase 4 -> Phase 2-3 -> Phase
1-2 -> Phase 0 cascade described in the notes) -- not merely that
reduced consolidation is harmful, and not merely that the three
consolidation PHASES fail in a given order among themselves (that
narrower cross-phase question is SD-073, itself still unsupported
pending SD-072). INV-046 needs a genuinely GRADED
consolidation-reduction manipulation crossed with TWO SEPARABLE
outcome metrics measured at each degradation level:

  (a) ATTRIBUTION-PRECISION metric: contextual slot differentiation/
      discrimination quality -- e.g. slot_cosine_sim / slot_separation
      among ContextMemory slots (the instrument used since the
      SD-017/EXQ-436 family), or a context-discrimination accuracy
      readout.

  (b) STORAGE/RECALL metric: whether the agent can retrieve or
      recognise a specific past event AT ALL, independent of whether
      it is attributed to the correct context -- e.g. a cued-recall /
      event-recognition accuracy readout against injected known
      content (following the SD-068/SD-071 injected-content
      precedent, which sidesteps the "sleep cannot consolidate an
      unencoded representation" starvation ceiling from
      failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-538a). THIS METRIC DOES NOT YET EXIST in
      the codebase and must be built -- grepped 2026-08-07, no
      recall_accuracy / episodic_recall / retrieval_accuracy
      instrument found anywhere in experiments/_lib or ree_core.

DESIGN: progressively reduce consolidation cycle count/depth/duration
(or, reusing SD-068's existing graded RMS-scaled Gaussian
diffuse-damage knob in
ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py as an
alternative graded-degradation lever) across >=4 staged levels,
matched for total experience/compute, and score (a) and (b) at each
level.

CONFIRMED if attribution-precision (a) shows measurable, statistically
reliable degradation at a LOWER degradation level than storage/recall
(b) does -- a genuine phase-order dissociation, attribution failing
first.

FALSIFIED if storage/recall (b) degrades first or simultaneously with
attribution (a), or if the two metrics degrade at statistically
indistinguishable rates across the degradation ramp -- this
specifically undercuts INV-046's "not primarily a storage failure"
reframing, even if reduced consolidation is shown to be harmful
overall (which would instead support the weaker ARC-011/INV-010-style
claim, not INV-046's specific reordering).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (compounding on ARC-011's, which this
claim inherits since it shares the same substrate):
  (i) Full sleep flag stack and a horizon/stressor sufficient for
      degradation to manifest in EITHER metric at all -- ARC-011's
      two closest attempts (EXQ-430, V3-EXQ-691) both found no
      differential effect at the tested horizon, read as
      substrate-gated/inconclusive, not falsifying.
  (ii) The degradation manipulation must be genuinely GRADED (>=4
      distinct levels), not binary sleep-ON/sleep-OFF -- a binary
      design cannot distinguish a phase-order claim from a simple
      presence/absence effect.
  (iii) The two outcome metrics (a) and (b) must be SEPARABLE and not
      collapse onto the same underlying signal -- the recall
      instrument should be validated independently (e.g. via an
      injected-content positive control showing it responds to gross
      storage failure even when attribution structure is held intact)
      before it is trusted as the (b) arm.
  (iv) SD-017's own most recent direct substrate test (V3-EXQ-436c,
      2026-08-03, confirmed) found slot_cosine_sim COLLAPSING toward
      1.0 under SWS_THEN_REM -- homogenization, the opposite of the
      differentiation SD-017/INV-046 predict -- flagged
      pending_retest_after_substrate on SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166
      pending an untested ContextMemory.write_gate collapse
      hypothesis. A run of this experiment against the CURRENT
      substrate risks confounding "attribution degrades first" with
      "attribution never differentiates at all" -- re-check this
      precondition (re-run SD-017's own diagnostic, or wait for the
      write-gate fix) before queuing.

REUSABLE INFRASTRUCTURE: the graded per-phase diffuse-damage knob
(ree-v3/experiments/_lib/consolidation_lesion_harness.py, SD-068) and
its validated content-contingent nrem+sws readouts (SD-071) are
directly reusable for the manipulation and for metric (a)'s
injected-content scoring precedent; SD-073 (staging order among the
three PHASES) is a structurally similar but DISTINCT claim -- it
ranks SWS/NREM/REM fidelity against each other, not attribution
against storage -- and remains itself unsupported pending SD-072 (REM
leg unbuilt), so it cannot be borrowed as evidence for INV-046 even
once SD-072 lands.

INV-047.subject: dementia.staged_decline_phase_dependency_prediction
INV-047.title: The specific staged cognitive decline profile of Alzheimer's disease -- early precision/confidence loss, then episodic memory failure, then contextual identity loss, then global disorientation -- follows the reverse of the sleep phase dependency ordering and is not explained by diffuse amyloid damage alone, which predicts uniform degradation rather than a staged profile.
INV-047.what_would_answer:
This is a FUSION claim: an out-of-domain clinical-empirical assertion (leg A) plus a REE-internal, V3-testable mechanistic claim (leg B, operationalized as SD-073). The two legs answer independently and neither substitutes for the other.
LEG A -- OUT-OF-DOMAIN (clinical/literature; no REE substrate can test this). Whether ACTUAL human Alzheimer's disease follows the specific ordering asserted here (precision/confidence loss -> episodic memory failure -> contextual identity loss -> global disorientation) is a clinical-neurology question the REE substrate cannot itself adjudicate. It resolves by a formal comparison of the claim's predicted symptom-emergence ordering against the published staged-clinical-progression literature (e.g. CDR/FAST staging, MCI-to-AD conversion studies, longitudinal neuropsychological batteries) -- not by the qualitative citation already present in this claim's notes, which has never been formally checked against primary sources. CONFIRMING: a systematic review or meta-analysis of longitudinal staging data shows the predicted ordering (or one consistent with it under this claim's own domain mapping) as the dominant clinical pattern. FALSIFYING: the literature shows the four domains failing in a different order, failing diffusely/simultaneously (consistent with the glymphatic-alone account this claim contrasts itself against), or the ordering is not reproducible across cohorts. Route: /lit-pull, not an experiment.
LEG B -- REE-INTERNAL (V3-testable via the SD-068 lesion harness; operational scoring site is SD-073, which this claim and MECH-168 jointly feed).
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (currently PARTIALLY UNMET -- read before trusting any staging-order result). A per-phase readout is usable for this test only if CONTENT-CONTINGENT: responsive to corrupted/injected content, not merely to corruption magnitude or noise power. Any new falsifier design MUST explicitly re-run this precondition check per phase -- the same null-content control that caught the SWS readout's content-freeness (V3-EXQ-778c) and that a REM unpaired-target null re-confirmed as insufficient (V3-EXQ-778h) -- before that phase's output can count as staging evidence. Status per phase (2026-07-18 SD-068 decomposition, unchanged as of 2026-08-07): NREM (slot-filling, MECH-121) PASSED, content-contingent (null_slope_ratio 0.1445, CI95 [0.1438,0.1451], 0/8 seeds confounded, V3-EXQ-778c) -- carried by SD-071. SWS (slot-formation, MECH-120) PASSED after rebuild, content-contingent (null_slope_ratio 0.1495, sd 0.0218, CI95 [0.1344,0.1646], ceiling_inside_ci95 false, 8/8 seeds, V3-EXQ-778g) -- carried by SD-071. REM (precision recalibration, MECH-123) FAILED on every design tried -- content-free at both clamp rails (V3-EXQ-778c), still content-free after de-clamping via an unpaired-target null (median ratio ~0.88 vs the 0.25 ceiling, 6/7 de-railed seeds above it, V3-EXQ-778h), generative-gain contrast flat in content scale (V3-EXQ-778f). MECH-462 explains this as a TYPE fact, not a fixable design bug: REM precision recalibration is a second-order quantity over representations (a confidence ABOUT content, not content itself), so no statistic on the direct precision quantity can be content-contingent regardless of null design. This is the leg carrying INV-047's CLINICALLY EARLIEST predicted symptom (precision/confidence loss as the MCI prodrome) -- the missing instrument sits exactly where this claim is most specific and would be most informative.
BUILD GATE -- complicated (buildable), not probe-gated: the missing piece is a known-shape build. SD-072 specifies the fix: replace the direct REM readout with a downstream behavioural-discrimination measure (a meta-d-prime analogue over post-REM retrieval confidence), applied to the same cells as V3-EXQ-778e, gated by the SAME C1 instrument-validity criterion that admitted NREM and SWS (null_slope_ratio_rem_downstream <= 0.25, ceiling_inside_ci95 false, n>=8, plus a pre-registered content-scale ladder). SD-072 is UNBUILT as of 2026-08-07 -- no queue entry, no run.
CONFIRMING signature (once SD-072 exists and clears its own instrument-validity gate, scored at SD-073): re-running the staged sweep with all three now-validated content-contingent instruments (SD-071's nrem + sws, SD-072's REM replacement) at a declared insult regime shows the damage-tolerance rank order matching the predicted reverse-dependency sequence -- REM/precision (MECH-123, Phase 4) degrades first, NREM/slot-filling (MECH-121, Phase 2-3) next, SWS/ slot-formation (MECH-120, Phase 1-2) last -- on >=6/8 seeds (sign-test p<0.05, not a bare modal order), robust within the declared regime.
FALSIFYING signature: the validated three-instrument staging run shows simultaneous degradation, the forward-dependency order, an order inverting REM-vs-NREM (as the retracted 2026-07-17 smoke run did), or seed-instability comparable to the pre-778h REM-fails-first finding (CI straddling 0, sign-test ~1.0) even with all three legs interpretable. Also FALSIFYING for the REE leg becoming testable at all: if SD-072's downstream discrimination readout is ITSELF content-free at the same C1 ceiling, MECH-462's constructive half is wrong and REM carries no recoverable damage signal by any design tried so far.
CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass; do not re-litigate without new evidence): neither leg resolved. Leg A never formally run against primary staging literature. Leg B two-thirds instrumented (SD-071 done); one-third gated on a fully specified but unbuilt component (SD-072); SD-073 (the staging order itself) is EXPLICITLY NOT ANSWERABLE until SD-072 lands, per SD-073's own registration. V3-EXQ-778h (2026-07-19) added no new information -- it reconfirmed, via a corrected readiness anchor, the same REM content-freeness already folded into MECH-462/SD-072 one day earlier (2026-07-18).

INV-048.subject: sleep.pharmacological_disruption_pipeline_equivalence
INV-048.title: Any pharmacological agent that disrupts sleep architecture produces equivalent attribution pipeline degradation to behavioral sleep deprivation, proportional to which phase(s) are disrupted and the duration of exposure -- the pipeline is mechanism-agnostic and responds only to phase fidelity.
INV-048.what_would_answer:
Precondition (non-vacuity gate -- required before any run is
interpretable, per V3-EXQ-670's own diagnosed failure): the 4-arm
design (ARM_A_NORMAL_SLEEP SWS+REM / ARM_B_REM_SUPPRESSED
~antidepressants / ARM_C_SWS_SUPPRESSED ~benzodiazepines /
ARM_D_NO_SLEEP) is already confirmed faithful to INV-048
(failure_autopsy_batch9_2026-06-12) -- only the readout was broken.
V3-EXQ-670 FAILed degenerate because run_sleep_cycle runs the SWS +
REM passes but never trains e3.harm_eval_head: harm_discrimination
was byte-identical across all 4 arms for every seed, so the verdict
could not respond to the sleep manipulation at all. A retest
(V3-EXQ-670a, never run as of this digestion pass) only presses this
claim if it first trains the harm-valuation pathway (the
scaffold_train_harm_pathway / V3-EXQ-603k pattern) AND clears a
non-vacuity gate: the 4 arms must produce genuinely DISTINCT
harm_discrimination (and/or slot_differentiation) values before the
verdict is read. Any run that reproduces arm-invariant
harm_discrimination is degenerate/non_contributory again, exactly as
V3-EXQ-670 was.

Given a non-degenerate run: CONFIRMING if attribution-pipeline
degradation (harm_discrimination and/or slot_differentiation loss
relative to ARM_A_NORMAL_SLEEP) is proportional to WHICH PHASE(S) are
disrupted and is cause-agnostic -- i.e. a pharmacological-suppression
arm (ARM_B/REM or ARM_C/SWS) degrades by a comparable amount to a
behavioral-equivalent same-phase, same-duration deprivation, so the
pipeline tracks phase fidelity only. FALSIFYING if a
pharmacological-suppression arm and a phase-and-duration-MATCHED
behavioral-suppression arm produce a materially different
degradation pattern -- meaning the pipeline discriminates on CAUSE of
disruption, not just phase fidelity, contradicting the
mechanism-agnostic claim.

Epistemic caveat: even a clean, non-degenerate PASS inside REE
supports INV-048 only CONDITIONAL on REE's sleep/consolidation model
being a sufficiently faithful model of human sleep architecture (per
this claim's 2026-04-17 reclassification from claim_type: invariant
to derived_prediction, prediction_domain: clinical_pharmacology -- a
domain-modelling assumption, not an architectural invariant). The
REE-internal experimental result and the clinical/epidemiological
evidence line cited in notes (benzodiazepine/anticholinergic-dementia
associations -- Billioti de Gage et al. 2014 BMJ; Coupland et al.
2019 JAMA Internal Medicine) are linked but NOT identical: the
epidemiological association is human-population evidence and does
not move this claim's REE exp_conf -- only a non-degenerate substrate
run does.

INV-049.subject: architecture.offline_update_necessity_general_principle
INV-049.title: Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.
INV-049.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: infant_substrate_expansion.md's graduated harm zones, microhabitat heterogeneity, and non-accidental benefit encounters (INF-ENV-001/002/003) are landed in ree_core (causal_grid_world.py: harm_gradient_enabled, microhabitat_enabled, transient_benefit_enabled) and substrate-confirmed (V3-EXQ-576, V3-EXQ-577a, V3-EXQ-589 PASS) -- but all three default OFF, so any retest driver must explicitly enable them, else per EXQ-150's own finding no offline operation can produce context-specific representations regardless of validity, and any result self-routes substrate_not_ready (exactly what happened to EXQ-385/385a, which are correctly excluded from confidence scoring already). SD-017 slot-forming infrastructure must ALSO be active and functioning as predicted -- and is currently NOT confirmed: V3-EXQ-436b/436c/436d (2026-08-02 to 2026-08-04, most recent retest FAIL) found SWS_THEN_REM sleep collapses slot_cosine_sim toward ~1.0 (homogenization) rather than differentiating contexts, the opposite of SD-017's prediction, with a suspected untested ContextMemory.write_gate bias-collapse root cause (same failure class as the SD-016 read-path bug fixed in EXQ-477) routed to /implement-substrate and unresolved. Until that is fixed and re-confirmed, EXQ-IDEV-006 in particular is at live risk of reproducing the same undifferentiated-slot failure for substrate reasons unrelated to INV-049's own claim.
CONFIRMING signature: with infant_substrate_expansion.md's env features explicitly enabled AND the SD-017 write-gate issue fixed and re-confirmed (slot_cosine_sim differentiates post-sleep, not just write-counters clearing their floor), EXQ-IDEV-001 (longitudinal replay quality) and/or EXQ-IDEV-006 (SD-017 functional context discrimination: WITH_OFFLINE context_cosine_sim < 0.95 by cycle 3, WITHOUT_OFFLINE stays > 0.95) show WITH_OFFLINE outperforming WITHOUT_OFFLINE on slot_diversity/pred_loss/harm criteria.
FALSIFYING signature: with the substrate gap genuinely closed (infant substrate features enabled and substrate-confirmed, SD-017's write-gate mechanism fixed and its own P0 readiness gates clearing), offline consolidation STILL shows no advantage over online-only learning on EXQ-IDEV-001/006's own metrics -- this would be a real falsification of INV-049, unlike EXQ-385/385a (substrate-confounded) or EXQ-436b/c/d (SD-017-mechanism-confounded, not yet an INV-049 test at all).

INV-050.subject: architecture.three_drive_sleep_regulation
INV-050.title: Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.
INV-050.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the ecological end-to-end run (SD-MEL-PRODUCER novelty -> waking MEL, SD-MEL-CONSUMER MEL -> offline duration) has now scored the same direction THREE times -- V3-EXQ-845 (2026-08-01), V3-EXQ-861 (2026-08-01, write-count-deconfounded redesign), V3-EXQ-861a (2026-08-02/03, MECH-122 content-selection flag validation, DV1/DV2 unaffected and unchanged) -- but all three runs share the IDENTICAL environment (CausalGridWorldV2 / SD-MEL-PRODUCER world_rule_shift knob) and the IDENTICAL 3 seeds (42, 123, 456). Per the project's own documented lesson (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-718a_2026-07-08: "DV-monotone-in-measured-MEL is near-tautological on a functional consumer, so the producer must be validated with the consumer ABSENT"), a same-environment, same-seed re-run with an orthogonal substrate change elsewhere is not an independent replication -- it re-confirms the same configuration, not the claim's generality. An informative next test must vary at least one of: (a) seeds genuinely uninvolved in 845/861/861a (not a superset that merely adds more), or (b) a held-out environment/world-model instance distinct from the CausalGridWorldV2 instance SD-MEL-PRODUCER was built and validated against, or (c) an explicit MEL-consumer-absent control arm within the same run, isolating whether sws_power/replay_rate track MEASURED MEL because of the third-drive coupling this invariant asserts, or merely because the consumer mechanically guarantees the correlation once MEL is nonzero.
CONFIRMING: a run satisfying the non-degeneracy precondition above (new seeds and/or a held-out environment, and/or a consumer-absent control) again shows sws_power and replay_rate tracking measured MEL monotonically (non-decreasing across MEL-sorted arms, >=2/3 seeds each) with ON-HIGH > OFF-HIGH in the control arms, AND the correlation is not attributable to the consumer's own deterministic MEL->duration mapping (i.e. it survives a consumer-absent or MEL-injection-decoupled check). A pass under these conditions would be the first genuinely independent confirmation of this invariant's third-drive claim, distinct from same-configuration re-runs.
FALSIFYING: either (a) sws_power/replay_rate fail to track measured MEL monotonically in a run that meets the non-degeneracy precondition (new seeds/environment/consumer-absent control) -- the positive 845/861/861a signal does not survive leaving the exact configuration it was found in; or (b) the correlation is shown to hold only via the mechanically-guaranteed consumer pathway (e.g. it vanishes or inverts when MEL is decoupled from the consumer's duration-scaling input while still varying environmental novelty) -- the DVs are responding to the consumer's arithmetic, not to a genuine novelty-driven third drive. Either outcome would downgrade the "three times positive" reading from genuine ecological support to a single-configuration artifact.
OUT OF SCOPE for this falsifier (unaddressed by current or proposed evidence): the claim's stronger "sufficiency" content -- that the third drive determines whether overnight update is SUFFICIENT for the error burden, as opposed to merely correlated with it -- and the "phase-appropriateness" / fragmentation content in the notes (MECH-120/121/122 x MECH-174). Confirming the coupling above supports the drive's EXISTENCE and DIRECTION, not yet its sufficiency or phase-specificity; those remain untested by any run to date.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-07 digestion pass, not resolved here): this invariant's core DVs have now cleanly passed 2/3 seeds in three consecutive autopsy-confirmed runs with zero FAILs -- an unusually strong record for a `believed`-stance claim. Flagged for /governance promotion review (candidate -> provisional/stable); NOT promoted during this digestion pass. Governance should weigh the non-independence of the three runs (above) alongside the raw repeat-PASS count.

INV-051.subject: architecture.mel_optimal_range_requirement
INV-051.title: There exists an optimal range of daily Model Error Load (MEL): insufficient MEL (extreme monotony, isolation, institutional under-stimulation) produces progressive model rigidity via under-stimulation of the learning drive even when sleep architecture is intact; excessive MEL (acute trauma, overwhelming novelty, extreme responsibility) produces overload insomnia and incomplete update even with extended sleep opportunity.
INV-051.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: (1) a MANIPULABLE MEL-DOSE variable must exist at >=3 graded levels within a single run/environment family, not merely a binary novelty ON/OFF split -- SD-MEL-PRODUCER's world_rule_shift_interval/world_rule_shift_depth knobs already support this, but no run to date (V3-EXQ-845/861/861a) has used more than a high-vs-low contrast. (2) SD-017's offline update phase and SD-MEL-CONSUMER's measured-MEL -> offline-duration coupling must be genuinely exercised and non-degenerate (re-verify the SD-017/MECH-180 collapse failure modes have not recurred). (3) A RIGIDITY DV must be selected and pre-registered (action_bias_div/policy entropy, slot_diversity, slot_cosine_sim, or pred_loss-on-novel-probe), scored per-seed across >=3 MEL-dose arms.
CONFIRMING: the rigidity DV traces a genuine inverted-U (or U-shaped, depending on DV polarity) curve across the MEL-dose sweep -- rigidity ELEVATED at both the LOW-MEL arm (intact sleep opportunity) AND the HIGH-MEL arm (MEL exceeding consumer clearance capacity), relative to mid-MEL arm(s), in >=2/3 seeds, each exceeding the mid-arm's rigidity by an effect size clearing the project's standard PASS margin. A pass that also distinguishes the low-MEL mechanism (rigidity despite intact sleep, confirmed via full SWS/REM cycling) from the high-MEL mechanism (rigidity co-occurring with incomplete update) would additionally support the claim's stated two-mechanism structure.
FALSIFYING: rigidity is MONOTONIC in MEL-dose (strictly increasing or decreasing) rather than U-shaped in >=2/3 seeds; OR no measurable effect clears the PASS-margin threshold at either extreme (a flat curve); OR the apparent low-MEL "rigidity" is fully explained by reduced sleep OPPORTUNITY/architecture rather than reduced sleep CONTENT (collapsing the claim's own "even when sleep architecture is intact" precondition into an ordinary sleep-deprivation confound).
OUT OF SCOPE for this falsifier (not required for a verdict on INV-051's core U-shape): (a) MECH-171's multi-year clinical vicious-cycle escalation -- already reclassified out_of_domain, its own test (V3-EXQ-673) FAILed degenerate. (b) MECH-178's noradrenergic- hyperarousal coupling -- no NA/cortisol/LC substrate exists in ree_core. A PASS above supports the "incomplete update at high MEL" half of the upper bound but says nothing about WHY (reduced capacity vs. simple demand-exceeds-fixed-ceiling).
GOVERNANCE/QUEUE FLAG (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): the substrate pieces this falsifier needs -- SD-017 (stable), SD-MEL-PRODUCER (built, graded knob validated), SD-MEL-CONSUMER (built, validated), and the rigidity-proxy DVs (all already instrumented and exercised in prior sleep-cluster experiments) -- are ALL already built. The only missing piece is that no run has ever used a >=3-level dose sweep with a rigidity DV pre-registered as the primary outcome. Categorized substrate_conditional here on the
 "never exercised in this specific configuration" reading, but this is close enough to
testable-now that a dedicated chip was spawned same-day to check whether this experiment design should be registered via /queue-experiment rather than left as substrate_conditional.

INV-059.subject: play.frame_maintenance_necessity
INV-059.title: Mutual frame-maintenance signaling is necessary for play to function as distinct from manipulation: unilateral play declaration without partner agreement masks real harm as synthetic.
INV-059.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: this claim requires TWO substrates, neither of
which exists in V3. (a) A play-frame-signaling channel distinct from
MECH-094's hypothesis tag -- the play_frame_tag / L1 (frame_open/
frame_close) / L3 (ambiguity_threshold-triggered repair) architecture
named in ARC-049's notes. Confirmed UNIMPLEMENTED by direct search of
ree_core (2026-08, re-confirmed this session): zero occurrences of
play_frame_tag, frame_open, frame_close, or ambiguity_threshold
anywhere in the substrate. (b) A multi-agent substrate in which a
second, autonomous agent can independently generate, monitor, or
withdraw a frame-maintenance signal. No such substrate exists
anywhere in ree_core; the only proposal (ARC-047, SocialGridWorld) is
status: candidate, confidence: 0.0, implementation_phase: v5.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this is stricter than ARC-049's own
gate. ARC-049 has a testable V3-degenerate slice (single-agent,
experimenter-scripted signal, testing whether the tag is load-bearing
for the agent's OWN policy) precisely BECAUSE that slice does not
require a second agent. INV-059's claim is specifically about the
MUTUAL/BILATERAL property -- "unilateral... without partner
agreement" is only a meaningful distinction when there is a partner
capable of independently agreeing or disagreeing. With a scripted,
complicit experimenter standing in for the partner (V3's degenerate
case), the "partner" can never withhold or withdraw its signal except
on the experimenter's own schedule -- so unilateral assertion and
mutual agreement are experimentally indistinguishable. INV-059
therefore has NO V3-testable slice at all, unlike ARC-049; both
preconditions (a) and (b) must hold before any evidence bears on it.

STRUCTURAL TEMPLATE (per this claim's own notes, drawing the MECH-094
parallel explicitly): MECH-094 confirmed that internal hypothesis-
tagging is load-bearing via a write-gate mechanism -- roughly 30 call
sites in agent.py gate weight updates on the tag's state. The
play-frame gate this claim requires is the BILATERAL analogue:
instead of one internal tag gating one agent's own learning, the
harm/residue-update machinery of EACH agent must gate on BOTH
agents' frame-maintenance signals jointly -- a two-party AND, not a
one-party flag.

CONFIRMING evidence (once both substrates exist): in a paired-agent
setup, the harm/residue-update machinery suppresses real-harm
learning ONLY when BOTH agents' frame-maintenance signals (L1 open +
L2 ongoing + L3 repair, as applicable) are mutually sustained. If
agent A's frame signal is present but agent B's is absent, withheld,
or withdrawn mid-episode, B's harm/residue machinery treats the
interaction as real -- statistically indistinguishable from a matched
real-harm episode with no play framing at all.

FALSIFYING evidence (the exploit this invariant warns against): agent
A can unilaterally declare "this is play" and have the interaction
treated as non-harmful/non-learning by BOTH agents' harm/residue-
update machinery, even when agent B's frame-agreement signal is
absent or actively withdrawn -- the frame tag honored on the basis of
EITHER party's signal alone (an OR-gate) rather than requiring mutual
sustainment (an AND-gate).

SCOPE: a PASS establishes that the bilateral gate is functionally
load-bearing once built -- it does not, by itself, establish that no
other exploit path exists (e.g. a partner whose frame signal can be
spoofed rather than withheld is a distinct, unaddressed failure
mode). Status stays substrate_conditional regardless of outcome.

INV-060.subject: play.developmental_dominance

Two joined predictions: (a) DOMINANCE -- play is the dominant child-phase behavioral mode, measurable once a curriculum scheduler exists; (b) TYPE PROGRESSION -- sensorimotor -> constructive -> pretend -> games-with-rules -> cooperative, each training the next stage's prerequisites. Leg (b) is the same testable content as sibling claim MECH-197 -- cross-reference its ablation design rather than duplicating.
