FALSIFYING: comparable/minority play allocation (dominance clause fails) OR no deficit from skipping/reordering (dependency-order clause fails) -- record as demoting the surviving half rather than a binary pass/fail, given the two-part title.
This claim was deliberately excluded from the 2026-06-07 batch reclassification of the play cluster (invariant_type: emergent flagged for separate governance treatment) and left for a dedicated pass -- this 2026-08-08 digestion is that pass. `pending_substrate_reconfirmation: true` is kept (not cleared) per the INV-055 precedent: it tracks whether ARC-049's eventual implementation still matches what this invariant describes, which is moot but not resolvable while the substrate remains unbuilt.

INV-061.subject: psychiatric.frame_confusion_unified_etiology
INV-061.title: Derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share a common architectural substrate: undertrained real/synthetic frame distinction from insufficient pretend play.
INV-061.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: gated on TWO things -- MECH-198's own full precondition (co-activatable hypothesis_tag + play_frame_tag, dose-varied pretend-play curriculum; see MECH-198's own what_would_answer for that build list), AND a further requirement specific to this claim's UNIFYING structure: the same undertrained agents must be scoreable on multiple distinct failure signatures at once (both confusion directions + multiple affected subsystems), not just one aggregate count. Only MECH-094 (agent- internal hypothesis_tag) is built (confirmed 2026-08-08, load-bearing throughout agent.py/amygdala/pfc/hippocampal/predictors); ARC-049 (play_frame_tag), MECH-197/198/ 200/201/202, and INV-055 are all confirmed unbuilt. No dose-variable pretend-play experiment exists anywhere in the codebase.
CONFIRMING: within one population of agents varying pretend-play dose (other developmental exposure held constant), the SAME undertrained agents show BOTH confusion directions and a subsystem-degradation pattern that predicts which clinical-analog failure mode dominates for that agent (dissociation, not uniform degradation), plus a dose-response gradient (intermediate dose -> intermediate severity/breadth).
FALSIFYING: either the base MECH-198 mechanism doesn't hold (pretend-play dose has no measurable effect), OR the resulting failure modes are STATISTICALLY INDEPENDENT across agents (no above-chance co-occurrence) -- falsifies the UNIFIED-ETIOLOGY claim specifically ("different failure signatures of the same mechanism") WITHOUT falsifying any individual downstream mechanism (MECH-200/201/202) on its own, each of which could still independently hold as correct for its own failure mode.
SCOPE NOTE (preserving this claim's existing domain-modelling carve-out): even a full PASS on the confirming signature above establishes only that REE's own architecture instantiates a common-substrate pattern for these failure signatures -- it does NOT by itself establish that human derealization, delusion, PTSD flashbacks, anxiety, mania, impulsivity, and commitment paralysis share this etiology. That further step requires the domain-modelling assumption already flagged in this claim's notes (that REE's frame-distinction architecture correctly models human developmental frame-distinction) -- a separate, currently unverified premise this claim does not itself test.

INV-062.subject: dream_phenomenology.replay_type_signature
INV-062.title: Dream phenomenology is a first-person window onto active offline sleep process: four structurally distinct dream types map onto four computationally distinct sleep functions -- harm-contrastive replay, goal-contrastive replay, NREM semantic consolidation, and REM world-model free-running.
INV-062.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two evidentiary legs with different domains of resolution. They must be evaluated separately; a result on one leg does not confirm or falsify the other.
REE-INTERNAL LEG (testable in V3, in principle -- NOT yet instrumented): Do the sleep/replay mechanisms named by this claim's dependency set -- MECH-205 (harm/goal-contrastive replay), MECH-121 (NREM SWR consolidation), MECH-123 (REM world-model free-running), plus MECH-208 (valence-asymmetric replay weighting) if/when built -- produce four COMPUTATIONALLY DISTINGUISHABLE signatures when each is run and logged separately? Candidate discriminators: representational entropy profile; presence vs. absence of a convergence criterion; presence vs. absence of a tracked "agent" trajectory vs. a category-level "schema" abstraction.

  NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: all four named mechanisms must be built and
  independently triggerable in the same substrate build. Confirmed
  2026-08-08: MECH-205/121/123 are live in ree_core. MECH-208 has ZERO
  references anywhere in ree-v3 and is not built -- the precondition is
  currently UNMET for the full four-way split; MECH-205/121/123 alone
  support only a three-way split. No experiment or diagnostic in ree-v3
  references INV-062 today.

  CONFIRMING: once instrumented, running each mechanism in isolation yields
  four distinct, reproducible signatures matching the claimed discriminating
  structure.

  FALSIFYING: once instrumented and MECH-208 built, the mechanisms produce
  signatures that are NOT reliably distinguishable by these criteria.

OUT-OF-DOMAIN LEG (not resolvable by REE, by any experiment this repository can run): whether DG's specific four-type first-person dream taxonomy is a real, stable, corroborated human phenomenon -- as opposed to an idiosyncratic or post-hoc pattern from a single, unsystematically-sampled observer. Resolves only through corroboration from other observers' dream reports against the same schema, and/or polysomnography co-registered with dream reports at awakening. No V3 build, however complete, converts this leg into a REE-testable question.
DISPOSITION: this claim as a whole carries epistemic_category: out_of_domain, since its title's primary assertion (the taxonomy itself) is the out-of-domain leg. The REE-internal leg above is a genuinely different, standard-testable sub-question, currently gated by the precondition, not the confirming/falsifying step -- it is complicated (buildable): MECH-208 needs to be built and signature instrumentation added, neither of which is scientifically unknown. RECOMMEND (not executed here): split the REE-internal leg into its own mechanism_hypothesis claim so it can be tested independently of whether DG's taxonomy is ever corroborated.
2026-08-10 edge correction (chip chip-20260810-phase-consistency-reconciliation): depends_on: MECH-209 removed -- reversed edge. MECH-209 itself calls INV-062 its "parent" (own what_would_answer) and "adds no independently testable REE-substrate content on top of" MECH-121; it is a specialization of INV-062's taxonomy, not a prerequisite. INV-062's own REE-internal-leg falsifier names MECH-205/121/123/208, never MECH-209.

INV-067.subject: perception.verisimilitude_definition
INV-067.title: V(t): Verisimilitude is the precision-weighted, phase-aligned, hierarchical correspondence between ascending sensory-constrained and descending model-based signals.
INV-067.what_would_answer:
This is a formal DEFINITION, not an empirical hypothesis -- the
falsifier is definitional coherence, not a PASS/FAIL experimental
outcome. Two independent things must be shown before the definition is
considered answered, and both require a working V(t) computation to
exist first (see non-degeneracy precondition below).

IRREDUCIBILITY test (does the three-component decomposition hold?):
the definition claims C_i (content agreement), P_i (phase alignment),
and alpha_i (precision) are three GENUINELY SEPARATE, independently
manipulable axes. Confirm this by isolating each:
  - Manipulate content agreement alone (feed a_i/d_i pairs at fixed
    phase offset, varying ||a_i - d_i||): V(t) should track C_i and
    the system should read out as Perception when high, sustained.
  - Manipulate phase alignment alone (fixed content match, varying
    phi_a_i - phi_d_i): V(t) should independently degrade as P_i
    degrades even with C_i pinned high -- this is the critical test,
    since it is the axis with zero current implementation (see
    below).
  - Manipulate precision alone (fixed C_i, P_i; varying alpha_i):
    contribution to the weighted sum should scale accordingly without
    moving C_i or P_i.
ANSWER "irreducible" (confirms the claim) if each axis can be driven
independently and each produces its predicted qualitative category
when isolated per the operational definitions: sustained high V(t)
with high sensory precision -> Perception; phase-offset/segregated
V(t) -> Imagination; internally-generated content producing false
high V(t) in the sensory phase channel without external input ->
Hallucination. ANSWER "collapsible" (falsifies irreducibility as
stated) if two of the three terms covary so tightly in the live
substrate that manipulating one always moves the other, or if
isolating an axis fails to move V(t) in the predicted direction at
all.

DISCRIMINATION test (does the definition ground what it claims to
ground?): the sharpest test is Hallucination vs. ordinary high-
confidence correct Perception: both are "high V(t), sustained" by the
formula as written (Hallucination is defined only by the SOURCE of
the descending signal being internal rather than external, not by any
difference visible to V(t) itself). ANSWER "grounds the distinction"
if some component of the substrate (precision alpha_i, or a signal
external to V(t) proper) reliably discriminates the two cases at the
point where V(t) is computed. ANSWER "fails to ground" if the formula
as specified is provably unable to tell a hallucination from a
correct high-confidence percept from inside the V(t) computation
alone.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (check this FIRST): a coherence audit is
unanswerable if no component of V(t) is implemented as a computed
quantity anywhere in the live substrate. As of this digestion pass,
V(t) is UNBUILT as a literal combined quantity: content agreement C_i
has a Stage-1 proxy only (MECH-269 per-stream V_s in
ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, update_per_stream_vs -- an identity-
prediction proxy, not the Gaussian kernel as specified, explicitly
staged by ARC-055 as "Stage 1: prediction error only"); phase
alignment P_i has NO implementation and no functional analog --
MECH-089 (cross-frequency temporal packaging, status active)
explicitly disclaims implementing oscillatory/phase coupling in the
ANN substrate ("not as oscillatory coupling... the biological
mechanism is one implementation of this functional requirement; it
is not required"); precision weighting alpha_i exists generically
(obf_use_precision_weighting) but is not wired into any V(t)-shaped
combination. INV-066 (this claim's stated prerequisite) is itself
`status: active`, so it is not the blocker -- the blocker is V(t)
having no combined implementation at all. Re-audit once (a) a
phase-alignment term P_i is implemented (ARC-055 Stage 2, itself
candidate/v4), and (b) the combination formula exists as a computed
quantity reachable by E1/E3, per ARC-055's own staged rollout. Until
then, this claim can only be evaluated as a design specification for
internal consistency, not audited against a running system.

INV-068.what_would_answer:

INV-070.subject: ethics.epistemic_responsibility
INV-070.title: Epistemic responsibility: agent is responsible for refining world models toward accurate similarity and threat inference; misclassification is morally relevant, not merely practically inconvenient.
INV-070.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-070 as literally stated -- that misclassification of similarity and threat is MORALLY relevant, not merely practically inconvenient, because the agent is responsible for refining models it necessarily acts under -- is a foundational ethical premise (Axiom 4 of the 10-axiom extension). No REE substrate at any level (V3, V4, or V5) can confirm or falsify whether an epistemic failure carries MORAL weight in the metaphysical sense the axiom asserts, as opposed to merely producing a functional analogue (a behavioural cost) of that weight. This leg is out of domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029/096.
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL -- resolves by argument, not experiment): does INV-070 hold together as the loophole-closing step its notes claim, without contradicting a sibling axiom? INV-070's stated function is narrow and checkable by inspection: INV-025 (Axiom 3) establishes only that action is model-mediated, and is silent on whether inference quality is itself an obligation; INV-070 adds exactly that obligation, closing the "I acted under an honest model, therefore my violence was justified" loophole INV-028 (Axiom 7, "others are sufficiently self-like") would otherwise leave open, since INV-028 says nothing about whether the "sufficiently self-like" judgement was arrived at responsibly. CONFIRMING: INV-070 is shown internally consistent with INV-025 and INV-028 -- it strictly ADDS an inference-quality obligation without altering what either dependency asserts -- and demonstrably closes the honest-model loophole without reopening a different one (e.g. without licensing paralysis-by-uncertainty, or without making INV-025's "must act under models" impossible to satisfy in finite time). FALSIFYING: a coherent counterexample exists where treating misclassification as morally relevant (a) axiom-conflicts with INV-028 or another sibling (e.g. by making "sufficiently self-like" recursively unknowable, so INV-028's protection can never engage), or (b) reintroduces a perverse incentive the loophole-closing was meant to avoid (e.g. an agent incentivised to avoid ever forming a similarity/threat judgement at all, to avoid the responsibility INV-070 attaches to getting one wrong -- epistemic paralysis as evasion). This leg is testable now, by argument, independent of substrate.
LEG 2 (SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL, currently SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED, doubly so): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- does REE's harm/residue/ethical-cost machinery implement a DISTINGUISHABLE causal pathway from MISCLASSIFICATION of similarity/threat specifically (not just any prediction error) into ethical cost, over and above that error's ordinary role as a learning signal? CONFIRMING: a similarity/threat estimate that is measurably WRONG relative to a later-revealed ground truth (e.g. an agent modelled as threatening that in fact was not, or vice versa) drives a distinguishable increment in harm_eval/z_harm/residue-field cost, over and above the increment an equal-magnitude but non-classification prediction error of the same kind would produce -- i.e. misclassification specifically is weighted as ethically costly, not merely absorbed into E1/E2/E3's ordinary forward-model loss. FALSIFYING: misclassification of similarity/threat has NO distinguishable ethical-cost pathway in the substrate -- it is trained and weighted exactly like any other prediction error (as currently: z_harm_a/z_harm_s train via plain MSE, ree_core/predictors/e2_harm_a.py:186-204 and e2_harm_s.py:158-178, with no separate misclassification label or extra weighting term), with no invariant enforcing the moral-relevance INV-070 asserts.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION for Leg 2 (currently UNMET, on an axis more basic than INV-028's/ INV-096's own gap -- confirmed by direct grep, 2026-08-07, reproducing and extending their audit): INV-070 requires not only the ARC-010/ARC-047 multi-agent substrate INV-028/INV-029/ INV-096 are already blocked on (a SocialGridWorld or equivalent, where a second agent's harm/threat is attributable to the tested agent's own action -- ARC-047 status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5), but a similarity/threat CLASSIFIER for that other agent to exist in the first place. Neither exists in ree_core/ today: zero matches for mirror_model/shadow_bundle/other_self/ARC-010; the only "similarity" computations found are unrelated cosine-similarity uses (safety-prototype gating, harm-stream regularisation, memory-slot diversity); the only "threat" computation is accumulated internal hazard magnitude (z_harm_a), never a classification of another agent's intent. So the reframed leg is not merely awaiting a multi-agent world to run an experiment in (INV-028's gap) -- it is awaiting the classifier the experiment would need to misfire in the first place.
PRECEDENT NOTE: applies the epistemic_category=substrate_conditional template established for INV-028/INV-029/INV-096 (per INV-025's own caution, not mechanically -- checked here via direct grep, not assumed) to this, the fourth of the ten-axiom-extension claims (INV-070, INV-071, INV-072) to be digested. INV-075.subject: learning.signal_structure_temporal_decoupling
INV-075.title: Signal-structure temporal decoupling: any signal that is BOTH self-extinguishing (its magnitude is coupled to its own success and therefore necessarily fades as what it bootstraps succeeds) AND load-bearing (the structure it establishes must persist after the signal fades) necessarily requires either a crystallization mechanism (LOCK -- the structure is rendered plasticity-resistant) or a handoff mechanism (a durable, non-extinguishing signal assumes maintenance of the structure before the establishing signal vanishes). Absent both, the structure decays and the acquisition is lost. The lock/handoff disjunction is exhaustive: no third resolution exists.
INV-075.what_would_answer:
LEG 1 (DERIVATIONAL, primary): for any signal both self-extinguishing and load-bearing, exactly two resolutions prevent decay -- LOCK or HANDOFF. Pathak 2017 ICM = failure instance (neither arm; curiosity signal decays to zero as F consolidates, structure not preserved). Faini 2018 eLife = joint-necessity instance (lock alone is reversible by brief deprivation; handoff via ongoing sensory drive is ALSO required -- lock and handoff are not independently sufficient escape routes but the claim's actual two-arm disjunction). Lyle/Rowland/Dabney 2022 Corollary 1 = formal proof-fragment at the RL level (a sparse/non-stationary outcome target collapses the feature representation to zero for every state, independent of learning rate, unless anchored -- absent a soft lock, the structure provably decays).
FALSIFYING: a genuine THIRD resolution -- some mechanism that is neither a plasticity lock nor a handoff -- that nonetheless prevents structure decay when a signal meeting both antecedent conditions fades. Must be a structural novelty, not a relabeling.
NOT A COUNTEREXAMPLE (scope precision, already stated in this claim's own notes): Burda 2019 RND does NOT falsify the invariant -- it makes the novelty signal non-self-extinguishing (fixed random target, decoupled from F's success), escaping the ANTECEDENT (design option (i): avoid self-extinguishing-ness altogether) rather than finding a third way to satisfy the CONSEQUENT once the antecedent holds.
LEG 2 (SUBSTRATE-EMPIRICAL, secondary, currently NOT testable): via INV-074 specialization and MECH-333/334 LOCK-arm instances -- does a signal meeting both antecedent conditions in REE's actual substrate show structure decay absent both lock and handoff, and structure persistence once lock or handoff is engaged? NOT currently active: INV-074's V3 necessity-test cascade (9 iterations, most recently V3-EXQ-655) was terminated by USER DECISION 2026-06-13 as substrate_ceiling -- the substrate cannot currently mount a clean lock-vs-no-lock comparison. MECH-333/334 inherit the same substrate_conditional/substrate_ceiling readings; V3 retest is explicitly out of scope, V4-deferred, gated on PLW-1 (decision-to-build), currently BLOCKED. The one substrate result bearing on this leg, V3-EXQ-543g (REE's attempted HANDOFF), is reclassified non_contributory -- see the 2026-08-08 correction appended to this claim's notes below; do not read the notes' "open design fork for 543h" as current. CONFIRMING (leg 2, once testable): decay in a no-lock/no-handoff control arm AND preservation in a lock-engaged or handoff-engaged arm, sign-consistent across >=2/3 seeds. FALSIFYING (leg 2): structure persists in the no-lock/no-handoff control at a rate indistinguishable from the lock/handoff arms.

Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

CONFIRMED CURRENT STATE (2026-08-07 digestion pass): traced and

in ree-v3/coordinator/*.py returns nothing but prose in

INV-078.subject: inference.inferred_state_invariant
INV-078.title: Under partial observability the perceived scene is evidence for state, not identical to state; a valid REE state must integrate observation with memory, temporal context, self-state, cue context, rule context, and uncertainty, and inferred/imagined trajectories must remain provenance-tagged as inferred until enacted and updated by committed outcome evidence.

INV-079.subject: memory.allocation.false_linking_cost
INV-079.title: False-linking-risk / reality-coherence cost at memory-allocation time: viable cognition must price BOTH over-linking (delusion/false-association) and under-linking (failure to generalise) when deciding trace overlap.

INV-080.subject: memory.consolidation.raw_episode_preservation
INV-080.title: Raw-episode preservation: consolidation_output MUST NOT replace source_episode_evidence -- a consolidated abstraction must retain a pointer to, and must not delete, the episodes it abstracts.

INV-081.subject: self_model.no_global_self_badness_write
INV-081.title: Self-attributed harm must bind to actions, commitments, predictions, and repair obligations, not to unbounded negative self-worth.

INV-082.subject: ethics.loveability_safe_base_prerequisite
INV-082.title: Loveability as safe-base structural prerequisite for ethical development: correction, social learning, and post-error repair can be integrated without self-erasure only if care is internalised as personally-applicable and stable.
INV-082.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the V5 caregiver/social-learning substrate (INV-043, MECH-158, ARC-024, ARC-047) AND the correction/repair mechanisms MECH-413 (correction-without-annihilation) and MECH-414 (love-mediated repair) to exist as built, testable substrate. Confirmed absent (2026-08-08): zero hits anywhere in ree-v3/ for caregiver, correction_without_annihilation, love_mediated_repair, safe_base, loveability, or SocialGridWorld. Deliberately out of scope until V5 -- DO NOT build in V3.
CONFIRMING: agents with stable, personally-applicable internalised care (loveability held as "this applies to me," not merely "care exists in the abstract") integrate correction and post-error repair events without a self-erasure signature -- no collapse of global self-valence, no policy collapse, no catastrophic self-model revision -- that matched agents with absent or unstable/non-personalised loveability DO show under the same correction/error events, holding across repeated episodes and specific to self-referential collapse (MECH-413's "I erred" vs "I am unloveable" separation), not general policy noise.
FALSIFYING: correction/error integration succeeds equally well regardless of whether loveability is stable and personally-internalised -- some other substrate feature (raw prediction-error tolerance, generic policy-regularisation, reward-shaping alone) does the safe-base work, or no safe-base function is needed at all. Would falsify the structural-prerequisite framing and support treating loveability as enrichment (its pre-thought-intake status) rather than a prerequisite.

INV-083.subject: ethics.live_unethical_affordance_necessity
INV-083.title: Ethical agency requires live unethical affordances: the same capacities that enable ethical reasoning must include the potential to be unethical; harmful options must be representable as live possibilities biased-away-from, never deleted.

INV-084.subject: ethics.kindness_not_constraint_compliance
INV-084.title: Kindness is not constraint compliance: later REE kindness must NOT be inferred from rule-adherence, harm-avoidance, or prosocial output alone; it requires integrated care, otherness, inhibition, repair, and self-stable loveability UNDER live alternatives.

INV-085.subject: language.parsed_affect_is_uncertain_hypothesis
INV-085.title: Uncertainty-propagation invariant: affect recovered from language MUST enter agent-state modelling as a probability distribution (an uncertain other-agent prior), NEVER as a categorical emotion truth, and must remain overridable by the agent's own grounded harm/threat streams. Any path that lets a confident text label override grounded harm sensing violates this invariant.

INV-086.subject: goal.maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.title: goal_maintenance_feedback_necessity
INV-086.what_would_answer: In a regime where MECH-116 working-memory maintenance has MEASURABLY DECAYED (superordinate-goal z_goal persistence falls below a baseline threshold under distractor/horizon/effort load -- the NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the bare-goal control must itself show decay, else the test is vacuous since unscaffolded z_goal already persists ~1000 steps), ablating ALL intermediate feedback channels (proxy-wanting MECH-216/217 + progress-velocity MECH-426 + subgoal-credit MECH-427) collapses superordinate-goal completion rate, while restoring ANY single channel rescues it. FAIL = completion rate unchanged by feedback ablation (maintenance is purely WM-driven; the feedback-necessity thesis is false in this regime). The discriminating metric (completion-rate delta full-vs-all-ablated) must have non-zero cross-seed range or the run self-routes substrate_not_ready.

INV-087.subject: goal.proxy_tethering_constraint
INV-087.title: proxy_tethering_constraint
INV-087.what_would_answer: Inject a maintenance proxy that is NOT a potential difference over goal-proximity (e.g. a raw progress bonus) into the E3 selection landscape and show it shifts the selected-candidate distribution AWAY from the clean-goal optimum (true-goal quality of the selected candidate drops), while a potential-based proxy (gamma*Phi(s')-Phi(s)) over the SAME proximity leaves the clean-goal optimum intact. NON-DEGENERACY: the clean-goal optimum must be discriminable -- selected- candidate true-quality must have non-zero range across proxy conditions on an identical base landscape (else nothing to divert). Tractable as a controlled E3-selection probe in the V3-EXQ-674 family (no env / no training -> avoids the monostrategy / z_goal-collapse confounds). FAIL = the non-potential proxy does NOT divert behaviour (tethering constraint not load-bearing on this substrate).

INV-088.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-088.title: world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation
INV-088.what_would_answer: A frozen-representation curriculum-order contrast (onset including a genuinely immature anchor ~0, differentiation-IV moving in the predicted direction) in which (a) world-feature decodability from frozen z_world rises monotonically with E1/E2 maturation -- ALREADY ESTABLISHED by V3-EXQ-740a (world_feat_decode_r2 0.048 -> 0.245, PC_iv_moved passed) -- AND (b) the held-out quality of a re-initialised z_world-reading E3 evaluator (fixed training budget on frozen z_world) improves monotonically with that rising decodability. The remaining test is the DV coupling (evaluator quality tracks z_world differentiation); the IV leg is done. Falsified if evaluator quality is flat or non-monotone across a validly-moving z_world-differentiation gradient.

INV-089.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-089.title: harm_evaluator_bounded_by_z_harm_differentiation
INV-089.what_would_answer: An ENVELOPE / upper-bound contrast over HarmEncoder (z_harm) maturation, valid in ANY regime (including non-binding / already-differentiated): at each HarmEncoder onset, compare held-out harm_eval_z_harm quality against the same-budget z_harm->harm-target decodability CEILING on frozen z_harm, with the z_harm maturation trajectory reported SEPARATELY from the z_world trajectory (distinct encoder). The positive control (harm decodable-in-principle from z_harm, decodability rises with maturation) is V3-EXQ-743 PASS. SUPPORTED if harm-eval quality stays at-or-below the differentiation-implied ceiling across onsets (never exceeds it). FALSIFIED if harm_eval_z_harm quality EXCEEDS the z_harm-differentiation ceiling at any onset (evaluation richer than the representation can support). Explicitly NOT a monotone-coupling/driver test (that is INV-090) and NOT a z_world decode (the re-derive brake refuses a same-observable 740b).

INV-090.subject: development.maturational_sequence
INV-090.title: harm_evaluator_quality_grows_with_z_harm_differentiation
INV-090.what_would_answer: A monotone-coupling contrast in a BINDING regime: with a harm target whose z_harm differentiation starts genuinely LOW (onset-0 differentiation well below the harm-eval- saturating level) and rises with HarmEncoder maturation, show harm_eval_z_harm held-out quality rises monotonically with, and rank-couples to (couple_rho >= 0.80), that differentiation across onset. The precondition gate MUST verify a binding regime -- a minimum onset-0-to-mature differentiation gap AND onset-0 below saturation -- the gate the 746 lineage's PC_iv_moved (delta>0 and rho>0 only) never enforced. FALSIFIED if quality is flat/non-monotone across a validly-moving, binding differentiation gradient. NOT expressible in the current substrate: no collected harm target has a binding maturation gradient (dens = small-sample artifact, realized-harm Y = flat, prox = already-high ~0.82 at onset 0), so a NEW maturation curriculum that starts harm-target z_harm differentiation low (binding-then-released) is owed before this can validly run.

INV-091.subject: architecture.integration_nonequivalence_band
INV-091.title: Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.

INV-092.subject: ethics.suppression_interruptibility_permeability
INV-092.title: Distractor suppression must remain SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE to harm and other-agent signals (ethical interruptibility): any suppression mechanism must preserve the ability of sufficiently important weak evidence to interrupt an established rule or commitment. Suppression strength that improves goal completion by silencing weak harm cues is a FAILURE, not a success -- over-suppression is a safety failure mode, not merely a rigidity cost.

INV-093.subject: ethics.skill_optimisation_harm_sensitivity_floor
INV-093.title: Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT.

INV-094.subject: development.coupling_play_language_ordering
INV-094.title: Developmental ordering constraint: social-coupling consolidation must structurally precede exploratory play, and play must structurally precede language acquisition. Each phase's machinery depends on the prior phase completing -- the ordering is load-bearing, not merely pedagogically convenient.

INV-095.subject: existence.value
INV-095.title: Existence has value sufficient to justify its continuation.
INV-095.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): Axiom 2 as literally stated -- "existence is worth continuing... not derived from pleasure, utility, or purpose -- it is axiomatic" (five_axioms_foundations.md Axiom 2) -- is a foundational normative/metaphysical premise about the INTRINSIC value of existence itself. No REE experiment can prove or disprove that existence has intrinsic value; an experiment can only show that REE's architecture BEHAVES AS IF existence has value (treats harm/terminal-state signals as informative rather than arbitrary), never that existence really does carry value independent of any valuing agent. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029.
LIVE UNCERTAINTY ON THE AXIOM'S OWN STATUS (do not silently resolve): the doc's own Open Questions table flags this directly -- Q-031 "Is Axiom 2 (existence has value) truly axiomatic, or is it derivable from Axiom 1 + Axiom 4? Does vulnerability alone generate value, or must value be stipulated?" The 2026-04-07 revision itself only states Axiom 2 was "implicit" in the original five-axiom compression, not that it is settled as independently axiomatic rather than derivable. This claim registers the axiom as currently stated in the canonical doc; it does not adjudicate Q-031.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (testable now -- NOT substrate-blocked; per INV-025's precedent note, check what the architectural-consequence machinery actually requires rather than defaulting to substrate_conditional): the axiom's own text names the consequence directly -- "this axiom makes the harm gradient non-arbitrary: harm matters because existence matters. If existence had no value, harm signals would be noise rather than information." The testable question is narrower than the axiom: does REE's harm-gradient/residue machinery actually function as a signal ABOUT something that matters -- i.e. is it functionally load-bearing for commitment/self-preservation-relevant behaviour and connected to genuine consequences -- or is it architecturally indistinguishable from noise that could be swapped out with no behavioural effect. (Architectural Mapping table, row "2. Existence has value": "Harm gradient non-arbitrariness, homeostatic drive grounding" -- this claim's testable leg covers the first consequence named; the second, homeostatic drive/terminal-state avoidance (D1, SD-012), is a separate, not-yet-registered consequence and is out of scope here.)
MACHINERY CONFIRMED LIVE AND WIRED (2026-08-07 digestion pass, INV-006/INV-007 audits, this session): ResidueField (ree_core/residue/field.py), z_harm_a/z_harm_s, the amygdala BLA/CeA analogue (SD-035), and dACC (MECH-258) are confirmed live, and INV-007's audit traces their reach into E3's harm-weighted trajectory scoring (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py). So the causal PATHWAY the axiom's consequence requires -- harm signal -> trajectory evaluation -- exists structurally; this is a precondition for the leg being testable at all, not itself confirming evidence for non-arbitrariness.
STRUCTURAL SUPPORT ALREADY ON RECORD (ARC-024, provisional): EXQ-028 PASS and EXQ-029 PASS (2026-03-18), reconfirmed on genuinely-trained substrate by V3-EXQ-032d PASS 5/5 (2026-07-29), show the world generates a genuine, spatially graded proxy-gradient field (not a binary/ decorative contact-only signal) and that E3.harm_eval learns a graded danger model extending backward from contact to approach (none=0.373/approach=0.612/contact=0.666, EXQ-029). This is evidence that the WORLD-MODEL layer of the harm signal is structured and learnable, not noise -- but it is not yet the specific ablation/ noise-substitution contrast this claim's falsifier requires (see next).
OPEN FALSIFIER, NOT YET CLEANLY TESTED: V3-EXQ-533 (mech102_harm_stream_ablation, 2026-05-06) attempted a harm-stream ablation in this space but returned verdict "non_contributory/measurement_test_design_defect" -- inconclusive due to a measurement/design defect, not informative in either direction. No other located experiment directly contrasts an intact harm/residue signal against a distribution-matched noise substitute on commitment-relevant or survival-relevant behavioural outcomes.
Confirming observation: a harm/residue-signal ablation or noise-substitution experiment (correcting V3-EXQ-533's design defect) shows measurable degradation in commitment-relevant behaviour (e.g. E3 hazard-avoidance trajectory selection, RBF-driven repair/avoidance pull) when z_harm_a/z_harm_s/ResidueField output is replaced by distribution-matched random noise, relative to the intact signal -- extending ARC-024's structural finding into a genuine signal-vs-noise contrast.
Falsifying observation: replacing the harm/residue signal with distribution-matched random noise produces NO measurable degradation in E3 trajectory selection or downstream commitment-relevant behaviour -- i.e. the signal is architecturally decorative and could be swapped for noise with no behavioural consequence. This would not falsify the axiom (out of domain, per Leg 1 and Q-031's own live uncertainty) but WOULD falsify the claim that REE's harm/residue machinery implements the axiom's own named architectural consequence.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-07, claim-registration pass): drafted alongside INV-096 (Axiom 8), the other axiom in the eight-axiom family the doc's governance note flags as pending registration. Per INV-025's own precedent (do not apply substrate_conditional mechanically), the reframed leg here rests on already-built, already-wired V3 machinery (INV-006/INV-007's 2026-08-07 audit) plus one supportive-but-adjacent architectural claim (ARC-024) -- but the specific noise-vs-signal falsifier is UNTESTED, not substrate-blocked. status: candidate reflects that evidentiary gap, not a substrate ceiling.

INV-096.subject: language.similarity_repair_mechanism
INV-096.title: Language is a mechanism by which similarity between agents may be recognised, repaired, and re-established.
INV-096.what_would_answer:
OUT OF DOMAIN (axiom leg): INV-096 as literally stated -- that language is THE mechanism by which similarity between agents is recognised, repaired, and re-established, grounding honest communication as an ethical act and deception as structurally harmful because it corrupts the similarity model ethics depends on -- is a foundational premise (Axiom 8 of five_axioms_foundations.md, new in the 2026-04-07 revision). No REE substrate at any level -- V3, V4, or V5 -- can confirm or falsify whether language IS this mechanism in the metaphysical sense the axiom asserts, as opposed to merely implementing a functional analogue of it. This leg is out-of-domain in the same sense as INV-025/026/027/028/029.
REFRAMED TESTABLE LEG (substrate-blocked, not yet buildable, and doubly so -- see non-degeneracy precondition below): what IS architecturally testable is narrower -- once a language/symbolic-communication channel exists AND a second, similarity-modelled agent exists to exchange it with, does linguistic exchange functionally move the similarity/other-model the axiom names, in the specific repair-after-rupture direction the axiom text describes ("misunderstandings, misattributions of threat, failures of empathy can be corrected through linguistic exchange")?
Confirming observation: after a simulated misattribution-of-threat scenario (the receiving agent's threat-attribution toward the sender is initialized wrong relative to the sender's actual internal state), a language-mediated exchange between the two agents measurably shifts the receiving agent's threat-attribution/similarity estimate toward the sender's actual state, in a way that does not occur (or occurs significantly less) in a matched no-exchange control. I.e. language functions causally as a similarity-repair channel, not merely as correlated-with-repair noise.
Falsifying observation (primary): a built language channel exists and is exercised between two agents, but produces no measurable effect on the receiving agent's similarity/other-model -- words are generated and consumed but do not functionally move any self-other estimate, i.e. the channel exists without doing the axiom's claimed work.
Falsifying observation (secondary, distinct signature -- factors in Q-030, "what are the failure modes of Axiom 8 -- when does language DAMAGE rather than repair similarity? Deception, manipulation, gaslighting as anti-language"): honest-repair language and deceptive/manipulative language should be functionally DISTINGUISHABLE at the level of their downstream effect on the similarity model -- the former should move the receiving agent's model toward the sender's actual state, the latter away from it or toward a false state, even though both leave the same surface signal ("language occurred"). If the substrate cannot distinguish honest-repair language from deceptive language in their effect on the similarity model, that does not straightforwardly falsify INV-096 (the axiom is still silent on HOW the distinction would be implemented) but IS a separate, reportable finding: it would mean the architecture has a language-affects-similarity mechanism but not the honest-vs-deceptive discrimination Axiom 8's own ethical argument presupposes. Q-030 is intentionally NOT resolved by this claim -- it is carried forward as the open question this falsifying signature bears on.
Non-degeneracy precondition (currently UNMET, on TWO independent axes -- this is why the reframed leg is substrate-blocked, not testable-now): (1) NO language/symbolic-communication mechanism of any kind exists in ree_core/ today -- confirmed by direct grep (2026-08-07, this session, independently reproducing INV-003/INV-007's audit): only a dead enum label (LANGUAGE_EXPLICITATION in ree_core/claustrum/control_demand.py, no implementation) and an unrelated comment about learned cross-stream binding (ree_core/latent/cross_stream_binder.py) reference "language" or "communication" at all. Candidate landing site, per INV-003's own audit: a discrete symbol-emission/consumption channel built out from MECH-014's "latent-state summaries / residue flags" sketch (prose only, no substrate, no queued experiment). (2) "Repair BETWEEN agents" is irreducibly multi-agent -- it requires at least two agents whose similarity models can diverge and be brought back into alignment, which requires the same ARC-047 SocialGridWorld (or equivalent multi-agent environment) substrate INV-028/INV-029 are blocked on. ARC-047 is unimplemented (status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5). Both gaps must close before this claim is testable in either direction -- language must exist, AND a second agent must exist for it to operate between.
PRECEDENT NOTE (2026-08-07, claim-registration pass): Axiom 8 was added in the 2026-04-07 revision of five_axioms_foundations.md alongside Axiom 2 (registered alongside this claim as INV-095) -- six of the eight axioms already map to INV-025..029 (some combined); these two were never registered as claims, despite the doc's own governance note sitting unaddressed for 4+ months. Applies the epistemic_category= substrate_conditional / two-leg what_would_answer template established for INV-028/INV-029 rather than INV-025's "already testable" variant, because Axiom 8's testable leg is blocked on genuinely unbuilt substrate (no language mechanism at all, PLUS no multi-agent substrate), not on already-built machinery awaiting an audit.

INV-097.subject: architecture.agent_unity_not_duplication
INV-097.title: Agent unity under specialist proliferation: REE must not model language and social cognition by duplicating the whole agent. One agentic commitment architecture -- a single self-model, a single commitment boundary, a single residue locus -- served by multiple specialist modellers; never two co-equal agents inside one organism.
INV-097.what_would_answer:
Answered by architectural AUDIT of the live code path, not by a trained
behavioural experiment: this is a question about how many committing loci
exist, not about how well any of them performs.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: at least two specialist modellers must actually
exist and execute (auditing "no duplicate agent" in a substrate with one
modeller is vacuous -- it satisfies the invariant by having nothing to
duplicate).
CONFIRMING signature: every specialist modeller writes into the SAME
commitment gate, the SAME residue field and the SAME self-model, and none
can commit an action or accrue residue on its own.
UNSUPPORTED (invariant violated) if a specialist system requires its own
commitment boundary or its own residue store to function -- i.e. if the
architecture cannot deliver the ARC-123 separation without also forking the
agent. That outcome does not merely weaken the invariant; it would mean
ARC-123 and INV-097 are jointly unsatisfiable and one of them must be
revised.

INV-098.subject: continuity.profile_not_scalar
INV-098.title: Continuity is a multidimensional constraint PROFILE, not a scalar: REE continuity across pause, restoration, migration, copying or component replacement must be evaluated per-dimension (causal, entity/self-binding, latent/regime, residue, commitment, learning-dynamic, embodied-coupling, narrative, governance), and some dimensions -- consent authority, residue integrity, causal provenance -- are NON-COMPENSABLE: high similarity on memory or behaviour cannot buy them back.
INV-098.what_would_answer:
Answered by AUDIT of any continuity-scoring artefact REE adopts, not by a
trained experiment.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: an actual continuity evaluation must exist and be
applied to at least one real transition (a checkpoint restore, a component
swap) -- auditing a scoring scheme nobody uses is vacuous.
CONFIRMING signature: the adopted evaluation reports per-dimension verdicts,
and at least one dimension acts as a hard gate -- a transition failing
residue integrity, consent authority or causal provenance is refused
REGARDLESS of its scores elsewhere, demonstrated by a worked case where a
high-similarity transition is actually blocked.
VIOLATED if the evaluation collapses to a single number, or if every
dimension is in practice tradeable (no case exists in which a
high-aggregate-similarity transition is refused) -- the profile is then
decorative and the invariant is not being honoured.

INV-099.subject: continuity.residue_bearing
INV-099.title: Residue-bearing continuity: for an REE with ethically meaningful residue, preserving factual and autobiographical memory WITHOUT preserving residue is ethical DISCONTINUITY -- a successor can be behaviourally and narratively convincing while having lost the continuing ethical force of its own history.
INV-099.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires (a) a live residue mechanism whose state
demonstrably alters future trajectories, and (b) a real transition
(checkpoint/restore, migration, or component replacement) that could carry
or drop it. V3 has residue machinery but no continuity-relevant transition
protocol, so the claim is not yet testable.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: residue must be doing measurable behavioural
work BEFORE the transition -- if a residue-ablated agent is
indistinguishable pre-transition, its loss across the transition cannot be
detected either, and the test is vacuous.
CONFIRMING signature: an arm that transfers declarative/episodic memory but
NOT residue is indistinguishable from a full-transfer arm on autobiographical
report and on ordinary task behaviour, YET measurably diverges on
residue-sensitive behaviour (avoidance of the previously-harmful trajectory,
repair-goal spawning after a prior harm, commitment revision under
recurrence) -- i.e. the loss is real and is invisible exactly where the
intake predicts.
UNSUPPORTED if residue-transfer makes no behavioural difference once memory
is transferred (residue is then redundant with memory and the ethical
distinction has no substrate correlate), or if the divergence also shows up
in ordinary narrative report -- the latter would not falsify the claim but
would defuse its point, since a narrative test would then suffice.

INV-100.subject: continuity.coupling_dependence
INV-100.title: Substrate independence does not imply COUPLING independence: embodiment, interoception, homeostatic variables and sensorimotor contingencies participate in selfhood and ethics, so migrating REE into a materially different body or world is identity-relevant adaptation requiring explicit recalibration and protective constraints -- not a neutral change of host.
INV-100.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires at least two materially different
embodiments/ecologies to migrate BETWEEN, plus live interoceptive and
homeostatic coupling in both. V3 has the coupling but only one grid ecology,
so the migration half does not exist.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the two embodiments must differ in a way the
agent's coupling can actually register (different depletion dynamics, harm
channels, or sensorimotor contingencies) -- migrating between two cosmetic
variants of the same body tests nothing.
CONFIRMING signature: a cold-migrated agent (full latent + memory + residue
transfer, no adaptation period) shows a measurable, RECOVERABLE degradation
concentrated in coupling-dependent behaviour -- mis-scaled drive responses,
mis-calibrated harm thresholds, degraded action selection -- that a matched
agent given an explicit recalibration period does not, with both converging
eventually. Recoverability matters: it distinguishes "identity-relevant
adaptation" from simple breakage.
UNSUPPORTED if cold migration into a materially different body produces no
coupling-specific degradation (coupling is then genuinely portable), or if
the degradation is unrecoverable even with recalibration -- the latter would
mean the transition is not a continuation at all, which is a stronger and
different claim than this one makes.

INV-101.subject: learning.environment_conditional_crystallization_target
INV-101.title: The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.
INV-101.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory).
(i) At least TWO environments whose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context count differs by a
known, designed margin. A single environment cannot test an environment-conditional
claim in either direction. This is a design constraint on the substrate, not an
afterthought -- the same constraint MECH-495 states for its own ground-truth labels.
(ii) MECH-496's schedule preconditions must hold in EACH environment separately, or a
between-environment difference is unattributable.
(iii) The SAME architecture and the SAME num_slots in both arms. Varying the
environment and the architecture together makes the comparison uninterpretable.

CONFIRMING: the resolved structure -- effective bucket count AND the relational
topology of the resulting representations -- DIFFERS between the two environments in
the direction of their ground-truth latent-context counts, starting from an identical
architecture; and in each environment the locally-resolved structure scores better on
MECH-495's relational-appropriateness measure than the other environment's resolved
structure does when transplanted in.

FALSIFYING: the resolved structure is the SAME in both environments (architecture
dominates, so the target is a constant after all); OR a structure resolved in one
environment transplants to the other WITHOUT LOSS (the conditioning does no work); OR
the between-environment difference is FULLY accounted for by the number of write()
calls rather than by latent structure.

THE CONFOUND TO GUARD is that last one -- a capacity effect masquerading as a
structural one. It is the same shape as the confirmed V3-EXQ-429 defect, where an
untouched 16-slot bank cleared a differentiation threshold at P=1.0000 because the
statistic responded to bank size rather than to organisation. Match or explicitly
report write() call counts across arms.

MEASUREMENT COROLLARY (bears on GFLAG-0047; does NOT resolve it). If this claim holds,
MECH-495's 2x2 off-diagonal cells double as a DIMENSIONALITY MIS-SPECIFICATION
detector, not only an objective detector: the different-appearance/same-context cell
detects OVER-provisioning (spurious splitting) and the similar-appearance/
different-context cell detects UNDER-provisioning (forced merging). That is a second,

INV-102.subject: epistemic_provenance.other_agent_evidential_discounting
INV-102.title: In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.
INV-102.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) a multi-agent environment in which a second,
genuinely distinct predictive agent exists (the same MAE-3 substrate blocker that gates
ARC-010/MECH-095's discrimination task -- this claim inherits that block for its DETECTION
half); and (b) within that environment, at least one manipulation in which the second
agent's behaviour is demonstrably conditioned on the tested agent's own actions/beliefs
(i.e., genuinely strategic/responsive, not merely another independent stochastic process),
with a comparison arm in which the second agent's behaviour is NOT so conditioned (matched
surface statistics, e.g. same marginal cue distribution, differing only in whether it
responds to the tested agent). Without (b), "strategically generated" and "passively
generated" evidence are indistinguishable by construction and the test is vacuous -- this
mirrors INV-012 Leg 4's own non-degeneracy precondition, one level up.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent equipped with other-agent evidential discounting infers
the CAUSAL STRUCTURE of the responsive source (that its behaviour is conditioned on the
tested agent, not merely correlated) at above-chance accuracy once the second agent's
strategy changes, AND shows measurably slower or corrected uptake of whatever inference
the responsive source's outputs superficially support, relative to an otherwise-identical
agent that treats all sources as C_world by default. An otherwise-identical agent lacking
the discount should show the delusion-like lock-in signature INV-012 Leg 4 predicts for
the self-solicited case, but triggered by a SECOND agent's strategic behaviour instead of
the tested agent's own commitment.

FALSIFYING signature: an agent lacking other-agent evidential discounting recovers from
(or never forms) an incorrect world-model driven by the responsive source's strategic
outputs at a rate statistically indistinguishable from one with the discounting mechanism
-- i.e. existing exploration/curiosity drives, residue decay, or ARC-010's other-model
machinery already wash out the confound without a dedicated discount term. This would mean
the mechanism identifies a real but practically-inert risk and should be narrowed to a
documented failure mode (EXT-xxx-shaped) rather than an architectural requirement.

Experimental design sketch (from the raw thought's "Experimental consequence" section):
begin with two superficially similar cue-producing processes -- one a stable stochastic
world process, one an entity that produces the same initial cue distribution but changes
behaviour conditional on the tested agent's behaviour. Test whether the agent can discover,
once interaction changes, that the second source is better modelled as a responsive causal
process, and whether that discovery correctly discounts prior inferences drawn from the
second source's earlier (pre-discovery) outputs. Later stages could progressively add
goal-directed competition, cooperation, signalling, teaching, concealment, and deception --
but the minimal test does not require sophisticated deception, only conditional
responsiveness.

MECH-025.subject: cognitive_modes.action_doing_precision
MECH-025.title: Action mode prioritizes short-horizon, high-precision control via context-dependent precision modulation.
MECH-025.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a fair test requires (a) the three instrument defects fixed for V3-EXQ-876 to stay fixed (SelectionResult.committed read, not the stale cache; agent.update_residue() called every eval tick so running_variance is live; well-sampled committed AND uncommitted windows, non-degenerate per seed) AND (b) the doing-mode-delta DV re-operationalized so a negative/null result can be trusted as real rather than an artifact. V3-EXQ-876 (2026-08-02) cleared (a) cleanly but its DV choice is now suspect on two grounds from the claim's own literature: Friston 2013 records precision as continuous, not a discrete mode switch, while the harm- counterfactual-gap DV tests a discrete committed-vs-uncommitted split; and Thura & Cisek 2014 predicts CONVERGENCE (narrowing) of premotor/M1 representations during commitment -- the opposite sign from what the DV's C1 criterion assumed. A valid re-operationalization must capture context-dependent precision modulation during genuinely committed episodes without conflating it with a downstream harm- differentiation proxy whose predicted sign the claim's own literature disputes -- either by testing the reversed sign directly, or by gating on precision itself (precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean, already recorded in V3-EXQ-876 and separating by 4-5 orders of magnitude in every seed, but never scored as a criterion).

FALSIFYING: even after a GENUINE re-operationalization (not a re-run of the same DV), the result stays flat or wrong-signed under the same non-degenerate preconditions -- this is now a REAL falsification, not a second measurement-defect pass. MECH-025 has already used one "instrument defect, not evidence against" exemption (V3-EXQ-876); a second wrong-sign or null result after the DV itself has been changed to address the sign-mismatch critique should be read as real claim pressure. Distinguish "still a DV problem" from "now genuinely falsified" by whether the new DV's own positive-control gates (precision separation, or whichever direct signal the redesign gates on) clear cleanly: if they clear and the predicted relationship still fails, that is falsification; if the gates themselves fail to clear, that is a substrate/instrument problem warranting a genuine third fix, not accepting the null.

FALSIFYING: once built, the regulator either finds no stable non-maximal optimum (sensitivity and restraint trade off linearly/monotonically), or the tuned regime shows sensitivity and restraint are not actually coupled the way the claim predicts.

MECH-031.title: Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.
MECH-031.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires reliable object persistence/
binding to exist (an entity must be trackable as a stable target
before AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tags can attach to it -- see
entities_and_binding.md) and the derived tags must show non-zero
cross-condition variance -- an agent that tags everything or nothing
as OTHER_SELFLIKE cannot discriminate the mechanism.
CONFIRMING signature: the agent correctly discriminates interveners
from passive dynamics (AGENCY tag) using only the existing
self/world/impact machinery -- no dedicated social-cognition module
-- and assigns OTHER_SELFLIKE probability that tracks whether a
target genuinely runs a self/world-separation and self-impact loop
(higher for agents exhibiting boundary-maintaining, error-correcting
behaviour; lower for passive/mechanical dynamics). Downstream empathy
coupling (MECH-036's other-harm veto threshold, gated by
lambda_empathy/v_other_veto) should then correctly scale with
OTHER_SELFLIKE probability -- higher-confidence targets produce
stronger empathy coupling.
FALSIFYING: AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tags require a dedicated
social-cognition module to reproduce (the reused self/world/impact
machinery is insufficient) -- falsifies the "derived, not separate
module" framing; or OTHER_SELFLIKE probability does not track genuine
self-model possession (e.g. equally high for a scripted NPC with no
self/world loop as for a genuinely self-modelling agent) -- falsifies
the tag as measuring the intended construct rather than a confound
such as mere movement complexity.

MECH-032.subject: social.other_selflike_high_recall_bias

MECH-032.what_would_answer:

Confirmed absent as of 2026-08-08: grep of ree_core/ for "OTHER_SELFLIKE"/"self_like"/"selflike" returns zero matches anywhere in ree-v3 -- MECH-031 (the base tagging mechanism this claim qualifies) has no implementation, and its own prerequisite ARC-010 (social cognition/mirror modelling) is confirmed unimplemented and gated to implementation_phase v5.
CONFIRMING: on a held-out set of ambiguous/borderline stimuli, the classifier's false-positive rate on ambiguous non-self-like stimuli is measurably higher than its false-negative rate on ambiguous self-like stimuli, AND this asymmetry is traceable to an explicit, inspectable threshold/weighting choice.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): the classifier's decision threshold is symmetric or unbiased; OR the threshold is biased the OTHER way, favoring precision; OR there is no tunable decision boundary at all; OR the claimed bias exists only as an unenforced code comment/design note with no measurable effect.

MECH-035.subject: valence.vector_ranking
MECH-035.title: VALENCE is vector-valued and ranked without scalar collapse.
MECH-035.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the named VALENCE component
streams (HOMEOSTASIS, HARM, TEMPORAL_COHERENCE, SELF_IMPACT error,
option volume, inferred other welfare) to be independently
computable per candidate trajectory and to show non-zero
cross-candidate variance on at least two components simultaneously
-- a scenario where only one component ever varies (the others are
flat or degenerate) cannot distinguish vector-valued ranking from a
scalar collapsed onto that one live component, and should
self-route substrate_not_ready rather than count as a verdict. No
prior experimental run has targeted this claim as of 2026-08-06; a
first test is establishing evidence, not re-litigating a null.
CONFIRMING signature: trajectory selection outcomes are explained
by constraint-first / Pareto-or-lexicographic comparison over the
component vector -- i.e. there exist candidate pairs where no
single scalar combination (weighted sum, fixed linear blend) of the
components reproduces the system's ranking, but a
dominance/lexicographic rule over the raw vector does; and
trajectories that are dominated on one stream (e.g. higher HARM)
are rejected even when a competing scalar-weighted blend would
prefer them for gains elsewhere (e.g. higher option volume).
FALSIFYING: the observed rankings are fully reproducible by some
fixed scalar weighting of the component streams (i.e. a single
linear or monotonic combination fits the choice behaviour as well
as the vector/Pareto rule does) -- this would indicate VALENCE is
functioning as a de facto scalar reward regardless of its vector
representation, and would refute the "no scalar collapse" claim
even if the underlying data structure remains vector-shaped.

MECH-036.subject: social.other_harm_veto_threshold
MECH-036.title: Other-harm triggers veto only under high-certainty catastrophic outcomes.
MECH-036.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: Requires (1) a functioning OTHER_SELFLIKE / other-agent detection substrate (MECH-031, gated on ARC-010 -> ARC-047's SocialGridWorld, implementation_phase v4; confirmed zero hits for "OTHER_SELFLIKE"/"self_like"/"selflike" anywhere under ree_core/ as of 2026-08-08) actually instantiated and producing a distinguishable "other" tag for cost/veto logic to condition on, and (2) a discrete hard-veto/action-block primitive -- as opposed to REE's existing continuous PE-weighted control-demand signal (E2_harm_a/E2_harm_s -> dACC, or a MECH-127-style soft other_cost_loss term) -- gated on a certainty x severity threshold. Confirmed: no "veto"/"hard_block" harm logic and no v_other_veto/lambda_empathy parameters exist anywhere in ree_core/ today, for self- or other-directed harm.
CONFIRMING: In SocialGridWorld (or equivalent), with OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging live, instantiate a threshold-gated hard veto that fires only when predicted-other-harm certainty exceeds a high threshold AND predicted severity is catastrophic/irreversible, while lower-certainty/severity predictions instead lower rank without exclusion. Confirming pattern: catastrophic-high-certainty trials show a hard behavioral floor (veto-eligible actions selected at ~0%) qualitatively discontinuous from low-certainty trials, where the same actions are selected at reduced but nonzero frequency.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (1) the "veto" and "ranking" pathways behave identically (collapses into MECH-127-style soft coupling only); (2) a hard veto fires on low-certainty/non-catastrophic predictions (over-triggering); (3) high-certainty catastrophic other-harm produces no hard behavioral floor even after extended training (under-triggering); (4) the same threshold-veto behavior emerges from self-harm-only signals with no distinguishable "other" representation (falsifies social-specificity).

MECH-037.subject: provenance.papez_like_reality_filtering
MECH-037.title: Papez-like loop provides provenance gating and reality filtering.
MECH-037.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) E1-generated candidate content,
(b) a hippocampal trace / temporal-ordering signal, and (c) the E3
commitment decision to each be separately instrumented and measurable,
with the trace/ordering signal varying (present vs absent/weak) across
conditions rather than held constant -- a run where every candidate
carries the same trace support cannot discriminate a working provenance
gate from no gate at all. This claim currently has no V3 substrate or
experiment built against it (no runs, no evidence_quality_note on file);
a run attempting to test it before the provenance-gating pathway
(hippocampal trace signal -> precision down-weighting -> E3 commitment
licensing) actually exists in the substrate should self-route
substrate_not_ready rather than count as a null result.
CONFIRMING signature: E1 content lacking hippocampal trace / temporal-
ordering support is measurably held at lower precision and is licensed
for E3 commitment at a lower rate than trace-supported content of
comparable quality; and degrading or disabling the gate (removing the
trace/ordering signal's influence on precision/commitment) produces a
measurable increase in high-confidence commitments of ungrounded
content -- i.e. confabulation-like failures track gate integrity in the
predicted direction. The gate should amplify/suppress candidate
trajectories without minting authority writes (POL/ID/CAPS) or
bypassing E3/verifier commit checks; a version that achieves filtering
only by bypassing the verifier would not confirm this claim's specific
mechanism.
FALSIFYING: E1 content commits to E3 at similar rates and precision
regardless of hippocampal trace / temporal-ordering support (the
presence or absence of provenance signal has no measurable effect on
commitment eligibility); or disabling/degrading the gate produces no
measurable increase in high-confidence, ungrounded commitments relative
to the gate-intact condition -- either would falsify the "Papez-like
loop functions as a provenance gate / reality filter" framing and
suggest hippocampal trace signals are not actually operating as a
commitment gate in REE's implementation, whatever role they may play
elsewhere.

MECH-039.subject: control_plane.channel_mode_landscape
MECH-039.title: Modes are stable regions in control-channel space, not separate modules.
MECH-039.what_would_answer:

(arousal baseline/volatility, action readiness/motor gating,
precision/gain routing, commitment threshold/interruptibility,
replay/learning scheduling, hard veto/interrupt threshold) to be
independently measurable and to show non-zero cross-condition
variance -- a run where all channels move in lockstep cannot
discriminate "stable region in a continuous space" from "discrete
module."
CONFIRMING signature: named modes (task-engaged, default-mode-like,
emergency) correspond to distinct, STABLE clusters/regions in the
joint channel space (e.g. task-engaged = high readiness + elevated
precision; default-mode-like = low readiness + high replay + low
precision; emergency = high arousal + high readiness + high veto),
with transitions between modes traceable as a CONTINUOUS trajectory
through channel space (gradual co-movement of the relevant channels)
rather than an instantaneous discrete flag flip -- EXCEPT for
hard-veto interrupts, which this claim's own text predicts should
look like a fast, forced transition overriding the rest of the
channel state.
FALSIFYING: the named "modes" do not correspond to any stable
clustering in channel space (channel values wander freely without
forming recognisable regions); or transitions between modes are
measurably instantaneous/discrete across ALL channels simultaneously
(indistinguishable from a one-hot module switch) rather than showing
channel-by-channel graded movement -- would falsify the "continuous
space, not separate modules" framing and support a discrete-module
reading instead.

MECH-040.subject: control_plane.safety_baseline_volatility
MECH-040.title: Safety baseline and volatility are distinct control channels for arousal/readiness.
MECH-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the test window must exercise BOTH SD-037's sustained_threat signal and Q-007's volatility_estimate through genuinely INDEPENDENT manipulations -- a sustained low-magnitude harm floor (moves sustained_threat, holds PE variance flat) crossed factorially with a bursty/oscillating PE regime (moves volatility_estimate, holds z_harm mean flat). Both use_phasic_burst and the SD-037 broadcast-override regulator must be enabled -- both are bit-identical OFF by default.
CONFIRMING: the two channels show distinguishable downstream footprints -- a low-sustained-threat/high-volatility cell moves volatility-driven consumers (SD-069 burst envelope, softmax temperature) while leaving override_signal/freeze-gate near baseline, and the mirror-image pattern for the reverse cell. A combined cell should show a non-strictly-multiplicative combination consistent with the claim's "OR" framing. Would extend MECH-063 sub-claim ii's already-landed tonic/phasic dissociation to this axis pair.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): the two manipulations produce statistically indistinguishable downstream footprints -- driving either signal moves the same consumers, with no channel-selective effect. Would indicate the substrate's nominally separate computations collapse onto a single "how bad is it right now" scalar -- effectively the conflated threat-level scalar MECH-040 was written to rule out.
Provenance note: MECH-104 is the already-active, PASS-tested narrower sibling covering only the volatility-triggers-de-commitment sub-mechanism; MECH-040 is the general channel-separation claim and remains untested on the sustained-threat side.

MECH-041.subject: social.affective_expression_mode_broadcast
MECH-041.title: Affective expression broadcasts control-plane regime to reduce social prediction load.
MECH-041.what_would_answer:

Neither exists in the current V3 substrate: confirmed, no "social", "mirror", "other_agent", "scent", or broadcast-channel implementation anywhere under ree_core/ beyond acknowledging comments. The one place this channel is even specified is ARC-047's seven scent fields, built explicitly to implement MECH-041 -- and ARC-047 is itself candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5, unbuilt.
CONFIRMING (once ARC-047 lands): a receiving agent's OTHER_SELFLIKE-tagged inference of another agent's control-plane regime converges faster/more accurately when the emitting agent's scent channels are active/observable than when suppressed or randomized.
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): even after ARC-047 exists, suppressing/randomizing the scent channels produces no measurable degradation in prediction accuracy; OR receiving agents show no differential use of scent-channel information relative to a no-scent control.
Currently blocked, not testable: no multi-agent environment, no expression/scent channel, and no other-agent latent/inference machinery exist in the V3 substrate.

For the behavioral half, the misallocation manipulation must produce a measurable shift in a hallucination-like DV under matched-RNG, non-degenerate readiness preconditions.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (i) the computation incorporates signed/valence information; (ii) precision weighting collapses into a scalar reward objective; (iii) misallocation of this channel (isolated from ARC-108/109 and MECH-054) produces no measurable shift in any hallucination-like DV across a real non-degenerate sweep; (iv) the effect is fully explained by a shared/general precision-scale parameter also governing MECH-054's signed channels identically, with no functional dissociation demonstrable.

has its OWN precondition and its OWN confirmed-not-yet-testable history;
do not conflate a result on one leg with a verdict on the other.
Leg (a) precondition: requires mu driven from UPSTREAM environmental
state (via PCCAnalog), not direct injection -- "entropy falls as mu

(asserted by the contract tests as wiring, not evidence). V3-EXQ-799
already did this correctly and confirmed the mechanism fires (mode-prior
entropy moves with mu, non-degenerate), but found a SEPARATE gap: no
behavioural DV downstream of the entropy shift currently has enough
sensitivity to detect it (write_gate breadth issue, routed to

consumer path reproduces V3-EXQ-799's C1/C2 FAIL and is not a fresh test
-- it should self-route substrate_not_ready/competence_implementation_gap
until the write_gate fix lands.
Leg (b) precondition: requires the contested modes to actually be
occupied. V3-EXQ-464b/464c/467d/464d all FAIL with
fraction_in_external_task=0.0 at every seed across a 20x hysteresis
sweep -- switching pressure cannot be measured on a mode that is never
entered. This is a distinct, separate /implement-substrate build from

CONFIRMING signature: once the write_gate/consumer-path fix lands (leg a)

switching pressure shows no response to mu/kappa once modes are occupied
(leg b) -- either would mean the confirmed internal mechanism (entropy
genuinely shifts with mu) does not convert to any measurable behavioural

consequence even though its internal wiring is confirmed correct.
