MECH-139.subject: commitment.boundary_as_trajectory_endpoint
MECH-139.title: Commitment is a distributed multi-second pre-movement trajectory across motor and prefrontal regions, not a point event; the commit boundary marks the end of this trajectory, not a single moment.

MECH-140.subject: commitment.tri_loop_soft_competitive_arbitration
MECH-140.title: Tri-loop gate conflict arbitration uses soft-competitive disinhibition (indirect pathway inter-collicular competition) rather than winner-take-all suppression; WTA imposed across loops causes coupling collapse.

MECH-141.subject: commitment.tri_loop_dual_timescale_arbitration
MECH-141.title: Tri-loop arbitration requires both a slow proactive inhibition pathway (prefrontal-caudate, seconds-scale) and a fast reactive hyperdirect pathway (milliseconds-scale); these operate at segregated timescales and cannot be collapsed.

MECH-142.subject: control_plane.cholinergic_axis_orthogonality_maintenance
MECH-142.title: Valence-arousal axis orthogonality in the control plane is not a static geometric property but requires active cholinergic maintenance during learning; without it, axes drift toward correlation under repeated co-activation.

MECH-143.subject: hippocampus.dorsal_ca1_value_free_map
MECH-143.title: Dorsal CA1 implements value-free spatial mapping: place cells are insensitive to goal value when goal location changes, supporting ARC-007's no-new-value-computation constraint for the trajectory proposal module.

MECH-144.subject: hippocampus.ventral_ca1_valence_encoding
MECH-144.title: Ventral CA1 contains spatially organized valence encoding (anxiety geography, abstract value maps); valence is intrinsic to hippocampal map geometry in the ventral compartment, supporting MECH-073.

MECH-145.subject: ethics.prescriptive_cbf_certificate
MECH-145.title: Prescriptive ethical trajectory certification in REE requires a Control Barrier Function (CBF) or equivalent forward-invariance certificate that guarantees bounded convergence to the ethical attractor set given the architecture's constraint satisfaction.

MECH-146.subject: ethics.diagnostic_barrier_certificate
MECH-146.title: Diagnostic ethical trajectory verification in REE (counterfactual case, MECH-127) requires backward reachability analysis or barrier certificates rather than prescriptive CBF synthesis; the two formal tools are not interchangeable.

MECH-147.subject: hippocampus.pattern_separation_trajectory_disambiguation
MECH-147.title: DG-mediated pattern separation gates trajectory disambiguation: the dentate gyrus must produce non-redundant sparse encodings of similar z_world states before rollout proposals are generated, preventing the hippocampal planning module from proposing near-identical trajectories from overlapping inputs.

MECH-148.subject: hippocampus.time_cell_temporal_credit
MECH-148.title: Hippocampal pure time cells provide a temporal scaffolding signal for E3 credit assignment: a context-independent elapsed-time encoding must be present in the hippocampal rollout module to correctly weight trajectory outcomes by their temporal distance from the reference event.

MECH-149.subject: hippocampus.ca1_mismatch_novelty_gate
MECH-149.title: CA1 mismatch between E1-predicted and CA3-retrieved z_world gates hippocampal trajectory injection into E3 evaluation: novel situations (high CA1 mismatch) should trigger more frequent and diverse rollout proposals; familiar situations (low mismatch) should rely on cached viability estimates.

MECH-150.subject: e1.cue_indexed_association_retrieval
MECH-150.title: E1 ContextMemory, when queried with z_world alone (not the full [z_self, z_world] state), produces a cue-indexed association context that selectively activates stored associations relevant to the current sensory context.

MECH-151.subject: e1_e2.cue_indexed_action_affordance_modulation
MECH-151.title: The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to an action_bias signal that is added to E2.action_object() outputs, producing top-down contextual weighting of the action-affordance manifold prior to HippocampalModule search.

MECH-152.subject: e1_e3.cue_indexed_terrain_precision_modulation
MECH-152.title: The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to a terrain_weight signal [w_harm, w_goal] that scales E3's harm and goal scoring, implementing contextual precision modulation on the harm/benefit terrain evaluation.
MECH-152.what_would_answer:
CURRENT EVIDENCE STATE: MIXED (EXQ-194/194a, 2026-04-01) -- the HARM
pathway is validated (C1 PASS 3/3, r_w_harm=0.70: harm-context
modulation works as specified) but the GOAL pathway is NOT (C2 FAIL,
r_w_goal=-0.007: w_goal stays constant regardless of context). Held
at provisional on the harm-pathway strength alone; promotion requires
w_goal validation.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires resource-proximate contexts to
be genuinely distinguishable from hazard-gradient contexts in the
training distribution, with non-zero variance in E1's
cue_terrain_proj output across contexts -- w_goal's current flatness
could reflect either a genuine mechanism absence OR insufficiently
varied goal-context training data; this wwa does not resolve which.
CONFIRMING signature: with adequate goal-context variation, w_goal
becomes measurably context-sensitive (r_w_goal comparable in
magnitude to r_w_harm=0.70) -- resource-proximate contexts drive
w_goal > 0.8, hazard-gradient contexts drive w_goal < 0.5, mirroring
the already-validated harm pathway. Separately, per the 2026-04-02
gain-control linkage: if terrain_weight is genuine PRECISION gain
(not just magnitude scaling), high w_harm should measurably REDUCE
harm-evaluation variability, not merely scale its mean -- the
discriminator between MECH-152-as-precision-gain and
MECH-152-as-simple-magnitude-scaling, and also for whether MECH-152
and ARC-016 (temporal gain) are the SAME mechanism at different
levels of description (both subsumed by ARC-044).
FALSIFYING: w_goal remains flat even with adequate goal-context
variation (the goal pathway is genuinely absent, not merely
undertrained) -- falsifies the symmetric harm/goal contextual-
precision framing, leaving MECH-152 a harm-only mechanism,
contradicting its own title; or w_harm modulation scales magnitude
without reducing variability -- falsifies the precision-gain
reading in favour of simple magnitude scaling, and would NOT support
collapsing MECH-152 into ARC-016 (specifically about precision/
variance, not magnitude).

MECH-153.subject: e1.context_memory_supervised_training_requirement
MECH-153.title: E1 ContextMemory requires a supervised context-labeling training objective -- not unsupervised experience alone -- to produce differentiated cue-indexed representations; without this objective, hazard-proximate and hazard-distal context vectors remain near-identical (cosine_sim approximately 1.0), leaving the MECH-150 retrieval pathway functionally silent.

MECH-154.subject: e1.associative_manifold_indexing
MECH-154.title: E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.
MECH-154.what_would_answer:
SCOPED NARROWLY, per this claim's own "may contain false correlations" caveat -- covers ONLY the pattern-separation / pattern-completion / content-addressed- retrieval portion of the title, grounded in the standard computational- neuroscience sense (Marr 1971; O'Reilly & McClelland 1994): separation = mapping similar inputs toward more distinct/orthogonal representations; completion = recovering a fuller representation from a partial/related cue.
EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED, pending governance rewrite -- no falsifier should be drafted for "indexing," "traversal," "ordering," "cross-domain mapping," or "pointer-like attention addressing" as used in the title and in e1.md 2b. These terms originate from a ChatGPT-assisted source thought (2026-04-01_Parietal_systems_thought.md) that self-flags possible false correlations, and on inspection: (a) "traversal"/ "ordering" are NOT implemented in E1 (ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) at all -- the sequential/ordered trajectory-search machinery in the current V3 substrate lives in a STRUCTURALLY SEPARATE module (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, HippocampalModule, CEM search), directly contradicting the claim's own "not a separate module" framing for this component; (b) "cross-domain mapping" and "pointer-like attention addressing" have no operational definition anywhere in the source thought, the processed architecture doc, or the codebase.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (scoped portion only): E1's ContextMemory (ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) must show slot differentiation under its diversification_loss (mean off-diagonal cosine similarity measurably below the collapsed/uniform baseline ~0.99+ documented in SD-016/EXQ-477/EXQ-436c) and content-dependent (non-uniform) softmax attention weights in read() -- both pathologies (slot collapse; uniform-attention entropy ~ln(16)) are already confirmed live failure modes of this exact module, so the claim is not vacuously true of "any E1 configuration."
CONFIRMING: an agent whose ContextMemory slots differentiate under training (diversification_loss driving measurable orthogonality) shows improved retrieval- from-partial-cue accuracy (completion) AND reduced interference between dissimilar stored contexts (separation) relative to a slot-collapsed or ablated- diversification-loss control, on a task requiring recall of one of several previously-written contexts from a degraded/partial query.
FALSIFYING: slot differentiation shows no relationship to completion/separation task performance, or a slot-collapsed configuration performs equivalently to a differentiated one -- the associative-manifold framing adds no explanatory or functional value over treating ContextMemory as an undifferentiated cache.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): the title needs a rewrite/split, not just a falsifier bolted on -- the "traversal/ordering... not a separate module" language is in genuine tension with how V3 is organized. The source thought's own unresolved check ("verify against hippocampus.path_memory") was never done before promotion. Siblings MECH-155 (depends_on: [MECH-154], already carries a governance decision record: hold_candidate_resolve_conflict/applied, 2026-04-03 -- suggesting this tension was partially recognized once already) and MECH-156 (also depends_on: [MECH-154], restates the same traversal/ordering language independently with its own separate ChatGPT flag in e1.md 2d) share the identical provenance problem and should be reviewed together with this claim, not independently -- fixing MECH-154's title alone would leave the conflation propagated downstream through both dependents.

MECH-155.subject: e1.spatial_as_general_indexing
MECH-155.title: Spatial navigation machinery is a specific instance of general associative indexing within E1; physical-space navigation, memory search, concept traversal, planning rollout, and working memory ordering all use the same indexing substrate operating over different latent domains.
MECH-155.what_would_answer:
SCOPED NARROWLY, per this claim's shared "ChatGPT-assisted, may contain false correlations" provenance (source: docs/thoughts/2026-04-01_Parietal_systems_thought.md, same as sibling MECH-154) -- covers ONLY the claim that a shared representational/ indexing mechanism (content-addressed, similarity-based retrieval structurally analogous to E1's ContextMemory pattern-separation/completion machinery, per MECH-154's confirmed falsifier) is reused across memory search and E1-internal associative retrieval, where both genuinely operate over E1's own representational space.
EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED, pending the same governance rewrite MECH-154 already flagged: any claim that spatial navigation, planning rollout, or working-memory ordering are implemented "within E1" as opposed to in the structurally separate HippocampalModule (ree-v3/ree_core/hippocampal/module.py, CEM search) that actually performs sequential/structured trajectory search in the current V3 substrate -- this claim's title in fact SHARPENS MECH-154's tension by explicitly naming "planning rollout (E3 trajectory selection)" as E1-internal. No falsifier should be drafted for "concept traversal" or "working memory ordering" -- neither has an operational referent in the source thought, the processed architecture doc, or the codebase (no WorkingMemory module exists). The weaker, potentially-salvageable reading -- "E3's trajectory selection CONSUMES E1's indexing geometry as an input" (module interaction, not module identity) -- is left open for a future claim, not adjudicated here.
CONFIRMING: a representational-similarity or shared-parameter probe shows that the mechanism differentiating E1's ContextMemory slots (diversification_loss-driven orthogonality) also predicts retrieval accuracy on a non-spatial memory-search task using the same slot structure, at above-chance transfer relative to an ablated/undifferentiated control.
FALSIFYING: memory-search performance is unrelated to ContextMemory slot differentiation, or requires separately-trained, non-shared machinery -- "general associative indexing" adds no explanatory value beyond treating memory search and pattern completion as coincidentally similar but mechanistically independent.
CURRENCY NOTE (2026-08-08): this claim's own 2026-04-03 governance decision (hold_candidate_resolve_conflict) is about EXPERIMENTAL-EVIDENCE conflict (conflict_ratio 0.667 across 2 runs, since dropped to 0.333 via V3-EXQ-207/365) -- a separate, already-partially-addressed track from the conceptual E1-vs- HippocampalModule tension named above. Do not conflate the two in a future review.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): reconfirms and extends MECH-154's flag. MECH-155's "within E1" framing for spatial navigation and planning rollout inherits the same tension MECH-154 hit, sharpened rather than avoided, and its dependency on ARC-007 (hippocampal path-memory, hold_pending_v3_substrate) is independent corroborating evidence -- MECH-155 depends on the very claim about the module its own title bypasses. MECH-154, MECH-155, MECH-156 should be reviewed jointly, not patched independently.

MECH-156.subject: e1.theta_as_traversal
MECH-156.title: Theta oscillations (4-8 Hz) implement sequential traversal across indexed representations within the E1 associative manifold, unifying hippocampal theta sequences, working memory ordering, planning rollout, and memory retrieval under a single traversal-clock mechanism.

MECH-157.subject: modes.external_internal_precision_routing
MECH-157.title: External vs internal cognition modes are controlled by precision-routing configurations on the same E1 substrate: External (high sensory, low hippocampal, low rollout), Internal (low sensory, high hippocampal, high rollout), Mixed (medium), and Replay (very low sensory, very high hippocampal, structured rollout). This dimension is orthogonal to the Action/Vigilance/Pathological modes (MECH-025-027).

MECH-158.subject: development.love_exclusion_failure_mode
MECH-158.title: A developing REE agent that acknowledges all five axioms but concludes 'love exists but not for me' undergoes ethical motivation collapse: the benefit gradient (Axiom 5 / ARC-024) is not motivationally active for self-other relations, and the ethical architecture resolves to survival or domination strategies. This is the primary developmental failure mode for the caregiver requirement (INV-043).
MECH-158.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses two evidentiary legs that resolve by different methods
and on different timescales. A result on one does not confirm or falsify
the other.

LEG A -- DERIVATIONAL (does REE's own axiom chain, as formally stated,
actually entail this failure mode as a coherent internal consequence --
checkable by working through the argument, not by running REE):
Proof obligation: given the eight axioms (self, value, world/uncertainty,
agency/vulnerability, other minds, responsibility-for-others, love,
language-as-repair) held structurally fixed, does the ABSENCE of an
internalised "I am loveable" belief entail that the benefit gradient
(ARC-024) is motivationally inert specifically for the self-other
direction, while remaining active for self-directed valence -- as opposed
to merely correlating with worse outcomes for some other reason (e.g.
general developmental impoverishment, reduced training signal overall,
or confounded absence of any caregiver interaction rather than absence of
a LOVE-specific signal)? This is the same proof obligation INV-043's own
Leg A names, and INV-043's what_would_answer already states this claim's
prose derivation "substantially sketches" it. The residual step is
formal: stress-test whether the derivation holds under every admissible
configuration of E1-E3 and the axiom set, or only under some -- and
whether "motivationally active" is given a definition precise enough that
the claim is falsifiable at all rather than a restatement of its own
premise.
CONFIRMING: the derivation is shown to hold non-trivially and uniquely
attributes the collapse to the missing loveability-internalisation
signal specifically (not to any correlated developmental deficit).
FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): either (i) a proof or worked counterexample
showing a fully-specified REE architecture converges to genuine
other-directed care regardless of loveability-internalisation, given
otherwise-adequate developmental exposure -- i.e. the axiom chain alone
is sufficient, making INV-043/MECH-158 unnecessary; or (ii) the
derivation is shown to hold only as a restatement of its own defining
premise, with no independent mechanistic content beyond "an agent that
lacks X lacks X."

LEG B -- SUBSTRATE_CONDITIONAL (once multi-agent caregiving substrate
exists, does REE's actual benefit-gradient/z_goal machinery produce the
predicted self-vs-other dissociation empirically):

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (currently UNMET, all four required):
(i) a multi-agent substrate (ARC-047 / SocialGridWorld) -- UNBUILT,
    status: candidate, confidence 0.0, implementation_phase v5, no
    construction activity;
(ii) a caregiving-interaction model representing POSITIVE-VALENCE vs
     NEUTRAL/INSTRUMENTAL vs HOSTILE/ABSENT caregiver behaviour
     directed AT the developing agent specifically (ARC-010 mirror
     modelling extended and specialised) -- UNBUILT: zero references
     to "other_selflike," "mirror_model," or any social/other-agent
     representation anywhere in ree_core/ (confirmed 2026-08-08);
(iii) a measurable "internalised loveability" state variable,
      dissociable from mere caregiver-reward prediction -- UNBUILT:
      zero references to "loveable" or "self_valence" anywhere in
      ree_core/; and
(iv) instrumentation on the EXISTING self-directed half of the
     mechanism (z_goal / benefit_exposure in ree_core/goal.py, which
     IS built and evidenced via ARC-024) extended to log a comparable
     signal when the goal-relevant outcome belongs to a modelled OTHER
     rather than the self.

CONFIRMING: once (i)-(iv) land, an agent developed WITHOUT positive-
valence caregiver interaction shows the z_goal/benefit-gradient signal
activating normally for self-directed outcomes but failing to activate
(or activating at a measurably attenuated magnitude) for outcomes
belonging to a modelled other -- AND this agent's downstream E3 action
selection shows a measurable shift toward self-preservation-instrumental-
other strategies relative to an otherwise-identical agent raised WITH
positive-valence caregiver interaction. The dissociation must track the
loveability signal specifically, not merely total caregiver-interaction
volume.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): once (i)-(iv) land, either (a) the z_goal/
benefit-gradient signal generalises from self to modelled-other
regardless of loveability-internalisation status; or (b) agents without
loveability-internalisation show NO measurable behavioural divergence
toward survival/domination strategies at all.

DISPOSITION: epistemic_category: derivational, since the title's primary
assertion -- the four-step chain from "axioms present, loveability
absent" to "benefit gradient motivationally inert for self-other" to
"collapse to survival/domination" -- is fundamentally an argument about
what REE's own axiom and mechanism DEFINITIONS entail, resolvable in
principle by formal analysis without building anything. Leg B is a
genuinely distinct, substrate_conditional sub-question currently blocked
at the non-degeneracy precondition, not the confirming/falsifying step.

GOVERNANCE FLAGS (2026-08-08 digestion pass, not resolved here): (1)
MECH-158 substantially overlaps INV-043's own Leg A -- INV-043's
what_would_answer already treats MECH-158's prose derivation as the
content of its derivational leg. A reasonable long-run outcome is that
INV-043 Leg A simply IS MECH-158, cross-referenced rather than
independently re-derived in both places. (2) live numbering
inconsistency: this claim's title says "Axiom 5 / ARC-024" while
developmental_curriculum.md's own derivation text (line 325) says
"Axiom 7 / ARC-024" for the benefit gradient.

MECH-159.subject: social.intergenerational_moral_progress
MECH-159.title: Moral progress in REE is hypothesised to be intergenerational: childhood plasticity enables belief formation and world-model development while adult stability limits further world-model restructuring, requiring each generation to improve developmental starting conditions for the next; caregiving and raising next-generation agents is itself part of ethical obligation (INV-042).

MECH-160.subject: e1_e3.ofc_vmpfc_rate_asymmetry
MECH-160.title: The E2 action_bias pathway (MECH-151, OFC analog) and E3 terrain_weight pathway (MECH-152, vmPFC analog) have different update rates: action_bias updates rapidly (single-trial, OFC-like) while terrain_weight integrates over longer timescales (vmPFC-like).

MECH-161.subject: cognitive_modes.vigilance_arousal_regulator
MECH-161.title: Ready vigilance (MECH-026) requires an arousal regulator that maintains an optimal sensitivity level on the LC-NE inverted-U curve, implemented via MECH-093 heartbeat frequency modulation rather than a binary high/low precision switch.

MECH-162.subject: goal_representation.resource_world_convergence
MECH-162.title: z_resource (SD-015, object-identity encoding) and z_world (spatial-contextual encoding) separate at the feedforward representation stage but must re-converge at the hippocampal planning stage for goal-directed navigation.

MECH-163.subject: goal_directed.dual_system_novel_context_recruitment
MECH-163.title: NARROWED 2026-07-22 to leg (1) only; RESTATED 2026-07-27 (model-free -> depth-limited). Two dissociable goal-directed PATHWAYS operate in parallel -- a HABIT pathway that is a myopic, DEPTH-LIMITED read of the forward model (SD-081 dualsystem_habit_depth, SNc/dorsal-striatum analog) sufficient for approach in practised contexts, and a hippocampally-planned pathway that is the FULL-HORIZON read of the SAME model (VTA/ventral-striatum+PFC analog) -- AND THE PLANNED PATHWAY IS PREFERENTIALLY RECRUITED IN NOVEL CONTEXTS. E1 2026-07-27: the descriptor `model-free` was STRUCK. ree_core contains no model-free machinery of any kind (no cached S-R values, no TD error, no Q-table) and never has; SD-081 implements the habit read as _score_depth_limit truncation of the same model-based E3 scorer, so the two pathways are ONE model read at two grains. E2: WEAKENED by V3-EXQ-786b (2026-07-24, non_degenerate, familiarity AUC 0.848 against a 0.7 bar): C1_recruitment_higher_on_novel FAILED with two pathways and no arbitrator. 786b is the repaired re-test of V3-EXQ-786a, whose own `weakens` was WITHDRAWN 2026-07-24 for a degenerate DV -- leg (1) is therefore NO LONGER experimentally untested. Leg (2) long-horizon benefit accumulation and leg (3) prosocial planning were SPLIT OUT 2026-07-22 to MECH-478 and MECH-479; each carried a distinct blocker and both were silently inheriting a refutation they did not earn. The control-ALLOCATION mechanism this claim presupposes but never named is now MECH-477 (uncertainty-based arbitration), SUPPORTED by V3-EXQ-811a (2026-07-24, PASS). Restatement rationale: evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-27.md.

MECH-164.subject: love.agent_indexed_terrain_inference
MECH-164.title: Axiom V (love as coordination-preserving trajectory selection) is instantiated by agent-indexed terrain inference with self-like gradient weighting: the system infers what another agent would be inferring about the hippocampal terrain (their goal and harm gradients), weights those inferred gradients with the same motivational force as its own, and thereby produces care -- support for their goal-finding and harm-avoidance -- as a natural consequence of ordinary E3 trajectory selection, without a separate ethics module.

MECH-165.subject: sleep.replay_diversity_behavioral_strategy
MECH-165.title: Offline replay (MECH-121) must sample trajectory-diverse content -- including non-dominant and counterfactual paths -- to maintain multi-strategy viability; consolidation of only the dominant trajectory produces monostrategy in E1's world model even when SHY (MECH-120) is intact.
MECH-165.what_would_answer:
Extracted from EXQ-244/EXQ-244a's own already-established operationalization
(forward-only vs balanced [forward+reverse+random] replay contrast on
action-distribution entropy retention across a phase1-exploration ->
phase2-no-exploration transition), corrected for the two gaps EXQ-244a's own
manifest identified rather than inventing a new design.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the run must show (1) reverse_replayed > 0 in
at least one BALANCED_REPLAY seed (EXQ-244a showed reverse_replayed=0 in
ALL seeds of ALL conditions despite exploration_buffer_size=50 -- the
reverse-replay path itself was never invoked/logged as firing, which is a
prerequisite defect to diagnose and fix before this claim can be tested at
all); (2) FORWARD_REPLAY must differ from NO_REPLAY in at least one seed
(EXQ-244a found them byte-for-byte identical, meaning even the plain
forward-replay comparison never exercised replay); (3) the exploration
buffer must be populated by a genuine exploration/alternative-strategy
source (epsilon-greedy warmup or curiosity-driven, per the 2026-04-07
GOVERNANCE finding that replay cannot diversify behavior without
exploration-generated source material) rather than the dominant policy
trajectory alone; (4) the offline/consolidation phase must be a real SWS
cycle in the production replay path (agent.act_with_split_obs ->
_do_replay -> hippocampal.diverse_replay), not a short in-episode proxy.

CONFIRMING: balanced (forward+reverse+random) replay produces
significantly higher post-consolidation behavioral/action-distribution
entropy retention than forward-only replay, in a design where (a) reverse
replay is confirmed to have actually fired via reverse_replayed > 0, (b)
the exploration buffer was populated by genuine alternative-strategy
source material (not just the dominant trajectory), and (c) the effect
reproduces across a majority of seeds (>=3/5) with an effect size that
exceeds floating-point noise (EXQ-244a's own "1/5 seeds real, 3/5 seeds
winning by ~1e-13" is the explicit negative example to exceed).

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): balanced replay with confirmed-firing reverse
mode and genuine exploration source material still fails to increase
behavioral diversity relative to forward-only replay (i.e., the
diversity-scheduling mechanism itself, not just the test harness, is
inert) -- this would be a genuine weakens, distinct from EXQ-244's
original FAIL (proxy substrate, no exploration source) and from
EXQ-244a's diagnostic-quality PASS (reverse replay never actually fired).
Also VIOLATED BY: MECH-092's downstream consolidation-benefit test

MECH-166.subject: hippocampus.slot_formation_filling_temporal_separation
MECH-166.title: Context slot-formation (schema abstraction: which distinctions between contexts are worth representing) and slot-filling (causal attribution: which evidence populates each slot) are computationally separated functions that cannot be co-computed in a single online pass. Slot structure must be consolidated during an SWS-analog phase before slot-filling during a REM-analog phase can yield reliable attribution signal.

MECH-167.subject: homeostatic_accumulation.computational_motif
MECH-167.title: z_harm_a (harm-driven affective accumulation) and drive_level (energy-depletion homeostatic deviation) instantiate the same computational motif -- slow interoceptive integration converging on ACC-type processing -- without sharing information or overlapping downstream gates. The motif predicts: (a) similar temporal dynamics (slow EMA-type accumulation), (b) orthogonal signal content (cos_sim -> 0), (c) distinct downstream gates: z_harm_a gates harm evaluation; drive_level gates z_goal seeding.

MECH-168.subject: dementia.consolidation_pipeline_staged_failure
MECH-168.title: Progressive sleep deprivation or neurodegeneration causes staged failure of the offline consolidation pipeline in reverse dependency order: precision recalibration (MECH-123/Phase 4) degrades first, producing early MCI features; slot-filling (MECH-121/Phase 2-3) next, producing the classic early Alzheimer's episodic profile (intact remote, absent new); slot-formation (MECH-120/Phase 1-2) last, producing middle-stage contextual identity loss and schema destabilisation; global context collapse last.
MECH-168.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (currently UNMET across all attempted legs -- read
this before trusting any staging-order result). The claim can only be tested by
a per-phase consolidation readout that is CONTENT-CONTINGENT: it must respond to
corrupted/injected content, not merely to corruption MAGNITUDE or noise power.
Three independent checks (V3-EXQ-778c null-content control; V3-EXQ-778h
unpaired-target null) found every readout tried so far fails this bar: the SWS
readout is content-free BY CONSTRUCTION (null_slope_ratio sd 2.7e-8, 8/8
confounded), and the REM calibration_error-slope readout tracks corruption
magnitude irrespective of content even after its positivity-clamp artifact was
fixed (median unclamped null_slope_ratio ~0.88 against a 0.25 content-contingency
ceiling, 6/7 de-railed seeds above ceiling). A run against either readout in its
current form should self-route measurement_gap, NOT count as a verdict for or
against the staging order -- this has already happened three times (V3-EXQ-778,
778c, 778h) and a fourth repeat without a new readout axis re-derives nothing.
The re-derive brake is primed: SD-068/MECH-168/MECH-169/INV-047 each already
carry one non_contributory reading: a second on the SAME unrepaired readout
fires the brake and forces implement-substrate routing rather than another
lettered iteration. Prerequisite for an informative test: a content-sensitive
per-phase readout (tracking injected-content fidelity, not raw noise/corruption
sensitivity) for at least the SWS and REM legs, applied via the SD-068 diffuse
per-phase lesion harness across n>=8 seeds.
CONFIRMING signature: with a content-valid readout in place for each phase, the
functional-decline order across a majority of seeds (sign-test p<0.05, not a
bare reported/modal order) matches the predicted reverse-dependency sequence --
precision recalibration (MECH-123/Phase 4) degrades first, slot-filling
(MECH-121/Phase 2-3) next, slot-formation (MECH-120/Phase 1-2) last, with REM
failing before SWS-mediated downstream processing -- under uniform diffuse
damage, robust across independent seeds rather than resting on a single
near-deterministic metric.
FALSIFYING signature: a content-valid readout shows the phases degrade
simultaneously, in the forward-dependency order, or with SWS/NREM-mediated
processing failing before REM, with comparable seed-robustness to the
confirming case -- or the REM-fails-first adjacency remains seed-variable /
underpowered (CI straddling 0, sign-test ~1.0, as it was even before the
content-validity problem was found) once a valid instrument is used.
CURRENT STATE (do not re-litigate without new evidence): no leg of the
reverse-dependency staging order is presently supported by a validated
instrument -- the one adjacency that initially looked robust (NREM-before-SWS,
8/8 seeds) was retracted as staging evidence once shown to be a content-free
metric artifact. This is a measurement gap, not a mechanism-level result in
either direction; MECH-168 remains untested at the ordering level. One
orthogonal, still-standing finding: REM's generative re-derivation pass shows
real corrective capacity (attenuating gain <1 on 8/8 seeds), which bears on
whether REM failure is pure feed-forward topology, not on the staging order
itself.

MECH-169.subject: dementia.glymphatic_attribution_complementarity
MECH-169.title: The glymphatic clearance hypothesis (amyloid-beta accumulation via insufficient sleep-phase clearance) and the attribution pipeline account (consolidation failure via disrupted offline phases) are mechanistically complementary accounts of sleep-deprivation-induced dementia: the former explains why structural substrate damage accumulates; the latter explains why cognitive symptoms are staged and context-specific rather than diffuse and uniform.

MECH-170.subject: dementia.sleep_restoration_dissociated_recovery_prediction
MECH-170.title: Sleep architecture restoration in early MCI should produce dissociated cognitive improvement: slot-filling (episodic attribution, MECH-121 analog) should improve before slot-formation (contextual semantic, MECH-120 analog), because the pipeline rebuilds in dependency order. This distinguishes the attribution account from accounts predicting uniform memory improvement with sleep restoration.

MECH-171.subject: dementia.sleep_disruption_vicious_cycle
MECH-171.title: Progressive neurodegeneration creates a vicious cycle through sleep disruption: early attribution pipeline failure disrupts sleep architecture, which accelerates consolidation pipeline failure, which accelerates attribution failure. This predicts disproportionate disease-modifying effect of early sleep intervention, because it breaks the cycle before the schema scaffold collapses.
MECH-171.what_would_answer: A clinical-cohort longitudinal study showing (or failing to show) that early sleep intervention in MCI/pre-dementia has a disproportionate disease-modifying effect relative to late intervention.

MECH-172.subject: dementia.habit_system_sparing_architectural_prediction
MECH-172.title: Preservation of habit and procedural memory in early Alzheimer's disease, while episodic and contextual memory fail, is architecturally predicted by the separation of the model-free habit system (MECH-163 D1/D2, SNc) from the contextual attribution system (E3 hippocampal, requiring offline consolidation phases): the habit system does not require offline consolidation to function, so its relative preservation under early consolidation pipeline failure is not incidental but follows from the architectural separation.
MECH-172.what_would_answer: A clinical Alzheimer's cohort showing (or failing to show) that procedural/ habit memory is preserved relative to episodic/contextual memory in the early-to-middle stage, tracking consolidation-pipeline failure.

MECH-173.subject: pharmacology.rem_suppression_phase4_disruption
MECH-173.title: Medications that suppress REM sleep (anticholinergics, MAOIs, most antidepressants at therapeutic doses, benzodiazepines) selectively impair MECH-123 precision recalibration -- the most downstream pipeline phase -- and thereby accelerate the earliest dementia prodrome: overconfident contextual attributions before overt memory loss.

MECH-174.subject: pharmacology.sws_suppression_phase12_disruption
MECH-174.title: GABAergic sleep aids (benzodiazepines and Z-drugs: zolpidem, zopiclone, zaleplon) suppress SWS depth and continuity at therapeutic doses, impairing MECH-120 synaptic homeostasis and MECH-121 schema replay, producing context representations that remain globally undifferentiated -- the same failure mode as SD-017 without any SWS-analog.
MECH-174.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (shared with parent claim INV-048, applies to the REE-architecture leg): before any REE-substrate run is interpretable, e3.harm_eval_head must be trained (V3-EXQ-670's own diagnosed failure -- the harm-valuation pathway was byte-identical across all 4 arms because it was never trained). V3-EXQ-670a has never been run as of this digestion pass.
LEG A -- REE-ARCHITECTURE (substrate_conditional; testable in principle, but the specific mechanism this claim asserts is not yet representable by the existing substrate knob). Current state: sws_enabled/sws_consolidation_steps/sws_schema_weight (ree_core/utils/config.py) provide only a BINARY on/off SWS toggle and a duration/weight lever. The one existing pharmacological-analog test (V3-EXQ-670, ARM_C_SWS_SUPPRESSED) sets sws_enabled=False -- full ablation, equivalent to complete SWS deprivation. This tests INV-048's coarse claim but CANNOT test this claim's specific two-pathway mechanism: (1) graded slow-oscillation DEPTH reduction (distinct from full ablation) and (2) SWS CONTINUITY fragmentation (distinct from duration reduction) -- nor the Z-drug/classical-benzo dissociation (partial spindle/MECH-122 preservation under depth-only suppression vs full suppression under both). A GABAergic decay regulator does exist (SD-036, GABAergicDecayRegulator), but it perturbs waking-state cross-stream z_harm decay (the PHARM-004 catatonia mechanism), not the sleep-phase machinery -- not reusable for this claim.
CONFIRMING (once the substrate gap above is closed): degradation in MECH-120 homeostatic reset quality and MECH-121 schema-replay completeness that scales with depth reduction and fragmentation severity, is dissociable from full-ablation degradation, and (for the Z-drug arm) leaves MECH-122 spindle-coordination metrics relatively less impaired than the classical-benzodiazepine arm.
FALSIFYING: graded depth/continuity perturbation producing no dose-response relationship to MECH-120/121 metrics; or no dissociation between the Z-drug and classical-benzodiazepine analogs on MECH-122 spindle metrics despite a depth/ continuity difference.
LEG B -- HUMAN-CLINICAL (out-of-domain to REE's own substrate; answerable now via existing polysomnography and neuropsychological literature, independent of REE substrate status): this claim's own prediction -- long-term BZD/Z-drug users show reduced SWS%, slower context-discrimination/new-schema learning, with relatively preserved remote episodic retrieval (the Phase 1/2-selective signature). CONFIRMING: PSG studies showing reduced SWS%/slow-oscillation power in chronic users, paired with neuropsychological batteries showing selective new-context-learning impairment. FALSIFYING: no SWS-architecture difference vs matched non-users, or a dissociation running the opposite direction.
NOTE (evidence-quality caveat): this claim's existing literature support includes Billioti de Gage et al. 2014 (BZD-dementia association), whose causal-direction interpretation has been substantially challenged by subsequent better-confounded designs (e.g. Gray et al. 2016) addressing reverse causation/protopathic bias (prodromal dementia -> earlier insomnia/anxiety -> BZD prescription). Read this leg's literature confidence with that caveat rather than the Billioti de Gage point estimate.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): V3-EXQ-670a retest (INV-048's own blocker, gating Leg A) still not queued as of this digestion. No graded SWS-depth/ continuity substrate knob exists -- an /implement-substrate gap, not chipped here.

MECH-175.subject: pharmacology.anticholinergic_dual_pathway_dementia_risk
MECH-175.title: Anticholinergic medications confer dementia risk via two independent and potentially additive pathways: (1) REM suppression (ACh is required for REM generation via nucleus basalis and brainstem PGO generators -- muscarinic blockade directly suppresses REM, impairing MECH-123); and (2) cholinergic deficit mimicry (AD is characterised by basal forebrain cholinergic loss; anticholinergic burden creates a pharmacological analog of this deficit during waking hours, independently degrading attention and encoding).
MECH-175.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain: no REE substrate at any level settles this; V3-EXQ-698's
grid-world dual-pathway proxy was confirmed not a fair test (manipulation
checks PASS but outcome DVs at the noise floor). The decisive test is a
prospective clinical-pharmacology cohort with mediation/structural-equation
analysis. Design: enroll older adults free of dementia, score anticholinergic
burden (ACB / ARS / German ACB) at each visit, obtain an annual
polysomnography subset to quantify REM-suppression-years, follow to a
dementia-conversion endpoint, and fit a parallel-mediator SEM with (1)
cumulative REM-suppression-years (Pathway 1) and (2) cumulative diurnal
anticholinergic dose (Pathway 2) as simultaneous mediators of the
ACB->dementia path. CONFIRMS the dual independent additive account if both
mediators carry significant, partially non-overlapping indirect effects whose
sum approximates the total ACB->dementia effect, AND ACB outperforms total
medication count and total sleep-medication count as a predictor. REFUTES if
the ACB->dementia association is fully mediated by a single pathway (e.g.
daytime dose only, with REM-suppression-years adding no independent indirect
effect), or if a non-anticholinergic substitution that removes only the
nocturnal limb (oxybutynin->mirabegron natural experiment) fails to reduce
risk. Note the Grace-Vanstone-Horner 2014 caveat: REM-transition reliability /
REM-theta integrity may be the true nocturnal mediator rather than total REM
amount, so the PSG metric should include transition and spectral measures, not
just REM%.

MECH-176.subject: pharmacology.orexin_antagonist_architecture_preserving
MECH-176.title: Orexin receptor antagonists (suvorexant, lemborexant) are predicted to be architecture-preserving sleep aids: they suppress wake-promoting orexin drive without directly compressing sleep phase machinery, allowing the brain's own homeostatic sleep architecture to unfold, and should therefore preserve or improve SWS/REM ratio relative to GABAergic alternatives at equi-efficacious doses.

MECH-177.subject: pharmacology.sleep_architecture_restoration_disease_modifying
MECH-177.title: Any pharmacological intervention that durably restores the NREM-to-REM sequence and preserves phase durations in MCI or early Alzheimer's disease is predicted to be disease-modifying via pipeline protection -- upstream of irreversible neurodegeneration, breaking the MECH-171 vicious cycle before schema scaffold collapse, with predicted effect size larger in early MCI than established AD.

MECH-178.subject: neurochemistry.noradrenergic_tone_rem_suppression_rigidity
MECH-178.title: Elevated tonic noradrenergic activity (from chronic stress, stimulant exposure, or noradrenaline reuptake inhibitor antidepressants) suppresses REM sleep by maintaining locus coeruleus REM-off firing above the silence threshold required for REM generation, thereby blocking MECH-123 precision recalibration and producing progressive behavioural rigidity equivalent to partial MECH-123 deprivation -- independent of any pharmacological REM suppression.

MECH-179.subject: sleep.mel_type_phase_specificity
MECH-179.title: Prediction error type determines which sleep phase is demanded for processing: episodic, spatial, and factual errors (incorrect world-state predictions) primarily demand NREM-mediated schema replay (MECH-121) for prior correction; emotional, social, and identity-threatening errors primarily demand REM-mediated simulation and recalibration (MECH-123) for policy and salience update.

MECH-180.subject: sleep.novelty_adaptive_sleep_upregulation
MECH-180.title: Novel environments and high-MEL learning episodes adaptively upregulate the learning drive component of sleep (INV-050 third drive), producing measurable increases in slow-wave activity power, sleep spindle density, and hippocampal replay rate proportional to the novelty and prediction error load encountered during the preceding wake period.

MECH-181.subject: dementia.cognitive_reserve_as_update_loop_maintenance
MECH-181.title: Cognitive reserve (produced by education, bilingualism, complex occupation, social engagement, and enriched environments) protects against dementia primarily by maintaining sustained novelty-driven Model Error Load throughout the lifespan, keeping the SD-017 model update system exercised and preserving sleep-architecture responsiveness to learning demands; conversely, understimulating environments accelerate dementia by depriving the update system of the error signal needed to remain adaptive.

MECH-182.subject: social.vocalization_harm_signal
MECH-182.title: Vocalization timbre as learned cross-modal harm-approach signal, generalizing to other-agent vocalizations.

MECH-183.subject: social.zbeta_leakage
MECH-183.title: z_beta leakage: attributed other-model affective state activates self z_beta directly, not via inference.
MECH-183.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires V3/V4 social substrate that does
not yet exist in ree_core -- a coupled other-agent model built via an
attribution stream, OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging (MECH-031/MECH-032), and a
multi-agent environment with observable other-agent distress cues.
Confirmed absent by feasibility assessment 2026-06-11 (IGW-200,
exp_0137_mech_183_feasibility_assessment.md): grep of ree_core for
other_model/attribution_stream/OTHER_SELFLIKE/mirror_model/z_beta_leak
returns nothing, and z_beta exists only as a SELF stream. Any run
attempted without this substrate must self-route substrate_not_ready,
not count as a verdict. Two proxy designs were already evaluated and
rejected as non-diagnostic -- do not repeat them: (a) simulated
other-distress cues without an actual other-agent model (tests
pattern-to-z_beta activation, not attributed-other-state activation --
a PASS would not validate the claim and a FAIL would not invalidate
it); (b) cross-modal z_beta activation from a correlated same-agent cue
(tests sensory association learning, i.e. MECH-182, not social
attribution). A test is only informative once the other-model/
attribution/OTHER_SELFLIKE substrate exists and both the
coupling-present and coupling-absent conditions produce non-zero,
non-identical z_beta variance.
CONFIRMING signature: with the coupled other-model substrate present,
the observer's z_beta activates above baseline when its other-model
registers the coupled other-agent's distress, and this activation (1)
scales with OTHER_SELFLIKE coupling strength/confidence rather than
being all-or-nothing, (2) persists when the explicit
inference/prediction pathway toward the other's state is ablated
(i.e. the activation is not merely a byproduct of predicting the
other's behaviour), and (3) is substantially reduced or absent when
OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging is off while the same distress cue is present
-- candidate design per the feasibility assessment: 2x2 factorial,
OTHER_SELFLIKE tag ON/OFF x distress cue present/absent.
FALSIFYING: z_beta in the observer does not activate above baseline
when the other-model registers the coupled other's distress; or the
activation is fully explained by (disappears without) the
inferential/predictive pathway alone, indicating leakage is mediated
by inference rather than direct activation; or the OTHER_SELFLIKE
tag ON vs OFF conditions produce statistically indistinguishable
z_beta activation, indicating the effect is not attribution-gated --
any of these falsifies the "direct activation, not via inference,
gated by attribution coupling" framing that is MECH-183's specific
(as opposed to the well-established PAM base-rate) claim.

MECH-184.subject: social.other_directed_harm_avoidance
MECH-184.title: Other-directed hippocampal harm avoidance: planning architecture identical to self-preservation with harm-gradient source swapped to coupled other-agent.

MECH-185.subject: social.empathic_curiosity_approach_doubling
MECH-185.title: Surprise-doubled approach gradient toward distressed other: prediction error approach and z_beta leakage approach converge simultaneously.

MECH-186.subject: serotonin.tonic_benefit_gradient_maintenance
MECH-186.title: Tonic serotonergic signal maintains VALENCE_WANTING floor under chronic harm exposure, preventing benefit terrain collapse.
MECH-186.what_would_answer:

under chronic harm in the tonic_5ht_enabled=False arm -- z_goal_norm should show real

2026-04-06/07) failed exactly this precondition: mean_z_goal_norm was ~0.01-0.02 in
BOTH the floor and no-floor arms, because no tonic-5-HT-to-VALENCE_WANTING substrate
was wired into the run at all and baseline SD-012 seeding was not functioning.
Governance reclassified both runs non_contributory/substrate_limitation on 2026-04-08
for exactly this reason ("cannot test floor effect without baseline seeding") -- both
the flat manifests and, as of 2026-08-06, the run-pack manifests and the derived
claim_evidence.v1.json index now consistently reflect this (0 genuine experimental
entries either direction; the index previously stayed stale at weakens=2/exp_conf=0.175
because the 2026-04-08 reclassification never propagated to the run-pack copies -- see

MECH-187.subject: serotonin.incentive_salience_gain_regulation
MECH-187.title: Serotonin modulates the gain on dopaminergic incentive salience, converting the hard SD-012 threshold into an adaptive graded transduction function.

MECH-188.subject: serotonin.pfc_goal_persistence_under_adversity
MECH-188.title: PFC-mediated goal persistence under adversity, sustained by 5-HT projections from DRN to dlPFC, maintains z_goal through harm spikes after seeding.

MECH-189.subject: development.super_ordinal_goal_formation

MECH-191.subject: social.signal_legibility
MECH-191.title: Stereotyped behavioral signals are causal externalizations of specific internal functional states, making them cross-architecturally legible without learned convention.
MECH-191.what_would_answer:
MECH-191 is CONJUNCTIVE -- "causally produced" and "cross-architecturally legible" are
separate assertions with OPPOSITE readiness. Split on testability, mirroring ARC-003's
Leg A/Leg B pattern.

LEG A -- CAUSAL PRODUCTION (testable now, single-agent, RECEIVER-FREE).
Testable today for 4 of the 7 catalogued signals, whose internal-state correlate already
exists in ree_core: whine (z_goal-active-without-satisfaction, ree_core/goal.py
GoalState), huff (E3 trajectory-discard fired at breath cadence, MECH-107/108's
BreathOscillator sweep logic, ree_core/heartbeat/clock.py -- genuinely implemented, not a
stub), yelp (z_harm_a threshold-crossing, ree_core/amygdala/bla.py + cea.py), tail-wag
(z_beta positive-valence threshold-crossing, ree_core/agent.py). The other 3 catalog
entries are each blocked on DIFFERENT missing substrate and are NOT answered by a Leg A
pass on the other four: facial-expression needs OTHER_SELFLIKE model activation (confirmed
absent from ree_core, same grep as MECH-183 below); play-bow needs a mode-manager/play-mode
substrate (confirmed absent -- no PlayMode/mode_manager class anywhere in ree_core);
licks/petting-received is MECH-193's two-agent reward-coupling territory and is not
single-agent by construction.
NON-DEGENERACY: the internal-state channel and the candidate signal-analog event must
both show non-degenerate variance (state activates and stays quiescent across the run;
signal-analog event fires and fails to fire across the run) -- a state pinned always-on
or an event that never/always fires tests nothing.
CONFIRMING: for each of the four substrate-present signals, the internal-state activation
predicts its own signal-analog event with high specificity against the OTHER three states
and against a quiescent baseline -- a decoder trained only on the other internal-state
channels cannot recover which event fired above chance, AND ablating the state variable
itself (not merely a correlated channel) collapses the corresponding event. This is causal,
state-specific production at the level the current substrate can express it -- internal
telemetry standing in for physical externalization, the same substitution MECH-107 already
uses for "exhale."
FALSIFYING: any of the four channels shows low specificity (e.g. z_harm_a
threshold-crossings occur at similar rates during z_goal-unmet or E3-discard episodes as
during genuine harm episodes), OR ablating the state variable does not suppress its
correlated event -- undermines "causal externalization" even before any receiver exists.

LEG B -- CROSS-ARCHITECTURE LEGIBILITY (BLOCKED; not queueable as of 2026-08-08).
Requires (i) an actual externalization/broadcast channel carrying the internal state
outward -- confirmed absent: zero scent/broadcast/social-signal-output implementation
anywhere under ree_core/ (re-confirmed 2026-08-08, same finding as MECH-041's grep); the
only specification is ARC-047's seven scent fields, itself candidate, confidence 0.0,
implementation_phase v5, unbuilt; and (ii) a receiving agent with its own
other-model/attribution-stream/OTHER_SELFLIKE substrate to do the "any observer with a
corresponding internal state can map it" decoding -- confirmed absent, identical to
MECH-183's 2026-06-11 feasibility assessment, independently re-confirmed 2026-08-08.
CONFIRMING (once substrate exists): a receiving agent -- ideally of a different
architecture/training lineage than the emitter -- correctly attributes the emitter's
functional state above chance from the broadcast signal alone, AND this decoding accuracy
drops toward chance when the receiver's own homologous internal-state machinery is
ablated/absent.
FALSIFYING: even once the broadcast + other-model substrate exists, receiver decoding
accuracy is statistically indistinguishable from chance, OR indistinguishable between a
receiver WITH and WITHOUT the corresponding internal-state machinery -- either falsifies
"legible via a corresponding internal state, not learned convention."
RELEASE CONDITION: identical substrate to MECH-183/MECH-041 -- ARC-047 (scent/broadcast
channel) plus ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-032 (other-agent modelling) landing. No separate build
is implied by MECH-191 beyond what MECH-183/MECH-041 already require.

MECH-192.subject: social.legibility_empathy_prerequisite
MECH-192.title: Signal legibility is prerequisite for fast empathy coordination: z_beta leakage (MECH-183) requires perceivable signals that map onto observer's own functional states.

MECH-193.subject: social.reward_coupling_reinforcement
MECH-193.title: Social reward signals (affiliative touch, oxytocin-gaze loop) reinforce empathic coupling strength, creating a self-strengthening coordination loop.

MECH-194.subject: play.synthetic_signal_substitution
MECH-194.title: Play mode operates by substituting synthetic z_goal and z_harm signals while permitting full learning flow through E3/E2/E1 as if signals were real.
MECH-194.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: play mode (ARC-049 frame tag + this
substitution mechanism) is UNIMPLEMENTED in V3 (substrate_conditional).
Requires: the play-frame tag (ARC-049) authorizing synthetic z_goal/
z_harm as legitimate training targets for episode duration; z_harm_s/
z_harm_a remaining ACTIVE during play with a RAISED escalation
threshold (not suppressed -- the Panksepp 1998 opioid-mediated
threshold-elevation reading, distinct from simulation's gradient
suppression); and z_goal_synthetic encoding learning-progress
d(PE)/dt (competence-based per Oudeyer 2007), not flat/entropy-based
magnitude.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires play episodes and matched
non-play (real-signal) episodes to produce measurably different
training dynamics -- if E3/E2/E1 update identically regardless of
play-frame status, the substitution mechanism is either absent or
inert.
CONFIRMING signature: during play episodes, E3 trajectory competence,
E2 forward model, and E1 world model all update AS IF the synthetic
signals were real (weight updates proceed normally, not suppressed)
-- distinguishing play from simulation (which suppresses post-commit
learning). Separately, z_harm_s/z_harm_a remain active but with a
measurably RAISED escalation threshold during play relative to
non-play episodes (graduated harm-adjacent exposure, not harm
blindness), and z_goal_synthetic tracks learning-progress rate rather
than a flat or entropy-derived magnitude.
FALSIFYING: play episodes produce IDENTICAL learning dynamics to
simulation (gradients suppressed) -- collapses play into simulation,
contradicting "play is authorized-synthetic learning, not
simulation"; or z_harm during play shows NO threshold elevation
(full suppression or unchanged threshold) -- falsifies the
opioid-mediated-threshold-elevation reading, supporting either harm
blindness (dangerous) or no functional difference from waking harm
processing; or z_goal_synthetic tracks flat/entropy-based magnitude
rather than learning-progress rate -- falsifies the competence-based
framing.

IMPLEMENTATION-MAPPING CAVEAT: the claim's prose ("goal magnitude
calibration," "harm threshold calibration") does not correspond to

trajectory-selection weights and E2 forward-model weights trained
during play episodes measurably improve real-episode task performance
on goal-pursuit-structure dimensions relative to an agent with no
play exposure; (b) NON-TRANSFER / RE-ANCHORING: post-play real-episode

homeostatic drive and harm signals at play-close, not the synthetic
values the agent operated under during play.

FALSIFYING (VIOLATED BY): (i) NO TRANSFER -- play-trained weights show
no measurable real-episode advantage; (ii) CALIBRATION LEAKAGE --

DISPOSITION NOTE: considered and declined a MECH-158-style
derivational/substrate_conditional fusion split (2026-08-08 digestion

MECH-203.subject: serotonin.replay_salience_tagging
MECH-203.title: Tonic serotonergic (5-HT) level during waking tags benefit-relevant experiences for preferential replay during subsequent SWS, complementing harm-salience tagging by the residue field

MECH-204.subject: serotonin.rem_gate_zero_point
MECH-204.title: Serotonergic withdrawal during REM actively defines the precision recalibration zero-point by removing the benefit gradient, not merely permitting recalibration
MECH-204.what_would_answer:
MECH-204 states a MECHANISM but has never stated its own falsification
conditions -- not the DV, not the required drift source, not the timescale at
which the correction must act. Every test to date has had to invent all three,
and each invention was wrong in a DIFFERENT way (EXQ-541 within-cycle no-op;
541a/541b under-powered timescale; V3-EXQ-596/602 scored on a cluster criterion
that is not a MECH-204 prediction; V3-EXQ-774 tautological DV; V3-EXQ-794
clamped drift source). That signature diversity is a SPECIFICATION gap, not a
granularity gap -- /claim-synthesis 2026-07-22
(claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-22.md sec 1c) REFUSED to decompose MECH-204 on
exactly this ground: classifying the cluster by the autopsies' own
four_layer_diagnosis yields ZERO non-degenerate substrate-ready FAIL signatures
and not one target carries `weakened`. This block supplies the three missing
objects so they are not re-invented a sixth time.

(a) THE DRIFT SOURCE -- now SD-076 (`use_waking_confidence_inflation`),
registered separately 2026-07-20 because it is the SOURCE while MECH-204 is the
CORRECTION, and the two must be independently ablatable. A MECH-204 test is
ADMISSIBLE ONLY WITH AN ACTIVE, DEMONSTRATED DRIFT SOURCE. "Sleep recalibrates
waking precision drift" is unfalsifiable if waking precision cannot drift, so a
null measured without live drift is a TAUTOLOGY, not evidence (V3-EXQ-774). The
drift must be shown live IN THE RUN -- a strict dose separation on the drift
variable between arms -- BEFORE the correction is scored. SD-076 currently has
NO usable headroom: V3-EXQ-794 pinned `rv_final` at exactly 0.010000 on all four
inflation arms, with `overconfidence_score` bit-identical to 15 significant
figures (-1.004111904519277) at the LO and HI asymmetry levels. MECH-204 is
therefore NOT ANSWERABLE until `sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom` lands
(separate /implement-substrate chip), followed by the V3-EXQ-794a re-run.

(b) THE PRECISION DV, AND THE NON-TAUTOLOGY BURDEN. ANY proposed DV must be
shown non-tautological BEFORE it is used. The paid lesson is V3-EXQ-774: a
SYMMETRIC precision EMA makes `running_variance` track true prediction error BY
CONSTRUCTION, pinning `overconfidence_score` near zero regardless of what is
ablated (774 measured -0.000148 and -0.000918). The DV must be a quantity whose
value can be driven materially away from the calibrated point by the drift
source ALONE, with the correction ablated. Discharge the burden in-run by
showing (i) the drift-on / correction-off arm moves the DV materially away from
calibration, and (ii) two drift doses produce DIFFERENT DV values beyond float
noise -- identical values at two nominally different doses are a SATURATION
fingerprint, not a null (V3-EXQ-794). The Phase 7 / Option B write-site in
PRECISION space (not E3-score space) is correct and must not be revisited; it is
what escapes the V3-EXQ-604c DV-invariance class.

(c) THE MINIMUM TIMESCALE IS RESOLVED, NOT OPEN: >= 16 sleep cycles per arm.
Measured -- do not re-derive it. At 4 cycles (541a/541b) cross-arm rv divergence
tops out at 1.75% against a 5% bar (inconclusive_timescale: the rv EMA damping
overwhelms the per-cycle nudge). At 16 cycles (541c; sleep_loop_K=1,
EPISODES_PER_RUN=16, precision_zero_point_ema_alpha=0.1) divergence is monotone
in step size -- 0.90% / 1.81% / 4.51% / ~10% at step 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.25 / 0.50 --
and step=0.50 clears the 5% C4 bar in 3/3 seeds, with C1-C4 PASS overall. A
MECH-204 run at fewer than 16 cycles per arm is under-powered BY MEASUREMENT and
its null carries no weight.

ANSWERS MECH-204 (5-HT withdrawal actively CALIBRATES the zero-point, not merely
permits recalibration) if, with the drift source demonstrably live and the DV
shown non-tautological, at >= 16 cycles per arm the recalibration-ON arm returns
the precision DV toward the cumulative zero-point reference relative to the
drift-only arm, with a monotone dose-response in
`rem_precision_recalibration_step` and sign consistency across seeds.

REFUTES MECH-204 if, under those same admissibility conditions, the correction
fires every cycle (C1) and adjusts with the correct sign (C2) yet leaves the
drifted DV statistically indistinguishable from the drift-only arm across the
defensible step range {0.05, 0.10, 0.25} -- i.e. 5-HT withdrawal is PERMISSIVE
only, and MECH-123 needs no zero-point term.

DOES NOT ANSWER IT EITHER WAY: any run whose overall outcome is decided by a
cluster-integration criterion that is not a MECH-204 prediction. V3-EXQ-596/602
FAILED on cluster_live_frac, a MECH-285 / GAP-3 criterion, while STRENGTHENING
MECH-204 on its own C1+C3 (recalibration fired every cycle in 3/3 seeds; 8.4-27.6%
rv divergence at 12 cycles).

NO TIMESCALE CHILD CLAIM IS WARRANTED NOW -- 541c already answered it. A
`recalibration_timescale` child becomes warranted ONLY IF, after
`sd_waking_confidence_inflation_headroom` lands and V3-EXQ-794a runs, the
correction fails on CYCLE COUNT again. Registering one now would mint an untested
claim from a resolved problem.

MECH-209.subject: sleep.semantic_consolidation_phenomenology
MECH-209.title: The simultaneous multi-instance, multi-scale, multi-time phenomenology of Type 3 dreams is the experiential signature of NREM SWR episodic-to-semantic transfer: rapid hippocampal sequential presentation of concept instances collapses to phenomenological simultaneity, with self-dissolution reflecting the stripping of episodic context during abstraction.
MECH-209.what_would_answer:
This claim fuses THREE evidentiary legs of different domains of resolution, following the precedent recorded on its own parent, INV-062. A result on one leg does not confirm or falsify another.
REE-MECHANISM LEG (deferred -- do not duplicate MECH-121's own falsifier): this claim's computational content (rapid hippocampal SWR sequential replay of concept instances, compressed to sub-conscious timescale, delivered to E1 for schema abstraction) IS MECH-121's mechanism. This claim adds no independently testable REE-substrate content on top of it -- its test is MECH-121's own NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION / CONFIRMING / FALSIFYING block (substrate_conditional, held pending the unbuilt ARC-065 rule-creator substrate + balanced harm/goal replay scheduling). MECH-092's triggering half is confirmed (V3-EXQ-761 PASS) but its consolidation- benefit half (the half this claim actually needs) remains gated on SD-006 / a working viability map. Score this leg as MECH-121's, not re-litigated here.
PHENOMENOLOGICAL-MAPPING LEG (mixed -- narrow buildable sub-question + irreducible residue): NARROW SUB-QUESTION (in principle buildable, currently unbuilt): does REE have any internal state whose behaviour during a replay/consolidation event would look like what this claim predicts for "self-dissolution" -- a measurable drop or discontinuity in self-model coherence (z_self/D_eff, already used elsewhere for depersonalization/dissociation claims) specifically during MECH-121-style replay, versus stability during ordinary online operation? NOT currently instrumented: MECH-121's own depends_on has no self-model linkage, and no architecture doc tracks an episodic who/when/where context tag on replayed traces that could be observed being stripped. Building this requires MECH-121's own substrate unblocked AND new z_self/D_eff wiring into the replay pipeline -- neither exists today. CONFIRMING (if built): z_self/D_eff shows a measurable coherence drop specifically during MECH-121-triggered replay windows, tracking with the volume of episodic content being abstracted. FALSIFYING (if built): coherence is statistically unchanged across replay vs. ordinary operation. IRREDUCIBLE RESIDUE (out of domain, permanently): even a confirmed computational signature would only show REE's self-model measure BEHAVES analogously to a self-dissolution reading -- it would not establish that this computational event IS what "self-dissolution" subjectively feels like from the inside. No REE build converts this residue into a testable REE question.
HUMAN-CLINICAL LEG (out of domain -- independently testable, but not on REE): this claim's own clinical prediction -- anxious patients (elevated MECH-208 harm- weighting) show predominantly Type 1/2 dreams and reduced/absent Type 3 -- resolves only through prospective dream-diary studies against this taxonomy, not through any REE experiment. MECH-208, the mechanism this prediction leans on, is CONFIRMED UNBUILT in ree-v3 as of 2026-08-08 -- so even the REE-side precondition for eventually cross-referencing this prediction against a matching REE signature does not yet exist.
DISPOSITION: epistemic_category is out_of_domain for the same reason as parent INV-062 -- the title's primary assertion is an identity claim between a specific phenomenology and a specific computational mechanism, which is the phenomenological- mapping leg's irreducible residue above, not the REE-mechanism leg (MECH-121's, deferred) or the human-clinical leg (dream-diary literature, not REE).
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): this claim's claim_type (mechanism_hypothesis) could arguably be reclassified to derived_prediction to match parent INV-062's own reclassification (phenomenological-identity claims are domain-modelling assumptions, not architectural invariants/mechanisms) -- surfaced for governance judgment, not applied here.

MECH-210.subject: sleep.rem_e1_world_model_free_running
MECH-210.title: Type 4 (detailed story, close to reality, super interesting) dreams are the phenomenological signature of REM E1 world-model free-running: with sensory input disconnected and the commit gate suppressed, E1's LSTM generates unconstrained sequential rollouts from its learned prior, producing coherent narrative arcs that are novel-but-plausible and experientially interesting.
MECH-210.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (REE-architecture leg): a genuine joint "REM mode" -- E1's LSTM running forward generatively (predict_long_horizon, prediction_horizon=20, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py) from an internally-generated starting point with NO live sensory correction, WHILE ARC-016's commit gate is suppressed (commitment_threshold driven low/negative) AND monoaminergic precision is reduced live during the rollout (not only as a post-sleep one-shot adjustment) -- does not currently exist as an assembled, invocable mode in ree_core/. predict_long_horizon is never called from ree_core/sleep/; the existing REM_ANALOG phase scaffolding (agent.py enter_rem_mode/run_rem_attribution_pass, ree_core/sleep/routing_gate.py) does hippocampal REPLAY of stored past trajectories, not E1-generative free-running of novel content -- it implements the Type 1/2/3 mechanism family (MECH-121/205/208/209), not Type 4. Before any confirming/falsifying test is meaningful, a driver must be built that: (a) seeds E1 from an internally-generated, not externally-observed, state; (b) runs predict_long_horizon with commitment_threshold overridden so no commit fires; (c) applies precision reduction concurrently with the rollout, not only afterward; (d) confirms sensory input genuinely does not reach E1 during the window.
CONFIRMING: once built, E1's free-running rollouts show (i) narrative coherence -- later predicted states measurably constrained by earlier ones, above an i.i.d.-shuffle-matched baseline; (ii) novelty-within-learned-prior-support -- rollouts fall outside the specific stored-episode distribution while staying low-error against a held-out plausibility model; (iii) an interestingness/surprise proxy that tracks independently-measured world-model calibration quality (MECH-123's own dependency) -- well-calibrated priors produce a measurably different rollout signature than deliberately miscalibrated ones.
FALSIFYING: rollouts under the jointly-induced conditions are indistinguishable from i.i.d. noise regardless of prior calibration quality; OR the interestingness/surprise signature shows no relationship to independently-measured world-model calibration; OR narrative coherence is present even without the commit-gate/precision manipulations, meaning the REM-specific framing adds nothing beyond ordinary free-running rollout mechanics.
HUMAN-CLINICAL LEG (separate, non-REE-blocking): (1) REM-suppressing-antidepressant prediction -- SSRIs/SNRIs (and other REM-suppressing agents, per MECH-178's NA-tone pathway) reduce/delay REM on PSG; this claim predicts selective loss of Type 4 (detailed-story) dreams under chronic use, with Types 1-3 relatively spared -- testable via dream-diary studies contrasting REM-suppressing vs REM-sparing agents. (2) Dementia-progression prediction -- progressive Type-4 degradation preceding its disappearance, tracked via longitudinal dream diaries in early-stage dementia. Both answerable from clinical/psychiatric literature and cohort studies, independent of REE substrate status.
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-08, not resolved here): this claim's direct mechanistic parent MECH-123 was set to substrate_conditional/v3_pending: true on 2026-08-06 ("mirroring sibling MECH-121") -- this claim is a downstream specialization and its own precondition is unmet a fortiori; consider adding v3_pending: true to match. The REM_ANALOG phase-name collision (see NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION above) could mislead a future reader into thinking this claim is substrate-supported because a similarly-named phase exists -- worth a short cross-reference note in docs/architecture/sleep/offline_phases.md.

MECH-212.subject: sleep.nrem.e2_consolidation
MECH-212.title: e2_motor_sequence_sleep_consolidation
MECH-212.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: The E2 fast motor-sensory transition model (ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py) must exist and produce trackable action_objects / z_self transition sequences (confirmed built; SD-004 implemented). MECH-121's NREM SWR-replay pipeline and MECH-205's surprise-buffer machinery must be operational for E1 (confirmed). Critically, an E2-specific offline consumption/replay pipeline -- one that pops high-motor-sensory-PE action-sequence entries and runs SWR-triggered counterfactual replay through E2 specifically (not the narrow e2_harm_s harm submodule, and not the MECH-423 R3 interleaved-schedule module, which serves a different purpose) -- is currently UNBUILT. Any test run before this pipeline exists will self-route substrate_not_ready rather than produce valid evidence either way.
CONFIRMING: Once built, a controlled NREM-sleep condition shows selective improvement in z_self-transition efficiency / reduced motor-sensory prediction error specifically on action sequences that were flagged high-PE (clumsy, novel, or skill-boundary episodes) pre-sleep -- and this improvement (a) scales with each sequence's pre-sleep PE magnitude, (b) is measurably larger under NREM/SWR- replay conditions than under an equivalent-duration wake-rehearsal or generic- gradient-descent control, and (c) persists when E1 world-schema PE is held constant or matched across conditions -- i.e. the effect is not parasitic on E1 consolidation.
FALSIFYING: (a) No NREM-specific improvement in z_self-transition efficiency or procedural performance beyond what wake-state rehearsal or a generic (non-PE- gated) offline gradient pass already produces; or (b) any observed motor-sequence improvement is fully explained by E1 world-schema consolidation spillover -- disappears once trials are matched on E1-relevant PE, with no residual E2-specific signal; or (c) once the E2-specific pipeline is built, ablating it produces no measurable procedural-memory deficit distinct from ablating E1 consolidation alone -- i.e. E2's contribution is not dissociable from E1's at the mechanism level.

MECH-214.subject: development.goal_coherence
MECH-214.title: goal_referent_e1_representability
MECH-214.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: this claim cannot be tested against V3. GoalState seeds and attracts z_goal purely in z_world space; the V3 grid world conflates location with reward, so proxy content and hedonic content cannot come apart. Before this claim is even meaningfully falsifiable, two V4 substrate steps must land (self_model_v4_plan.md SELF-5/SELF-6, both status: blocked): (a) DR-11/SELF-5 -- a z_self-domain goal channel, so a goal can name a self-state and not only a world-location target; (b) DR-14/SELF-6 -- an environment that dissociates a goal's proxy cue from its hedonic outcome. Until both land, any experiment framed as testing this claim is measuring something else (most likely MECH-215's z_self-viability question instead).
CONFIRMING (once DR-11 + DR-14 exist): agents fail to form coherent, effective goals/viability terrain for self-states E1 has not yet differentiated a schema for (goal quality no better than random-vector baseline); goal coherence improves monotonically as E1 schema richness for the relevant domain expands; the addiction-analog failure mode reproduces (repeated pursuit of a z_goal proxy without hedonic grounding, i.e. wanting persists while the actual satisfaction state stays E1-unrepresented).
FALSIFYING: E3 forms coherent, effective goals and viability terrain for a self-state that E1 demonstrably cannot represent (no schema differentiation for that state, verified independently) -- i.e. goal quality is statistically indistinguishable between E1-represented and E1-unrepresented target states. That would show goal referent content is NOT constituted by E1 representations, and that E3/frontal goal machinery can specify and pursue goals independent of world-model vocabulary.

MECH-216.subject: goal.e1_schema_wanting
MECH-216.title: e1_predictive_wanting
MECH-216.what_would_answer:
A properly-powered retest of the E1-schema predictive-wanting mechanism,
run only after a measurement redesign (reward-dense episodes, longer
future-target windows, or a denser auxiliary supervision signal) raises
positive_label_rate above the quality-density floor established by
EXQ-332a.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must clear before the run counts as
evidence either way -- otherwise the result is non_contributory, per
the pre-registered rule carried over unchanged from EXQ-332/332a):
  - positive_label_rate (fraction of P1 steps with future_target=1)
    > 0.10 (C3 quality gate; EXQ-332a measured 0.00128, ~78x below
    floor)
  - future_target_corr in the PREDICTIVE_CUE_ON arm must be a genuine,
    non-degenerate correlation (not an artifact of near-zero variance
    in near-empty positive labels) -- adequacy of label density is
    what C3 checks for before C1 is interpretable at all.

CONFIRMS MECH-216 (supports) if, once C3 clears:
  - C1: future_target_corr(schema_salience_t, future_target_t) > 0.10
    in the PREDICTIVE_CUE_ON condition (schema activation carries
    predictive signal above noise), AND
  - C2: PREDICTIVE_CUE_ON future_target_corr > ABLATED
    future_target_corr (the E1 schema-cue, not some other correlate,
    is what enables the prediction), AND
  - the resulting wanting seeding shows the mechanism's own
    distinguishing spatial signature: schema-driven wanting fires at
    approach/intermediate positions from which a resource is
    predictable but not yet contacted, spatially offset from
    direct-contact wanting, which fires only at the resource position
    itself. (EXQ-263b's diagnostic dry run already demonstrated this
    offset in principle: salience_at_landmark_b=0.83 enabled vs 0.0
    ablated -- this needs re-confirmation under the corrected,
    dense-label supervision scheme, not fresh invention.)

FALSIFIES MECH-216 (does_not_support) if, once C3 clears (density
floor met, so the run is genuinely diagnostic):
  - C1 and/or C2 fail -- schema salience does not predict future
    resource contact above noise, or does no better than an ablated
    (schema-blind) control, even with adequate positive-label
    density. This would mean E1's LSTM hidden state does not carry
    the CS-detector signal the mechanism claims, ruling out a
    measurement-density explanation for non-support.

INCONCLUSIVE / hold at provisional (repeat, do not adjudicate) if:
  - C3 still fails to clear 0.10 after the redesign -- indicates the
    redesign itself was insufficient and needs a further iteration,
    not that the mechanism is refuted.

CURRENCY (2026-08-07): the measurement redesign called for on
2026-04-18 has NOT happened -- no MECH-216/schema_wanting retest of
any kind since EXQ-332a. The live_status.evidence pointer above
("failure_autopsy_EXQ-539-540_MECH307_2026-05-17#V3-EXQ-540f",
verdict superseded/measurement_design_broken_criterion) is a stale
cross-tagging artifact: that autopsy is about MECH-307's own C1
