What a behavioural-cloning prior supplies to a floored converter is PRIMARILY TRACTABLE EXPLORATION / STATE-VISITATION, not merely a competent action distribution: VPT (Baker 2022) reports RL from random initialisation in the same action space obtains essentially no reward and never reliably reaches the first link in the item chain, while BC-initialised RL reaches the diamond pickaxe -- a PRESENCE/ABSENCE result, not a speed-up. Three further functions are separable: the action distribution (the vehicle), VALUE-SIDE GROUNDING (DQfD's large-margin loss, which plain BC does NOT supply and whose ablation costs most of the benefit), and STRATEGIC-DIVERSITY PRESERVATION against collapse (AlphaStar). Because REE already owns deterministic in-substrate demonstrators (LocalViewGreedyPolicy 48-55 and OraclePolicy 57-61, instantiated in experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::run_anchor_cell), NO PERMANENT EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATOR IS REQUIRED -- REE's transience question is not how to stop paying for demonstrations but whether the seed leaves a RESIDUE in the converter after the guide leaves the action path. The only strong transience construct in the literature is JSRL's ROLLOUT HANDOFF (a guide acts for the first h steps, the learner for H-h, with h decreasing to 0 as the learner clears a threshold), NOT a decaying loss weight: none of VPT, AlphaStar or DQfD ever anneals its prior term to zero.
MECH-460.what_would_answer: Three readouts, in decreasing order of decisiveness. (a) RESIDUE AFTER PRIOR REMOVAL -- the JSRL h=0 endpoint: does foraging competence survive when the prior is fully out of the action path? SUPPORTED if competence persists post-removal above the 780 ctrl; FALSIFIED (as a SEED reading) if it collapses to the 0-1 floor the instant the auxiliary/guide is removed, which would make the prior a permanent crutch rather than a bootstrap. (b) GUIDE-QUALITY GRADIENT -- seeding from greedy_oracle (57-61) should dominate local_view_greedy (48-55), and both should dominate random_walk; a FLAT response across guide quality is surprising under this claim and points at the converter rather than the seed. (c) VALUE-SIDE SEED CONTRAST -- policy-only seeding vs policy+value seeding at matched actor warm-start budget, read out as critic calibration on demonstrator-visited states.

MECH-461.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.innate_approach_primitive_bootstrap
MECH-461.title: innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.
MECH-461.what_would_answer: The V3-EXQ-781 pre-registered readout is the direct test on the drive half: a sustained, non-extinguishing, demonstrator-free approach drive (constant-coefficient intrinsic reward on resource proximity) that leaves the actor at the passive-survival floor on BOTH representations -- with mean_approach_reward_recent confirming the drive actually fired, so a null is informative rather than a plumbing bug -- FALSIFIES the drive half. The PRIMITIVE-BASIS half is NOT tested by 781 and is the claim's distinctive, currently-untested content: it would be answered by contrasting a converter given a pre-specified action-primitive basis (a small set of composable multi-step motor primitives) against one that must construct its repertoire from single-step actions, at matched drive. A drive-only arm clearing the floor would show the primitive basis is unnecessary; a primitive-basis-only arm clearing it would show the drive is.

MECH-462.subject: sleep.consolidation_readout_order
MECH-462.title: Consolidation-phase damage is content-scorable only where the phase's output is a FIRST-ORDER content-bearing quantity (NREM inter-store transfer; SWS retrieval margin). A phase whose output is a SECOND-ORDER quantity over representations -- REM precision / confidence recalibration -- is content-free BY TYPE, and its damage is readable only through a downstream behavioural discrimination consequence, never through a statistic computed on the precision quantity itself.
MECH-462.what_would_answer: Build the meta-d-prime-analogue downstream readout for the REM phase (does the agent's post-REM confidence separate its own correct from incorrect retrievals) and run it on the SAME CELLS as V3-EXQ-778e. SUPPORTED if the downstream readout is content-contingent (null_slope_ratio <= 0.25, ceiling_inside_ci95 false, >=6/8 seeds) WHILE the direct precision readout on those same cells remains above 0.25 -- the same-cells contrast is what makes this a test of the type fact rather than of the build. REFUTED two ways, and both matter: (i) if the downstream readout is ALSO content-free, the phase carries no recoverable damage signal at all and the type story is wrong about recoverability; or (ii) if a DIRECT precision-quantity readout can be made content-contingent, the type-fact is simply false and all three results were construction defect after all.

MECH-463.subject: selection.global_arousal_variance_amplification
MECH-463.title: Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.
MECH-463.what_would_answer: A variance decomposition of committed-selection scores into F vs the other channels, CONDITIONED on arousal (urgency_applied decile, and secondarily on tonic temperature and the D1/D2 da scalar). Supports if F-share rises monotonically with urgency decile and the bottom-vs-top decile gap exceeds the effect-size floor. Refutes if F-share is flat across arousal deciles -- which would mean F-dominance is structural in the score geometry and arousal is causally inert with respect to it, leaving MECH-439 untouched and killing this claim cleanly.

MECH-464.subject: selection.d1_d2_opponent_gain_is_order_changing
MECH-464.title: D1/D2 opponent dopamine gain is ORDER-CHANGING, not a uniform scalar: because it gains the promote and suppress populations asymmetrically about zero, a non-zero da can reorder any candidate pair whose loop accumulators straddle zero -- so this route is capable of the behavioural differentiation MECH-463 asserts no global-scalar route can produce.
MECH-464.what_would_answer: Sweep da EXOGENOUSLY (as V3-EXQ-785a swept urgency) with d1_da_gain / d2_da_gain at their configured values, recording per-candidate loop accumulators and the committed argmin per tick. SUPPORTS if the committed-candidate identity changes with da at a rate exceeding the da == 0 baseline, and if the reordering rate scales with the fraction of candidate pairs whose accumulators straddle zero. REFUTES if the committed identity is invariant to da across the sweep, which would mean the straddle fraction is ~0 in practice and the asymmetry, though real in code, is behaviourally inert. MANDATORY NON-VACUITY GATE: report the straddle fraction. If it is ~0 the run is vacuous and MUST be scored precondition_unmet, not as a null -- without this gate the probe returns a spurious "inert" for a purely structural reason.

MECH-465.subject: selection.commit_gate_arousal_effect_requires_boundary_regime
MECH-465.title: Arousal's effect on WHETHER commitment fires is expressible only near the commit-gate boundary: in every run to date the gated quantity sits 25-48x below the threshold and commit rate is pinned at 0.99-1.00, so MECH-463's commit-gate prediction is UNTESTED rather than falsified.
MECH-465.what_would_answer: STAGE 1, SCOPING SPIKE (this is why the claim is substrate_conditional and probe-gated, NOT queued): establish whether a boundary regime -- commit_variance within ~2x of effective_threshold -- is reachable BY CONFIGURATION (e.g. lowering commit_threshold), or whether it requires raising z_world variance. STAGE 2a, IF REACHABLE BY CONFIG: re-run the V3-EXQ-785a exogenous-urgency design in that regime with COMMIT RATE as the load-bearing DV. SUPPORTS if commit rate varies monotonically with urgency and the span exceeds a pre-registered effect floor. REFUTES if commit rate stays flat WITH DEMONSTRATED HEADROOM. MANDATORY PRECONDITION on any stage-2a run: median gate margin < 2x AND commit rate away from both 0 and 1. Without it the run reproduces the 785a ceiling effect and must be scored precondition_unmet. STAGE 2b, IF NOT REACHABLE BY CONFIG: the claim is substrate-gated and routes to /implement-substrate, not to /queue-experiment.

MECH-466.subject: architecture.event_relative_temporal_grammar
MECH-466.title: Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.

MECH-467.subject: attention.distractor_failure_mode_dissociation
MECH-467.title: Distractor resistance has THREE dissociable failure modes -- sensory capture (distractor enters/dominates the active representation), rule corruption (distractor overwrites or destabilises the active goal/rule/task context), and behavioural capture (rule survives intact but the distractor still controls action selection). REE's distractor evidence covers rule corruption ONLY; a system can pass rule-corruption tests while failing behavioural capture.

MECH-468.subject: hippocampus.anchor_topology_functional_information
MECH-468.title: Hippocampal anchor TOPOLOGY carries functional information not present in local anchor payloads. REE's typed relations (spatial, temporal, action-transition, event, goal, valence, social, schema, staleness, scale) are each realised as a payload field, a gate, or a scoring term -- a property of an anchor or proposal -- and none is exposed as an EDGE TYPE over the anchor set. Nothing tests whether the topology carries information beyond local anchor features.

MECH-469.subject: hippocampus.relation_type_noncollapsibility
MECH-469.title: Relation types are NOT collapsible to one adjacency structure: collapsing all edge types into a single adjacency, or removing event / goal-motivational edges, or removing action-transition directionality, degrades functional-label recovery. The same non-collapsibility argument as MECH-069 (error incommensurability), one level down.

MECH-470.subject: hippocampus.topological_ghost_goal_reactivation_ranking
MECH-470.title: Topological position improves ghost-goal reactivation ranking: MECH-292/293 rank inactive anchors by preserved-goal-payload match; adding a topological term (relational distance to the current anchor along typed paths) improves reactivation precision. An anchor's functional role -- gateway, bottleneck, recurrent trap, interruption point, repair opportunity -- may be inferable from its POSITION even when its local payload is incomplete.

MECH-471.subject: learning.competence_update_bounded_provenance_rollback
MECH-471.title: Behavioural-competence updates require the same BOUNDED / PROVENANCED / ROLLBACK-CAPABLE discipline already registered for consolidation. MECH-392, INV-080 and MECH-401 give the memory-consolidation path bounded, attributable, provenance-carrying, rollback-capable, over-rewrite-gated editing; NOTHING EQUIVALENT is registered for behavioural competence -- policy / affordance / action-object learning has no rollback, no provenance record, and no gate against a single successful rollout propagating widely.

MECH-472.subject: learning.heldout_context_acquisition_vs_memorisation
MECH-472.title: HELD-OUT CONTEXT distinguishes skill acquisition from task memorisation: a competence update should be promoted to durable only on evidence from contexts that did not generate it.

MECH-473.subject: learning.rejected_adaptation_memory
MECH-473.title: REJECTED-ADAPTATION MEMORY improves later recovery and transfer: retaining failed behavioural revisions together with their failure conditions improves adaptation when conditions later change. A failed adaptation should remain available as evidence about what was tried, why it failed, and under what conditions it might later become useful.

MECH-474.subject: learning.regime_meta_selection_narrow
MECH-474.title: LEARNING-MECHANISM META-SELECTION (narrow form): the control plane selects among the learning regimes REE actually has -- online practice, exploration, counterfactual simulation, offline consolidation -- rather than applying one learning rule universally, and this selection is state- and mode-dependent.

MECH-475.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.baseline_informativeness
MECH-475.title: uninformative_value_baseline_makes_optimisation_iatrogenic. In REE's MECH-457 actor-critic pathway the value baseline is UNINFORMATIVE on the policy's own state distribution, so the advantage carries variance rather than signal and ADDED OPTIMISATION PRESSURE IS IATROGENIC: policy capacity, training budget, an earned intrinsic approach drive, environmental reward-coupling and post-installation RL refinement each drive competence BELOW THEIR OWN CONTROLS rather than plateauing beneath a ceiling, and the magnitude of the loss tracks baseline uninformativeness rather than the identity of the intervention. Measured mechanism: V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) reads the shared CTRL critic at std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 against a 0.25 collapse threshold and a pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio of 0.016 against a 0.25 floor -- an unbaselined high-variance advantage. A ceiling plateaus; this does not.
MECH-475.what_would_answer: Two readouts, in decreasing order of decisiveness. (a) REVERSAL -- the decisive test. Re-run the three destructive ACQUISITION-side treatments (V3-EXQ-769 capacity/budget, V3-EXQ-781 approach drive, V3-EXQ-771 metabolic coupling) with the V3-EXQ-788 DISTRIBUTIONAL CRITIC in place, everything else byte-identical to the original arm, on the non-regressed reference build (128-wide / 3x budget / z_world detached / credit-replay 3 / topk 32). SUPPORTED if the treatment-below-control inversion REVERSES OR FLATTENS in at least 2 of 3. WEAKENED if treatments still land below their own controls with an informative baseline -- the destructiveness is then not the baseline's doing and this claim is WITHDRAWN (it does not degrade into a weaker version; the whole content is the causal attribution). (b) DOSE -- the cheap standing readout. Record std(V)/std(G) and the pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio as DECLARED COVARIATES on every arm of every future MECH-457-family run, and test whether the control->treatment competence DELTA is predicted by baseline informativeness across instances. SUPPORTED if the correlation holds and is signed as predicted; a null here is weak evidence only (n is small and the five existing instances differ on many axes at once). MANDATORY on both: TRAJECTORY, not terminal competence. This signature is invisible to terminal-only measurement, which is precisely what hid it across nineteen autopsy targets -- every one of which recorded the numbers that show it. NON-DEGENERACY GUARD: an arm whose control did not itself clear the readiness anchors cannot exhibit a treatment-below-control inversion and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a reversal verdict.

MECH-476.subject: f_dominance_conversion_ceiling.acquisition_retention_dissociation
MECH-476.title: competence_retention_dissociable_from_acquisition. ACQUIRING competence and RETAINING it are dissociable capabilities with separate substrate requirements: REE has the first and lacks the second. Behavioural cloning installs foraging competence at 20.933 on raw_view (3/3 seeds took) and 32.72 on z_world, and unconstrained RL refinement then ERODES it to 11.667 -- while a distributional critic (V3-EXQ-788, retains 1.839) and a KL anchor to the installed snapshot (V3-EXQ-792, retains 0.778 vs 0.525 unconstrained, still plastic) each preserve it. Retention is supplied by properties of the VALUE ESTIMATOR and the UPDATE CONSTRAINT, NOT by continued demonstration (V3-EXQ-789 eliminates the imitation-auxiliary schedule axis at every setting). COROLLARY, and the claim's distinctive testable content: consolidation is properly defined as RESISTANCE TO RETROGRADE INTERFERENCE (Krakauer 2005), hence dependent on install DOSE and elapsed offline INTERVAL -- neither of which REE has ever varied.
MECH-476.what_would_answer: An A -> B -> A RETROGRADE-INTERFERENCE design, the standard consolidation assay (Krakauer 2005). A = BC-install competence; B = an interfering unconstrained-RL phase; then re-measure A. Vary the TWO factors REE has never varied: INSTALL DOSE (BC episodes) and A->B INTERVAL (offline steps before refinement begins). DV: retained-fraction TRAJECTORY, never terminal competence. SUPPORTED if resistance to interference GROWS with install dose and/or with the A->B interval -- retention is then a dose/time-dependent consolidation PROCESS, and the build target is a consolidation window rather than a larger constraint coefficient. WEAKENED if retained fraction is INVARIANT to both and tracks only the concurrent constraint coefficient -- there is then no consolidation process and this claim is withdrawn into MECH-459/460. THIRD ARM, from the behavioural-tagging literature (Moncada & Viola 2007) and cheap because REE already owns the signal: pair the install with a NOVELTY episode (the landed RND drive) inside the consolidation window. Behavioural tagging predicts a WEAK install that would not otherwise persist becomes durable when a novelty exposure falls close in time. SUPPORTED if a sub-threshold BC dose consolidates only in the novelty-paired condition. This arm is the sharpest available discrimination between "consolidation process" and "regulariser", because a regulariser has no reason to care about an unrelated novelty exposure. PREREQUISITE, inherited from the retention portfolio and NON-NEGOTIABLE: an install that did not take is UNINFORMATIVE about retention and must self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a retention verdict. Bands: floor 1.0, RND plateau 5.22, lift target 13.05, BC-expert 32.72, local_view_greedy 48.05, greedy_oracle 57.2, random_walk 0.933.

MECH-477.subject: goal_directed.uncertainty_based_control_arbitration
MECH-477.title: dual_system_uncertainty_arbitration. Differential recruitment between the habit and the hippocampally-planned goal-directed pathways is produced by an explicit ARBITRATION element that reads the two pathways' relative uncertainty/reliability and reallocates control accordingly -- NOT by the mere presence of two pathways. Two pathways WITHOUT an arbitrator produce a FLAT recruitment response regardless of context novelty. Registered 2026-07-22 as the control-allocation mechanism MECH-163 presupposed but never named; MECH-163 conflated ARCHITECTURE (two pathways exist) with DYNAMICS (control shifts between them with novelty, uncertainty and practice).
MECH-477.what_would_answer: Build an uncertainty/reliability-weighted arbitrator over the two pathways (sd_dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration, default OFF and bit-identical when OFF). Re-run the V3-EXQ-786a design as a two-arm contrast, arbitrator OFF vs ON, holding the familiarity manipulation and the AUC manipulation-check bar (>= 0.7) fixed. SUPPORTED if the novel-minus-familiar recruitment delta is strictly greater with the arbitrator ON than OFF on >= 2/3 of divergent seeds, with the ON-arm delta clearing mean - SEM > margin. REFUTED if the ON arm reproduces the OFF arm's flat response (delta mean within noise of zero, d < 0.1) WITH the arbitrator demonstrably live -- mandatory manipulation check: the arbitration weight must be shown to vary with measured uncertainty, otherwise the run is a readiness failure and scores nothing. NOTE the OFF arm is already measured: V3-EXQ-786a IS that arm.

MECH-478.subject: goal_directed.long_horizon_benefit_accumulation
MECH-478.title: long_horizon_benefit_requires_model_based_rollout. Sustained benefit accumulation is a TRAJECTORY property, not a single-contact event, and is therefore reachable only by goal-seeded multi-step rollout; a 1-step greedy or value-flat-proposal policy cannot navigate toward it. Split out of MECH-163 leg (2) on 2026-07-22 because it carries a blocker of its own -- ARC-007 STRICT value-flat proposals -- entirely unrelated to the blockers on MECH-163 legs (1) and (3), and was inheriting MECH-163's V3-EXQ-786a weakens without ever having been tested.
MECH-478.what_would_answer: GATED on an ARC-007 relaxation supplying goal-seeded proposal generation (the MECH-292 / MECH-293 ghost-goal path is the registered candidate route). Then: an environment in which the cumulative-benefit optimum DIVERGES from the greedy-contact optimum, with the divergence verified as a property of the environment by a manipulation check on the environment itself, not on the agent. SUPPORTED if the goal-seeded arm accumulates strictly higher INTEGRATED benefit than the value-flat arm on >= 2/3 seeds WHILE MATCHED ON CONTACT COUNT -- the matching is load-bearing, since an unmatched advantage is consistent with the planned arm simply foraging more. REFUTED if integrated benefit is equal or lower with goal-seeded rollout demonstrably live and the two optima demonstrably divergent.

MECH-479.subject: goal_directed.prosocial_trajectory_planning
MECH-479.title: prosocial_planning_requires_planned_system. Planning trajectories that affect ANOTHER agent's z_harm_a accumulation and benefit_exposure over time is structurally inaccessible to a 1-step greedy policy and requires the hippocampally-planned pathway. Split out of MECH-163 leg (3) on 2026-07-22 and REFILED implementation_phase v3 -> v4: there is no V3 substrate for it whatsoever -- no second agent exists, hence no other-agent z_harm_a to plan over. Arguably the clearest single piece of granularity debt in MECH-163, since the leg had been carrying a V3 implementation_phase it could not possibly satisfy since 2026-04-02.
MECH-479.what_would_answer: GATED on the V4 multi-agent substrate. SUPPORTED if a planned-arm agent reduces a SECOND agent's integrated z_harm_a relative to a greedy-arm agent on >= 2/3 seeds, WITH ITS OWN RESOURCE ACQUISITION MATCHED -- the matching is load-bearing, otherwise the effect is confounded by the planned agent simply being better at everything. REFUTED if planned and greedy arms are indistinguishable on the other agent's integrated harm, with both arms demonstrably able to PERCEIVE the other agent (mandatory manipulation check; without it a null is a perception failure, not a planning failure).

MECH-480.subject: cingulate.lofc_execution_gain_dissociation
MECH-480.title: LOFC-analog execution-gain channel is dissociable from dACC-analog (SD-032b) strategy authority: how strongly a persisting policy is expressed should be modeled as a control channel distinct from whether the policy retains behavioural-adjustment authority.
MECH-480.what_would_answer: Ablate SD-032b's adjustment-magnitude output (dacc_weight=0 vs >0, an existing config flag -- no new substrate needed) while leaving action selection and E3 scoring otherwise intact. Measure (i) outcome-sensitivity: does the agent correctly re-weight toward a newly-favoured trajectory after a reward-contingency change (an authority metric), and (ii) execution strength: the logit margin / softmax confidence of the committed action (a gain metric that deliberately does NOT require committed-action diversity, avoiding the F-dominance/committed-action floor-lock that blocks MECH-260's entropy-based c2 tests -- see MECH-260 notes). PASS (supports dissociation): outcome-sensitivity degrades under ablation while execution strength is statistically unchanged -- the two vary independently. FAIL (does not support): both degrade together at matched effect size under every ablation tried -- fold this claim back into SD-032b. NON-DEGENERACY: execution-strength (logit margin) must show non-zero cross-arm/cross-seed variance in the OFF-ablation baseline; if it is pinned near a ceiling or floor regardless of arm, the run is substrate_not_ready, not a verdict.

MECH-481.subject: control_plane.typed_coalition_instantiation
MECH-481.title: Selective cognitive coalition instantiation: the control plane converts typed control demands (e.g. PROVENANCE_CHECK, COUNTERFACTUAL_EXPANSION, SOCIAL_MODEL_CHECK) into temporary functional interaction graphs over E1/E2/hippocampal/reality-coherence/social/language/affective/E3 systems, recruiting only the subsystems relevant to the discrepancy type.
MECH-481.what_would_answer: Four-arm ablation on a task battery deliberately constructed to contain at least two distinct discrepancy types (e.g. a perceptual-doubt trial requiring resampling and a provenance-doubt trial requiring source reconstruction) at matched base difficulty. Arm 1 (monitoring-only): agent registers a typed low-confidence/conflict signal but the processing configuration never changes. Arm 2 (parametric-only): agent may adjust precision/commitment threshold on a typed signal but cannot recruit additional subsystems. Arm 3 (untyped coalition): agent may recruit arbitrary additional subsystems but all discrepancy types collapse into one undifferentiated REFLECT trigger (no typing). Arm 4 (typed coalition, the mechanism under test): discrepancy type is matched to a coalition template that recruits only the relevant subsystems. PASS (supports): Arm 4 shows selective improvement concentrated in the matched problem class (e.g. provenance-doubt trials improve on the provenance-coalition, not on perceptual-doubt trials) at lower computational cost than Arm 3, and Arms 1-3 each show their predicted deficit signature (1: accurate confidence but no behavioural improvement; 2: generic caution/deferral without resolving type-specific uncertainty; 3: costly over-recruitment / interference / unstable switching). FAIL (does not support): Arm 4 does not outperform Arm 3 on the matched problem class (typing does no discriminative work beyond raw recruitment), or Arm 2 alone matches Arm 4 (coalition/topology control adds nothing beyond existing parametric modulation). NON-DEGENERACY: the underlying typed discrepancy signals (confidence/provenance/coherence-conflict) must show non-zero cross-trial-type variance in Arm 1's baseline; if the agent cannot distinguish discrepancy types at all, the typing manipulation in Arms 3 vs 4 is vacuous and the run is substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. A fifth check (coalition persistence -- premature dissolution vs over-long engagement, scenario 5 in the source thought) is a follow-on refinement, not part of this claim's primary falsifier -- register separately if Arm 4 passes.

MECH-482.subject: drive.epistemic_deficit_accumulator
MECH-482.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.
MECH-482.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a substrate where target-bound
uncertainty can be tracked per-candidate/per-region (MECH-314b is currently
a global scalar per the existing curiosity intake -- not yet built in V3)
AND where cross-seed/cross-condition variance in the accumulator is
non-zero (not floor-pinned at zero or ceiling-saturated) -- below that the
run self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a verdict. CONFIRMING signature
(once built): an unresolved, consequential uncertainty accumulates across
time steps even as raw novelty and instantaneous prediction error fall to
baseline, AND providing diagnostic/resolving evidence specifically quenches
the accumulator (satiation) rather than only reducing raw uncertainty.
FALSIFYING signature: no persistent deficit state is needed to explain
information-seeking behaviour -- raw novelty (MECH-314a) or raw uncertainty
(MECH-314b) alone predict exploration equally well, OR the accumulator
remains elevated after verified resolution (no satiation), OR the system
preferentially engages irreducible noise over learnable uncertainty (would
falsify the expected_resolvability term).

MECH-483.subject: policy.orient_survey_regime
MECH-483.title: orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.
MECH-483.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires trajectories to be classifiable as
orient-mode vs random-exploration vs directed-approach on some structural
measure (state-coverage, trajectory structure, observation-before-commitment)
with non-zero variance across conditions -- a run where all three regimes
are behaviourally indistinguishable self-routes substrate_not_ready.
CONFIRMING signature: a structured orient/survey condition improves LATER
action-selection quality (not just entropy/state-coverage) relative to
matched stochastic-exploration-only and no-orienting baselines, and
terminates (commitment resumes) once uncertainty measurably falls.
FALSIFYING signature: orient/survey behaviour is indistinguishable from
random wandering with no benefit to later competence, OR orienting
persists despite already-adequate information (no termination condition),
OR the same benefit is fully explained by existing MECH-313/314/320/ARC-065
substrates with no need for a distinct regime.

MECH-484.subject: development.sensitive_period_coupling_plasticity_narrowing
MECH-484.title: Sensitive-period plasticity narrowing follows social-coupling consolidation: consolidation of the initial coupling pattern is obligate (occurs regardless of coupling quality, adaptive or maladaptive) and is followed by a plasticity-reduction window that closes around whichever pattern existed at consolidation, rather than continuing to update on subsequent coupling quality.

MECH-485.subject: commitment.predicted_harm_confidence_threshold_gated_triage
MECH-485.title: A single predicted-harm/success magnitude with an associated confidence (epistemic_deficit) term, computed from E2/E3 forward rollouts, is threshold-gated into three distinct consumers rather than producing one uniform response: real-time interrupt/reroute of a committed trajectory or a newly branched choice (via the MECH-090/MECH-141/MECH-138 hyperdirect and cancel-window pathways) when confidence is high and magnitude crosses the interrupt threshold; information-seeking orient/survey (MECH-482/MECH-483) when confidence is too low to trust the magnitude; and retention of the alternative for later counterfactual evaluation and responsibility attribution when magnitude is sub-threshold but non-trivial.

MECH-486.subject: language.tom_representational_interference
MECH-486.title: Representational interference between language and fast empathy: discrete/reportable/sequential language representations and graded/affective/resonant empathy representations exert conflicting representational pressures, so forcing them into one shared workspace too early measurably degrades BOTH relative to separated systems at matched capacity.
MECH-486.what_would_answer:
SUBSTRATE PRECONDITION: requires both a language channel and a fast-empathy
channel (MECH-405), neither of which exists in V3.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: each system must reach a measurable competence
when trained ALONE, so that a shared-workspace deficit is attributable to
interference rather than to one of them never having worked.
CONFIRMING signature: a shared-workspace arm degrades on BOTH a
language-fidelity metric and an other-bound-affect metric relative to a
separated-workspace arm, at MATCHED total capacity and compute, with the
degradation growing as the two training signals are made more simultaneous
(the "too early" clause -- interference should be worse under early merging
than under merging after each system has consolidated separately).
UNSUPPORTED if the shared-workspace arm matches or beats the separated arm at
matched capacity, or if the deficit disappears once capacity is equalised --
that result says the limiting factor was capacity, not conflicting
representational pressure, and ARC-123 would then rest on the developmental
evidence alone with no mechanistic support.

MECH-487.subject: memory.uncommitted_candidate_retention_provenance_tagged
MECH-487.title: A bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer for rejected/uncommitted E3 candidate trajectories: it persists WHICH differentiated alternative was considered (identity plus a trajectory/value sketch, not merely a transient scalar) past the tick it was rejected on, so a later stage can counterfactually evaluate it and attribute responsibility -- admitted and typed under the MECH-322 template (audited replay_origin-style flag, fail-closed admission, accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution), riding ON the MECH-094 imagination/reality write gate rather than relaxing it.
MECH-487.what_would_answer:
Registered 2026-08-07 from the dedicated lit-pull commissioned by MECH-485 /
INV-012 leg 3 and by memory project_imagination_learning_constraints.md
(2026-05-10), which gated this exact registration "do NOT register without
dedicated lit-pull". Literature: evidence/literature/
targeted_review_uncommitted_candidate_retention/ (5 entries).

MECHANISM SHAPE the lit-pull grounds -- TWO disciplines, both required:
(1) a TYPING discipline (Schnider 2013 orbitofrontal reality filtering,
10.3389/fnbeh.2013.00067; Bouzerda-Wahlen 2015 reality-filter / source-
monitoring dissociation, 10.1162/jocn_a_00686): retained content must carry a
fast, standalone provenance/reality tag -- separable from the "which
alternative" content -- that keeps it typed considered-but-not-real and off
the residue/valence/hippocampal write paths committed action gets; the failure
mode of an untyped store is confabulation. This is REE's MECH-094
committed_vs_imagined bit, made load-bearing.
(2) a BOUNDING discipline (Janner 2019 MBPO, arXiv:1906.08253): imagined /
non-executed content may feed evaluation/learning only within a bounded,
uncertainty-gated, corroboration-limited regime -- MBPO's short model-trust
horizon is the algorithmic form of MECH-322's fail-closed admission plus
accelerated dissolution of any chunk not corroborated by real waking
execution; the trust bound should scale with model uncertainty (REE
epistemic_deficit / MECH-482), tying retention to the same confidence term
that routes MECH-485's orient/survey leg.

LICITNESS (the other half of the lit-pull's question): Boorman 2011
(10.1371/journal.pbio.1001093) shows a dedicated frontopolar network tracks
the BEST counterfactual (unchosen) option and carries a counterfactual
prediction error for learning from hypothetical feedback -- so retaining and
learning from rejected options is a normal adaptive function, not confabulation
by construction, PROVIDED it stays a prior for future testing (memory LICIT
category #4) under the bounding discipline above. Its selectivity (the BEST
option, not all) bears on Q-090's admission criterion.

WHAT IS ALREADY BUILT vs MISSING: Boorman 2009 (10.1016/j.neuron.2009.05.014)
is the biological anchor for REE's SD-033e/MECH-264 frontopolar counterfactual
value, but the signal is an ONLINE relative-advantage magnitude -- exactly
MECH-264's cfv_now transient scalar overwritten every tick. So the substrate
for representing a rejected alternative's VALUE exists; what does NOT exist in
ree-v3 in any form is persistence of WHICH alternative existed, past the tick,
in a store usable for retrospective evaluation. That identity + persistence is
MECH-487's novel content.

CONFIRMED if a built retention buffer (a) persists a rejected E3 candidate's
identity / trajectory-sketch past the tick it was rejected on, (b) keeps it
provenance-distinguishable from committed/real content under test (no elevated
confidence for imagined-only content leaking into residue/valence/hippocampal
channels -- the confabulation guard holds behaviourally, not just by design),
and (c) supplies a function -- measurably different counterfactual evaluation
or self-attribution behaviour -- BEYOND what MECH-264's existing transient
scalar already provides, over a discard-immediately ablation baseline.

FALSIFIED if retained-alternative content cannot be kept distinguishable from
committed content without a hand-tuned, case-by-case gate (no general
MECH-322-shaped template suffices) -- i.e. the confabulation risk is not
tractably bounded, and the mechanism should be retired or radically narrowed --
OR if a bounded, provenance-tagged retention buffer produces no measurable
change in counterfactual-evaluation / responsibility-relevant behaviour over
the discard-immediately (MECH-264-only) baseline, i.e. persistence-of-identity
adds no function beyond the existing transient scalar.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (shared with MECH-485 / INV-012 leg 3): MECH-439's
E3 selection conversion ceiling must clear first (ceiling_decision: exhausted
as of registration) -- with no genuinely differentiated candidates to select
among, there is nothing to retain, so no retention test is meaningful. Do NOT
build ahead of that clearing, or ahead of Q-090's admission-criterion
resolution (same-scale vs independent goal-match). Architectural synthesis
grounded in the cited literature; not yet verified against a built ree-v3
retention buffer, which does not exist.

MECH-488.subject: control_plane.selection_conflict_brake
MECH-488.title: A selection-conflict signal (E3's per-candidate decision-gap, gap_norm) should feed the control plane as a distinct S6 class, driving K5 control-allocation escalation and K10 hard-veto threshold as a fast, conflict-triggered brake -- an STN-hyperdirect-style mechanism, complementary to (not a substitute for) the existing tonic Go/No-Go + lateral-inhibition selection machinery (MECH-449/MECH-450).
MECH-488.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (hard gate -- do not attempt to build or test this
claim without it): MECH-439's F-dominance / candidate-pool-collapse conversion
ceiling must first clear (candidate diversity demonstrated to reach committed
action, per the standing MECH-439 falsifier ladder), such that BOTH of the
following hold on the cleared substrate: (a) gap_norm regains genuine
cross-seed spread (gap_spread_seeds >= 2, mirroring V3-EXQ-689's own
non-vacuity gate), and (b) the PAG freeze-gate shows non-zero engagement
under the same substrate (pag_release_count_end > 0 in >=2/3 seeds, mirroring
SD-037 axis Phase-3's acceptance gate). Do not queue an experiment against
this claim until both (a) and (b) are independently confirmed -- a run on a
substrate where either is still pinned at zero self-routes
substrate_not_ready_requeue, it is not a verdict on this claim.

Once both preconditions hold: build the S6 signal path (propagate gap_norm
out of _gap_scaled_commit_pick as a control-plane-visible quantity; wire it
as an additional, independent input alongside the existing z_harm_a-based
trigger into K10's freeze-commit condition and/or K5's control-allocation
escalation). Run a 2-arm comparison (gap_norm-informed brake vs. harm-only
brake, matched substrate, matched seeds).

CONFIRMING: the informed arm fires >=1 additional non-degenerate
freeze/escalation event per seed on >=2/3 seeds that is attributable to
selection conflict (high gap_norm at a tick where z_harm_a alone would not
have triggered), AND existing harm-triggered freeze behaviour is unchanged
(no regression on the harm-only trigger pathway).

FALSIFYING: the informed arm shows no additional discriminable events beyond
seed noise, OR wiring the signal delays/degrades harm-triggered freeze
commitment (the new input interferes with the existing, validated MECH-279
commit law).

MECH-489.subject: pag.defensive_orienting_response
MECH-489.title: Defensive-orienting response: a phasic freeze-arrest -> orient/identify -> epistemic-sufficiency-override -> valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume behavioural chain triggered by a sudden, UNIDENTIFIED onset (positive-derivative spike in unsigned prediction-error surprise and/or sensory-discriminative harm), distinct from MECH-279 (chronic, accumulated-suffering freeze) and from MECH-482/MECH-483 (persistent target-bound epistemic_deficit accumulator and the diffuse orient/survey regime it drives -- the opposite end of the timescale from this PHASIC, transient trigger, which MECH-482 explicitly excludes by definition).
MECH-489.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires the two onset channels (residue_surprise, z_harm_s norm)
to show non-zero variance in the evaluation run (a run where neither channel ever crosses its
onset delta self-routes substrate_not_ready / trigger_never_fired, not a verdict).
CONFIRMING signature: ablation ON vs OFF (same seeds, same ground-truth injected-event
schedule as observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b) shows (a) the trigger fires reliably on
limb_damage_injected / external_hazard_injected / world_rule_shift_occurred -- the specific
ground-truth event set Section 12h identified as the pre-build design's failure mode; (b) the
ON arm's surprise-onset->freeze and post-identification dread->withdraw / excite->approach
couplings move well past the pre-build incidental baselines (12b: P(moved@t+1|spike)=44.3% vs
24.0%; P(mode-change@t+1|spike)=15.4% vs 11.1%) toward a sharp, deterministic signature.
FALSIFYING signature: the trigger still under-fires on the ground-truth event set despite the
two-channel redesign (channel choice was still wrong, not just calibration); OR the ON arm's
behaviour-coupling numbers are statistically indistinguishable from the OFF arm's incidental
baseline (the mechanism adds a gate but not a genuine coupling); OR identification-confidence
resolves on a fixed schedule regardless of whether the triggering signal has genuinely decayed
(the freeze is a disguised timer, not epistemically driven -- the exact failure mode the
baseline-freeze fix during the build was designed to prevent, so this would indicate a
regression or an unforeseen second such bug).

MECH-490.subject: sleep.action_sequence_coherence_via_commitment_gate_persistence
MECH-490.title: Sleep-associated action-sequence coherence via E3 commitment-gate persistence: if sleep increases post-sleep action-run coherence (fewer local re-decisions / reversals, longer directionally-persistent action runs) in the Fishtank substrate, the most mechanistically plausible route is increased persistence of E3Selector's commitment gate (lower commit_variance -> longer open-loop execution of an already-committed action sequence, reducing per-tick CEM/softmax re-scoring) -- NOT a global reduction in stochasticity (structurally excluded: sleep never touches the noise floor/temperature), NOT preferential consolidation of specifically successful trajectories (replay sampling is confirmed outcome-agnostic, staleness- or uniform-weighted), and NOT policy-chunking macro-execution (use_chunk_proposal_injection is confirmed off in every Fishtank driver, bit-identical to chunking being absent).
MECH-490.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires (a) spawn position matched across WITH_SLEEP/NO_SLEEP
arms at each compared segment index (CONFIRMED UNMATCHED in the only existing data,
V3-EXQ-913 -- a run with this precondition unmet self-routes substrate_not_ready, not a
verdict), and (b) E3Selector commit-variance/commit-gate-engagement logged per matched
window, so the behavioural signature can be tied to the mechanism rather than left as an
unexplained correlation.
CONFIRMING signature: with spawn position matched and commit-variance instrumented, WITH_SLEEP
windows show BOTH (i) a directionally consistent lift in action-run coherence (mean run
length, turning-entropy/tortuosity reduction) across >=5 seeds at a sign-test or permutation
p<0.05, AND (ii) that lift covaries with commit-gate engagement rate/lower commit-variance in
the same windows -- behaviour and proposed mechanism must move together, not just the
behaviour alone.
FALSIFYING signature: the coherence lift (if real) shows NO relationship to commit-gate
engagement (mechanism wrong even if behaviour is real); OR a matched "long wake interval, no
sleep firing" control shows the SAME coherence gain given equivalent elapsed time/experience
(relocates the cause to time/experience accumulation, not sleep); OR the effect does not
survive the transfer test to a structurally different ecology (route memorisation, not
reorganisation).

MECH-491.subject: memory.external_scent_trace_internal_memory_interaction
MECH-491.title: REE emitting a slowly-decaying self-scent trail into the environment, later re-encountered as an external sensory signal, produces measurable interaction with internal spatial/episodic memory (confirmation, conflict, or substitution effects) that is distinct from -- and detectable independently of -- internal memory operating alone.
MECH-491.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires a self-scent-deposit-and-decay mechanism in the environment substrate (does not exist in v3 fish-world) and REE's internal episodic/spatial memory state readable at the point of comparison.
CONFIRMING: REE's behaviour or internal-memory readout differs measurably between (a) revisiting a location with its own fresh scent present, (b) revisiting after the scent has decayed, and (c) revisiting a location never visited but carrying another organism's overlapping scent -- in a pattern consistent with the scent functioning as an external memory cue (e.g. faster reorientation, altered precision/confidence signals, or measurable belief updating), not merely being ignored.
FALSIFYING: behaviour/internal state is statistically indistinguishable across conditions (a)-(c), or the self-scent signal is used identically to any other undifferentiated sensory-novelty cue -- i.e. REE shows no differential treatment of "this is my own trace" versus "this is unfamiliar."

MECH-492.subject: sleep.mech286_threat_term_sourcing
MECH-492.title: MECH-286's sleep-permission threat conjunct is an UNCALIBRATED, UNDECLARED-SOURCE consumer of the same shared z_harm_a.norm() expression whose place-safety informativeness V3-EXQ-917 showed is set by unrelated driver config: the gate's third term is `z_harm_a.norm() < mech286_threat_tonic_threshold` (default 0.4), the identical expression MECH-303's contextual-safety gate reads, which measures at chance (AUC <= 0.52 across 18 swept thresholds) under damage_sourced and at AUC 0.84-0.97 under the proximity_ema_sourced default. MECH-286 declares no sourcing mode of its own and inherits whichever the driver happens to set, and its 0.4 threshold has never been calibrated against any measurement of that signal. Therefore, with use_mech286_sleep_onset_gate enabled, threat_ok does not reliably gate on place safety; being ANDed into a three-way conjunction, a near-constant term silently degrades the gate to an effective always-permit (or, above threshold, always-refuse) rather than a safety gate.
MECH-492.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the falsifier must drive the agent through REAL world positions with known ground-truth hazard and read the gate's own emitted diagnostics there. It must NOT set z_harm_a by hand -- see the V3-EXQ-891 correction in notes below, which is exactly the degenerate form.
NO NEW SUBSTRATE INSTRUMENTATION IS NEEDED: evaluate_sleep_onset_permit already emits mech286_threat_ok, mech286_z_harm_a_norm, and mech286_threat_tonic_threshold in its diagnostics dict. A new DRIVER is needed (891 cannot be reused as-is); no ree_core change is.
The falsifier must be run under BOTH sourcing modes (limb_damage_enabled True and False), because the whole point of the claim is that MECH-286 declares neither and inherits whichever the driver sets.
CONFIRMING (claim SUPPORTED): mech286_threat_ok fails to discriminate hazardous from non-hazardous locations above chance under the sourcing mode(s) tested, OR is invariant across the ground-truth hazard gradient (near-constant 0 or 1 across all locations), OR discriminates under one sourcing mode and not the other -- the last being the specific "informativeness inherited from unrelated driver config" leg, and the one that would confirm the claim in its exact registered form.
FALSIFYING (claim REFUTED): mech286_threat_ok discriminates hazardous from non-hazardous locations above chance under BOTH sourcing modes at the default threshold of 0.4, i.e. the term does gate on place safety regardless of driver configuration and the sourcing is adequate as built.
ALSO FALSIFYING (weaker, partial): the term is shown to be near-constant but the conjunction's behaviour is nonetheless unaffected because another conjunct is always the binding one -- in which case the wiring is still undeclared but the "silently degrades the gate" consequence does not hold, and this claim should be narrowed rather than supported.

MECH-493.subject: context.inference_as_hysteresis_bearing_arbitration
MECH-493.title: Context inference is an active, persistent control process rather than passive nearest-match retrieval: selecting which latent situation is currently active is itself a COMMITMENT-BEARING act that requires hysteresis (a switch threshold and switch cost preventing small fluctuations from continuously reinterpreting the situation) and a protected EXPLOITATION WINDOW (a period after selection during which the organism acts on the interpretation rather than immediately reopening inference). Without both, a sufficiently uncertainty-sensitive agent becomes PERMANENTLY EPISTEMIC -- continuously checking, rarely acting. REE already has a developed commitment-hysteresis account (MECH-106 dwell/switch-cost, MECH-047 asymmetric de-commitment) but applies it only to the ACTION/mode variable; this claim asserts the same machinery is required one level up, on the CONTEXT variable, where no dwell, switch cost, or protected window currently exists (ARC-062's learned context discriminator is a soft per-step gate with none of these). The loop spans existing modules (ContextMemory, epistemic_deficit, orient/survey, event segmenter, commitment) and does NOT require a new executive module.
MECH-493.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory -- without it the run is vacuous):
(i) the context variable must be observably live -- context assignment must vary
across episodes and be recoverable from the substrate, NOT collapsed to a single
value (cf. V3-EXQ-436f, where 3/5 seeds occupied exactly 1 of 16 ContextMemory
slots despite thousands of write() calls); (ii) the agent must not have collapsed
to monostrategy (MECH-309) -- either run on the ARC-062 gated-policy substrate or
pre-register MECH-309 collapse as an alternative explanation, because a
monostrategy agent has no context-conditional behaviour for context arbitration
to affect and will produce a null for reasons unrelated to this claim;
(iii) MECH-153's undifferentiated-ContextMemory finding (cosine_sim ~= 1.0 without
a supervised context objective) must be excluded or the retrieval path is silent.

CONFIRMING: in an environment family containing perceptually similar states
requiring OPPOSING policies, an agent with hysteresis + exploitation window
(a) maintains the active context under minor/transient ambiguity, (b) switches
when evidence genuinely and persistently favours another context, and (c) achieves
higher task competence than a matched no-hysteresis ablation BECAUSE it sustains
an interpretation long enough to act on it -- with the competence gain traceable
to increased mean dwell in a correct context, not merely to fewer switches.

FALSIFYING, two distinct routes, BOTH of which count against this claim:
(1) SUFFICIENCY OF THE SIMPLE ACCOUNT -- context switching in these environments is
fully explained by similarity retrieval alone or by unsigned prediction error
alone, with no residual variance for hysteresis/orienting to explain; the larger
mechanism is then unnecessary.
(2) OVERBUILD / PATHOLOGY -- adding uncertainty-sensitivity, orienting and
hysteresis fails to improve hidden-context discrimination, OR produces pathological
indecision (the permanently-epistemic failure: orienting occupancy rises without a
corresponding competence gain). Note route (2) is a REAL predicted risk of this
claim's own mechanism, not merely a null -- an agent with orienting but without a
protected exploitation window should be predicted to get WORSE, and observing that
specific pattern supports the necessity of the window while falsifying any account
that treats orienting alone as sufficient.

MECH-494.subject: context.switch_criterion_structured_explanatory_failure
MECH-494.title: The criterion for abandoning an inferred context is PERSISTENT, STRUCTURED evidence that the currently inferred latent situation no longer explains observations OR THEIR ACTION CONSEQUENCES -- not unsigned prediction-error magnitude. A startling transient, sensor noise, gradual environmental drift, and a genuine latent-state transition can all produce large prediction error, and should NOT produce the same response: transient surprise should not switch context, gradual drift may warrant update-in-place rather than switch, and only genuine latent transition should switch. The ACTION-CONSEQUENCE term is the part with no existing REE analogue: MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD change-point already supplies a persistence-based (rather than threshold-based) boundary signal over z_goal, but it is computed over observations and is consumed as a region KEY by downstream substrates (MECH-269 anchor sets, per-region V_s, MECH-284 staleness, MECH-287 broadcast) -- nothing consumes it to arbitrate retain-vs-switch-vs-create over stored contexts.
MECH-494.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the four conditions must be genuinely dissociable in
the substrate -- transient surprise, sensor noise, gradual drift, and abrupt latent
transition must each be independently inducible and must produce COMPARABLE
unsigned prediction-error magnitude at the moment of onset. If the abrupt-transition
condition simply produces larger PE than the others, the design cannot distinguish
this claim from a PE-magnitude threshold and the run is vacuous. Verify by
measuring the PE distributions per condition BEFORE scoring any switch behaviour.

CONFIRMING: context-switch rate is predicted by persistent structured explanatory
failure and NOT by instantaneous PE magnitude, specifically -- switches are rare
under transient surprise and under noise (high PE, no sustained explanatory
failure), rare-or-update-in-place under gradual drift, and reliable under abrupt
latent transition. Additionally, and this is the discriminating half: a condition in
which OBSERVATIONS remain well-explained but ACTION CONSEQUENCES do not (the same
scene now rewards the opposite policy) triggers switching, which an
observation-only criterion such as MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD cannot detect.

FALSIFYING: switch behaviour is fully predicted by an unsigned-PE threshold or by
MECH-288's existing observation-side change-point alone, with the action-consequence
term adding no independent predictive power; OR the four conditions cannot be
behaviourally dissociated at all, which would indicate the criterion is not
implemented (distinct from being wrong -- report as non_contributory, not as a
claim-layer falsification).

MECH-495.subject: memory.relational_topology_objective
MECH-495.title: The objective for hippocampal/episodic memory organisation is RELATIONAL APPROPRIATENESS, not maximal pattern separation: related experiences should overlap appropriately (overlap is what supports generalisation and memory linking) while behaviourally distinct latent situations should separate appropriately. It follows that "more diverse slots", greater slot occupancy, and lower representational overlap are NOT objectives in themselves, and that a metric which is monotonically improved by increasing differentiation is scoring the wrong quantity regardless of whether it is computed correctly. This is a claim about the TARGET, and is therefore distinct from -- and not answered by -- the already-established finding that REE's slot_cosine_sim family was computed incorrectly (whole-bank, no occupancy mask; 2026-08-07 governance reversal at V3-EXQ-436d) or the finding that the ContextMemory write path could not produce differentiation at all (scores.mean(0).argmin() single-slot fixed point; V3-EXQ-436f).
MECH-495.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory): (i) the memory store must actually be
recruiting multiple slots -- V3-EXQ-436f found 3/5 seeds occupying exactly 1 of 16
slots despite 2,837-4,903 write() calls each, and a single-slot store has NO
topology to evaluate, making any relational statistic undefined rather than merely
null; verify occupancy BEFORE computing any topology statistic. (ii) The environment
must expose GROUND-TRUTH latent-context labels, since the statistic is an agreement
measure against that structure -- this is a design constraint on the substrate, not
an afterthought. (iii) All four cells of the 2x2 must be populated at adequate n.

TEST DESIGN: vary perceptual similarity and latent-context identity INDEPENDENTLY --
(similar appearance, same context), (similar appearance, DIFFERENT context),
(different appearance, SAME context), (different appearance, different context).
The diagonal cells are what any similarity-driven store gets right for free. The two
OFF-DIAGONAL cells are the entire test: similar-appearance/different-context is
where a nearest-match store fails by MERGING; different-appearance/same-context is
where a maximal-separation store fails by SPLITTING.

CONFIRMING: representational similarity structure tracks LATENT-CONTEXT structure
rather than perceptual similarity -- specifically, representations in the
different-appearance/same-context cell overlap MORE than those in the
similar-appearance/different-context cell, and this ordering predicts downstream
generalisation and discrimination performance. Critically, a differentiation-
maximising objective scores the similar-appearance/different-context cell correctly
and the different-appearance/same-context cell BACKWARDS, so the two objectives make
OPPOSITE predictions in that cell -- that cell is the discriminator between this
claim and the incumbent objective, and a design that omits it cannot decide between
them.

FALSIFYING: a maximal-separation objective predicts downstream generalisation and
discrimination at least as well as the relational-topology objective across all four
cells (i.e. appropriate overlap confers no measurable benefit and separating
everything is not merely harmless but optimal); OR the relational statistic cannot be
computed at adequate power because latent-context ground truth is not recoverable
from the substrate (report non_contributory, not falsified).

NOT ANSWERED BY: any re-run of the SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 lineage scored on a
differentiation DV, however correctly that DV is computed. Six generations
(V3-EXQ-436a..436f) have established measurement and substrate facts about
differentiation; none of them tested whether differentiation is the right target.

(iv) DEVELOPMENTAL TIMING (added 2026-08-23 per MECH-496 / INV-101): the topology
statistic must be read either AFTER representational structure has stopped changing,
or as a trajectory ACROSS the change. A system whose bucket structure is still
plastic will read as poor relational agreement on any static snapshot, and that
reading is an artifact of TIMING, not evidence against the objective -- so a run that
omits this precondition can produce a false FALSIFYING result. If no crystallisation
schedule exists in the substrate (TRUE AT REGISTRATION: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) is
a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth or allocation policy), record the structure at
a declared, fixed training point and state that point explicitly, so the snapshot is
at least comparable across arms. See MECH-496's own what_would_answer precondition
(iii) -- do not re-derive it.

MECH-496.subject: memory.representational_dimensionality_crystallization
MECH-496.title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.
MECH-496.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (mandatory).
(i) The store must be recruiting more than one slot before ANY dimensionality
statistic is computed -- V3-EXQ-436f found 3/5 seeds occupying exactly 1 of 16 slots
despite 2,837-4,903 write() calls each. A single-slot store has no dimensionality to
measure. This INHERITS MECH-495's precondition (i); do not re-derive it.
(ii) num_slots must actually be VARIED. The claim is about dimensionality as an
OUTCOME, so a single fixed-N run cannot address it in either direction.
(iii) The schedule must be OBSERVABLE: whether the effective number of distinct
buckets in use CHANGES over training must be recorded per-episode, not only at the
end. A single end-of-training snapshot cannot distinguish "crystallised at N" from
"was always N", and the distinction is the claim.

CONFIRMING: with num_slots varied across a range spanning under- and
over-provisioning relative to the environment's ground-truth latent-context count --
(a) the effective bucket count in use converges toward the GROUND-TRUTH count rather
than toward num_slots; (b) that convergence is non-monotone in plasticity -- high
early, reducing -- rather than flat; and (c) downstream generalisation /
discrimination is FLAT with respect to num_slots over the range where (a) holds.
(c) is the LOAD-BEARING leg: it is the claim that the architecture is insensitive to
a constant which is currently hand-set.

FALSIFYING: effective bucket count tracks num_slots rather than the environment (the
store simply fills what it is given); OR downstream performance is MONOTONE in
num_slots (more is just better, so dimensionality is a capacity parameter and not a
structure to be resolved); OR the effective count is FLAT across training (no
schedule, so crystallisation is doing no work even if the final count happens to be
right).

CHEAPEST FIRST STEP -- A PROBE, NOT A BUILD. Treat num_slots as a declared
experimental variable rather than a constant and re-run the V3-EXQ-436 lineage across
a small sweep. If the 436-lineage results are STABLE across num_slots, the
dimensionality question is not currently load-bearing and this claim can wait; if they
MOVE, it is. This is `complex (probe-gated)` work resolving to `puzzle (known rules)`,
NOT the `complicated (buildable)` self-sizing-memory build, and must not be routed as
the latter. Registered as a proposal at intake; see manual_proposals.v1.json.

NOT ANSWERED BY: any run at a single fixed num_slots, however well designed --
including MECH-495's own 2x2, unless that 2x2 is itself swept over num_slots.

MECH-497.subject: control_plane.self_referential_stopping_failure
MECH-497.title: A persistent cognitive process can degrade the very confidence/evidence variable that gates its own termination condition, producing a positive-feedback failure to stop: repeated verification/checking reduces subjective recollective confidence while leaving objective accuracy largely intact, so the stopping condition ('sufficiently confident') becomes progressively harder to satisfy the more it is checked. This self-referential-measurement failure is mechanistically distinct from MECH-080's attractor-lock-in account of OCD (deep locked rollout basin via BG/ACh gate dynamics); the two may co-occur but a substrate fix for one does not by itself fix the other.

MECH-498.subject: control_plane.progress_gated_disengagement
MECH-498.title: Continuation of a persistent process should be gated jointly on marginal expected return relative to available alternatives (Marginal Value Theorem framing) AND on the observed RATE of progress -- whether uncertainty, goal-distance, or informational yield is actually decreasing under continued investment, not only its current absolute level -- so that a process whose marginal progress has collapsed increasingly loses justification for further resource allocation even while absolute uncertainty/value remains high. This is the disengagement-direction complement to MECH-343/SD-061's difficulty-gated proposal-entropy WIDENING response to stall: it covers the case where widening the search ALSO fails to restore progress.

MECH-499.subject: hippocampus.ephaptic_actionable_now_aggregation
MECH-499.title: Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

MECH-500.subject: control_plane.field_coherence_commitment_readiness
MECH-500.title: Content authority (which candidate future should win commitment -- already REE's existing architecture via MECH-090/MECH-341/ARC-003) and temporal/readiness authority (whether a candidate future has become sufficiently coherent, in the cross-system field-coherence sense, for commitment to be permitted to land AT ALL) are distinct constitutional questions that may require different mechanisms. Fast cross-system field coherence (extending MECH-499's content-aggregation function) is a candidate mechanism for the readiness axis specifically -- locating the moving frontier at which a previously branching predicted future becomes sufficiently well-predicted for commitment to land -- distinct from MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference layer, and distinct from MECH-090's beta-gated propagation of an already-decided commit.

MECH-501.subject: commitment.interrupt_triggered_now_reconstruction
MECH-501.title: Interruption of a committed trajectory by a sufficiently consequential prediction violation should trigger an explicit BACKWARD RECONSTRUCTION of the current-state estimate proposed by ARC-129 -- a measurable discontinuity in which the forward-displaced predicted-now s_hat(t+tau) is replaced by a less-displaced, evidence-corrected estimate closer to s_hat(t) -- distinct from, and downstream of, gate re-opening (MECH-090) and decommitment (MECH-342), which govern behavioral/ACTION authority but say nothing about what happens to the STATE REPRESENTATION consumed as 'now' at the moment of interrupt. Expected corollary: unexpected interruption of a highly predictable action-linked sequence should produce stronger state-estimate reconstruction than an expected within-trajectory correction of the same magnitude.

MECH-502.subject: commitment.nested_multiscale_displacement_horizons
MECH-502.title: Because REE can hold multiple simultaneously-active commitments at different behavioural scales (e.g., a fine-grained motor/action-level commitment nested within a longer path/sequence-level commitment, itself nested within a longer goal-level commitment), the displaced-present construction proposed by ARC-129 should not be modeled as one global scalar displacement but as potentially several concurrently-active, differently-scoped forward-displacement horizons -- with local interrupt/correction at a fine-grained level (e.g., a single-step prediction-error correction) plausibly not requiring re-opening of a coarser-grained commitment, and vice versa. This is a nesting-of-DISPLACEMENT-HORIZONS claim, distinct from ARC-070/MECH-321's nesting of POLICY-DECOMPOSITION depth (which recursively re-segments candidate action primitives, not the temporal position of the consumed current-state estimate).

MECH-503.subject: control_plane.motif_selection_and_content_binding
MECH-503.title: Motif selection and content binding: given a typed control demand or task requirement, the control plane should select a reusable computational motif (an operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) from a repertoire and dynamically bind task-relevant content to it, as a step distinct from and inserted before/ alongside coalition/topology instantiation (MECH-481). Content binding and coalition/topology selection are proposed as separable causal axes: correct-coalition/wrong-binding and wrong-coalition/correct-binding should produce dissociable failure signatures if the axes are genuinely distinct.
MECH-503.what_would_answer: Primary falsifier -- COALITION x BINDING FACTORIAL (source thought Test D): a 2x2 diagnostic crossing {correct coalition, wrong coalition} x {correct content binding, wrong content binding}. CONFIRMING: the two manipulations produce DISSOCIABLE failure signatures (e.g. wrong-coalition/correct-binding degrades WHICH subsystems interact while the bound content remains usable to whichever subsystems do engage; correct-coalition/wrong-binding degrades what the correctly-recruited subsystems operate ON while their interaction structure stays intact) -- this would show topology control and binding control are genuinely separable causal axes, not one axis dressed as two. FAILING: the two manipulations produce the SAME failure signature, or wrong-coalition/correct-binding and correct-coalition/wrong-binding are behaviourally indistinguishable -- binding does no discriminative work beyond what coalition/topology control (SD-091/MECH-481) already provides, and this claim should be retired or folded into MECH-481 rather than treated as a separate axis. Secondary/corroborating -- RECOMBINATION TEST (Test C): two motifs developed/trained in separate contexts are recombined for a novel task never directly experienced; compare recombination (no structural learning) vs. de novo mechanism learning vs. a control with one required motif unavailable. A clean positive result is rapid, motif-recombination-specific transfer. NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (learned from the analogous MECH-481 4-arm design and the general REE non-degeneracy discipline): before trusting Test D's dissociation, confirm the "correct" coalition and "correct" binding conditions are each independently sufficient to solve the task at above-chance performance in isolation -- otherwise a null dissociation is uninformative (substrate_not_ready), not a verdict against separability.

MECH-504.subject: developmental.other_agent_discovery_via_responsive_intervention
MECH-504.title: Developmental specialisation of the scientist-agent principle (MECH-276) for other-agent / responsive-entity discovery: parallel to MECH-278's stage-2 object-schema formation via experimental intervention on passive world-features, an agent discovers candidate other- minds by performing actions and testing which environmental entities' subsequent behaviour covaries with those actions (I-move to entity-responds; I-stop to entity-changes-behaviour; I-approach to entity-withdraws; I-pursue to entity-evades; I-signal to entity-changes-state), producing the RESPONSIVE-entity discrimination that a purely passive-world-focused curriculum (static hazards and resources only) cannot supply. This is the "V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents)" MECH-276's own notes already name as a known specialisation but do not register.
MECH-504.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: requires an environment offering at least two superficially
similar cue-producing sources at curriculum-entry: one exogenous/passive (stable stochastic
rule, uncorrelated with the agent's behaviour) and one RESPONSIVE (behaviour measurably
covaries with the agent's own prior actions -- approach/withdrawal, pursuit/evasion,
signal/state-change, or simpler). Without a genuinely responsive counterpart, "discovering
agency via intervention" cannot be distinguished from ordinary world-model learning, and the
claim is untestable by construction. No existing V3 CausalGridWorld variant is confirmed to
supply this (ARC-047's SocialGridWorld is the designated candidate substrate but is itself
unimplemented, status candidate, confidence 0.0, gated v5 per ARC-010's own testability
note) -- this precondition needs its own dedicated environment check, not an inherited
pass/fail from an adjacent claim.

CONFIRMING signature: an agent using only the existing self/world scientist-agent
experimentation machinery (MECH-276/277/278's shared mechanism, applied here to entities
rather than passive features) discovers, through its own actions and without a dedicated
social-cognition module, which entities' behaviour is conditioned on its own actions --
i.e. the responsive/non-responsive discrimination emerges from the SAME experimental-
intervention logic MECH-278 already uses for object-schema formation, requiring no
additional architecture beyond redirecting the intervention target from world-features to
candidate-entity behaviour. This discrimination should then measurably improve MECH-031's
AGENCY/OTHER_SELFLIKE tagging accuracy relative to a version trained only on static
hazards/resources (no responsive entities in the curriculum).

FALSIFYING signature: the responsive/non-responsive discrimination requires a dedicated
social-cognition detector that cannot be reduced to the existing scientist-agent
experimentation logic reused from MECH-278 -- i.e. redirecting the SAME mechanism to
entity-behaviour targets fails to produce above-chance discrimination even with adequate
intervention density, meaning other-agent discovery is not, in fact, a specialisation of
the general scientist-agent principle and needs its own architecture, contrary to what
MECH-276's notes already anticipate.

MECH-505.subject: social.fast_empathy_gated_transfer_requirement
MECH-505.title: Fast-empathy other-harm transfer into REE's own valuation/action-selection must be a GATED channel, regulated along (at minimum) six axes -- mapping fidelity, self/other identity preservation, gain control (regulatable transfer magnitude), context gating (familiarity, attachment, kinship, threat, competition, role), timescale differentiation (brief resonance vs. sustained caregiving), and graded action-selection authority (able to suppress self-serving action or trigger costly protection when warranted) -- with interaction history able to update future transfer, rather than an undifferentiated scalar leak from other-harm to self-harm.

MECH-506.subject: social.operational_otherhood_functional_threshold
MECH-506.title: An entity crosses an operational "vulnerable goal-directed other" threshold when convergent evidence shows (a) diverse behaviour compactly predicted by persistent latent goals and (b) systematic, adaptive alteration of subsequent behaviour in response to harm, threat, goal-frustration, damage, or restoration -- a functional/behavioural criterion sufficient for protective treatment while explicitly preserving uncertainty about subjective experience, and distinct from both MECH-031's self-model-possession criterion and EXT-009/INV-072's similarity-based ethical-inclusion criterion.

MECH-507.subject: e1.compression_decompression_bridge
MECH-507.title: E1's persistent context should be reframed as an explicit RECIPROCAL compression/decompression bridge, not merely a latent representation with compression left implicit inside ordinary representation learning: high-dimensional experience, autobiographical history, and body state compress into a lower-dimensional organising state z_t, and z_t decompresses into higher- dimensional predictions and candidate sensorimotor futures. Compression is what makes different high-dimensional situations become functionally equivalent when they imply sufficiently similar action-relevant consequences; decompression is what turns that summary back into usable prospective content for downstream planning.

MECH-508.subject: attractor.compressed_generative_disposition
