ANSWERED BY: comparing REE with and without an explicit coordinated organising
principle on the 2x2 design in MECH-495's what_would_answer, scored on downstream
generalisation and discrimination rather than on any internal representational
statistic. Resolves toward ADDS CAPABILITY if the coordinated version achieves
relational topology and downstream competence the sum of the individually-registered
mechanisms does not. Resolves toward REINTERPRETATION if the existing mechanisms,
once armed, already produce the appropriate overlap/separation pattern -- in which
case the correct disposition is to keep the thought as an explanatory framing in the
architecture docs and NOT register further mechanism claims from it.

This question is deliberately gated behind MECH-495 and behind substrate readiness;
it should NOT be the first thing tested from this intake.

Q-096.subject: meta.human_ai_coupled_confirmation_loop
Q-096.title: Does REE's evaluation-channel-integrity discipline (INV-077) generalize beyond REE's own development process to an ordinary human-AI conversational dyad, where sycophancy can weaken the error signal and let a coupled human-AI cognitive system mistake internally-generated coherence for external confirmation?
Q-096.what_would_answer:
Answered by inspecting REE's ACTUAL conversational/development-support
surfaces (chat sessions, /governance walks, thought-digestion,
/session-land, any place a human reads and acts on REE-authored text)
for a structural error-signal channel, analogous to INV-077's audit of
write-path gating -- NOT by a V3 cognitive-substrate experiment.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the audit needs at least one identifiable
case where a human user's uncorrected acceptance of AI-generated
elaboration measurably increased downstream confidence/action without
an intervening independent check -- absent that, the question is
hypothetical risk, not an observed gap.
CONFIRMING (generalization holds / gap is real): tracing shows human-
facing REE outputs (e.g. governance recommendations, thought-intake
novelty tables, claim status framing) can influence a human's
subsequent claim/experiment decisions without any mechanism analogous
to INV-077's provenance/review/governance gate -- i.e. AI-elaborated
coherence can reach human belief and downstream REE state changes (new
claims, queued experiments, governance dispositions) through a softer,
unaudited path than the one INV-077 closes for REE's OWN confidence
fields.
FALSIFYING (gap is not real / already closed): every human-facing REE
surface that can influence a claim/experiment/governance decision
already routes through an explicit human confirmation or independent-
evidence gate (e.g. AskUserQuestion-mediated choices, governance's
interactive walk, the standing rule that lit and experimental evidence
are reported/weighted separately) -- in which case this is already
covered by existing process discipline and should be closed as
derivationally answered, cross-referencing the specific gates found,
rather than left open.
AUDIT RESULT (2026-08-25, evidence/planning/q096_human_ai_surface_audit_
20260825.md): CONFIRMING. `/thought-ingestion`'s claim-registration path
has no AskUserQuestion gate anywhere in the skill and commits its own
novelty judgment to claims.yaml before reporting to the user -- a
concrete instance is this claim's own registration (see notes above).
`/governance`'s promotion/demotion path IS interactively gated, a real
structural difference from thought-ingestion, but the depth of that
gate's independence is itself an open, self-reported question in REE's
own tooling (the Recommendation-Agreement Ledger), not a closed one.
Left `candidate`/open rather than closed, since the finding motivates a
process change (see notes) rather than fully answering whether the
generalization holds everywhere -- re-audit if `/thought-ingestion` or
`/governance`'s AskUserQuestion gating changes.

Q-097.subject: ree.care_gate_deception_discounting
Q-097.title: What mechanism should estimate an interacting agent's mimicry/deception risk and feed it into EXT-009's liberal care-gate criterion -- i.e. how does (or should) REE detect that a candidate mind is an adversarial agent mimicking mind-signals to extract undeserved care, tightening the criterion's false-positive-cost term (Axiom 8 deception) without collapsing the liberal floor that protects genuine-but-ambiguous minds from exclusion?
Q-097.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: unmet in V3. Requires a multi-agent substrate in
which at least one agent can act deceptively -- emitting mind-signals (behavioural
cues the observer's similarity/agency detector treats as evidence of
mind-likeness) without the goal-structure that would normally accompany them --
so mimicry is actually possible to attempt and to detect or fail to detect. No
such substrate exists in V3; ARC-047's SocialGridWorld (multi-agent,
unimplemented, v5-gated) is the nearest planned candidate, consistent with
EXT-009's own notes that this failure mode is "presently V5-load-bearing
(multi-agent) and largely philosophical under the single-agent V3 substrate".
CONFIRMING (a dedicated mimicry-tightening mechanism is buildable and
load-bearing): once a multi-agent adversarial substrate exists, an agent
equipped with INV-102's evidential-discounting machinery (attributing an
observed mind-signal to a plausible strategic goal) can supply a mimicry-risk
estimate that measurably tightens the care-gate's false-positive-cost term under
adversarial pressure, while EXT-009's liberal criterion floor is preserved for
genuine-but-ambiguous minds -- i.e. the same provenance-discounting machinery
that answers the epistemic question also feeds the ethical one, without the two
thresholds collapsing into one.
FALSIFYING (the question dissolves / no dedicated mechanism is needed): EXT-009's
existing asymmetric cost structure already absorbs deception risk without a
separate mimicry-detection term -- e.g. because the cost of transiently extending
care to a successfully-mimicking adversary is bounded and low relative to the
cost of wrongly excluding a real mind, so no machinery beyond EXT-009's existing
criterion placement is scientifically motivated.
Out of scope for a V3 experiment; this is a design/architecture question pending
the v5 multi-agent substrate that would make mimicry attemptable at all.

RA-001.subject: clinical.depression_network_coupling_reversal
RA-001.title: Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.
RA-001.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a clinical fMRI cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes named large-scale networks (CEN/DMN), so the
anchor is confirmed or collapsed by external replication, never by a V3 run.
Discriminating empirical signature that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent
fMRI cohort, stratified by episode duration at a ~24-month chronicity
threshold, reproduces a SIGN REVERSAL in the relationship between symptom
severity (HAM-D) and CEN<->precuneus(DMN) functional connectivity --
non-chronic patients show connectivity DECREASING with severity, chronic
patients show connectivity INCREASING with severity (the Zanao et al. 2026 Sci
Rep n=46 result), establishing that the depressive brain-state is
duration-indexed rather than a single static regime. COLLAPSES the anchor if a
larger or pre-registered replication finds the severity-connectivity slope is
the same sign in chronic and non-chronic cohorts (no chronicity moderation),
or if the apparent reversal is explained by a confound (medication exposure,
age, scanner/motion) rather than chronicity, or if the threshold is not near
24 months and no stable duration boundary exists. PRECISION guardrail:
'reverses' means a cross-sectional reversal of the connectivity-vs-severity
slope between cohorts, NOT demonstrated therapeutic reversibility (that is
Q-061); and this is long-term CLINICAL depression, not synaptic LTD. A
confirming replication strengthens the REE depression cluster (MECH-088 /
INV-034 / MECH-124) and motivates MECH-367; it must never be cited as REE
substrate evidence.

RA-002.subject: clinical.psychiatric_genomic_factor_overlap
RA-002.title: Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.
RA-002.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is a human-genetics cohort; no
REE substrate distinguishes genomic factors, so the anchor is confirmed or
collapsed by external genomics replication, never by a V3 run, and it must
never be cited as REE mechanism evidence. Discriminating empirical signature
that CONFIRMS the anchor: an independent large-scale genomic
structural-equation modelling effort across childhood- and adult-onset
psychiatric disorders reproduces a SMALL number (~five) of shared
cross-diagnostic latent genomic factors (Compulsive;
Schizophrenia-bipolar/psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing;
Substance-use) that capture the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance,
with factor-specific developmental biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte-gene
enrichment in the Internalizing factor) -- i.e. the genomic structure is
low-dimensional and cuts ACROSS diagnostic boundaries (the Grotzinger et al.
2025 Nat Genet result, >1M individuals, 238 variants). COLLAPSES the anchor if
replication instead recovers factors that align ONE-TO-ONE with DSM categories
(no cross-diagnostic sharing), or if the dimensionality is not low (no
parsimonious small factor set survives out-of-sample), or if the factor
structure is unstable across ancestries/cohorts. GUARDRAIL (anti-determinism):
genetic overlap does NOT make diagnoses meaningless and individual
presentations cannot be read off polygenic factors -- the load-bearing
extraction is the SURFACE-CLUSTER principle (categories are emergent clusters
over overlapping latent axes), which REE already holds (IMPL-005, INV-061). A
confirming replication motivates the architectural axis layer (ARC-086), the
syndrome-as-vector question (Q-064), and the p-factor analogue (MECH-371); the
factor labels and 238-variant count are from the abstract plus press summaries
and should be cross-checked against the full paper.

RA-003.subject: comparative_cognition.llm_convergent_motifs
RA-003.title: Convergent cognitive motifs in language models: sufficiently capable models trained to predict human language may independently develop computational motifs functionally analogous to specific REE mechanisms (orienting, replay, self-representation, other-agent modelling, prediction-error management, arbitration, epistemic uncertainty, long-term goals), because language statistically encodes traces of the cognitive machinery that generated it. Predicts functional convergence, not architectural identity.
RA-003.what_would_answer:
out_of_domain research_anchor: the test domain is mechanistic interpretability
of trained external language models, not REE's own V3 substrate -- no REE
experiment can confirm or collapse this anchor. CONFIRMING signature: an
independent mechanistic-interpretability study identifies internal
computational circuits in a language model that are FUNCTIONALLY analogous
(same input-output role, not shared architecture) to a named REE mechanism
(e.g. an uncertainty-driven exploration bonus resembling MECH-314b, a
self-referential state tracker, an arbitration-like competition between
candidate continuations), established via causal ablation/activation-patching
rather than behavioural similarity alone. COLLAPSING signature:
interpretability work finds the analogous behaviour is produced by
mechanisms with no principled functional correspondence to the REE
mechanism (e.g. pure memorised pattern-completion with no separable
"uncertainty" or "arbitration" subcircuit), or convergence claims fail to
replicate across model families/scales. Never resolved by a REE experiment;
resolved only by tracking external interpretability literature (a lit-pull
target, not a queued experiment).

SD-005.subject: latent_stack.self_world_latent_split
SD-005.title: z_gamma split into z_self (E2 motor-sensory domain) and z_world (E3/Hippocampus domain).
SD-005.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the arm under test must have differential loss
routing genuinely active between E2 (z_self) and E3 (z_world) -- not a frozen
post-hoc probe (EXQ-047d showed frozen representations carry near-equal
action info in both channels, split_action_dissociation=0.008) and not a
geometric-orthogonality penalty (EXQ-047f showed cosine constraints produce
two decorrelated-but-unspecialised channels, orth_cos_mean_eval~0.002-0.018).
Warmup must be adequate for specialisation to emerge under whatever objective
is active (EXQ-047g/113 used 400/300 episodes; EXQ-113's own write-up flags
the 350->300 reduction as a plausible confound for its null result). SD-008's
alpha_world must be pinned and reported (0.9 across the three confirmed
functional-specialisation runs). Cross-decoding probe samples must clear the
pre-registered minimum (n_contact/n_approach >= 20/30) and, given EXQ-113's
explicit finding that the EXQ-078 behavioural gap did not replicate at 6x6
scale, environment scale must be stated and matched to the arm being compared
against. A test failing any of these self-routes substrate_not_ready /
design_failure and does not count as evidence either way.

CONFIRMING signature: on a well-powered rerun (>=4 seeds; warmup and env
scale matched to the best-supporting prior run) with differential loss
routing confirmed active, BOTH sides of the dissociation clear the original
pre-registered thresholds -- action_dissociation_split (self - world) > 0.10
AND contact_dissociation_split (world - self) > 0.05 (EXQ-047g's own C1/C2) --
and the behavioural gap_approach delta (split - unified) replicates at
>= 0.02, EXQ-078's confirmed threshold, at more than one environment scale.
Critically this must show BOTH-SIDED specialisation: EXQ-532 already shows
self_body_advantage clearing its threshold (+0.126) while world_obs_advantage
does not (-0.032) -- a one-sided result on a rerun does not confirm SD-005,
it reproduces the existing falsifying pattern.

FALSIFYING signature: already observed, three times, at increasing rigor and
scale, all with differential loss routing active and adequate n. EXQ-047g
(2026-03-23, functional cross-decoding, decision=retire_ree_claim): 1/5
criteria, action_dissociation_split=+0.085 (<0.10), contact_dissociation_
split=+0.000 (<0.05), split-vs-unified action advantage NEGATIVE (-0.030).
EXQ-113 (2026-03-28, behavioural double-dissociation at 6x6 scale,
decision=retire_ree_claim): 2/5 criteria, gap_world_split=0.0095 (<0.06
threshold), delta_self=-0.0006 (purification not demonstrated, needed
<=-0.02). EXQ-532 (2026-05-06, latest run on file, correlational latent-
domain selectivity): FAIL 2/3, world_obs_advantage=-0.032 (z_self predicts
world observations as well as or better than z_world does). The consistent,
specific pattern across all three redesigns is: z_self shows genuine
self-specialisation, z_world does NOT show reciprocal world-specialisation.
A further well-powered rerun landing in this same band -- cross-decoding
gaps within noise of zero on the world side specifically, gap_approach
delta < 0.02 -- corroborates rather than merely repeats this finding and
should be read as confirming SD-005's functional-specialisation
justification does not hold on the E3/z_world side, independent of whether
the z_self/E2 split itself is retained.

SD-007.subject: encoder.perspective_corrected_world_latent
SD-007.title: ReafferencePredictor provides perspective-corrected world latent by subtracting self-caused sensory change.
SD-007.what_would_answer:
GOVERNANCE FLAG (2026-08-07 digestion pass): the live_status.evidence
pointer this claim previously carried
(failure_autopsy_zworld-integration-cluster_2026-06-06#V3-EXQ-145,
verdict non_contributory/substrate_ceiling) was a stale cross-tagged
artifact, corrected here. That autopsy's substrate_ceiling finding is
about z_world's representational granularity generally (relevant to
SD-008/Q-002), not about SD-007's own subtraction mechanism -- for
V3-EXQ-145 specifically, the autopsy's own table says the run was
blocked BEFORE selectivity was measured (reaf_r2=0.076 < 0.08 gate,
"engineering/non_contributory... Does not retire SD-007 or SD-008").

A discriminative-pair comparison of z_world_corrected against
z_world_raw, run within episodes containing BOTH agent-caused sensory
change (locomotion with no external event) AND independent
world-caused change (an event the agent did not cause), with the
ReafferencePredictor's own held-out R^2 gate passing first so the
comparison is not confounded by an undertrained predictor.

CONFIRMING if z_world_corrected shows measurably reduced self-caused
variance/change relative to z_world_raw during pure locomotion (self-
caused reafference is subtracted) while an externally-caused event
still produces a comparable-or-greater signal in z_world_corrected
than matched self-caused steps (world-caused change survives
correction) -- i.e. correction preserves or improves an agent-caused-
vs-world-caused discrimination margin rather than collapsing it.

FALSIFIED if correction either (a) under-subtracts, leaving
z_world_corrected as contaminated by self-motion as z_world_raw, or
(b) over-subtracts, collapsing corrected-signal variance so broadly
that externally-caused events become as hard (or harder) to detect
than before correction -- the failure mode EXQ-027b found directly
(correction_delta=-0.045, harm_pred_std 0.108->0.008), though that
run pre-dates the ARC-027/SD-010 harm-stream separation the finding
motivated (SD-010's HarmEncoder was introduced specifically "to
resolve the EXQ-027b over-correction paradox") and has not been
re-run since that fix landed.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: the episode set must contain both non-
trivial agent-caused perspective change (informative delta-z_world_raw,
sufficient for the predictor's own R^2 gate to be measurable) AND
independent world-caused events, in a ratio balanced enough for
discrimination to be measurable -- the zworld-integration-cluster
autopsy separately found (V3-EXQ-177) that a 6.6:1 event imbalance
made discrimination "near-unmeasurable" even with an otherwise-
adequate stack, so a degenerate event mix would produce an
inconclusive result regardless of predictor quality.

CURRENT STATE: the two pre-registered discriminative tests of this
exact claim (EXQ-111, EXQ-118: C1 predictor-quality gate -> C2
selectivity lift REAF_ON vs REAF_OFF -> C3 cross-seed consistency)
both FAILED at C1 -- neither ever reached C2/C3, so the discriminative
claim itself has never been tested to completion. This is a
predictor-quality/engineering gate (R^2 repeatedly 0.03-0.36, mostly
below threshold across three separate attempts: EXQ-111, EXQ-118,
V3-EXQ-145), not a representational-capacity ceiling in the SD-008/
Q-002 sense -- implemented-but-unvalidated, not substrate_ceiling.

SD-012.subject: environment.homeostatic_drive
SD-012.title: Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.
SD-012.what_would_answer:
SD-012 is CONJUNCTIVE across two dissociable sub-claims with opposite
readiness. SEEDING (drive-scaled benefit crosses benefit_threshold and forms
z_goal) is SETTLED: C1 PASSED repeatedly (EXQ-085f/g: z_goal_norm 0.228/0.399;
EXQ-582a drive_floor=0.9 arm: effective_benefit=0.115>0.08, 3/3 seeds seed,
OFF arm 0 seedings -- MECH-306 registered+provisional on this evidence).
Status stays provisional, not implemented, because of the second half:

NAVIGATION-OUTCOME (C2: does drive-scaled seeding produce goal-guided
behaviour that beats a random baseline) is the OPEN question and the reason
for provisional status. EXQ-085f-l returned benefit_ratio 0.034-1.026 across
five iterations with no stable PASS; EXQ-085g's own autopsy attributed the
failure to z_world at contact being scene-wide rather than resource-specific
(goal_resource_r=0.087), not to the drive-modulation mechanism itself.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a
verdict): a navigation-outcome retest is only informative if ALL of:
(a) sustained-drive seeding is active -- MECH-306 drive_floor>=0.9 explicitly
enabled, not the claims.yaml default-OFF instantaneous drive_level that
collapses to ~0.005 at the exact step of contact (EXQ-536a);
(b) z_world/z_resource specificity is active -- the SD-049 Phase-2 hybrid
encoder + SD-057 object-bound incentive-salience layer
(use_incentive_token_bank=True, MECH-344/345/346), which is what corrected
goal_resource_r from 0.087 (EXQ-085g) to 0.93-0.96 (V3-EXQ-514o, 2026-06-15,
on scaffolded_sd054_onboarding, ready=true since 2026-06-11);
(c) proximity_benefit_scale is configured correctly (>=0.18 per EXQ-189/238)
-- EXQ-233 showed drive_weight is inert at the wrong default (0.03),
producing identical near-zero z_goal_norm regardless of drive condition;
(d) resource_respawn_on_consume=True, enabling repeated drive-reduction
cycles (Balleine & Dickinson 1998).

CONFIRMING signature: with (a)-(d) held, benefit_ratio (goal-guided vs
random-policy baseline, same env/curriculum) exceeds 1.0 by a margin
clearing the cross-seed SD on >=2/3 seeds, with C1 (z_goal_norm) and
goal_resource_r reported alongside so a PASS is legible as "drive-scaled
seeding now converts into steering."

FALSIFYING signature: benefit_ratio remains at or below random-baseline
parity (<=1.0, or within noise of it) DESPITE (a)-(d) all holding and
C1/goal_resource_r both confirming seeding + specificity are genuinely
active on that run -- meaning drive-scaled benefit is behaviourally inert
for navigation even once the two previously identified confounds are
cleared, and SD-012 should demote from provisional rather than continue
holding on "substrate not ready."

What would NOT answer it: any run tagged claim_ids=[] / non_contributory
that omits (a)-(d) (as EXQ-233/536a/582/622 all did for different reasons).

SD-015.subject: goal_representation.z_resource_encoder
SD-015.title: Goal-directed navigation requires a dedicated z_resource encoder that captures object-type features invariant to spatial location, separate from z_world.
SD-015.what_would_answer:
SD-015 is CONJUNCTIVE across two dissociable sub-claims, and only one is
answered.

REPRESENTATION-ADEQUACY (does the ResourceEncoder learn a
position-invariant, resource-specific z_resource usable for goal
formation) is SETTLED, PASS. EXQ-182a (2026-04-01, oracle ceiling) showed

(2026-03-30) showed the trained encoder achieves prox_r2=0.908-0.921,

under the now-landed SD-057 object-bound incentive-salience substrate on

goal_resource_r (cosine similarity of z_goal direction to true
resource-type embedding) at 0.93-0.96 across 3 seeds, up from the
EXQ-085g baseline of 0.066-0.087, under realistic foraging (not a
forced/oracle probe). Do not re-test this sub-claim.

BEHAVIOURAL-SUFFICIENCY (does SD-015 + adequate downstream
foraging-competence CAUSALLY produce goal-directed navigation -- the
agent reaching resources at a rate beating a random-policy baseline, not
merely correlating its z_goal direction with them) is the OPEN question
and the reason this claim stays candidate/substrate_ceiling. No run has
reported a behavioural-navigation metric (benefit_ratio or equivalent)
under the SAME configuration that produced 514o's representational PASS.
SD-012's own what_would_answer names this identical unresolved test as
its own NAVIGATION-OUTCOME sub-claim (C2) -- SD-012 and SD-015 share ONE
open behavioural test, not two independent ones.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (else substrate_not_ready_requeue, NOT a
verdict): a navigation-outcome retest for SD-015 is only informative if
ALL of: (a) the SD-057 object-bound incentive-salience layer is active
(use_incentive_token_bank=True, MECH-344/345/346) on the SAME ready
scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum that produced 514o's
goal_resource_r lift -- not a coarse pre-enrichment config (538a's
failure mode) and not a stale pre-514n harness fork (693's failure
mode); (b) MECH-306 sustained-drive seeding is active (drive_floor>=0.9),
mirroring SD-012's identical precondition; (c) a FRESH non-degeneracy
check on this exact curriculum/harness config has been re-confirmed --
V3-EXQ-866a (2026-08-03, INV-034/Q-021, gated on the SAME SD-049-reef
foraging-competence family) found the FULL arm's resource_visit_rate

SD-016.subject: e1.frontal_cue_indexed_integration
SD-016.title: E1 must expose a z_world-only ContextMemory query path that produces two downstream signals: an action-affordance bias for E2 (MECH-151) and a terrain precision weight for E3 harm/goal scoring (MECH-152); the existing bulk generate_prior() path is insufficient because it blends z_self and z_world and produces no cue-specific modulation.
SD-016.what_would_answer:
SD-016 splits into two independently falsifiable sub-questions.

(A) RETRIEVAL-SELECTIVITY (does z_world-only cue-indexed retrieval
differentiate at all?): ALREADY ANSWERED, negatively, for the
originally-proposed remedy: environment enrichment does not restore
selectivity. V3-EXQ-418j/k (4-arm reef/landmark enrichment ladder,
2026-05-05/06) found cos_cross_mean 0.987-0.9999 and separation_gap_mean
~0-0.004 across ALL arms including the enriched ones. Independently
reconfirmed by the 2026-07-18 z_world near-static characterisation:
contrast ratio is flat (~0.094, 1.52x range) across a 782x foraging
change and 17x survival-horizon change, and is highest at the most
impoverished rung -- "env enrichment is the wrong lever for this
quantity." Both the original q.k selection mechanism (exhausted across
418d/e/i) and Path 3 (feedforward cue->slot tagger, V3-EXQ-418m,
2026-06-05, FAIL: C1 ON entropy 0/3 seeds <2.5, C1b ON
context-divergence 0/3 seeds >0.1, OFF saddle reproduced exactly at
ln(16)=2.772589) fail identically because both consume the same
near-constant z_world -- the bottleneck sits one level upstream of the
selection mechanism, in the encoder, not in which architecture sits on
top of it.

STILL OPEN: whether an encoder-level fix restores cross-context z_world
separation enough for ANY selection mechanism to have something to
differentiate on. Under the x724/x734 P0 protocol the world encoder is
never trained at all (weight-delta 0/61 tensors); the 2026-06-06
zworld-integration-cluster autopsy separately found even a TRAINED
z_world at dim=32 lacks event-selective structure (substrate_ceiling);
SD-070 found the currently-prescribed P0 recipe makes contrast WORSE
(0.1222 -> 0.0726 CR), diagnosed as a wiring fault. V3-EXQ-783
(dim32/128 x untrained/trained crossing, PASS 2026-07-18) is the live
discriminator for this upstream thread but is scoped to Q-002/SD-031
and has not been read back onto SD-016's own retest criteria. What
would answer this leg: re-run the 418g/418m-shaped acceptance test (C1
sel_entropy_mean <2.5 AND C1b context-divergence >0.1, both >=2/3
seeds, with OFF reproducing the ln(16) saddle as the ablation-cleanliness
check) under an encoder configuration already shown to raise z_world
contrast independently of SD-016 (SD-070's replacement recipe, or
V3-EXQ-783's trained dim=128 arm) -- NOT the originally-planned
SD-023-landmarks probe, which the evidence above renders redundant.

(B) DOWNSTREAM EXPLOITATION (once selectivity exists, do
action_bias/terrain_weight get used behaviourally by E2/E3?): UNTESTED,
explicitly gated, and NOT automatic even when selectivity is engineered
directly -- V3-EXQ-418g forced slot_diversity=1.000 and
attn_entropy=0.000 and action_class_entropy still stayed at 1.105e-10
identically across all four arms. Two further named prerequisites: (1)
cue_action_proj's own consumer wiring (FAIL/collapsed in V3-EXQ-449,
std ~2.7e-8; reportedly fixed in V3-EXQ-449b) and (2) SD-055
differentiable-CEM gradient path (substrate landed, V3-EXQ-568 PASS,
but its own default-flip note requires a SEPARATE behavioural
validation with use_differentiable_cem=True, not yet run per
substrate_queue.json). What would answer this leg: once (A) clears, an
action_bias_div / terrain-weight discriminative test (418g C4/C5-shaped)
run with cue_action_proj confirmed live and SD-055 differentiable CEM
engaged, showing behavioural divergence tracks retrieval content rather
than staying flat.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: selection entropy pinned at or within
~0.02 of the uniform ceiling ln(16)=2.772589 (as OFF has reproduced
exactly, 3/3 seeds, across both the q.k and feedforward-tagger paths)
is not evidence against SD-016 -- it is the signature that the
selection INPUT (z_world) is not varying, recurring identically across
five+ independent probes regardless of selection architecture. A pass
on entropy (C1) alone without a context-divergence instrument (C1b) is
equally uninformative: 418m's ON arm moved entropy a cosmetic 0.019
below ceiling from random-init fixed MLP logits while context-divergence
stayed ~0.002 against a 0.1 target -- a static non-uniform-but-fixed
selector, not a context-selective one. Any future SD-016 retest must
report BOTH instruments, and must independently confirm (via a
raw-channel or contrast-ratio control) that the environment/encoder
configuration under test actually clears cross-context z_world
separation before attributing a pass or fail to the selection mechanism
itself.

SD-017.subject: sleep_phase.minimal_sleep_infrastructure_v3
SD-017.title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

SD-019a.subject: harm_stream.immediate_affective_valence
SD-019a.title: harm_unpleasantness_channel: a distinct pre-integration affective valence signal encoding the immediate motivational relevance of noxious input, processed via the medial pain pathway before temporal accumulation into suffering.

SD-019b.subject: harm_stream.suffering_accumulator
SD-019b.title: harm_suffering_accumulator: z_harm_a is specifically the output of a controllability-gated hysteretic integrator over harm_unpleasantness, constituting a persistent load state modulated by escapability and inescapability, not merely a temporally lagged copy of the sensory stream.

SD-020.subject: harm_stream.affective_surprise_pe
SD-020.title: z_harm_a encodes affective surprise (precision-weighted PE), not raw accumulated harm state. The affective stream training target is the mismatch between predicted and actual harm accumulation, making E3 urgency respond to unexpectedness of threat, not just magnitude.

SD-021.subject: harm_stream.descending_modulation
SD-021.title: Descending pain modulation: when E3 is committed to a trajectory through expected harm, z_harm_s PE precision is reduced (endogenous analgesia). Commitment gates sensory harm attenuation.
SD-021.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: MECH-269 V_s landing (alternative operating modes producing measurable behavioural divergence between drive regimes) must occur before DESCENDING vs CONTROL can differ at all -- otherwise any result is uninformative. Demonstrated 3x on this exact claim (V3-EXQ-325a commitment-substrate-absent FAIL, 325b bit-identical DESCENDING==CONTROL FAIL, 325d/325f non_contributory under the same monostrategy lock). The adjacent MECH-295 goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 retest cohort (V3-EXQ-490g/h/ i/j/k) ran this same precondition to its own conclusion in a parallel pathway: GAP-4 CLOSED 2026-06-09 without landing V_s-driven behavioural divergence. As of 2026-08-07, MECH-269's per_region_vs remains instantaneous-only (no temporal-integration form), and a 2026-06-19 note on the sibling SD-032b claim records MECH-269 as "wired_but_inert... superseded as the operative diversity blocker by the MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling (~88-89% of E3 variance)." This precondition is therefore not merely pending -- it has been actively tested via at least two independent routes (direct reef/monostrategy fix, and the GAP-4 cascade route) and neither broke the degeneracy. A fresh substrate approach to MECH-269, or resolution of the MECH-439 ceiling, is required before this precondition can be considered live again. CONFIRMING: once MECH-269 V_s landing produces genuine behavioural divergence between drive regimes (independently verifiable, e.g. via a non-SD-021 diagnostic showing action-class or trajectory divergence across depleted/well-resourced conditions), a DESCENDING-arm run shows z_harm_s PE precision measurably reduced specifically during committed trajectories through expected harm (elevated beta_gate via MECH-090), while z_harm_a PE precision remains unattenuated -- a clean selective dissociation matching the S1/ACC double-dissociation logic of Hofbauer 2001, already cited in this claim's literature base. FALSIFYING: after MECH-269 V_s landing is confirmed live (behavioural divergence demonstrably present elsewhere in the same run, ruling out the "nothing can differ yet" explanation), DESCENDING and CONTROL remain statistically indistinguishable on z_harm_s_ratio -- OR z_harm_a is ALSO precision-attenuated in the DESCENDING arm, violating the claimed selective (harm_s-only) attenuation design.

SD-026.subject: attention.prospective_precision_write_channel

validation sequence (queued post-SD-014, per this claim's own note)
is: (a) verify z_goal seeds (SD-012 -- already provisional, not
gating); (b) verify z_resource separates (SD-014); (c) enable/

CONFIRMING: dan_feedback=on lifts benefit_ratio substantially over

exceeds irrelevant-channel precision specifically under

FALSIFYING (primary): dan_feedback=off performs equivalently to

rather than the claimed fast dynamics, the two "distinct channels"
have collapsed to one and SD-026's separability claim (not just its

This is the same architectural-distinctness question INV-012's Leg 1

SD-032a.subject: cingulate.salience_network_coordinator
SD-032a.title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.
SD-032a.what_would_answer:
CORE CLAIM (CONFIRMED, stable): the SalienceCoordinator substrate itself -- a discrete operating_mode register {external_task, internal_replay, internal_planning, offline_consolidation} plus a mode_switch_trigger reading the AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog subdivisions -- is implemented and behaviourally validated: V3-EXQ-446 (substrate-readiness) PASS, V3-EXQ-455 (behavioural) PASS, V3-EXQ-453 (write-gate landing) PASS; 28 supports / 0 weakens across 11 experiment + 20 literature entries, conf 0.928, conflict_ratio 0. A CONFIRMING signature is any future evidence entry that restates this bar -- already met and not expected to be re-litigated.

Its named validation successors, V3-EXQ-464d and V3-EXQ-467d, ran 2026-06-13 WITH the drive enabled and still self-routed non_contributory / substrate_not_ready_requeue (occupancy still 0.0 across every seed/arm). The follow-on diagnostic V3-EXQ-797 (2026-07-22) narrowed this further: it falsified nav-competence and frozen-argmax as causes and localised the gap to the BG/action-commitment layer (commit term fires on < BETA_FLOOR of genuine coordinator ticks) -- i.e. upstream of SD-032a's own substrate.
UPDATE 2026-08-13 (confirmed failure_autopsy_mech266-464e-467e-cluster_2026-08-13, V3-EXQ-467e + V3-EXQ-464e): the commitment-layer fix landed and occupancy IS now reachable (1.0 at r=0.10 in 467e, sticky-arm 1.0 with zero switches in 464e) -- the predicted successor condition above is met, and MECH-266's own behavioural falsifiers are indeed now live, exactly as this paragraph anticipated. This remains non_contributory against SD-032a -- the substrate itself is exercised and working; the residual is a downstream gate/measurement defect plus an over-correction (bang-bang, no mixed regime) in the mode-governance-engagement extension, neither of which implicates SD-032a's core (28 supports / 0 weakens, unchanged).
FALSIFYING signature (would REVERSE stable status -- nothing currently threatens this): a well-powered future run in which the coordinator's mode_switch_trigger is reachable and exercised (i.e. the commitment-layer gate above is cleared, ruling out the substrate-not-engaged confound) and STILL shows operating_mode transitions decoupled from the underlying AIC/dACC/MCC/PCC-analog salience signals -- e.g. mode switches occurring at chance rate regardless of input -- would be a genuine weakens against the coordinator mechanism itself, not a readiness artifact, and should trigger stable -> candidate reconsideration.

CONFIRMING: once MECH-269 unblocks alternative operating modes: for matched z_harm_a input, a depleted agent (low drive_level / high fatigue) and a well-resourced agent produce measurably different aic_salience values, such that the MECH-259 switch threshold is crossed (network-switch trigger fires to SD-032a) in one regime and not the other, or fires at reliably different latency/magnitude. FALSIFYING: once MECH-269 has landed and alternative operating modes are confirmed to produce genuine behavioural divergence elsewhere in the agent (ruling out "the substrate still doesn't support divergence" as the explanation), depleted and well-resourced agents nonetheless show statistically indistinguishable network-switch-trigger behaviour for matched z_harm_a. This would mean SD-032c's salience/threshold gating design fails to translate structural drive-dependence into behavioural effect -- the gating computation, threshold placement, or its coupling to SD-012's drive signal would be wrong, not merely untested.

SD-032d.subject: cingulate.pcc_analog_attention_partition
SD-032d.title: PCC-analog (attention partition / metastability): module coordinating transitions between external-task and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) modes; contributes a mode-stability parameter to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

SD-032e.subject: cingulate.pacc_autonomic_coupling
SD-032e.title: pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.
SD-032e.what_would_answer: ALREADY CONFIRMED (V3-EXQ-448, 2026-04-19, diagnostic PASS, supports; reinforced by V3-EXQ-453 write-gate landing PASS, 2026-04-20). NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: use_pacc_analog must be enabled (default False) and SalienceCoordinator.write_gate("autonomic") must actually be open (MECH-261 mode-conditioned) for z_harm_a to reach drive_level at all -- with the gate closed or the flag off, pacc.effective_drive(base) reduces to a no-op (confirmed by V3-EXQ-448 c3/c10) and no signature is testable, so absence of drift under those conditions would not falsify the claim. CONFIRMING: with the gate open, sustained z_harm_a exposure produces measurable, monotone drift in drive_level via pacc.effective_drive(base) (V3-EXQ-448 c2: bias 0.045 -> 0.5 across a sustained-load window, held at cap under 5000 high-load ticks per c5, and reversible toward 0 on quiescence per c6), and this drift subsequently modulates SD-032c's salience threshold, producing the chronic-pain-like sensitization pathway (Baliki 2012) -- already observed per the stable-promotion evidence base (5 supports/0 weakens/4 mixed across 5 exp + 4 lit entries, including V3-EXQ-448 and V3-EXQ-453). FALSIFYING: (i) with the write_gate open and use_pacc_analog enabled, sustained z_harm_a exposure produces no measurable drive_level drift (bias stays ~0 despite load) -- would indicate the write path is disconnected or the EMA accumulator is not actually receiving z_harm_a; or (ii) drift occurs and accumulates as expected, but never propagates to modulate SD-032c's salience threshold -- would sever the claimed write-back -> salience-gate link and invalidate the chronic-sensitization behavioural prediction even though the drive_level mechanism itself is intact.

SD-033.subject: pfc.subdivision_architecture
SD-033.title: PFC subdivision architecture: a network-level module with lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal), OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure map), vmPFC-analog (value integration), premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution), and frontopolar-analog (branching / nested control; V4 scope) subdivisions. Primary output: the rule/policy context that gates action selection and the natural write target for MECH-261 mode-conditioned gating.
SD-033.what_would_answer:
SD-033's load-bearing falsifiable content is carried by its first
subdivision, SD-033a (lateral-PFC-analog), which IS implemented
(ree-v3/ree_core/pfc/lateral_pfc_analog.py, landed 2026-04-20) -- this is
a comparative ablation test, not a substrate-existence test. SD-033b
(OFC-analog) remains unbuilt (second V3 priority); SD-033c/d are
registration-only consolidations of already-active substrate
(ARC-035/MECH-151/152/235; E3 trajectory machinery) and are not
separately falsifiable; SD-033e is V4-deferred (only a V3 forward-compat
hook exists).

ANSWER "SD-033a is over-specification, E3 alone suffices" if a ree-v3
implementation WITHOUT SD-033a's rule/goal substrate reproduces, without
degradation, all three MECH-262 functional signatures relative to the
SD-033a-ON arm: (i) stimulus-abstracted generalisation -- transfer to
novel stimuli under the same rule produces equivalent representational/
behavioural effect; (ii) distractor-resistant persistence -- rule-
selective effect survives internal_replay / MECH-092 micro-quiescence
intervals; (iv) training-dependent emergence -- the effect strengthens
with training exposure rather than being present from init. ANSWER
"SD-033a is required" (falsifies the over-specification hypothesis) if
E3-alone fails any of the three and the SD-033a-ON arm passes it.

CURRENT STATE (partial, mixed -- not "untested"): signature (ii) has
DIRECT SUPPORTING evidence (V3-EXQ-484: replay_drift/task_drift ratio
0.088, C1-C4 PASS, canonical governance replica). Substrate wiring
integrity (frozen-silent vs trainable-nonzero contrast) is confirmed
PASS across V3-EXQ-598/598b/598c. Signature (iv)'s causal test
(V3-EXQ-598b) and the closure-coupled persistence probe (V3-EXQ-461c)
both reached SD-033a's own decision boundary correctly but could not
complete, because of substrate ceilings IN OTHER CLAIMS, not in
SD-033a: MECH-309 monomodal collapse (blocks iv) and the SD-034
ClosureOperator's env->emit_closure() hook being unwired on the
foraging-competent agent (blocks the closure-coupled persistence read).
Both are recorded non_contributory/substrate_ceiling,
pending_retest_after_substrate, explicitly NOT a weakening of SD-033a.
Signature (i), stimulus-abstracted generalisation to a novel stimulus
under a held rule, has no experiment at all yet -- this is the one
clean gap, not a substrate block.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: a run of this ablation is vacuous, in
either direction, unless the agent demonstrably occupies the states the
test depends on. Confirmed failure modes to guard against (all from the
SD-034 closure-cluster-ext autopsy, 2026-06-12): (a) the agent must
actually enter external_task / internal_planning mode with nonzero
occupancy -- V3-EXQ-464c/467c passed their own non-vacuity gate while
fraction_in_external_task=0.0 for the entire run, because that gate
counted episode-boundary mode settles rather than genuine mode

formation alone is not sufficient, and this precondition silently
failed on the foraging-competent substrate; (c) the agent must clear
whatever generic competence floor gates task engagement on the chosen
environment (the recurring MECH-457 cold-start / foraging_contact_guard
pattern) -- an incompetent agent trivially "passes" the E3-alone arm by
producing no rule-conditioned behaviour of any kind, which is not
evidence E3 suffices, it is evidence nothing is being tested. A clean
run must report all three preconditions explicitly, not just the three

SD-033a.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_analog_rule_goal
SD-033a.title: Lateral-PFC-analog (mid-lateral rule/goal substrate): module that holds stimulus-abstracted rule and goal representations across delays, persists through simulated distractors, and projects bias signals into E3 action selection. Primary write target for MECH-261 under external_task and internal_planning modes.

SD-033b.subject: pfc.ofc_analog_outcome_structure
SD-033b.title: OFC-analog (specific-outcome prediction and task-structure cognitive map): module that represents the state space of the current task and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. E2's natural substrate address for harm-predictive rollouts; distinct from scalar value integration (SD-033c).

SD-033c.subject: pfc.vmpfc_analog_value_integration
SD-033c.title: vmPFC-analog (subjective value integration): module that integrates scalar value across goals, needs, and competing options to produce a unified value signal. Consolidates existing ARC-035 / MECH-151 / MECH-152 / MECH-235 functions under the SD-033 cluster.

SD-033d.subject: pfc.premotor_sma_analog_sequence_execution
SD-033d.title: Premotor/SMA-analog (sequence execution substrate): module that holds candidate action sequences, binds actions to states, and executes committed sequences. Largely implemented inside E3's existing trajectory-selection machinery; registered for claim-graph completeness.
SD-033d.what_would_answer:
TWO DISTINCT THINGS ARE BEING TESTED HERE, and they must not be conflated.
(i) V3-NARROW GEOMETRIC SLICE (BUILT, 2026-07-09; use_frontopolar_decommit / frontopolar_gain, ree_core/pfc/frontopolar_analog.py compute_counterfactual_value). A parameter-free, SINGLE-TICK goal-proximity advantage of the best unchosen candidate over the committed endpoint (||z_chosen-z_goal|| - ||z_alt-z_goal||), wired only as an entry-relative de-commit PRESSURE on the natural-commit latch (NaturalCommitUrgencyRelease). This is NOT a maintained parallel value channel and is NOT what this claim asserts -- it is a deliberately degenerate stand-in, built to serve a different substrate goal (the MECH-439 F-dominance duration-face de-commit lever), that happens to instantiate MECH-264's switch logic in its simplest possible form.
(ii) V4-FULL SUBSTRATE (UNBUILT). The mechanism this claim actually asserts: a RUNNING, MULTI-STEP counterfactual-value ESTIMATE maintained in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal (not recomputed fresh each tick), with a switch fired when it exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin. Structurally blocked on MECH-163 (hippocampal multi-step trajectory planning, unmet) -- without multi-step plans a counterfactual value is necessarily 1-step and collapses to MECH-257 (dACC immediate-reward comparator), which is a different mechanism entirely.
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (must hold before any result is interpretable): - For (i): the isolated-GAP-A substrate must sustain a genuine natural-commit
  latch to de-commit FROM -- i.e. competent committed foraging must exist at
  all. V3-EXQ-726 (the slice's own validation script, arms ARM_FP_CONTRAST vs
  ARM_FP_ON) is written and gate-hygiene-fixed but explicitly HELD, NOT QUEUED:
  its resume condition is "a substrate that sustains competent committed
  foraging," which is the SAME substrate gap the MECH-457 competence-floor
  campaign (V3-EXQ-724 lineage, GOV-FANOUT-1) is diagnosing. That campaign
  remains open (candidate/v3_pending) as of the latest confirmed evidence
  (V3-EXQ-821, 2026-07-25). Running 726 before MECH-457 clears would
  self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on a precondition already known to
  be unmet.
- For (ii): requires MECH-163 multi-step planning landed, plus a non-degenerate
  3+-alternative decision task (this claim's own functional_restatement names
  "simulated three-alternative decision tasks").

CONFIRMING observation: - (i), once MECH-457 clears and V3-EXQ-726 runs: ARM_FP_ON's median committed-
  latch occupancy (ncur_last_occupancy_at_release) drops >= 0.40 vs
  ARM_FP_CONTRAST on >= 2/3 strong-F seeds, WITH frontopolar_release_count > 0
  on the ON arm (proving the release is attributable to the counterfactual
  term firing when cfv_now > cfv_at_entry, not to flat-timeout or F noise).
  This would confirm the geometric switch signal behaves as a genuine
  counterfactual-value comparator even in its degenerate 1-step form --
  supportive but NOT sufficient to promote MECH-264 itself, since (i) is
  explicitly not the claim's mechanism.
- (ii), in a V4 implementation: lateral-FPC-analog activity tracks the value
  of the best UNCHOSEN alternative (dissociable from SD-033c's chosen-option
  value stream) during simulated three-alternative decision tasks, and
  individual variation in the counterfactual signal's magnitude predicts
  switch propensity (per Boorman et al. 2009).

FALSIFYING observation (this claim's own primary falsifier, verbatim from functional_restatement): if lateral-FPC-analog activity in a V4 implementation tracks CHOSEN-option value rather than counterfactual-option value during simulated three-alternative decision tasks, MECH-264 fails at source and SD-033e collapses functionally into SD-033c -- in that case the OFC/vmPFC/FPC value architecture is over-specified at REE's level of description and the frontopolar subdivision should be folded into the vmPFC-analog. A secondary falsifier applies to (i) alone: if V3-EXQ-726 runs post-clearance and ARM_FP_ON shows no attributable occupancy drop (frontopolar_release_count == 0, or the drop is indistinguishable from the flat-urgency contrast), the geometric slice fails to behave as a counterfactual comparator even in its minimal form -- this would NOT itself falsify MECH-264 (the slice is not the claim), but would remove the one piece of experimental purchase currently available on any instantiation of the mechanism.
Until MECH-457 clears, MECH-264 has zero experimental evidence (genuine_exp_count: 0 in claim_evidence.v1.json; all current evidence entries are literature) and cannot be tested even in its narrow V3 form.
[2026-08-08 thought-digestion]: implementation_phase was flipped v4->v3 on 2026-08-07 as an administrative phase-follows-dependency move (MECH-487 lists MECH-264 as a dependency) -- this is NOT a green light to build; the full mechanism remains unbuilt and blocked as described above.

SD-033e.subject: pfc.frontopolar_analog_branching
SD-033e.title: Frontopolar-analog (parallel-goal deliberation substrate): V4-scope module maintaining counterfactual-value estimates for alternatives to the current course of action, mediating transitions between external engagement and internally-generated deliberation, enabling disengagement from the current task to explore novel alternatives, and monitoring relative importance across multiple active goals. Hooks reserved in V3 via the operating_mode vocabulary; substrate deferred to V4.
SD-033e.what_would_answer:
This claim packages TWO distinct testability scopes -- do not conflate them.
SCOPE 1 -- the V3-NARROW de-commit lever (BUILT, 2026-07-09; blocked, not unbuilt). ree-v3 REEConfig.use_frontopolar_decommit + frontopolar_gain wire a parameter-free geometric proxy for function (1) counterfactual value (||z_chosen - z_goal|| - ||z_alt - z_goal||) into a commit-latch release pressure for function (3)/(4) disengagement-for-exploration. This is testable in principle today; it is currently untestable IN PRACTICE for one named reason, not an open-ended one.
Non-degeneracy precondition (all three must hold; none does as of 2026-08-08):
  (i) the MECH-457 competence floor is cleared -- per
      competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08.md, the campaign's
      discrimination job is finished but its one residual thread
      (H-consummation-binding) showed both arms installed at ~14% of ceiling
      (V3-EXQ-821), underpowering ANY contrast run on this substrate; the
      scoped fix (stronger BC install landing in the 20-40 forage/episode
      range, corrected 8-metric instrument -- landed 2026-08-07) is named but
      NOT yet queued or re-run. Until a run on this substrate clears a usable
      floor, an all-ON/all-OFF de-commit contrast cannot be distinguished from
      floor-saturation noise;
  (ii) a genuine 3+-alternative decision context is present, so "best
      unchosen alternative" is a differentiated rather than degenerate
      quantity (a 1-2-option context makes the geometric advantage trivial);
  (iii) use_frontopolar_decommit is actually flipped ON with nonzero
      frontopolar_gain (the OFF/default arm is bit-identical to baseline by
      construction and is not itself a test of anything).

CONFIRMING (mirrors the Mansouri 2015 lesion phenotype already named in this claim's notes): the ON arm shows release pressure -- de-commit/switch rate -- that positively covaries with frontopolar_gain * max(0, cfv_now - cfv_at_entry), and relative to the OFF arm shows measurably WORSE current-task persistence but BETTER counterfactual exploration (willingness to abandon the committed trajectory for a superior alternative); the OFF arm shows the inverse -- over-focus on the committed course, impaired exploration of better-valued alternatives.
FALSIFYING: once the floor precondition is cleared and a genuine 3+-way decision context is exercised, the ON arm's switch/de-commit behaviour is statistically indistinguishable from the OFF arm's despite nonzero frontopolar_gain -- i.e. the geometric counterfactual-advantage signal is not behaviourally load-bearing even in this minimal parameter-free form. This would mean the V3-narrow slice does not reproduce even the weak version of the Mansouri 2015 phenotype, independent of whatever the full V4 learned substrate might later show.
SCOPE 2 -- the V4-FULL four-function module (UNBUILT; MECH-264 head + MECH-265 monitor over K>=2 simultaneously active goals). Not operationally testable yet at all, and no non-degeneracy precondition can be stated in concrete terms until its own prerequisites exist: MECH-163 hippocampal multi-step planning (a 1-step counterfactual collapses MECH-264 to MECH-257) and a CausalGridWorldV2 dual/K-active-goal environment extension (function (4)/MECH-265 is structurally inaccessible with the current single-resource env). Per this claim's own v4_scope_deferred note, the SD-033e design doc itself (with a follow-up frontopolar lit-pull) is a V4-ENTRY prerequisite, not V3 work -- so this scope's own concrete falsifier is properly drafted at that design-doc stage, not here. The three pre-registered V4 proposals already staged for it (manual_proposals.v1.json EXP-0165/0166/0167 -- counterfactual-value dissociation, Mansouri-2015 ablation phenotype, and SD-033c/SD-033e double-dissociation respectively) remain status: gated, reconfirmed gated 2026-08-02, on exactly these unmet prerequisites.
POINTER, not re-derivation: for the counterfactual-value-TRACKING mechanism itself (MECH-264's own falsifier -- chosen-vs-unchosen value dissociation at the V4 substrate level), see MECH-264's own what_would_answer. This entry is scoped to the MODULE level (the V3-narrow lever's own testability, and the V4-full four-function packaging separately) and does not restate MECH-264's falsifier.

SD-034.subject: governance.closure_operator
SD-034.title: Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

SD-035.subject: amygdala.analog_substrate
SD-035.title: Amygdala analogue as BLA + CeA salience stage between z_harm_a and the cingulate/hippocampus — two peer non-trainable arithmetic modules owning the MECH-046 and MECH-074a-d behaviours.

SD-036.subject: gabaergic.cross_stream_decay_regulator
SD-036.title: GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.

SD-037.subject: broadcast.override_regulator
SD-037.title: Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.
SD-037.what_would_answer:
PRIMARY (unchanged): a 4-arm factorial {SD-036 OFF, SD-037 OFF} /
{SD-036 ON, SD-037 OFF} / {SD-036 OFF, SD-037 ON} / {SD-036 ON,
SD-037 ON} on V3-EXQ-471-class conditions. Predicted: arms 2 and 3
partial recovery, arm 4 full recovery, arm 1 reproduces the
catatonic-lock baseline. A clean FAIL on arm 4 (no recovery with
both regulators ON) falsifies the broadcast-override architecture
outright.

SECONDARY (unchanged): two dissociable failure phenotypes once the
factorial runs on adequate substrate -- (a) saturated override
(override_signal pinned high) should produce compulsive drive-
pursuit despite negative outcomes (PWS/hyperphagia-analog); (b) lost
override (override_signal absent) should produce decoupling -- z_harm
and drive_level compute normally but fail to integrate into
coordinated behaviour (narcolepsy/cataplexy-analog).

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (the actual current gate -- three
consecutive "substrate confirmed, behaviourally inert" findings, not
two):

Stage 1 (V3-EXQ-483d, 2026-05-29): override_signal fires and
saturates correctly, but only one consumer pathway (GoalState
effective_drive) was wired and was dominated by the MECH-295
liking-bridge -- action_counts/goal_norm_peak bit-identical across
the broadcast_override axis. FIXED 2026-05-30: four more consumer
sites landed (LateralPFCAnalog eff_eta, BLAAnalog encoding_gain,
CeAAnalog mode_prior/fast_prime, BetaGate urgency_interrupt_
threshold), all default-OFF gain knobs.

Stage 2 (V3-EXQ-483e, 2026-05-31): with all four consumer sites
wired, EVERY consumer-side readout was still exactly zero across all
12 runs. Diagnosis: SD-037's mechanism is multiplicative (output *
(1 + gain * override_signal)) -- it can only amplify an ALREADY-
NONZERO consumer output. On the fishtank baseline no consumer output
crosses its own input-gate threshold (BLA arousal_threshold_on=0.4,
CeA fast_route_threshold=0.5, PAG theta_freeze sustained-product=2.0,
dACC pe-magnitude floors), so broadcast amplification has nothing to
amplify: 0 * anything = 0.

Stage 3 (V3-EXQ-620/620b through 625b/625d/625e, 2026-05-31 ->
2026-06-20): axis (a) is CLOSED -- V3-EXQ-620's initial "all-zero"
reading was a config artifact; the corrected V3-EXQ-620b PASSED
(pooled p70=0.43, clears BLA 0.4). Axis (b) (sustained-threat

V3-EXQ-625b cleared the magnitude floor but failed on temporal
structure (collapse to monomorphic action attractors under sustained
threat). The follow-up V3-EXQ-625d diagnosed this as ENV-
CONDITIONAL: the selection-diversity -> committed-action-diversity
conversion axis-(b) depends on only holds on the reef-bipartite
substrate's structural guarantee of opposite first-action argmaxes,
and does not survive a threat-engaged candidate pool -- the SAME
root as the campaign-wide MECH-439 F-dominance conversion-ceiling
(shared with ARC-062 GAP-B, dACC C2, OFC behavioural conversion,
SD-034 de-commit). The recalibrated V3-EXQ-625e (10x lower threat
magnitude + pulsed duty cycle) still returned TERMINAL FAIL/
non_contributory. As of the 2026-08-07 inter-governance workset,
axis-(b) Phase 1b remains status=assembling, held pending a
demonstration that the MECH-439 selection-face fix (MECH-448/449,
BUILT + PROMOTED-provisional) generalises off the foraging substrate
to a threat-engaged pool -- the four retests run against it to date
have not shown that generalisation. Phase 2/3/4 (Phase 4 =
V3-EXQ-483f, the actual SD-037 4-arm behavioural validation) remain
blocked.

WHAT WOULD ANSWER: a run of the primary 4-arm factorial (V3-EXQ-483f
or successor) on the CURRENT fishtank/CausalGridWorldV2 baseline is
expected to reproduce zero-everywhere across all consumer readouts
regardless of SD-037's own ON/OFF state, per 483e's own diagnosis,
and is NOT a valid test of the architecture -- UNLESS BOTH of the
following have landed: (i) axis-(a) consumer-input-threshold
recalibration confirmed adequate under the specific env config used
(620b demonstrates this is achievable), AND (ii) axis-(b)'s
committed-action diversity gate PASSES, which now requires the
separate MECH-439/GAP-A selection-face-conversion fix to demonstrate
generalisation beyond the foraging substrate to a threat-engaged
candidate pool. Only once both are independently confirmed non-
degenerate does a FAIL on the primary factorial (arm 4 no recovery)
become a genuine falsification of the broadcast-override
architecture; a FAIL run before then is not falsifying, and a
degenerate zero-everywhere result on any attempt run before then
should be read as further confirmation of the substrate ceiling, not
as evidence against SD-037/MECH-280/MECH-281.

SD-038.subject: hippocampal.cem_anti_recency_exploration
SD-038.title: HippocampalModule CEM trajectory sampling must include an anti-recency exploration bonus that down-weights recently committed trajectory segments, ensuring the proposal distribution covers all available paths rather than converging on recency-weighted routes.

SD-039.subject: hippocampal.anchor_goal_snapshot_payload
SD-039.title: Dual-trace anchors preserve a goal-state snapshot plus wanting/arousal payload at write or invalidation time, so unresolved goals remain queryable after the active plan fails.
SD-039.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (partially unmet as of 2026-08-03, root cause identified, not hypothetical): use_sd039_anchor_payload defaults OFF and must be explicitly enabled; a genuine behavioral test additionally needs at least one deferred consumer (MECH-292 ghost-goal bank and/or MECH-293 waking ghost-goal probes) wired to actually USE the payload for downstream decisions. Both are already satisfied today (MECH-292/293 are landed and wired). A THIRD, MEASURED precondition currently blocks the query/retrieval half specifically: the retrieval cue must carry goal-context identity across distinct goal-epochs. As of the 2026-08-03 V3-EXQ-889 dry run this does NOT hold -- z_goal is a single global EMA attractor whose cue-centered max pairwise cosine saturates near ceiling (0.99752 vs a pre-registered 0.99 non-degeneracy bar) and monotonically worsens with re-exposure, so four deliberately-distinct goal-epoch cues collapse onto the same top-1 anchor (n_distinct_top1_anchors=1.0). A valid test design must also run within a single continuous agent stream across the invalidation-to- retrieval window: AnchorSet.reset() clears the entire dual-trace pool at every agent.reset() episode boundary.
CONFIRMING signature, by level: - Unit level (ALREADY MET, V3-EXQ-494 UC5, 2026-04-27): mean goal-match
  on Phase A (goal-inactive) anchors = 0.0 vs Phase B (goal-active)
  anchors = 0.998, 3/3 replicates above the pre-registered 0.3 threshold.
- Consumer-ranking level (PARTIALLY MET, V3-EXQ-868, 2026-08-02): a
  goal-relevant inactive anchor outranks a goal-irrelevant, matched-
  staleness inactive anchor in >=4/7 seeds.
- Retrieval/query level (STILL OPEN, blocked on the precondition above):
  once goal-identity is met, a post-failure retrieval cue correctly
  surfaces the anchor on the formerly-valid-but-now-blocked path as its
  top-1 hit at an above-chance rate, while unrelated stale anchors are
  not surfaced.
- Full behavioral/task level (NEVER COMPLETED, V3-EXQ-495 SIGTERM'd
  2026-04-28, not since requeued): PLANNED-arm benefit_post_block exceeds
  HABIT-arm benefit_post_block by >=0.30 in >=4/7 seeds in the detour
  paradigm, without a harm regression or standard-episode degradation.

FALSIFYING signature: with the goal-identity precondition met and a continuous-stream design, a downstream consumer built on this payload shows NO behavioral advantage over ignoring the payload entirely -- e.g. cued retrieval performs at or near chance even once cues are demonstrably goal-distinct; PLANNED-arm is statistically indistinguishable from HABIT/ABLATED. The payload would then exist and dissociate goal-active/ inactive state at the unit level, without translating into any measurable recovery advantage.

SD-040.subject: hippocampal.type_encoder_anchor_input_projection
SD-040.title: Type-encoder produces a category-prototype feature vector that is written into the AnchorSet alongside z_world, so anchors can be queried by type-key as well as location-key. The type-encoder uses the same input substrate as the existing instance-encoder but produces a different (regularity-extracted) representation, mirroring the trisynaptic-vs-monosynaptic complementary-learning architecture within hippocampus.
SD-040.what_would_answer:
NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION (unmet): requires BOTH the type-encoder substrate (learned projection writing a type-key into AnchorSet entries, plus MECH-296's prototype-readout to consume it) AND a multi-instance-per- type environment. Neither exists -- zero type_encoder/type_key/ prototype_readout hits in ree_core; Anchor carries only (scale, segment_id, stream_mixture) key, z_world, and SD-039's goal_payload. MECH-296 is itself candidate/v4/unbuilt. V3's gridworld has discrete entity types with no instance-variability by design -- a test-bed limitation, not just missing code.
CONFIRMING: in a multi-instance environment, type-keyed AnchorSet queries retrieve ALL instances of a type while location-keyed queries retrieve only the specific instance.
FALSIFYING: with the precondition met, type-keyed queries fail to generalize across same-type instances, or perform no differently than location-keyed queries.
(Digested 2026-08-07, session cool-torvalds-a82359, thought-digestion wave 11.)

SD-041.subject: thalamic.routing_substrate_hpc_pfc_gate
SD-041.title: An explicit thalamic-routing substrate (reuniens/MD-analogue) gates and amplifies bidirectional traffic between hippocampal anchor pool and frontal substrates. Currently abstracted into the GoalState->HippocampalModule call chain; making it explicit is needed when V3 dynamics demonstrate that the implicit routing is insufficient.

SD-042.subject: action.option_library_hierarchical_subroutines
SD-042.title: Option library substrate stores a discrete codebook of named, reusable action subroutines (each as initiation-set + termination-function + internal-policy triple, per Sutton-Precup-Singh 1999), distinct from the existing continuous SD-004 action_object_decoder. Required for hierarchical action composition, tool use, social-coordination protocols, and richer ghost-probe seeding.

SD-043.subject: pfc.vmpfc_abstract_task_structure_encoding
SD-043.title: vmPFC analogue gains an abstract task-structure encoding capacity that compresses anchor-pool geometry into a generalisable structural code, preserving similarity geometry across surface-different but structurally-matched problems. Without this, REE cannot exhibit Baram et al. 2020 task-structure abstraction signatures.

SD-044.subject: motor.primitive_substrate_bottom_of_action_stack
SD-044.title: Motor primitive substrate at the bottom of the action-representation hierarchy: a small fixed dictionary of force-field-like primitive activations that vectorially combine to produce the action_object that E2 consumes. Required only when REE moves to continuous limb-like control.

SD-045.subject: bg.action_chunk_cache_dorsolateral_loop
SD-045.title: Action-chunk cache stores frequently-traversed action sequences as cached lookups, indexed by (state-signature, expected-outcome-signature). Sits in the dorsolateral-loop slot of ARC-021. Provides the model-free habit pathway missing from V3 and the runaway-chunking failure mode underlying OCD compulsions and rituals (Graybiel 2008).

SD-046.subject: goal.multi_slot_state_per_goal_workstream
SD-046.title: Multi-slot GoalState holds N>=2 simultaneously-active goal slots with per-slot z_goal, drive coupling, age, and persistence parameters. Each slot generates its own ghost-goal-bank rank, ghost-probe budget, and proposer trajectories; a dACC-style arbitrator selects which slot's best trajectory commits this tick.

SD-047.subject: environment.multi_source_dynamics
SD-047.title: Multi-source environmental dynamics: concurrent stochastic event sources at distinct spatial and temporal scales (spatial perturbation field + transient Poisson events + background drift sources) provide an agent-independent causal background dense enough for agency-detection comparators (MECH-095) and reafference cancellation (MECH-098) to be honestly tested at substrate level.

SD-048.subject: body.interoceptive_noise_dynamics
SD-048.title: Interoceptive noise dynamics: stochastic body-state perturbations independent of the agent's motor output (autonomic background noise + sensitisation spikes + fatigue drift) provide an agent-independent interoceptive background dense enough for the affective comparator (ARC-058, Level 2 of the reafference comparator family) to be honestly tested at substrate level.
SD-048.what_would_answer: NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION: interoceptive noise substrate must be implemented and active (interoceptive_noise_enabled=True) with all three sources (autonomic, sensitisation, fatigue) firing at a non-trivial rate. CONFIRMED: implemented 2026-05-03 in CausalGridWorldV2; activation smoke (4-arm sweep, 200 ticks) shows all three sources fire and bit-identical OFF holds. Further confirmed operationally by V3-EXQ-511/512/512a, all of which ran against the live substrate. Precondition is satisfied; it is not the open question. CONFIRMING: V3-EXQ-512a (2026-05-04, PASS, evidence_direction=supports) is a first confirming data point -- at noise_scale=3.0 (3x default), the interoceptive forward model shows genuine self-vs-noise discrimination (C1/C2/C3 all pass) rather than memorising action-damage coupling. Full confirmation requires the still-unrun calibration-sweep-near-default-scale successor: a 4-arm sweep (ARM_0 OFF through ARM_3, spanning default scale=1.0) showing the predicted inverted-U -- comparator competence peaking at an intermediate arm, degrading at ARM_0 (too little independent variance to force structural learning) and at the highest arm (too much noise to learn a stable separation) -- with the peak occurring at or near the substrate's OWN default calibration, not only at an artificially inflated scale. FALSIFYING: the calibration-sweep successor reproduces V3-EXQ-512's finding that discrimination collapses to near-baseline (quiet_gap ~ 0) across arms at or near default noise scale, and only recovers at scale >= 3.0 -- i.e. the comparator can only be honestly tested when noise is cranked well above the substrate's own designed default. This would route ARC-058's Level 2 comparator from V3-tractable to substrate_conditional (richer/recalibrated body-state substrate needed), per the claim's own stated fallback.

SD-049.subject: environment.multi_resource_heterogeneity
SD-049.title: Multi-resource heterogeneity: qualitatively distinct resource types (e.g. food / water / novelty) with per-type identity tags, type-specific spawn distributions, type-specific benefit profiles, and a per-axis homeostatic drive system, plus a curriculum-introduction hook. Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.
SD-049.what_would_answer:
The 4-arm substrate gradient sweep already specified in
functional_restatement (ARM_0 OFF-single-resource / ARM_1 2-type
homeostatic / ARM_2 3-type-with-novelty (default) / ARM_3 5-type
overshoot), scored on all four pre-registered criteria in the SAME
run: (1) goal_resource_r identity-discrimination margin, target
ARM_2 - ARM_0 >= 0.4; (2) wanting != liking trajectory fraction,
target near-zero ARM_0/ARM_1, >= 0.6 ARM_2; (3) one-way ANOVA of
per-axis homeostatic drive on z_goal cluster ID, significant in
ARM_2 only; (4) encoder identity-recovery accuracy, at-chance ARM_0,
> 0.6 ARM_2, falls back ARM_3. PASS validates SD-049 and unblocks the
INV-034/SD-015-gated cohort. Flat failure across all arms
specifically on criterion 2 routes MECH-229 (not SD-049 itself) from
V3-tractable to substrate_conditional with a V4-1 multi-agent-ecology
dependency, per the pre-registered Woo/Spelke off-ramp already
exercised in V3-EXQ-514o.

NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITIONS (must clear before any of the four
criteria are adjudicated -- all three have independently blocked
this lineage before):
(a) Foraging-competence/contact gate must clear -- the ~0.2%
    consumption-failure signature recurring across V3-EXQ-514l,
    V3-EXQ-693, and V3-EXQ-538a ("the waking pass never encoded
    consumption-identity so sleep had nothing to consolidate") is a
    missing-dependency signature, not a falsification, and must not
    recur.
(b) The wanting/liking scoring harness must be non-vacuous on the
    same cross-target-inequality statistic used elsewhere in this
    lineage -- V3-EXQ-693's own R3 hard-zero precondition: liking
    target and L2-bind type read from the authoritative
    info['sd049_consumed_type_tag_this_tick'] at the consumption
    tick, not a post-clear obs_dict read.
(c) Per-seed guard_pass robustness must be checked and reported, not
    just the arm-level aggregate -- V3-EXQ-793a found a joint
    curriculum+density-preserving-spawn config clearing the
    arm-level D3 gate while only 3/6 seeds individually passed
    guard.

CROSS-REFERENCE RESOLUTION (514o): V3-EXQ-514o (2026-06-15, PASS)
does NOT close any part of this falsifier and is correctly excluded
from this claim's evidence trail -- not a governance tagging gap.
Its manifest carries claim_ids=["MECH-229"] ONLY (explicit
claim_tag_note). It is a single-arm run (SD-049-on + SD-057
object-bound layer only, an ARM_2-analog) that never ran the
ARM_0/ARM_1/ARM_3 comparison arms this claim's design requires, and
of the four named criteria here reports numbers for only two
(goal_resource_r, WL dissociation fraction), neither against the
required baseline delta; the per-axis drive ANOVA and encoder
identity-recovery criteria do not appear in it at all. It is
informative context (shows the underlying substrate can produce
strong goal_resource_r/WL numbers in a related condition) but
non-dispositive here.

The actual 4-arm design (matching this claim's arm labels and the
ANOVA gate exactly) has already been attempted twice under this
claim's own tag -- V3-EXQ-693 and V3-EXQ-693a -- both
FAIL/non_contributory on non_vacuity_unmet before any of the four
